product_title: Womens Jeffrey Campbell Prickly
review_body:
I LOVE these shoes. I did a TON of research on these before buying them since I had nowhere nearby that I could easily try them on. I first saw them at Urban, but they only had them in size 6.5 in store, which would never work since I am a size 8.
I read online that they run small, which, they do. The regular size 8 in these shoes have a 9 5/8\\" insole with 1/4\\" for each half size +/-. I decided to order them in size 8.5 since my other favorite heels had a 9 7/8\\" insole and I figured that would work.
Buuuut, when I got them, they had accidentally sent me size 9 instead. I was kinda bummed cause I was sure I would have to send them back since there was no way a full size up was going to fit right. I tried them on anyway and found out that the full size up was PERFECT. They were slightly looser than I would normally go for, but my heel never slips and the strap holds my foot in nicely. I wore them ALL DAY yesterday and everywhere I went people were stopping me in my tracks to compliment me on my amazing shoes. They love to ask how I walk in them too. Haha, which, by the way, is super easy if you're used to walking in heels.
They feel like a high wedge (more stable than stilettos) but unlike most super high heels, they don't put a huge strain on your ankles since the angle of your foot in the shoe is not a super dramatic \\"tippy toe\\" feel. The angle of my foot in the shoe feels more like a 4\\" heel than 7\\".
I tried dancing around in them a bit and it's fairly easy to balance even if your rock back onto the \\"heel\\" or toe of the shoe.
The only time I would opt for flatter shoes would be if I was going to be someplace where my primary walking surface would be something like cobblestone or tall grass. Everything else if it is a flat-ish surface (concrete, carpet, hard wood, tile, etc.) even if its a hill, means walking is a breeze.
The only scary thing about these heels is the THOUGHT of falling. I haven't fallen yet, but I'm pretty sure if I dofall down I'm gonna let my bum take the impact instead of my ankle. Haha. That was my only concern before buying them.
The more I walk in them, the easier it is, as with any other pair of heels. And the coolest thing is, YES they are actually easier to walk in than a high \\"heeled\\" shoe.

product_title: BIG BUDDHA Jliz Clutch
review_body:
I purchased the Jliz because I wanted a lightweight, casual clutch; so often clutches are too dressy to pair with jeans and a slouchy sweater, yet sometimes I'm not in the mood to lug around a handbag. The edgy zipper detailing falls in line with my moto/rocker wardrobe, but alas, this clutch is virtually useless for me.

First, I'm not a huge Big Buddha fan as they work in synthetics and I'm a leather snob. However, I do have one fantastic hobo bag from them and it's super soft, really durable/well made, and doesn't scream faux. So I know the brand is capable of churning out good pieces. Unfortunately, the Jliz looks and feels like the vinyl in my mom's old Pinto--yes, sadly I'm old enough to remember Pintos. For those under 40: think cheap pleather a là Payless.

So one strike for looking and feeling cheap, plus the front zipper work is sub par. The color I ordered was burgundy. It's a cool shade but a lot more brown than it looked online. So bummer there too.

But the fatal blow was when I opened it to reveal oodles of organization. Generally that's a good thing, but basically it's designed like a wallet. No, strike that, it's IS a wallet. There's card slots and coin zippers, and pretty much everything you'd find in a standard wallet. So because I cannot place the small bi-fold wallet I already own inside the clutch (as there is no real open place to do so, merely many divisions,) I decided I'd just try this out as an actual wallet. Great! Right? Nope. It's obviously waaay longer than any standard wallet so you assume you can fit in a lot. But it's SO slim that forget about carrying a lot of cash because in any one slot/divider, it only accommodates the slimmest of items. So unless you want to divide slips of paper, it's utterly useless. I put in my 4 credit cards, cash, ID and some coinage and the snap was already balking. I literally shoved a NARS slim lippie in one of the dividers and then vice-gripped my iPhone into the zipper slot...it was like suitcase you have sit on to get everything to fit. Bottom line: it just won't. It just won't.

This fails as a clutch because there's no loose area to place items. To call this a 'clutch' is way misleading. Forget a little mirror or your lipstick, it won't fit. Then it fails as a wallet because it's too much material/length to fit inside a small handbag--yet it still manages to hold less than the normal contents of a small wallet! It has to be one of the least practical things I've ever purchased. The only use I could get out of this is a place to store old movie ticket stubs. And even then, I think the cheap snap would probably do just that-- snap right off.

I carried it exactly once and wrestled with it the entire night. Fail! If I want an impossibly small clutch, I'll get a far more chic option. And if I want a wallet, I'll buy one half this size yet with 2X the storage.

product_title: Salomon Men's XA Pro 3D Ultra 2 GTX Trail Running Shoe
review_body:
Soy de 1.70 m, peso 130 lb.

De lo mejor para correr en el campo y la ciudad.

El cobertor 3D brinda un buen recubrimiento para proteger el pie al momento de correr o andar sobre caminos empedrados evitando que los dedos esten expuestos a piedras en el camino. El Gore-Tex lo he comprobado caminando en pequeños charcos en la laguna Lachua en Guatemala y es de lo mejor, mis pies estuvieron siempre secos. La suela de los zapatos permiten un buen agarre en suelos pantanosos o con lodo evitando que uno resbale.
En cuanto a los materiales con solo tocarlos se persive la resistencia de los mismos, la suela no es tan simple y se ve mucho más durable que cualquiera otra (yo antes era cliente de adidas y ahora sin dudas seguire usando esta).

Muy buen producto, se los recomiendo.

This backpack is the perfect solution for this. It fits everything I need, plus allows me to keep the use of both hands (which is HUGE when I'm chasing after her).

review_headline: Reefs are the only flip flops I will wear - these are my favorite style by far
review_body: I have been wearing this particular style of Reef flip flops for over a decade now. I strayed away foolishly for one summer when someone talked me into buying Rainbows and they fell apart in just a couple of months. When I lived in Florida these babies would last me for a full summer and up until the beginning of the next one when I would simply buy another pair. Now that I live in New York where there's more than 2 seasons, I can get about 2 summers out of them. I should have taken pictures of the pair that this order replaced. I had worn the tread off the bottoms and almost completely worn through the sole, but even then they were super comfortable. Although their sturdiness is amazing, what I love most about these flip flops are their ability to mold themselves to your feet in such a way that after a month or so of wearing them sometimes you forget you have shoes on (minus the fact that you're not stepping on glass or hot cement). Some people default to heels or sneakers as much as possible, I default to these flip flops as much as I can.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Evander2 Lace-Up
review_headline: Great style, decent construction, my new favorite pair of shoes.
review_body:
I purchased this shoe to be my go-to daily wear boot. It is very challenging to find a wingtip boot in this price range that is not garbage and in a timeless style.

Pro's:

Fantastic styling. The style of this boot is a very classic wingtip brogue design. The lug sole provides great traction. The sole is beveled on the sides to hide the lugs. I have no idea why more high end shoe makers don't do this, as the shoe looks much dressier while still being versatile. The heel appears to be stacked leather, and the contrast stich around the sole looks great. The pictures don't do the finish justice. It is a rich brown that shines and looks way more expensive than the price. I'd give these a 5/5 or more for style, they are beautiful. The insoles are not glued in. They are stuck in with a light, tape like adhesive. I replaced them with a more cushioned insole and it made the shoes a joy to wear, but it isn't required.

Con's: On both my shoes, there was a waste punch left in one of the brogue holes from the tooling process. I had to fillet it out with a razor blade then heat a screwdriver and burnish the hole myself. Very easy, and nobody would have ever noticed but me if I hadn't done it. The laces sent with the boot are HORRIFIC. 0/5 stars. I replaced them with a flat-waxed style boot lace I had spares of from a Banana Republic boot I used to own. It made a night and day difference in the look (see picture above). They come single helix or \\"shoe shop\\" laced. I re-laced them with over/under cross lacing off Ian's shoe site (google it) and the look is impressive.

Fitment: These shoes are a little wide. I usually wear a 11.5 E. These came in an 11.5 D and fit perfectly. The boots are very flexible, supportive and comfortable. If you have a very narrow foot, I'd recommend going a half size down or using an insole.

Overall, These are a outstanding pair of boots. The quality is not flawless, but to find flawless quality in a wingtip boot, you'll be spending 350-450$ on Allen Edmonds or the like. For 120 bucks, I don't think you can find a better value in the wingtip boot market right now. Plus, if you get a scuff or nick, you don't want to cry like I do with my AE's. The boots are timeless. Buy these with a new set of flat laces and you are set for years (yes, they are that good).ingtip boot, you'll be spending 350-450$ on Allen Edmonds or the like. product_title: The North Face Snow Beast Pull On Insulated Waterproof Boot Medium Width - Men's
review_headline: GREAT boot NF, my feet love you!
review_body:
Oh my god. I cannot believe how wonderful this boot is. My girlfriend and I have an 11-month golden retriever and we go hiking, to the dog park, and on long casual walks for 2-3 hours a day every single day - rain or shine. We live in Seattle, WA, so it gets pretty wet on occasion. I used to wear my work shoes (Croc Bistro - for all-day nonslip behind the counter at a cafe) to go hiking after work, which was nice for the waterproof-ness; although, they did let a lot of moisture and gravel into the shoe. These were a great present for me for the sole purpose of everyday dog hiking shoes.

I was amazed at how water repellent the whole boot was, especially the suede upper. I jumped right into the water along our usual swimming spot on the shore of lake Washington, and I did not have soaked ankles! Our first hike with my new boots was 2.2 miles long and they were comfortable and very warm in 40 degree weather. They were light enough to hike with as well as run with (to chase Molly running down the trails). I would recommend these as a warm hiker, and even as a snowshoeing boot. They are absolutely fabulous! My favorite boot so far!

Sizing is a minor issue, if any. I have some wide-ass feet and I usually wear 9.5, but can fit into 9's in some brands. But I these were a bit on the small side, but not by a lot as the other reviewer reported... I slipped on the 10 and they were perfect width for my feet with extra room in the toe for some thick wool socks for winter use. They seriously are not more than a 1/2 size bigger than usual. And since they only come in while sizes, just round up.

I also have developed plantar fasciitis in the same foot thanks to the ankle injury. These shoes allow me to look cute/somewhat dressy while still having decent support. I certainly wouldn't wear anything but a good pair of tennies for a long day of walking, but these are the closest I've found to a nice dress shoe that doesn't give me pain a couple minutes into walking in them.

They look great, have a unique style, and the textured/pattered ribbon on the top flows into the side tassel functioning as a tightening/loosening feature (which is important to note as I was fully prepared to cut the tassels off upon arrival).

The flats also feature nice padding on the inside and decent support.

Final note - these run LARGE. I suggest getting a full size smaller than your normal size.

All in all a pretty, high quality flat, with only mild discomfort.. .but hey...us women are used to torturing our feet for fashion anyway....

product_title: Baffin Men's Wolf Snow Boot
review_body:
Background:
I'm from Phoenix, and I've done a lot of backpacking, but I do not have a lot of experience in the snow/intense cold.

Experience:
I took these on a snowshoeing trek through Colorado in December. During the day while being active, my feet were sweating profusely at 15 F. You'll want to bring many extra wool socks to have some socks dry for when you stop moving.

Warmth:
A cold front moved in, and temps dipped to -15 F. We were up late, so I was using the boots in these temps with my feet often fully immersed in snow. When stagnant, my toes were a bit cold. Nothing too crazy, just a little chilly. Also though, I was dehydrated (I didn't know this at the time, but dehydration will make your feet colder) and my body was not used to the cold (Phoenix had been about low-70's before I left). As soon as we started gathering more firewood at about midnight, my feet warmed right up.

Sizing:
The sizing on these boots were a little off for me. I'm a size 11-12 for normal shoes, and I have slightly wide feet. I ordered a size 11 for these shoes and they felt almost 2 sizes too big. My friend is a size 13 (~12.9), and he fit into it perfectly. He and my other friend have the Baffin Selkirk and those are true to size (12 and 13). I gave the size 11 to my size 13 friend, he returned his Selkirk (Too warm for what we were doing), and I ordered a size 10. 10 is near perfect (just slightly big). It's perfect though width-wise.

Structure:
These boots are very flexible around the ankle and have regular flexibility on the sole. This is what I prefer but have been told that it's best to have a stiff sole for extended periods walking in snow. I had snowshoes on, so it didn't make a difference.

Fun Facts:
*These boots are completely waterproof.
*They are non-breathable.
*These are one of the most comfortable shoes I've ever worn. Possibly the most comfortable.
*On the same trip, Iused the boots as snowboarding boots. They happened to fit in my bindings well. I snowboarded for about thirty minutes. It felt completely normal except that the binding was sort of digging into the back of my leg. It was a little uncomfortable, but not too bad. If I had some kind of stiff surface in the boot, it would have been just like regular snowboarding. In either case, I probably could have snowboarded for several hours.

product_title: Teva Women's Vero WP Insulated Boot
review_headline: Very uncomfortable, color is not accurate: Returned
review_body:
Before trying these boots on I really liked them, even though the color was a lot darker brown than what is pictured. I like that there is a zipper as well as laces, so they fit nicely with jeans tucked in or left out. However, every time I used the zipper, both up and down, it got stuck. (On both boots) Fiddling with the zipper so much made me feel like I was going to break it.

There is also a little flap of material inside the boot at the bottom of the zipper that bunches up when the zipper is closed. This, along with the rigid material of the boots, pushed into my ankles and made walking just up and down my hallway painful. I do not have wide ankles (the boots were actually a little loose around my ankles) so the problem wasn't due to tightness.

It was a pretty easy decision to return the boots, which is disappointing because I like the look of them so much, but it's not worth walking in pain.

product_title: Timberland Mens Madison Summit Oxford Shoe
review_body:
... And socks. Both. I hate shopping for them and I hate paying for them. About three-quarters of the time I'll go cheap and regret it. Then I see how much a quality product costs and I'll buy another cheap one, fully prepared for its short life-expectancy and fully prepared to complain about it.

However, in this case I went out of my price comfort-zone. I was looking for the sweet spot where \\"at-the-office\\" meets \\"bumming around\\" from a design standpoint. I also wanted materials with lasting endurance. Something shinier, fancier (or cheaper) might wear noticeably with daily use. Hopefully Timberland's reputation will prove itself in this regard. I wanted something casual enough to wear with jeans, but attractive enough to wear with slacks and a button-down. In my humble fashion opinion these shoes fit in that spot. The \\"contrast\\" stitching doesn't jump out (the thread is medium grey, not white) but is not so subtle as to go unnoticed. The overall shape is rugged, but softened just enough to look like a shoe and not like a boot. The finish - a textured matte - should wear very well for obvious reasons. Even the eyelets seem to be well-built with the topmost being ovals which makes sense: lesser shoes with weak (or no) eyelets tend to distort where they are tied again and again. The small spandex-like web at the top-rear of the counter is a genius element making putting on and removing the shoe easier yet not diminishing the look of the shoe or the strength of the counter.

If I can hold anything against this shoe it's the thickness and lack of padding in the upper. Despite this it was one of the most comfortable shoes I'd ever had out of the box. It applies no uncomfortable rubbing points around the ankle, heel, top or tongue. So I guess padding isn't necessary if a shoe is cut just right. (Note: there IS sole padding, I am referring to the upper surfaces.) One possible downside is warmth during the winter. We'll see how that goes.

The only design point I would considering altering would be the laces - which are black - matching them to the grey stitching. Given the low-contrast I don't believe it would look ostentatious, but I'd have to see it. Certainly the black laces do not detract from the appearance.

Other comments mentioned a lack of traction in wet or snowy conditions. I haven't experienced much in wet and we haven't had any snow stick yet so I can't comment there. In dry conditions they seem about as grippy as an average sneaker, certainly more so than a smooth soled dress shoe.

However since they are real leather I am hoping they stretch a bit on their own after I wear them more.  Very comfortable to wear!  Highly recommend!  I have gotten lots of compliments on them.

product_title: Bates Men's Enforcer 11 Inch Paratrooper Boot
review_body:
I have owned several pairs of tactical and combat boots over the years and this pair of Bates is among the best. They ARE NOT sneakerlike, in the recent style popular with military and police, but that is not their intent - like all jump/paratrooper boots, they are designed for long, steady marches rather than sudden sprints. This means they have supportive ankles that are too stiff for comfortable running over long distances but those same ankles help battle fatigue when you're on your feet for long periods.

Further, these boots have a thick rubber sole with what I call a 'neutral tread' - there's enough friction generated outdoors but not so much that walking on slick tile or wet concrete is a major problem.

Finally, I've owned three or four pairs of Bates in the past and this pair is representative of the quality I've come to expect from Bates (even though they're made overseas). The toe caps and heel counters are thick patent leather and the less-shiny leather that comprises the rest of the boot simply scream durability. These boots will need a bit of breaking in - again, they're not meant to be sneakerlike SWAT team boots - but once broken in, they will become comfortable with time. AND they will be more durable than sneakerlike boots made partially of nylon with glued-on (rather than sewn-on) soles.

product_title: SCARPA Women's Rockette Lady Climbing Shoe
review_headline: Aggressive Toe, Not for the Heel Hooker
review_body: This is my first aggressive down-turned bouldering shoe and through buying this product, I don't think I'll be buying such an aggressive shoe for bouldering again. Climbing shoes is all about preference for the wearer. I think of myself as a well-rounded bouldered with no one specific style. Technically, I use all areas of my foot so the fact that the heel is hollow on this shoe is a negative. It doesn't really get a good foot hold, other times, it simply is hard to move it after the heel hook or slips off. I do, however, enjoy its sticking power and edging. If you've got a lot of big toe power to spare, this shoe is for you! I also feel the difference  in comfort climbing in an indoor gym vs. outside on real rock. I can't stand climbing indoors with this shoe for more than 2 min. Outside, I dread even falling off the rock and landing in them onto a crash pad. That's how much they hurt and I ordered a size down from my street shoe size. I'm a 7 1/2 narrow and ordered a 7 in Rockettes. Maybe you could order more sizes up but because of the construct of the shoe specifically the heel, the overall balance of how it fits would be thrown off. e.g. a size up would maybe be more comfortable for the length of the foot but the heel would be hollow...  I've had these shoes for 4 months now and they do not stretch as the material is synthetic. Again, great aggressive bouldering shoe, excellent smearing and toeing but a lot of pain. Recommended for those who like to climb with bounded feet in pain, haha.

product_title: KEEN Men's Howser Wool Slipper
review_headline: Better Than Most Slippers I've Worn
review_body:
I have 2 basic requirements for slippers.

1. They need to stay comfortably on my feet
2. They need to keep my feet warm

These slippers meet my needs better than most.

I have narrow-ish feet that are very particular about fit. The Keen Howser slippers fit my feet reasonably well. I don't have to scuff my feet when I walk just to keep my slippers on. I don't have to wear socks with them either; no pinching, rubbing or stabbing. I also didn't notice any problems with them fitting too tight initially.

I haven't had the chance to try them out in much snow yet, but I've worn them in plenty of rain and sleet taking the dog outside, and my feet have stayed warm and dry.

Overall, they're good quality slippers that fit comfortably and keep my feet warm. I'm happy with that.

review_body: Excellent everyday sneaker. Very comfortable and true to size. I wouldn't recommend for running, personally not enough support but great for being on feet during the day and around house.

product_title: Orthofeet Men's 481 Pedorthic Shoes
review_body: The shoes are comfortable, but kind of big and I ordered a half size smaller. I guess I'll wear heavier socks.

product_title: Sorel Flurry TP Winter Boot (Toddler)
review_body: Received the boots on time and they are exactly as advertised.  They seem to be true to size - I ordered a size 6 - and are well made.  They are a little hard to put on, but that is no surprise when you try to put boots on a 19 month old.  We haven't had much snow yet, but they are great for stomping in mud puddles!

product_title: Nomad Women's Puddles Rain Boot
review_body: The picture doesn't do justice to these boots.  They are everything and more than I had hoped.  Excited for my daughter to receive these at Christmas, everyone at the office has loved them!

product_title: Foster Grant Black Light Specs Lighted Reading Glasses +2.00
review_headline: How did I do without them!
review_body:
I love, love, love these glasses. I enjoy hand sewing and can now bring my applique work anywhere knowing I will have adequate light. So much nicer to sit and sew while waiting in doctor's waiting room stitching than reading three year old magazines. The glasses give enough light in almost any situation.

I find the optical quality to be very good although I am judging by what I can see rather than any professional examination. I have not had them long enough to judge battery life but am going to buy a spare set of batteries because I do not want to make my tiny stitches without the glasses again. I use them with the lights on for sewing, reading menus in restaurants and other previously difficult situations and without the lights they are my go to glasses for general use.

Some reviewers found them difficult to keep on their faces. My face is very small: I have no problem. Although they are heavier than my bifocals in the hand, on the face they are comfortable and I wear them for hours without discomfort.

In addition to loving the glasses I must also give thanks to the distributor's customer support. When I received the glasses I had a problem, customer support quickly and politely dealt with it. Yes, I would purchase them again. The price makes them affordable, the usefulness of them makes them a must have.

product_title: New Balance Men's M3090 Athletic Running Shoe
review_body: My 16 year old son wore these shoes for 8 weeks and they started losing tread. The tread was breaking off in pieces. He also has completely worn a hole through both shoes at the interior ball of the big toe. Did not last very long for the price of them. However, they are lightweight and dry quickly. They are a good fit for his size 14 EEEE foot.

product_title: Womens Studded Roman Gladiator Sandals Flats Thong Shoes
review_body: I wore these a few days ago,it was very comfortable not hard its also,its also the right size need more colours tho.

product_title: Nine West Women's Sosie Ankle Boot
review_body: The boots look cute The fit is good but a little narrow around the arches If you plan to walk a lot better wear socks that are longer than the boot shaft The top of the shaft rubs on your skin while you walk and may cause friction burn Also the sole is very slippery, so mind your step Otherwise i survived a whole day of walking in these boots with minimal pain

product_title: DC Women's Chalet 2.0 SE Boot
review_body:
I have a hard time finding boots that I truly enjoy, due to the fact that I am completely intolerant to any form of cold (when indoors they were even almost too hot, which is great). These boots are not only comfortable, but provide so much warmth, that winter is actually enjoyable. I will be buying multiple pairs.

UPDATE 2 years after original purchase: Still love these boots more than anything, granted the inners come out a little as you take them off but then you just push it back in, however its totally worth it. I would say I got a good two winters out of the first pair before the cold/wetness started to slightly leak through. I just bought a new pair for myself and also one for my daughter. I will probably never buy another type of boot again (unless something even more amazing comes out)

product_title: Portlandia Women's Seattle Slingback Pump
review_body: Extremely wide shoe and I had to return it.  I wear a size 8 M or W but these shoes were extremely big.  If you have average to slightly wide foot this shoe may be too big for you.

product_title: Kamik Women's Naomi Rain Boot
review_headline: Can't wait to wear in the mud!
review_body: I bought these after my $10 pair split open during an east coast rainstorm.  I didn't want to spend a lot, but have to be in the woods daily with my dog where it's always muddy.  These boots are very stylish, and look cute even out shopping in the rain.  The shaft is shorter than I expected -- they do not reach my knees and are more like mid-calf.  The circumference is definitely snug -- almost too snug at the calf for tucking in jeans.  That could be because I wear a size 6 shoe, and it's just the proportion of the boot.  That's the only reason for 4 stars.  They do make my feet look incredibly small, but after wearing a borrowed pair in a men's size 10, I'm grateful they stay on my feet. Soles are durable and overall a very well-crafted boot for the money.

product_title: Funtasma by Pleaser Women's Schoolgirl-50 Mary Jane
review_body: OH my goodness I love these shoes! I will wear them with all my holiday outfits from pants to dresses! They are just as described by the seller. They are so comfortable!

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Fuji Racer Running Shoe
review_body: so comfortable and cute. :) :) :) :) :) :) :) :) :) :) :) im so happy i bought this!

product_title: Skechers Women's Parties-Mate Oxford Shoe
review_body: I purchased these shoes because I have found that I don't need orthopedic inserts and ugly shoes with skechers shoes. They are sooo comfortable and they are made with enough supports in the arches to alleviate the pain I have had from wearing other shoes with no support. Skechers are true to size so ordering online is not a problem.

product_title: Reebok Women's Realflex Running Shoe
review_body: when I got these in I was amazed at how light they where, they are perfect and feel so great, they shape to your foot so they are very comfortable! I will deff buy another pair!

product_title: Baffin Unisex Cush Insulated Slipper
review_headline: Was going to get some Uggs or slippers but for $25 Ill try these out!
review_body: I know they are tent shoes, but I got them for using everywhere.  The grippy white lettering on the bottom wore off in a day so they are a little slippery on hardwood floors.  They keep my feet warm on cold ground.  The bottoms are water resistant, not water proof.  If you stand in wet grass your feet will get wet.  If you walk across zed wet grass you will be ok.  I wish they carried the camouflage pattern on amazon as i consider these to be glorified slippers and who wouldn't want camouflage slippers?

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Power Pressed Walking Shoe
review_body: these were comfortable at first then I had surgery on my left foot and they started to bother that foot

product_title: FitFlop Women's Gogh Clog
review_headline: A real blessing for my feet
review_body: Have not been able to stand enclosed shoes on for over 2 years now. Have tried many different shoe that would be comfortable on my feet, which thru injurys , back problems and working on my feet for over 45 years[nursing, waitress], it has gotten to where I can only wear othotonic sandals,or teva walking shoes. winter is hard to muster with open shoes. Received these today, praying they would work for me after reading reviews. Oh my, I cannot express how comfortable from the very moment I put them on they are.They are attractive too. can wear with almost anything,well except evening dress.which I would if that is all I could stand on my feet. will be purchasing more colors. thank  u Gogh clog for this shoe. u have no idea what I have been thru for my feet not to hurt.what a blessing.when your feet hurt, u hurt all over.

product_title: Crocs Women's Candace Clog
review_body:
If I had known Crocs was going to discontinue this style, I would have purchased several pairs.

I wrote and complained that this was the only really cute style in a roomy fit, and they wrote back that they have plenty of cute styles. Really? Go check out any of the newest styles, and NONE of them are in the wider fit.

So as happy as I am with these, I am not happy with Crocs right now.

product_title: MephistoMMelchior
review_body: As always for me the fit is perfect and nothing is more comfortable than the Mephisto. I have may pair and they last forever.

product_title: Crocs Women's Cobbler EVA Lined Clog
review_body: The crocs arrived quickley, was surprised however, they didn't come in a shoebox, but on a hanger, like the cheap ones in the store. The shoe is very comfortable, fur is warm, with or without socks. I must say, the left is more snug than the right, and it's not my foot because actually the right is a bit larger (most people have one foot slightly bigger). Love the color and for 20$ great grab and go shoe!

product_title: Charles David Men's Grenade Oxford
review_body: This is a great looking shoe, however I wasn't impressed with the way it fit. Runs wide and slightly long. Low heel which makes the shoe feel more like a boat shoe than a dress shoe. Really wanted to keep them, but just didn't like the way they looked on.

product_title: Superfeet GREEN Full Length Insole
review_body:
This is a very good general-purpose support insole product. For my particular foot-size and shape, they fit my shoes without modification.
I own several pairs and am very satisfied with them. (I do wish they were a little more affordable.)

product_title: Roma Genuine Leather Organizer Bag Handbag Purse
review_headline: Roma Genuine Black Leather Organizer Bag Handbag Purse
review_body: It was larger that I want to carry and I plan to return the bag. I found a Brighton bag that is more to my liking!

product_title: Easy Spirit Women's Romy Walking Shoe
review_body: I bought these shoes for my mother for her birthday because she LOVES them! True comfort. Upsetting that you can't find them in Macy's any longer.

product_title: Women's John Deere 10 inch Steel Toe Waterproof Wellington Boots Poplar
review_body: This boot is really well done, especially the soles. The last John Deere boot I bought was comfortable, but way too heavy due to the soles. These are most excellent, the only thing making them less than 5 star quality is the narrow toe area, which could be alleviated with just a little more thought and a little more rounding. Other than that, these are great boots.

product_title: Very Volatile Women's Hustle Bootie
review_body: I LOVE these boots. They seem to run a little big, so I wear a thicker sock with them. Very comfortable and I have received many compliments on them.  It's not every day one sees blue boots:)

product_title: ITASCA ICE BREAKER WINTER BOOT KIDS
review_body: I bought this for my 6 year old son, he loves it, its really sturdy and i am sure will be in good condition when handed down to his brother.

product_title: Minnetonka Men's Pile Lined Hardsole Slipper
review_body: My husband was super excited to receive these as a birthday gift and is looking forward to using them for years to come. Very good quality item AND very nice to look at.

product_title: New Balance Men's MX20 Minimus Training Shoe
review_headline: from cushioned support to minimus-be careful
review_body: I bought the half size larger with wide foot intending to wear sock.  They meet expectations and are  light.  As I have achilles tendon and calf problems caution is suggested, especially if one comes from a softer sole with high arch.  So far have only used them on treadmill but my 21 yr old son wears them without socks and climbs mountains and runs with them regularly, hasn't worn out the sole yet.

product_title: PUMA Clyde Script Lace-Up Fashion Sneaker
review_body: I love these shoes.  The leather looks great!  The light grey is very stylish with all kinds of jeans.  They are very comfortable and are very good quality. I bought the kiwi suede care kit and these shoes still look as good as new.  Every once and a while you might get a scuff on them or something dirty, but with a suede eraser you can get it right out.  Do not wear them in the rain or where they will get wet.  Using the suede protector by kiwi I have worn these shoes in light rain and the water slides right off of them with no damage done.

product_title: ECCO Men's Seattle Slip-On Loafer
review_body:
This is my first experience in online shoes shopping, I was reluctant in doing this but, later I decided to go on and luckily, When I received the shipment I found that I did the right thing
First the shoes are the same as advertised, they are so neatly made, I usually look at the details of any product, and this product shows very good detailing
These shoes are excellent for walking, they are comforting to the feet and the whole weight of the body is absorbed in two rubber soles making walking a great sport for old guys like me

product_title: Annie Shoes Women's Violet T-Strap Sandal
review_body: I have very bad knees and had a difficult time finding a nice looking shoe with a comfortable heel for my daughter's wedding.  I found these on Amazon and went with a reviewer's advice to order small as they run a little wide.  I wear either a 71/2M or 8M but the smaller size was perfect in this shoe.  I did not have a chance to break them in and wore them for 9 hours without a problem.  The black patent leather went perfect with my dress color called "eggplant."

product_title: Clarks Women's Heath Skylark Knee-High Boot
review_body: I'm in love! They're not as traditional riding boot as I would have liked because of the buckles, but they're pretty darn close and not one bit of cowboyish like a lot of boots out there right now. I have the Clarks Orinocco Jazz and love them so figured I'd love these too and I do... I've never been able to fit into MOST boots as the calves are always too narrow (I have 15\\"-15.5\\" calves) and knee high usually means the shaft is too high (I'm only 5'4\\" with a 29\\" inseam) But these are perfect. I can easily fit into them with jeans tucked in without having to adjust the width, easy on/off with zipper, perfect heel and shaft height, and perfect foot width (I have borderline wide size 7 feet) with just enough room to wear thick socks. And I LOVE the color... a tad bit darker and less warm than Amazon's image. Also love the leather - not a fan of shiny leather on boots - it's more of a matte sueded leather, although I'm sure there's a correct term for them. Anyways, GET THEM! Oh and TRUE TO SIZE.

product_title: Volatile Women's Big Bear Clog
review_body: very cute and stylish, a little too high for me and a bit hard to wear and walk in for long periods, but still a nice, casual shoe.

product_title: Nine West Women's Rocha Pump
review_body: I love wearing high heels in spite of the pain of it :)  But a pair of these Nine West Rocha Pump revealed a bliss of pure pleasure and thrill of wearing them. LOVE this stylish, comfortable, sexy shoes!!! Will buy more in different colors! Finally, a high heel shoe that is comfy and beautiful without breaking the bank! Thank you, Nine West!  (Sizing  - they run half size bigger than your usual size, so keep that in mind).

product_title: New Wide Calf Flower Festival Wellies Wellington Boots, Womens, Sz US 9
review_body: I never needed rain boots as it wasn't that serious here in Jersey but lately, we've been getting all kinds of weather and my basement flooded for hurricane Irene. Boots like these would've saved me from wading in dirty water. Lesson learned. Problem is, I have huge 18" calves. Looked on Amazon, saw these wellies, ordered them, tried them on...problem solved. The fit is perfect and they're too pretty for just basement duty!

product_title: DV by Dolce Vita Women's Pilar Bootie
review_body: The first pair I ordered in my usual size (6.5) and they were way too small. The second I ordered a half size bigger and they never arrived. The third pair I ordered a 7.5 because they ran out of 7s and they fit great! I love them and waited way too long for them!

product_title: Ektelon Men's NFS Classic MID Racquetball Shoes
review_headline: Eyelet tore in Ektelon Court Shoes
review_body: I received the product and tried them on. When lacing up the shoes I found an eyelet on one shoe tore. As it was near the top of the shoe where it receives the most stress, I returned the shoes.

product_title: Nike Lady Flex Run 2012 Running Shoes
review_body: Great shoe--bought for my daughter. They are lightweight and slightly low profile (minimalist and not too cushioned). She likes them very much for PE, track conditioning and general training.

product_title: New Balance Women's WX20 Minimus Training Shoes
review_body: Always pick New Balance. Great shoes, good fit and feel. Bought them for weightlifting and crossfit - a great pick!

product_title: ECCO Women's Rainier Sandal
review_body: I have several pairs of ECCO's in different styles but this pair ran short.  Unfortunately I had to return them.  Will look for another ECCO sandal.

product_title: Timberland Men's Hookset Camp 2-Eye Lace-Up
review_body: I would recommend this pair of shoes to anyone... the color, quality  and design is great... you'll love it! It is worth buying!

product_title: Red Coffin Sunglasses
review_body: Could never get my daughter to wear sunglasses she would squint and get headaches but would not wear sunglasses...until these, she loves them! I want a pair but alas I need prescription ones. Recommended over and over!

product_title: Rockport Men's Fairwood 2 Wingtip Oxford
review_body: As in most Rockports, these shoes fit great, true to size, and are very comfortable. They look great with jeans and slacks. The soles are wonderful, no worries about slipping as in shoes with a leather sole. Great price too.

product_title: Salomon Men's Tech Amphib 3 Cross-Country Shoe
review_headline: They are very light and fit well
review_body: I have narrow "low volume" feet and it is had to find shoes that fit. These work, but omly without my orthotic.  I use them like sandals.

product_title: Clarks Originals Men's Desert Boot
review_body: I've been wearing these boots nearly every day since I got them, and they are great. They look good, and are highly versatile. They were a bit painful to wear at the beginning, but once my ankles callused over a very tiny bit and once they started breaking in, it's been smooth sailing since. I typically wear a 9.5 in sneakers, and went down to an 8.5 in these, so sizing down at least a half size but maybe a full size is a good idea.

product_title: Beverly Feldman Women's Tartufo Flat
review_body: I was really disappointed when I saw the shoes. The footbed is totally inflexible, the band going across the foot is way wider than average, so I have no idea how anyone walks in them. They are gorgeous and would be the perfect sandal to give ooh-la-la to any outfit provided you never have to walk anywhere!!

product_title: Coloriffics Women's Jayla Ankle-Strap Sandal
review_body: Wore these for my wedding. Very comfy and looked great!! The thick heel worked perfect in an outdoor all grass location.

product_title: Dansko Women's Sigrid Sandal
review_headline: All good for Dansko Sigrid Sandal
review_body: Super comfort/super support like nearly all Danskos have proven to be.  Style a real plus including sale price, which is hard to find.

product_title: Skechers Performance Women's Go Walk Slip-On Walking Shoe
review_headline: So comfy they could be slippers, but better!
review_body: These are the most supportive, comfortable casual shoes I've ever worn! I wore them every day walking around Ireland and my feet felt great! They are less sporty than their Oxford counterpoint so can go as well with a dress or skirt as with pants or jeans. I have gray, denim and black ones... now if only they came in brown!

product_title: Mosey Life Convertible Backpack
review_body: I purchased this bag in black for the winter months.  I have this same bag in another color which I used all summer.  It is absolutely the best bag for my needs.  There are 3 large completely independent internal compartments along with a zippered area.  The organization is unmatched in any of my other bags....and I have many.  The only complaint I have is that the handles are slippery when used as a shoulder bag which is how I use it daily.  My solution was to order an Ameribag luggage grip, attached it to the handles and voila...no more slipping off the shoulder.  The slippery handles are my only real complaint.  I love it.

product_title: UGG Women's Classic Short
review_body: I was waiting for it as it was a surprise gift to my daughter but unfortunately after I received it I found out that one of the pairs was ripped from the back & it's not cheap to have that defect

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Speedstar 6 Running Shoe
review_body: They are pretty good.  They are better for walking around than running.  One of them is making some kind of clicking noise, so I'm not sure what that is.  Oh well.

product_title: Easy Street Women's Leader Slip-On
review_body: They are comfortable and great for work!  I like that they slip on and off easily.  They arrived on time and were reasonably priced.

product_title: Skechers USA Women's Keepsakes Postage Slipper
review_body: These are incredibly comfortable and are quickly becoming my 'go-to' shoes/slippers.  I wasn't sure if I would feel comfortable wearing 'slippers' out and about, but they have enough structure that they seamlessly transition from lounging around the house to running errands. I have a couple of other pairs of Skechers shoes so I knew to order a half-size larger than usual, and I'm glad I did.

product_title: Annie Shoes Women's Tame Boot
review_body: Boots are very confortable and looks great with dresses, slacks and even with leggings. Needed a pair of brown boots and these boots works with my work attire.

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Whistle Platform Pump
review_body: I love these shoes for a simple close toe pump. I have big size 10 feet but usually don't run into any problems with ordered sizes feeling too tight or loose, but these shoes were definately tight in the toe box (or it could just be that I'm too used to wearing heels with peep toes). I ordered them for my sister's wedding and didn't want to lose extra breaking-in time by sending them back for a bigger size, and I can say after a little wear they have stretched out nicely. Besides the early toe crampage they are really quite comfortable and very easy to walk in, and I know I can easily wear them all day for the wedding without much suffering and searching out chairs all night.

product_title: Clarks Unstructured  Women's Un.Loop Slip-On Shoe
review_body: Have a narrow (A) in between size foot  ( 7 1/2 to 8). Ordered an 8 medium and it fit perfectly. Comfortable from day one.

product_title: Cougar Women's Stanza Waterproof Boot
review_body: These are the second cougar boots I order. I loved my first pair and I love these ones as much. I can wear them to work since they look formal (for winter boots) or with jeans since they are stylish. Also, they are super warm and waterproof. I recommend them without any reservation.

product_title: Ariat Women's Reina Boot
review_body: I Love the boots. Fell in love with them the moment I saw them. We were in the US on a holiday and had to find them in my size (10) which is not easy. In the end I found them through Amazon and with the 2 day shipping option they were on time before we left again. Again I love the boots and people in the streets will comment on them how gorgeous they are.

product_title: Propet Men's MPED25 Pedwalker 25 Walking Shoe
review_body: My husbend has diabeties and these were great for him he can get them on and off without my help.

product_title: BCBGeneration Women's Bg-Cielo Pump
review_body: I love these. They are not metallic at all and the price can't be beat. Also, I usually wear an 8, and the 8 fit perfectly. They look very professional, but also cute with jeans.

product_title: Rockport Men's Eureka Walking Shoe
review_body: At the end of a day, my feet feel better wearing my older Rockport World Tour Walkers, than these. I don't know if it is the shoes, or just that certain shoes are better for certain shaped feet.  But I will stick with the World Tour Walkers from now on.

product_title: Skechers USA Men's Blaine Orsen Ankle Boot
review_headline: the 11 year old who assembled these boots should be fired....
review_body: i got these boots at a pretty good cyber monday price.  so they show up  and i open them up to try them on and one of the tabs you hold on to while u slip your foot in the boot came right off.  i wasn't even applying much force.  while the boots were still wearable i sent them back cause i expect better products from underpaid children in china.

product_title: RYKA Women's Aqua Fit 4 Shoe
review_body: I was ready to return the shoes -- they are impossible to put on -- they took a long time to put them on, but they did fit.  A friend who recommended them, suggested wearing them around the house for a while and eventually they will loosen up to put on at the pool.  So far that is working.

product_title: Ninja High Top Tabi Boots
review_body: Fantastic product. I purchased to compliment ninja attire for Halloween and they really refined the look. Snug and comfortable. High recommendation.

product_title: Timberland Men's Earthkeeeprs Oxford Shoe
review_body: Very comfortable, but need to be broken in. Rides high on the achilies tendon. Maybe uncomfortable for some. The soft nylon strings often come untied. Suggest replacing them.

product_title: Skechers Sport Men's Energy Afterburn Lace-Up Sneaker
review_body: A favoured style of mine,very comfortable and with the wide fitting provides plenty of side support too,can wear for long periods of time.Having had a good many pairs of these I can say they look nice are comfortable and are reasonably priced,(especially if you shop around............or shopping on line with Amazon,bide your time.4 weeks ago these were $54 now $39 and some change)..............(noticed this after another reviewer mentioned she waited on a different product)................anyhoo,like a white sneaker goes well with blue or black jeans for a casual look.Will buy again.

product_title: Clarks Women's Wish Excite Boot
review_body: I love these boots and they are worth every penny!  I live in Florida and work in an office.  My feet did not hurt by the end of the day.  Some times my feet will hurt by the end of the day but not in these boots.  They also look very nice.  I got plenty of compliments and even some of my male coworkers noticed them.  Clark's is a very good brand.  I just discovered them and I will be a returning customer.

product_title: UGG Women's Bailey Button
review_body: This boots are so comfortable and warm.  Once fall hits, they are a staple in my wardrobe. Recommend them to anyone!

product_title: AND 1 Men's Rocket 2 Basketball Shoe
review_body: I purchase these to play some street basketball. They were better than I had expected them to be. Very comfortable with a soft insole. These were my first AND 1 and I must say I love them.

product_title: Softspots Cassidy Women's Leather Mary Jane Casual Shoes
review_headline: Cute, cushy comfortable and very sturdy
review_body: I can tell by the way these shoes are designed that they will last for a very long time.  They have a rugged sole, the stitching is well done and the footbed is nicely padded.  They took 2 wearings (all day at work)to break in, although not terribly uncomfortable.  I think they are styled a little bit narrow.  I have a B width foot and until broken in, the leather across the widest part of my foot was very snug.  Being 5' 5\\" I usually have to hem everything, so it's nice to have a 2.5\\" heel for my longer pants.  Based on the brochure that arrived in the box, the price was right too.  Practical yet cute; not an easy combo to find.

product_title: Muk Luks Women's Jewel Slipper Boot
review_body: They're so perfect, so soft, I had my eyes on them when it was 40% off and when I was ready to check out the sale just past.... But totally worth the money even without sale.

product_title: New Balance Kid's KV689 Running Shoe (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: We have had great luck with New Balance Shoes. My daughter has had 4 pairs of New Balance shoes and they have all lasted until she grew out of them. They fit well and allow for her to run and play hard!

product_title: Sanuk Women's Torrey Boot
review_headline: Love the look/feel But NOT GOOD
review_body: I purchased these several pairs of these boots for presents, and also a set for myself.  These boots are warm and comfortable, however, I worn them only 3 times and the stitch at the top left side already unraveled.  NOT a happy camper! Nothing like having to return and pay for a return when you thought you were getting a good quality boot :(

product_title: Saucony Men's Grid Omni Walking Shoe
review_body: Excellent walking shoe.  the shoe is perfectly sized for length & width.  It's well made and sturdy.  I imagine it could be a bit warm in warmer weather since it is 100% leather.  But for the fall, winter & springtime walks, these are perfect.

product_title: Reebok Men's Club C Sneaker
review_body: My husband has worn Reeboks for years. We moved to the beach and everyone wore Romeos because the salty wet weather is so harsh on shoes. When we moved back recently we could not find any at any store!! I was so frustrated as my husband rarely wants anything specific. I thought about Amazon...  of course it worked! I now have a happy hubby!!  Thanks Amazon!!!

product_title: Birkenstock Amsterdam Clog
review_body: Fits well and is comfortable.  Nice color, I would order this again.  I have a wide foot and the medium fits well.

product_title: RAY BAN AVIATOR LARGE METAL Sunglasses - Gold/Brown RB3025 001/51 (58mm)
review_body: I've always wanted to have an aviator sunglasses but kinda skeptical to buy online because of authenticity and size issue but I was really happy coz  it fits really good and its authentic! Plus it's super cool and trendy! I'm lovin it! I'm satisfied with the service and the quality of the product..Thanks amazon!

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Dixxin Sneaker
review_body: Great comfortable sneakers for casual wear in the city.  The only thing that would make them cooler is if the sole was black

product_title: Brinley Co Women's Augusta 02 Slouch Boot, Black, 9 M US
review_body: These boots are amazing!  They came way sooner than I was expecting.  I am a size 8 1/2 - 9, so I ordered a 9, and it's perfect.  These boots make my feet look smaller, they're very comfy, and it doens't feel like there's a very big heel on them at all!  (I like that).  The bottoms are a little bit slippery at first, but overall, I'm loving these boots!

product_title: Nike SHOX SHOX TURBO+ VII Womens Running Shoes

product_title: Crocs Men's Yukon Clog
review_body:
I bought these when my intended summer-sandals fell to pieces after a month, but then I guess you get what you pay.

SATISFIED
I used these shoes all summer and even a few months after - always barefoot. They were my primary daily shoe working at a summer camp. As a lake lifeguard, I am regularly in and out of the water while hauling boats. They protected my feet from rocks and boats, they drained well, and if I wanted a dry shoe, I could slip them off and after about five minutes in the sun, they were good to go.

I also frequent the woods and unlike some of the more open sandals, these shoes did a good job of keeping my foot from being jabbed by sticks.

For having been barefoot for months throughout the foot-smelliest (summer) time of year, I haven't noticed any shoe odor.

DISSATISFIED
After about two or three months as a primary and barefoot shoe, I noticed that the skin on my heels splitting and becoming painful. They required extra healing lotion. I have never had a sandal or any other type of shoe do this to my feet.

Superficial error, but there nonetheless, the leather of one of my shoes either arrived (or happened after the first time I got it wet) with a wrinkled appearance.

------------
4 out of 5
Because these shoes got the job done, but prolonged use caused mild discomfort.

review_body: The Doc Marten's 1460 Re-Invented Victorian Print Lace-Up Boots, of which I ordered the taupe, are most definitely a well-made and beautiful pair of shoes.  I also found the air-cushioned soles to be as comfortable as advertised.  However, there is one problem I'm having with the boots that I thought I'd mention as a heads-up for anyone else who might have a similar medical issue: due to arthritic deformity in the foot, I have very high arches (pes cavus), and the way these boots are stitched at the tongue of the shoe, no matter how loosely one ties laces, it places significant pressure on the top of the medial arch or talus bone of the foot.  I haven't figured out if there's a way to loosen the stitching a bit or if the boots will begin to give more with wear, so, for now, I can't wear them for long periods of time or the discomfort of this pressure soon enough becomes pain.  For anyone without this sort of deformity, I'm sure the boots would be every bit as comfortable as they are stylish, but it is something to consider for those dealing with arthritis, injury or any other problem with the arch of the foot.

product_title: MUNDI Big Fat Flap Wallet
review_headline: The only wallet that fits everything, and organized too!
review_body:
This wallet neatly and easily fits my assorted 60+ collection of plastic cards (with a few cardstock business card mixed in), my cash (bills and coins), the thin calculator that comes with it, and a pen. There is still room for a checkbook (if I chose to carry one), and then I'd still have unused pockets! There are pockets that you can't see in any of the photos. Everything is organized and easily accessible. There are loads of pockets and card slots. I like how there is a zippered pouch on the outside of one side so that I can still close the wallet, even while it holds a sizable stash of lumpy, bulky coins. The pen-holding elastic loop is a thoughtful touch. The zippers (with handy pulls) work smoothly and easily, the two snaps (which give a choice of how far down to snap the front closure) are secure. The compartments are just the right sizes. I tried three other wallets before being satisfied with this one, and none of the others held everything and could close (this one closes easily), was as organized and easy to use - and this one still looks nice too. It doesn't look fat and bulky. The pebbled leather texture and classic design are attractive. It's the perfect shade of red. It seems durable. I'm a very happy customer.

After having read all the other reviews, I do have to add that I didn't receive the extras listed in the product description, so I had to drop the rating from 5 stars to 4, even though I love this wallet. I'm not positive what photo flips are (maybe clear plastic pages that flip like a book?) but I don't see anything like that. The 5 photo/ID windows (maybe 4 of them are considered to be photo flips?) don't pull out. It also did not come with a key ring, agenda/phone book, or pen. They should remove these items from the product description if they are not included. I would still eagerly buy this wallet again - it's the best!

product_title: EMU Australia Womens Stinger Lo Winter Real Sheepskin Boots in Chestnut Size 8
review_headline: Pleased with my experience - a good purchase so far
review_body:
I ordered these because I wanted to spend less than I would on a pair of Ugg boots ($160) plus the Ugg "care kit" (another $25+). Emu brand was suggested to me on the Macy's website when searching "Ugg" so I began to read about them. To my surprise, the price was nearly that of Ugg boots but with many more advantages. For example, I read Emu has much more arch support than Uggs, which was very appealing to me because I already have issues walking and lack of arch support only worsens the situation. Additionally, the boots already come with a water and stain repellent ON the boot so you do not have to spend extra money on a care kit. To top it all off, the boots are actually made from authentic Australian sheepskin and are not assembled in China like Ugg boots.

I received the boots from Amazon seller "backcountry" (who I would highly recommend) very promptly. The boots came carefully packaged and retained their shape well in the box. I had ordered a size 8M (women's) and was worried because many of the reviews I read stated the boots ran large. However, when I slipped my foot into the soft, luxurious sheepskin interior (ahhhhhhhh!) I found to my pleasant surprise that the boots were actually a little snug! I have been wearing them for the past two days to break them in and they are already feeling more comfortable and are conforming to my foot. Therefore, I would recommend ordering your normal shoe size. There is definitely a good amount of arch support in the boot which is great. The only thing that bothers me is that the heel cup does not grip the back of my foot as I had hoped, but it DOES help and the boots don't slide nearly as much as my Costco sheepskin boots (they slide much more than the Emu boots!!! you get what you pay for!).

Overall I am pleased with my experience so far and I hope I grow to LOOOOOOOOOOVE these boots like so many others! I know for a fact they will keep my feet toasty and warm all winter long. My feet feel so pampered and comfy in the soft, soft, SOFT sheepskin!My feet feel so pampered and comfy in the soft, soft, SOFT sheepskin!

For those who don't mind a 3\\" heel, I do recommend them. The suede is nice quality, they are very stable to walk in, and they appear to be well-made. I like that the bottom sole (and heel bottom) is made of durable rubber, and I bet they grip the ground well. There is very good arch support (cushion), although for a brand called \\"sofft\\", I expected a little more cushion in the ball area (in their defense, there is more cushion there than most brands, but not as much as Clark's or Sachelle). product_title: Saucony Men's Progrid Kinvara 3 Running Shoe
review_body:
Daughter gave me an Amazon gift card for my birthday (I am hard to shop for as I have everything I need or want). Noticed everyone wearing new style kicks so I wanted to upgrade.

Did a lot of comparison shopping in bricks & mortar plus online prior to my purchase. The reviews are what made me choose this particular shoe. VERY glad I did my homework and am especially appreciative of those who posted reviews of this product. I chose these shoes standing on the reviewers shoulders.

These shoes are VERY lightweight. Seem lighter than some of the heavier socks I wear. Amazing.

I have a wide, EE foot. I used to purchase +1/2 size to get the width I needed. These fit me perfectly in my native size with the wide (2E) model.

They were instantly comfortable from the first wearing. No break in of any sort. The shoe's sole is not a zero rise/zero drop but is definitely not your usual cushioned heel either. I won't debate the merits of any particular sole/waffle style; to each his own. But this has less rise than traditional shoes but is still more comfortable than a true zero rise sole.

Love the looks/style. Draw lots of admiring glances (I am an old fart living in a warm climate; I wear this type of shoe year round).

Sole looks slippery but grips surprisingly well. Seems to be wearing well too. I run/walk exclusively on asphalt and concrete and the soles are holding up well so far.

One small complaint: when I wear my lowest quarter socks, the molded heel cups sometimes rubs the skin on the back of my ankle. Feels like sandpaper abrading my skin. I can cure by wearing higher socks if I choose to.

I have owned many brands of shoes before and somehow, I always seem to circle back to the Saucony brand. For me, best fit and best wear. Saucony serves me better than any other brand of shoe.

product_title: Aquatalia Women's Quirky-C Boot
review_body:
I bought a pair of these boots, at full price, in August in preparation for a trip overseas. I had planned to alternate these with another pair of shoes, but they were so comfortable I wore them almost the whole time we were in France. They run approximately 1/2 a size large--I normally wear an 8.5 and I kept the size 8. They will stretch out a bit with wear, so keep that in mind. The lining is warm, but breathable. I was wearing them in upper 80s to low 50s temperatures and I never felt hot/cold in them. They are truly waterproof--we had some rain during the trip and my feet were kept dry. My only complaint is that when the boots arrived, the leather had marks on both boots but once I polished them up with some brown leather polish/treatment and brushed them, the leather looked pristine. These will last a long time and I'm planning to buy them again in black (now that they're on sale!). You can't beat the quality and they're made in Italy. These will be a classic you'll wear for a long time.

**These do run narrow in the forefoot--if you have wide feet then these are not the boots for you. Also, the calf opening is for slim legs--my calves are 13\\" wide at the widest point and these boots *just* fit over skinny jeans with enough room for movement--I'd say the opening is right at 14\\" max. They work perfectly under boot-cut jeans without any bulkiness.**

product_title: Baggallini Luggage Jet Set Rolling Tote
review_body:
I have several Baggallini travel bags and have always thought their products were superior. Was so glad to see a roller bag so lightweight and yet looking at the item online it appeared to fit all the criteria for a roller bag for an airline. Unfortunately that is not the case. It is indeed light in its weight, looks good and maybe for someone that does not travel a lot might be able to \\"make do\\" but unfortunately there were too many \\"misses\\" on this and yet could be corrected I believe and then have a better product. Thus I had to return it.

The four wheels do not roll correctly - it wobbles on flat surface and on an indoor/outdoor carpet (like airports or the aisle of an aircraft) does not roll at all - one has to go back to the drag behind method. The zippers are very lightweight and the pulls which are smaller in size than their carry on purses do not pull easily - they stick. Once you open the bag it does not zip totally open at the end you have to put something of weight so that it wil stay open to pack it. The two \\"side pockets\\" snap but are so narrow that neither a water bottle or even a paperback book fit into that space - so what is the purpose? The larger front pocket that is designed for a kindle etc worked fine if it had a stronger zipper and bigger pull. The smaller flap would hold a cell phone but the other zipper pocket is so small a hand does not even fit into it. The back pocket albeit is wide and the length of the bag and they did put a gusset opening however only on one side so does not open wide enough - I was barely able to get a magazine in it.

I feel that had they added bigger zipper and zipper pulls and made the opening pockets wider so that they would be useful this would be a good design - definitely the weight would increase and that is probably why they were trying to cut corners somewhat. Disappointed sums up my feeling -
I really hope that someone in their design department tries again.

product_title: Zamberlan Men's 308 Trekker RR Hiking Boot
review_body:
I just received my pair yesterday and put a few miles on them right away. The fit and feel is really nice. I wear a size 11 wide in a running shoe. Had to change from Nike to NB because the Nike's were too narrow. I was concerned about ordering a size 11D(med width) in these boots. They fit like they were made for me. Perfect sizing. The width is comfortable in the toes and just the right amount of snug in the heel. For me the fit and feel were perfect right out of the box. I assume that they will become more comfortable with time. Living in the south I was willing to give up some absolute waterproofness for light weight and cooler. I have a great pair of goretex lined and insulated boots and they are too hot and heavy for most of my hikes. These feel almost tennis shoe light and comfortable. I don't think this will be my last Zamberlan product.

Update: I have about 400 miles on these boots now and like them more and more. I have also bought a pair of Zamberlan Tofanes which are totally waterproof and very high quality. The trekkers are still my favorite boot for the relative light weight and oerformance for the price. After six months of muddy trails and stream crossings I have yet to experience wet feet. The Zamberlan cream that they suggest you use goes a long way. I treat my boots often and have used very little of the tube of hydra bloc that I bought for $9. I crossed a creek last week that required about 6 or 8 steps in laces deep water and still did not leak. It has given me the confidence to wear these boots on wet days and not have to resort to hot heavy gore tex boots. Don't get me wrong when it is really cold and really wet the Tofanes are a wonderful choice. My wife wears women's Zamberlans. Can't go wrong with any of their products if they fit the shape of your feet.

review_body: I had a pair of this almost exact same shoe (same brand/look- no fuzzy lining), that I had bought about two years ago and they were looking pretty shabby (toe wear/faded- no problem with rubber sole separating from shoe- still completely functional).  I ordered these in a hurry not realizing they had the fleece lining. My first pair had more of a slinky lycra like material liner.  Being as it's winter I think these will do quite well and since they are lined I think they will also hold up better to the common complaint about wear and tear on shoes like this- that is that your toe nail sometimes rubs against the top leather and makes a mark. The fleece is much thicker than the lycra liner and it should protect it well. First day wearing these- I should've worn a bandaid on my heel (small rub from the seam/elastic on one foot) but other than that they are so comfortable! If you are into the barefoot thing, or just like a flexible shoe that you can wear with jeans, a skirt, or work pants, then this is a great choice. My only improvement would be to make it a split sole (like the Yosi Samra) instead of a full sole just for a slight bit more improvement on being able to really articulate your foot movement.  Also I have a wide foot- these were 'tight'in the toe space for about 5 minutes when I put them on this morning and by the time I got in my car for work they were already letting my foot move as it wanted. Highly recommend!

product_title: Cushe Men's Bespoke Chukka Boot
review_headline: The Comfortable Cushe Bespoke Chuka Casual Boot
review_body:
The Cushe Bespoke Chukka Boot falls in line with my top favorites of Cushe Shoe brand models, while the Surf Slipper Chukka's is my overall favorite I wear those every day, all day the Bespoke Chukka falls in line around my 2nd overall favorite, alongside with the Cushe Boutique shoe model. All Cushe brand suits me well due to the wider formatted front section of their shoe last around where the pinky toe sets; they all are perfect for me for some reason. The Bespoke Chukka is traditional Cushe shoe last style format and a bit more it seems in the width area, but as comfy as it comes. Nice rounded toe area and one thing that differs a bit with the Bespoke model is the height of the toe area as well, so if one has thick toes in depth as well as needing the wider toe area, the Bespoke Chuka is well worth a considerable look see.

They are not your heavy duty work type boot say like Keen and so forth but your comfort casual style type slip-on level shoe format, super lightweight weighing in at only 11 oz. in the size 12 I personally have, low formatted heel format in which I personally like and have become accustomed to, easy on/off for quick shoe changes for slipping on when I leave my Surf Slipper Chukka's inside as I don't wear those outside in the elements and Bespoke are more rugged in this area in comparison of the two but I haven't worn them out in drenching rains, snow etc., but are definitely more durable in this area in that comparison anyways and have been holding up quite well for light outside duty affair, although for heavy work and strong outside elements I always grab my Keens, Clarks and so forth but the Bespoke works well for outside casual mingle.

Comfort wise for me anyways I like the overall feel and comfort level of the Bespoke model much better than the Cushe EVO Desert Boot Model but as the weather changes, the Desert Boot will probably come more into play but until then for now the Bespoke keeps the feet warm whether insideworking, driving or short outside errands in total comfort during these long cold winter months.

Overall one of my favorite Cushe shoe brand models and if you find a pair at a super low price level, grab em, your feet will more than likely thank you latter!

product_title: Vibram Men's KMD LS Cross Training Shoe
review_body:
Pros: Lightweight (as all vibrams are), offers good protection for the base of the feet, True to size, excellent for squats/deadlifts

Cons: The LS system is really nice and allows tightening of the shoe, but when tightening it pinches a little at the top - very minor problem, may want to consider the original velcro design

Let me preface by saying I am not a runner, I use these shoes for fitness/weightlifting - if you haven't considered the KSOs as a gym rat then you should. One of my biggest problems with my previous shoe was I would feel off balance when squatting or dead lifting. With the barefoot approach you are able to engage your lower body quite a bit more for deadlifts and I really feel as though it is a lot safer on my lower back.

As an added anecdote I have accidently kicked weights that are laying on the ground when wearing these and there is a fair bit of padding that extends up along the big toe - I have no idea if this padding was designed for 'toe stub' situations but I haven't actually hurt myself by doing this - however if you drop a weight directly on your toes it would hurt quite a bit, but no shoe aside from a steel toe would help with that

review_body:

My podiatrist recommended wearing sneakers with the arch support.
I now wear these shoes most of the day together with a Powerstep 3/4 arch ... I walk 4 miles/day (no running) andfinally have everything I need to have comfy feet. If only regular shoes gave this kind of support and fit.

REVISED REVIEW: these shoes so distorted my feet that they gave me pain. I ordered the ones for extreme pronators. The running store always recommended a neutral shoe with orthotic rather than a shoe that is so corrective. Then while searching online for a new style of Saucony I read an article about women who were provided with 3 different styles of footwear: guiding, neutral or corrective regardless of the type of stride. Only the neutral group remained injury free.

product_title: Cushe Men's Surf Slip-On Chukka
review_headline: Don't Forget my Cushe Chuka's Please!
review_body:
Boy, these are comfortable lil buggers, Hehe - Out of the large array of shoes I own the Cushe Surf Slipper Chuka is one of my top favorites, due to the fit of this model for my particular shoe shape and format. First of all I would say most Cushe in their standard sizing are rather made for the regular - to maybe a slight narrow foot form in which I have, this particular model is very comfortable and light weight weighing in at only 8 ½ oz. in the size 11 that I presently have. It is very comfortable like a well fitted type slipper and feel but in shoe format and I personally wear them everywhere, they look good as well and many people also like the Chuka style, I think the style is coming back in vogue again, I see allot more of this style popping up with all the manufacturers as of late it seems. The whole Cushe line as to what they refer to as \\"slipper\\" in their line are extremely comfortable shoes, at least the models I have anyways and the Chuka model is my overall favorite overall and top favorite of all shoes that I own actually for the leisure comfort factor anyways.

The one thing that drives me absolutely bananas however as far as Cushe anyways is their sizing; they appear all over the board it seems. I have some shoe models in size 12 that I float in, yet some of their line particularly what they refer to their slipper's seem allot smaller than their more aggressive shoe line it appears, not quite sure why they seem to be all over the board. For instance the surf slipper loafer in size 12 are about as small as the Chuka model in size 11 - I originally purchased the Chuka model in size 11 because at that time the Cushe models I had were too big in size 12's, thus I began to figure out that the slipper line, as they call it seem to run smaller in length than their other model lines it so appears anyways, I don't have them all but from what I do have would seem to indicate that anyways. I could however although it was rather small fit into the Chuka model in the size 11 and I loved them so much, they would have to pry them off my feet to get them back, Hehe - However my toes do touch the end of the shoe when standing, walking etc., but not so bad I couldn't wear them and they were soooo comfortable I refused to do anything but wear and keep them, their whole slipper line is incredibly comfortable with the Chuka being my favorite of the line so far anyways.

IMO, I would say the Chuka runs at least a ½ size small, so if one is 11 ½ then a size 12 would probably fit perfectly more or less. Now some Cushe models a size 11 say would be about right for me but their slipper line or as they refer to them appear to run smaller, sort of baffling to me anyways, but if getting the right size they are indeed incredible, as far as foot form comfort anyways and again, would probably suit well for regular width to even narrow width like mine for instance, not sure if they offer wide widths or not.

With all the positives in regards to Cushe's Chuka model, other than their sizing of course I can also think of one other negative in the Chuka model and that is my feet get a tad warm sometimes with them but with that would make a cozy house shoe in the midst of winter I suppose, they are indeed everything in the term referred to as cozy comfort I guess.

Also, like some other popular shoe brands IMHO they seem a tad high on the end retail pricing structure but if purchased on sale at a fair discount price reduction, they a more than worth the $ value in the asking price. Just an incredible and also different type shoe the Cushe Surfslipper Chuka is and personal not one I'd be without of anyways and hope my sizing reference helps a few out there anyways, if anybody decides to give them a try. Overall one of my favorites and hope you find as much reward in Cushe's shoe model known as the Surfslipper Chuka, a Very Comfortable and also a very Attractive Shoe!!
