review_body: Clogs are great, good quality. Run small so order a size up. This style goes higher up on the top of the foot then other brands, so if you have a really high instep and/or high arch, that may be an issue. Price can't be beat. Super fast shipping.

product_title: New Balance Women's WT810 Trail Running Shoe
review_body: My wife searched many of shoe stores looking for the right fit. She has an extra wide foot and a narrow heel. After almost giving up, we found these in a double extra wide, and she had me order them. Finally the search is over, he feet don't feel crammed in a shoe and is very happy with them. Not to mention the price is much better than ordering special from NB site.

product_title: Merrell Women's Siren Sport Gore-Tex Hiking Shoe
review_body: My experience with Merrells is a very mixed bag --when they fit they really are the most comfortable shoes. When they don't-- which happens half of the time, they are painful. Unfortunately, Merrells's size 10 does not fit not the same as another Merrell size 10-- sometimes not even close. This style was painful, and have EXTREMELY POOR TRACTION.

product_title: Alegria Women's Mule Clog On Mini Sole
review_body: Very comfy.  Nothing but compliments on these comfy cuties!  My favorite nursing shoes yet!  May be turning over to Alegria, but I feel a bit like I'm cheating on Dansko's.

product_title: adidas Women's Kanadia 4 TR Running Shoe
review_body: la compra fue excelente, super conforme con el tiempo de entrega y con los zapatos, bellos y originales, comodos y me gustaron mucho

product_title: MUNDI Big Fat Flap Wallet
review_body: Have to say that I carry a large wallet now that holds everything I need.  It is starting to fall apart so I was hoping this wallet would satisfy my needs.  This particular wallet only has a zipper compartment in the side that zips while the wallet I have has side pockets inside the zipped area so I am not going to be able to use this new wallet as well as I used my previous wallet.  It's not a bad wallet just wish it had more options inside it.  For its size it doesn't utilize the space well.

product_title: Nunn Bush Men's Mesa Slip-On
review_body: I have not much used these slip-ons as yet. But my initial impression is that they are very comfortable, and deserve what is claimed.

product_title: Magpul Gen 2 MBUS Rear Flip Sight, Black
review_body: I bought this sight for my DEL-TON DT Sport and I love it. It aligns perfectly with my A2 post front sight. I didnt even touch it and it is zeroed to at least 75 yards. I was also not willing to pay $100+ for a Troy Sight and for only $50 this seemed like a steal. Overal im happy and will b buying more as time goes on.

product_title: Rockport Women's Juliet Knee-High Boot
review_body: Just like other reviewers said, the heel height is perfect and the boots are very comfortable.  And I'm not talking about pretend-comfortable that girls always say about their high heels, these are real-comfortable.  I think they are true to size and the calf size is perfect for what I think are my small-average size calves.

product_title: Brinley Co Faux Suede Wedge Heel Slouchy Boot
review_headline: Cannot return seller did not respond
review_body: The  shoes is too flimsy, like it will break in one use,  material is not good, no support and the sizing is way too small.

product_title: ECCO Men's Yucatan Sandal
review_body:
This sandals is super amazing. At first when I worm it, it started to hurt my feet but last time I wore a sandals was 9 years ago... So I must get used to it.
If you want a sandals that last long get this one. You won't regret.

product_title: NIKE WMNS SNEAKER HOODIE (WOMENS)
review_headline: Not the quality I would expect from Nike.
review_body:
I was disappointed in the quality of this boot. The sole was
quality, but the rest of the boot felt like it was made of
thin cardboard. Sent them back.

product_title: Clarks Men's Wave.Terrain Slip-On
review_body: I bought these for my husband because he is a life long Clark's wearer and needed new brown shoes.  He wears these to work and is on his feet most of the day. He says they are by far one of the most comfortable pairs he has owned and they are holding up very well.  They are also very sharp looking casual dress shoe.  Sometimes I find the more comfortable the shoe the less attractive they are and this is not the case.

product_title: FitFlop Women's Electra Sandal
review_body: Absolutely love Fit Flops.  I have achilles tendonitis, and these shoes have helped my pain immensely.  Not to mention that I get many compliments on them.

product_title: Livie & Luca Brussels Slip-On (Toddler/Little Kid),Brown Suede,4 M US Toddler
review_body: These shoes are very cute and fit well. Sole is flexible while still giving support to little feet. I would buy these again and again!

product_title: Stride Rite Srt Aubree Mary Jane Flat (Toddler)
review_body: I have been extremely pleased with all my Stride Rite purchases. These little shoes are adorable, comfortable (no rubbing) and breathe easy so they don't get stinky. I do think they run a little large.

product_title: New Balance Kid's KV689 Running Shoe (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_headline: Mom, it feels like my feet are on bouncy cushions!
review_body:
My son loved these from the moment he tried them on :)
They are supportive, comfortable and very giving for his wide feet.

product_title: Havaianas Women's Slim Allegra Flip Flop
review_body: These are comfortable, light, and beautiful - people comment on them all the time! Also love the purple and orange colors. Ordered a few so I can have fresh ones next season.

product_title: Skechers Performance Women's Go Play Frisky Shoe
review_body: I absolutely love this shoe!  I plan to buy more in different colors.  I have been a flip flop kind of girl for many years.  Living in Florida, I need to have something that my feet can breathe in.  These shoes are the best.  I do not wear socks, and this shoe does not make my feet perspire or smell.  Very comfortable.  I can wear them all day without my back or feet hurting.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Specialist Clog
review_body: i love crocs. i use them all the time for work. i work in the hospital. great condition and on time. they were new. very pleased

product_title: Rockport Men's Rolle Moc-Toe Slip-On
review_headline: Most Comfortable Dress Shoe I've Ever Owned
review_body: I love this pair of shoes.  Comfortable all day.  Great for slipping off and on at airport security.  A great price.  Love them.

product_title: Reebok Women's Realflex Tempo Shoe
review_body: This shoe is very lightweight and very comfortable for long walks. I have been using it for about one month now and have not had any pain nor discomfort while taking long walks 3 to 4 times/week. Stylish and attractive, I would recommend purchasing this shoe.

product_title: Diba Women's Pro Gress Riding Boot
review_headline: Nice but didn't work for me
review_body:
I took took the following measurements from the boots I received (size 8.5):
Shaft height: 16.75 inches from arch
Opening at top of boot: 15.5 inches

This is a really nice looking boot. I ordered the beige, which is yellowish, as pictured. The shaft doesn't crumple or look slouchy even though it's just unlined suede. Despite the pointed toe my feet look smaller than expected. I would say it's a smallish 8.5....I can wear 8.5 or 9 depending on the brand, and for these I would have to wear thin socks or tights. The height of the boot is perfect for me (I'm 5 feet 6.5 inches tall). Unfortunately, the shaft is simply too big around because I want to wear them with skirts.

product_title: Nine West Women's Totheflo Wedge Pump
review_body: what is there to say, if you are currently looking at the shoes, stop looking and start buying. Great shoes...bought for work but thinking i would wear out for other functions...

product_title: Brooks Women's PureFlow Lightweight Running Shoes
review_body:
This is my first pair of running shoes. I did a LOT of research after a considerable amount of trial and error (nike free run and reebok realflex were just a little off in fit and sizing). I'm so glad I held out and found these online, for less than they sell here on Amazon.

I'm more of a walker than a runner, but like to break out into a run on a trail every now and then. I needed something super comfortable and light for the gym, so I'd actually enjoy and be comfortable going. These shoes have met my expectations and then some. I've been wearing fit flops to work all summer and have gotten quite used to the freedom and squishy soles. These shoes are just as, if not more comfortable. The minute I put them on I wanted to GO. They feel amazing. I just got them, but will update if my opinion changes over time.

True to size. The red is a nice color, a little on the pink-red side, but very cute. I've already gotten compliments on them.

product_title: Wanted Shoes Women's Lario Ballet Flat
review_body: I love these flats! They are great for the price! While I wish there was a little more cushion and support you really can't go wrong with the price! They do run a bit small so I ordered one size up and they fit like a glove! Will be ordering more colors for sure!

product_title: Clarks Unstructured  Women's Un.Loop Slip-On Shoe
review_body: Put these on and you won't want to take them off. They provide excellent arch support and comfort, look great with jeans or pants, and need no breaking in. Ditch the flip flops and high heels for cute shoes that are good for your feet. Amazon's price can't be beat!

product_title: Skechers USA Men's Diameter Marsh Hiking Shoes
review_body: I have the [[ASIN:B005O65HF8 Men's Merrell Chameleon3 Stretch]] and I got these shoes because they look similar. While I like my Merrell Chameleons, they're very stiff, which is perfect for hiking but not everyday use. The Skechers probably wont be as rugged as the Merrells, but I wear them all day and they're comfortable. I might add a new sole, some kind of gellin sole, but overall I would recommend this shoe to anyone who likes the look of the Merrells but don't plan on hiking everyday. These shoes feel like i'm wearing a loafer but look like I'm ready for a day in the woods!

product_title: Blues Brothers Wayfarer Dark Black Sun Glasses - Black
review_body:
When u pay ~ 4 bucks u dont expect much. I didn't either. But u need to get sth from what u pay and all I got was a plastic scrap. Could be isolated incident. But this product was toyish looking right out of the gate. The plastic frame was of same quality that u would find in plastic toy found in a dollar store. Heck the sunglass u buy in dollar store is 10 times better in quality.
I ordered for return shipment label as soon as I opened the package. All that said, Amazon is still the best place to shop in my opinion.

product_title: Nine West Women's Rocha Pump
review_headline: For a high heel wearer these are heaven on earth
review_body: If you are a seasoned high heel wearer these shoes are heaven on earth! I can't believe the negative reviews on this shoe because I buy it in every color. Basically if you are used to wearing other types of heels from Aldo Steve madden or bakers this is a nice but sexy conservative heel for every day use. I work in sales and have to run all around the city with packages and deliverables and THIS IS MY STAPLE SHOE. I've bought it in atleast 4 colors already to wear atleast 3 times a week to give my feet a rest in between the more adventurous stilettos. If you are not a high heel wearer maybe these are not for you but otherwise I'd highly recommend them! Super comfy, great arch support without looking fuddy duddy and the ball insole are really helpful on a long day running around.

product_title: Crocs Women's Adrina Strappy Sandal
review_body: One of the BEST crocs!! Hugs my feet so well and is soo comfortable!! I am a hair stylist and have invested into buying many croc shoes. All of them are very comfortable. But these sandals are great!! I didnt want to take them off when i tried them on!

product_title: Stride Rite Jordan Sandal (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: this shoe is really cute, but it is a terrible shoe for those of us with kiddos with wide(r)feet.  had to return them, sadly.

product_title: Merrell Men's Loess Lace-Up
review_headline: A great casual shoe! Which is what it is design to be!
review_body:
The people who gave these shoes a bad rating clearly bought them for the wrong reason. Yes these are made by Merrell, the company that makes great hiking shoes and boots. But these are not meant for hiking! Just look at the tread and low ankle. These are casual shoes for a walk downtown, going to church, or just looking stylish when you don't plan on leaving the pavement too much. Sure they will fall apart and be uncomfortable if you try hiking with them! So would any other dress shoe.

I bought these shoes for the look, and because I trust the Merrell brand. I don't use them for hiking, running, or dirty jobs. I use them as they were meant to be used - for casual purposes. And mine have held up great! I wear them quite often. The longest walk I took them on was probably when I walked during a 4 mile parade route. They weren't as comfortable as walking shoes or cross-training shoes would have been, but they did fine enough.

In short, I love the look. That is why I bought them, and that is why I will by another pair so that I can continue wearing them once Merrell stops selling them. I am sure the pair I have now will last longer than the current fashion trends.

product_title: Clarks Men's Wave.Barrier Sandal
review_body: As advertised, sandals are comfortable and have good support. Heel is cushioned, and sandals are great for long distance walks. Sandals are not made very wide so if you have a wide foot these may not be for you!!

product_title: Yellow Box Women's Gateway Flip Flop
review_headline: I love the look and get lots of compliments but they ...
review_body: this is my 3rd pair. I love the look and get lots of compliments but they break easy where they connect to base.

product_title: Adidas - Snova Glide 4M Mens Shoes In Running White/Metalic Silver/Prime Blue
review_headline: comfortable shoe, but started to break down at 100  miles
review_body:
I really loved this shoe when I first bought it to train for a Spring marathon. About 100 miles into training, I started hearing a \\"clicking\\" noice in the right shoe. I only noticed it when running on pavement. I assumed that a small rock was caught in the tread, but that was not the case. Another 50 miles in, the clicking or popping noise started with the left shoe too. Somehow the bottom rubber of the shoe seperated from the cushioning causing the sound. It was a pretty minor sound until I hit 300+ miles where it got louder so I quit running in the shoes. I was afraid something was going to fall apart.
It's really too bad. I liked the feel of the shoe.

product_title: Apex Women's Ambulator Biomechanical
review_body: The shoe itself is sturdy, well designed and well made; however, the width is actually one width less.  For example, a Wide is actually only a C and not really a D.

product_title: Capezio Women's Manhattan Character Shoe,
review_body: Great Shoe!  I did buy wide and a half size bigger.  I usually take a 7 or 71/2 but I bought an 8 which was slightly big.  A 71/2 would have been better but I was too lazy to exchange them.  Heel and sole are thin,meant for stage so I suggest a street tap ASAP.  Comfy all day long on the run and look nice.

product_title: Tribal Bohemian Patched Woven Cotton Long Shoulder Bag
review_headline: Very Pretty, But Not Well Made
review_body: I was thrilled with this bag when it arrived, the colors and fabrics are really pretty.  Unfortunately, after only one week, the patchwork stitching had ripped apart in three places.  I investigated a little more and discovered that the patches were not given an adequate seam allowance, and the seams are also unfinished.  This causes the fabric edges to fray with even minimal use, and the patches come apart.  Unfortunately once the seams fray, there's no easy way to sew the patches back together because the fabric has unraveled making the patch smaller.  Very disappointed with the quality.

product_title: Mephisto Men's K2 GT Lace-Up Boot
review_body: The previous poster says these boots are not over priced? What the heck are they smoking? These boots are almost $500.. you can buy a cheap car for that much. Do you realize that you can pick up a pair of quality boots for 10% of this price that will last the same & look as good? There is absolutely no justification for this price based on any of the information they list about this boot. The Previous poster is obviously a paid sponsor who is posting fictitious reviews in an attempt to generate a sale.

product_title: Au Naturel Women's Paulina Open-Toe Espadrille Sandal
review_body:
These shoes are really nice but they are a size small. I usually wear size 38 but these are far too small.I will re-order them in size 39(hopefully they will still be available!)
They will be great for our Australian summer

product_title: Onex Women's Fortune Sandal
review_body: What a great looking shoe.  Loads of compliments. But what's even better .... They are comfortable!  I try to wear new shoes for short outings not on my feet much.  Well that didn't happen.  The sandles' first outing ended up an 8 hour search for a specific item. I walked for miles!  My brain was more tired than my feet. True to size, padded footbed.

product_title: Minnetonka Double Fringe Bootie (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: these moccasins are wonderful! Not only are they very fashionable, but have a soft flexible sole that makes it incredibly comfortable for your little one! My daughter loves to wear these to preschool and we get tons of compliments. they are also very easy for her to get on and off all by herself.

product_title: PUMA Men's Bolt Slide Sandal
review_body: The size of the slide sandal was listed as a \\"D\\" but it was more like a \\"C\\" width and is too narrow and does not fit well. There is always a risk when you buy shoes on line that different brands will vary in size.

product_title: Fila Women's Skele-Toes Tri Fit Slip-On Shoe
review_body: I love wearing these shoes!  They are so comfortable, and I get lots of compliments on them.  They are also easy to clean because they dry quickly.  Wish they made a faux fur-lined option for the winter months!

product_title: Report Women's Marks Ankle Boot
review_body:
These shoes are comfortable for a teaching job, walking around school all day and being on my feet. I got the leather upper. I can wear them with dresses, skirts, or pants. They do have a worn look to them, and the leather easily scuffs. They also made a scuff on my wood floor, but that rubbed off with a rubber sneaker sole.

Overall - nice shoe, I wear them a lot!

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Liv-Beachy Sandal
review_body:
I liked the look of these sandals and they fit my foot well. I wear an 8 and the 8 fit perfectly. It even looked good on my foot. However, an earlier reviewer said they were shape-ups and since I had never worn that style before it seemed OK with me. I discovered I can't wear shape-ups and walk comfortably for very long. My back was killing me by the end of the day. I am guessing the \\"ridge\\" in the middle of the foot bed is the cause of that pain, but whatever, I won't wear them again.

I won't buy a shape-up shoe again, but I hope to find a friend who can use and enjoy them because they're attractive.

product_title: Sam Edelman Women's Betty Ballet Flat
review_body: These are cute shoes, but be careful because they can be very uncomfortable.  If you are going to purchase them, make sure you go up at least a half size. I didn't like them because the dug into the top of my foot and I ended up sending them back and getting a different shoe.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Amerie Wedge Pump
review_body: I gave the shoes a 3.  aesthetically it looks really nice but the leather is a bit hard.  It rubs on your skin which may cause blisters. The color is more of a brown hue than orange. I mean it is not a bad buy for the price.

product_title: Naya Women's Palomi Sandal
review_body: It is a nice looking but also comfy sandal, runs narrow (I have regular feet, wear narrow in Birkenstocks, but had to exchange those for a wide). Runs true to size in terms of length. Soft suede. I had blisters on my heels though - but I get them with almost all the shoes. I took off one star for the price, blisters, and narrow-wide confusion.

product_title: Propet Men's M4070 Village Walker Oxford
review_headline: After Years I found these great shoes !!
review_body: A number of years back I found shoes that were comfortable to me. They were the Zeeta brand and made in the USA. I bought 5 pairs of them. They are now worn out and not made any longer. Now I found these shoes and bought a pair to try. After one day I knew they were the shoes I was looking for al this time. I just ordered 3 more pairs.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Blur33 Running Shoe
review_body: I walk about 30 - 35 miles per week so i need a good shoe. This shoes has turned out to be a very good shoe...however it is important to note that is a small fitting shoe. You will need to order at least a half size up and be warned that they are slightly narrower than most asics shoes, as well as the laces being quite short, but i think this is due to them being narrow. I walked in them for about 6 weeks before they became comfortable and molded to my feet, they are supportive and good for a neutral to under pronator. I do recommended this shoe, but be warned about the sizing issue.

product_title: KEEN Women's Waimea H2 Sandal
review_body:
Very speedy delivery to UK.

These are my third pair of Keen flip-flops, I absolutely love them. Because of the toe protection you can go over any terrain without fear of damaging your toes. I have searched high and low on the UK websites for this style of flip-flop and come up with nothing, I cannot understand why they are so difficult to get hold of. They are a brilliant design and not only that they are comfortable too. A definite 'thumbs-up' to Keen.

product_title: Danner Women's Danner 453 GTX Women'S Outdoor Boot
review_headline: Buying my second pair  of 453 GTX
review_body: Love these boots, worn them almost 4yrs (week days) probably could of replaced them a year ago. Can't wait for my new ones to arrive, very happy feet. Outside held up great, inside support gave out finally. Wish they were made in USA!!!!!!!!!!!![[ASIN:B002OSY0GQ Danner Women's Danner 453 GTX Women'S Outdoor Boot]]

product_title: Hip Hop Rapper Retro Large Clear Lens Eye Glasses Black
review_body: I bought these glasses for my son & they look just as expensive as the ones that I have and I paid over $200 for those. Im very pleased & I think in the event if I want another color I'll consider paying $195 less & buy them on Amazon instead of paying 200. This was a great deal!!!!!!

product_title: New Balance Women's W870v2  Light Stability Running Shoe
review_body: I loved the fit and feel of this shoe.  Got lots of compliments on the cool color.  It runs a little short.  I sent them back after a week and a half because even with two packages of superglue the sole on the heal continued to fall apart!

product_title: BORN - Womens - Attila
review_body:
Edited review:
I ended up returning the boots after wearing them around the house. I had a few issue with the return but the sellers graciously assisted me. I recommend buying from Sole connect.

These are truly excellent, beautiful, supple boots but the buckles are a little odd. I wore them one evening and the straps at the ends of the buckles began to flare out.
I really like these boots they are SO comfortable. The leather is soft as butter. I bought the dark brown and the color is gorgeous. I felt like I'd owned them for years within 15 minutes of wearing them. But I don't like how the straps on the buckles flare out. They stick out about 2 inches which really changes the profile and makes me consider returning them. The toe also looks REALLY long even though they fit perfectly, they almost look a size too big. My boyfriend didn't notice and said I was being picky. True, but they're $200 so I have the right to be. I'm 5'6\\" 130lbs with size 8 feet. They fit perfectly over jeans but might look too bulky over tights.
Regardless, Born makes a perfect boot and you can't go wrong with this level of quality and comfort.

product_title: Spenco Women's Yumi Sandal
review_body: I like to slip shoes on and off during warm weather.  Flip flops are very convenient and inexpensive but don't give your feet arch support nor do they have a decent sole for slick surfaces.  These shoes fill have both and last more than one season.

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Nimbus 13 Running Shoe
review_headline: Best running shoes I've ever had
review_body: They are like a dream: light, comfortable and gread cusheon. They didn't hurt me, even after the first workout. Nice colors!

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Speedstar 6 Running Shoe
review_body: More for a skinny and narrow foot but a nicely made shoe. The colors and fabrics are very cool. It's pricey though.

product_title: Rainbow Men's Hemp Sandals
review_body: I've been wearing these for years. The natural colorway gets too dirty, and the black ones don't look as nice. These brown hemp sandals look great, and are easy to clean. The biggest advantage of hemp, to the leather Rainbow sandals, is way less *smell*.    Edit: still love Rainbow sandals, but I've since moved on to the synthetic stuff. The hemp wears down too easy.

product_title: Skechers Double Noll Cryptic Skate Shoe (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: [[ASIN:B004IARBLE Skechers Double Noll Cryptic Skate Shoe (Little Kid/Big Kid)]]. Great quality, name brand, and my son loves them. You can purchase almost anything through Amazon.com and save money.  My kids really beat up their shoes and I have ordered shoes from here and they hold up, no rips or holes. Great!

product_title: CLARKS Women's Wave.Run
review_body: This new model from. Clark's is wonderful. They are comfortable, fit well, and are great for walking distances or standing for lengthy periods. Not waterproof.

product_title: Via Spiga Women's Wanda2 Wedge Pump
review_body:
What is it with Via Spiga shoes? The look so beautiful but there seems nearly always be a problem with the fit. In this case the heel cap is to loose. I can hardly keep the right shoe on, what can I do? I have tried to use gel lining inside the heel, but it does not work to well.
I am really disapointed because this brand is very pricy, too pricy for poor design.

product_title: Hi-Tec Men's Altitude Enviro Light Hiking Boot
review_body:
The \\"leather\\" uppers don't really look like leather, but once worn in a bit and polished they get closer to resembling real leather. The recycled rubber soles do have white spots but not too big of a deal and are hardly noticeable when wearing the boots.

The biggest problem I have with the boots I received was that when looking down, the right boot was off center. The part that holds the laces is off slightly to the left. It doesn't really affect comfort but is noticeable, at least to me, when standing with both boots together. I would have returned them but received the boots right before my camping trip.

Now for the good. This is my third pair of Hi-Tec boots, the other two being the suede Altitude boots. These are just as comfortable and keep my feet dry. I haven't tested them in very cold weather yet but while camping in low 40's and upper 30 degree weather, temperature wasn't an issue. I had them on almost the whole weekend except for sleeping and had no comfort or sweating issues.

All that being said, I think the value of the boots is good enough to recommend and purchase again.

product_title: Retro Rockers - Clear - Eyeglasses With Attitude, Tortoise
review_body: perfect size...Not goofy looking...Better then RayBans because the frames on bans are tiny, and dont fit my face...These are a perfect size,not to big and not to small. The price is GREAT!!! They should be a little more in price due to the great quality of the frames...thanks

product_title: ECCO Men's Yucatan Sandal
review_body: Left sandal fine. Right sandal has bumps and causes some pain in my arch. However, I did decide to keep them.

product_title: Mundi Black Croc My Big Fat Wallet Organizer
review_body: Absolutely love this wallet.  The pictures do not provide an adequate representation of the roominess and quality of the wallet.  It is not leather, but is very shiny and looks to be durable.  Plenty of storage space and the quality is great.  The price is much better than I have seen in retail stores.

product_title: FitFlop Women's Pietra Sandal
review_body: This is the third pair of Pietra Fit Flops I have had - enough said ! The most comfortable things ever.....

product_title: FRYE Women's Hutch Pull-On Boot
review_body: I only gave these shoes a 4 star ONLY because the style was not was I was looking for. The toe was very pointy and I felt a little weird weiring such a pointy boot. Not sure if this style is supposed to be that pointy but they were almost hard to walk in. They were VERY comfortable. A snug fit too, so if you have wider feet and a bigger calf then these boots are not for you. I have small boney stick legs so these boots were a dream for me, but alas, I returned them for the pointyness. The color grey matches the picture spot on and I love the fact that they are pull on boots that are fitted. They are sexy boots for those bold enough to wear them.

product_title: Skechers Performance Women's Go Walk Slip-On Walking Shoe
review_body: I bought these shoes, so I can comfortably walk my dogs.  The shoes are comfortable for every day casual/shopping wear!  They fit like a glove and I felt they were true to size!  Although they may not be chic and sexy, they are EXTREMELY comfortable.  My dogs are happier since I bought the shoes. I am walking longer with them

product_title: New Balance Men's MX608V2 Training Shoe
review_body: I have never been a fan of online shopping, but had no choice when I received an Amazon gift card. The item I purchased, New Balance Cross Trainers,not only fit exactly right but the process was very user friendly.  I had always been sceptical of correct sizing.

product_title: Shupeas Rocket Genuine Leather Pre-Walker (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: These are so adorable and soft.  A must have for growing babies and toddlers!!!! I  love the style and variety of colors available.

product_title: Polo Ralph Lauren Men's Vaughn Saddle Fashion Sneaker

product_title: Iron Fist Zombie Girl Wallet
review_body:
Alright, so, the wallet itself.. Blue bits of the wallet like the strap, card slots and other things. Don't be fooled it's nothing like the picture, it's a very metalic.. fake, leather. Which, by the way, smells, horrible. I do like the wallet itself though. Well kind of.

To be honest, it's very... well.. The \\"leather\\" in which covers the outside.. Is very very loose. I know that's cause there's a spot in there where you can stick rather large pieces of paper or money or whatever BUT. I don't want my wallet wrinkling when I hold it. Being able to grab the excess leather and pinch it like loose skin, not very appealing.

Second of all, there's no coin pouch. You -could- use the little zipper pouch on the other side of the wallet, but in all honesty, there's gaps at the bottom of the walls which could easily let coins slip out unless you were carrying like.. half or whole dollars.

The card slots, aren't just a bit snug, they are TIGHT. I can't get my credit cards out, but this will eventually loosen in time. I hope.

Alright, so, there's no place you can put a check and still be able to easily access. I mean there -are- spots, but you'd have to actually dig out the check book and place it on a hard surface to write on it then stick it back in, compared to a lot of other wallets that have a spot for check books, this just seems very very annoying and tedious.

Last, but definantly not least, my biggest complaint on this wallet, IT STINKS. I got it in today (9/25/2012) by ups. It. Smells. Horrible. To put it... In a term that would somewhat describe it as I can't even place the smell to something, but... It smells like penicillin. But.. ten times stronger. I'm just.. Sickened. Like, really. It. smells. Disgusting. It's going to take more than airing out to get that smell off.

A good thing but it's kind of bad, it's thin. Yes, I like the fact I can easily grip it, but, it tends to bend easily and form into that bent shape. Mine is still bent from being in my purse, I've not been able to straighten it back out. So prepare for some cattywhompus shapes.

Okay.. Now onto some of the good things.

The overall design of the wallet is gorgeous. I love it. It looks gorgeous. The pops of teal everywhere really adds to the wallet. Very easy to hold onto seeing as it's thin enough to do that. But, like I said earlier, bends very easily.

Would I recommend this to a friend? No, no I would not, am I going to be getting a refund for it? simply because it's cute, no. Would I ever buy something like this again? NO.

product_title: FRYE Women's Naiya Kiltie Oxford Pump
review_body:
These booties are hot! Hot, hot hot.

It's not quite cold enough to wear them, but I look so forward to putting on a cute chunky sweater, a pretty scarf, tight skinny jeans and these Frye booties and wearing them all fall. The outfit I just pictured with these is a pair of nubby olive green tights, a rust boucle pencil skirt, a pretty cropped neutral sweater, neck scarf tied to the side and hair upswept. Ok, come on now, get colder already!

I wear and ordered a size 9.5 and they fit great. True to size, as my other Frye boots are too. I recommend not sizing up at all, because I think if you do you'll end up with heel slippage. Given that you'll most likely be wearing tights or nylons with these, it would make it easier for your heel to slip out with even just a little bit of extra space. If the toe-box is too tight, just spray a mix of 50/50 water/rubbing alcohol in there and wear them with socks for an afternoon. Better to mold the front of the shoe to your foot than have slippage in the back.

I looked all over for booties like these, hoping to save a little money, and could not find anything remotely comparable, and am so glad I ended up buying these.

Also, because the heel is chunky it creates a solid platform (along with the platform on the front of the shoe), which makes walking easier. But like all platforms, these booties make you much taller than flats! Note that the heel on these is 4\\", which is pretty standard for high heels, stilettos and platform heels, but you might not expect that of an oxford shoe, so you'll want to add that onto your height if you plan on using these for normal daily wear.

product_title: Bates Men's Delta Gore-Tex 9 Inch ICS Waterproof Boot
review_body:
I bought these last week so I'd have a second set of boots for an upcoming elk hunt. Two years ago, I bought the GX-8 (Goretex, zip-sides) in a closeout just before leaving for an elk hunt in Montana. I crossed my fingers they'd hold up, have the support I'd need for mountain hiking and hunting, and would keep my feet warm. We didn't have much snow (2-3 inches a couple days), but I did walk daily through a marshy field & up to 4-5 in of water. I couldn't have been happier with them. They were about as comfortable as tennis shoes, kept my feet dry, easy on and off, and got me up and down some really treacherous and rocky terrain. I wore them A LOT after I got back of the next two years and still have them.

They've held up pretty well, but I figured I better have an extra sets of boots on the hunt trip we're taking this year, so I bought these Delta-9's. They are definitely beefier than the GX-8s. The entire lower end of the boot is much more boot-like vs sneaker-like with the GX-8. I've been breaking them in over the last 4-5 days since they arrived. Wore them around the house & out and about late last week, hiked about 3 miles in them Saturday, another mile or two yesterday. At first I wasn't sure they were going to break in, they were rubbing me hard in my upper ankle and were causing pain. After Saturday and Sunday's hikes, however, they are feeling really comfortable and I'm confident they'll be a step up from the GX-8s. So far so good... maybe I'll update this again after the hunt in a few weeks I think of it.

product_title: Vibram FiveFingers SeeYa - Men's
review_body:
If you walk or run at all during the day, get these shoes. If you want to get attention, get these shoes. If you don't wear shoes, get thses shoes. If you're skeptical about toe shoes, get these shoes. To be honest, I shouldn't even really be calling them shoes, that would imply that they are ordinary. These are not ordinary. These Seeyas are my fourth pair of Vibram Five Fingers, and please let me tell you how great they really are.

Good:

They are really light and bend and flex easily.
- This is good for running and increased balance.
- They are so light because the soles are so thin. Don't let this concern you though, there is plenty of protection between your precious feet and the unforgiving gorund.

They are generally thin.
- The fabric is thin and this allows for increased circulation and wicking action.
- Like previously stated, the soles are thin, but with good reason. This allows for flexibility and ease of movement.
- They feel weak because everything is so small and thin, but the fabric and velcro on all Vibram Five Fingers hold up remarkably well to any torture you can throw at them.

They are absoultely exquisite to run in.
- I look foward to running with these on. In fact, it is a pleasure to run in them.
- When I wear regular shoes to run, my feet tend to cramp up and I am forced to stop. With VFFs, I can run for a long time, much longer than I am capable of.

I love the look of them.
- I did not get the blue and grey ones, but the black and dayglow color.
- While this was not why I bought them, you get a whole lot of attention when wearing such a bright color. The picture looks very bright but they are brighter in real life.

Bad:

- Nothing, seriously. I am totally not joking, everything about them is great.

Get them, for real.

product_title: Dr.Martens 1461 Vegan Cherry Mens Shoes
review_body: As a vegan, finding a quality, stylish, waterproof shoe has not been easy. Many of the shoes I have tried have not been waterproof and have not lasted very long. So when I came across these I promptly purchased a pair and so far so good. They look just like a standard DM, so much so that I have to inform people that they aren't leather ! The quality seems good and they seem to be waterproof. In fact they seem to be the same quality, make and styling as the standard DM so pretty much like wearing them as you remember but with the added bonus of not being made from the skin of a slaughtered animal. Of course the true test will be the test of time; will they stay waterproof and how long will they last ? If they fail at any time then I will update my review, so if there is no update then you know that they are still performing well (purchased in Sept 2012). I must say, I do have confidence that these will last a good many years. There is a thought within me that I am giving my money to a company that uses animal skins but I can see the positives in this product. The fact that a classic shoe/boot has been made specifically for vegans is something we should celebrate and it shows that veganism is making progress - and well done to Dr Martens for making these. I believe that in a few years time vegan will be as mainstream as vegetarian is today (as vegetarians realise that the only way to be cruelty free is to be vegan) so buying footwear will be easier, with more styles and choice. For today these certainly seem to tick all the boxes of being quality, stylish, waterproof and I would guess suitable for both male and female. My love to all the vegans out there.

The only problem I've had with them so far is that they make a soft \\"clomping\\" sound while you are walking.

Update: After about one year of wearing these, they have loosened up and are no longer as tight on my foot, but still give sufficient support. However, my mom recently bought several pairs of the Abbi Oxfords and they were extremely LOOSE on her foot, even though her feet are much wider than mine. product_title: Mizuno Women's Wave Alchemy 11 Running Shoe
review_headline: For the first time, no orthotics needed!
review_body: I don't know anyone who has feet as narrow as mine.  These actually fit and support my flat flimsy feet from all sides!  I got orthotic inserts for them because I always do, but they actually hurt my feet, so I took them out and put the insole that comes with the shoe back in.  Lo and behold, I can wear them as is with no pain!  (and no pronation!) I did have to order a half size up for the length in the toes.  the bands on the sides of the toe box may bug you if your feet aren't abnormally narrow, but I saw a video of a podiatrist who just cut the bands off with an exacto knife.  These shoes grip my heels, which tend to slip out of other lesser shoes and they have extra lace holes so you can really cinch 'em up. Also, the soles have good traction, but don't tear up my carpet like trail shoes. I use these for step aerobics and kick boxing, too.  The aerobics instructors say to use slippery cross-trainers for pivoting and lateral support when moving side to side, but all the cross trainers I tried on (well over 20 pairs all high end brands) were junk with no support or structure of any kind- like just wearing socks.  So glad I tried these.  Please don't ever stop making narrow widths!

review_body: As a vegan, finding a quality, stylish, waterproof boot has not been easy. Many of the boots I have tried have not been waterproof and have not lasted very long. So when I came across these I promptly purchased a pair and so far so good. They look just like a standard DM, so much so that I have to inform people that they aren't leather ! The quality seems good and they seem to be waterproof. In fact they seem to be the same quality, make and styling as the standard DM so pretty much like wearing them as you remember but with the added bonus of not being made from the skin of a slaughtered animal. Of course the true test will be the test of time; will they stay waterproof and how long will they last ? If they fail at any time then I will update my review, so if there is no update then you know that they are still performing well (purchased in Sept 2012). I must say, I do have confidence that these will last a good many years. There is a thought within me that I am giving my money to a company that uses animal skins but I can see the positives in this product. The fact that a classic shoe/boot has been made specifically for vegans is something we should celebrate and it shows that veganism is making progress - and well done to Dr Martens for making these. I believe that in a few years time vegan will be as mainstream as vegetarian is today (as vegetarians realise that the only way to be cruelty free is to be vegan) so buying footwear will be easier, with more styles and choice. For today these certainly seem to tick all the boxes of being quality, stylish, waterproof and I would guess suitable for both male and female. My love to all the vegans out there.

product_title: New Balance Women's W1260 Stability Running Shoe
review_body:
Brand new straight from the box this am. and was able to do just shy of seven miles, with no problems whatsoever. I previously owned the New Balance WR870 stability running shoe, which gave me excellent results. I was worried that I would not be able to find a shoe equal to them, as the WR870 is no longer available. This shoe is equal to them. They have the stability which I need because I take my speed walking/jogging outdoors. The comfort is great, has a nice cushioned bed. The mesh is also great on this shoe. I live in Florida where the heat index gets to over 100 degree's and these shoes will keep my feet cool and dry. The only thing about them is the weight of the shoe, they do feel kind of clunky for about the first mile. Once I get my rhythm going, I find it not to be a problem. I have had a previous injury, and I know this shoe will not let me down. They also have a lighter weight shoe in this model that I almost bought. I think if I was doing my running on a tread mill I would have gone with the lighter one, but for outdoors this is the shoe for me. Now the cost- I have to look at it this way, you get what you pay for. I know this shoes preformance is not going to let me down. I highly recommend it! My last shoes lasted about three and a half months, then I could feel them starting to break down some. I average about 45 miles a week. I am interested in how long other peoples shoes last and how often they replace them. There is also a promtion on running shoes on Amazon right now, by using the promtion code RUNNING2, you will receive $20 dollars off a $100 dollar purchase.

Follow Up:-- I did not think it was possible, but I love this shoe more than my previous shoe. I have to agree with the other reviewer, these shoes have given me better posture. I also find myself running my route with confidence, no knee or shin pain.( Did not mean to become a runner either.) Could be the cooler weather also. This is one great shoe!

Considering it's a substantial bag it doesn't weigh that much. The wide shoulder strap distributes the weight well on my shoulder, and is long enough that the bag can be worn cross-body. I can't stand those fake strap closures so I like the little twist lock things. The inside is simple with 2 small interior pockets for your phone, etc., but otherwise it's one compartment. This is good for me, as I lose things in bags with a lot of pockets. If you're a pocket person I don't think you will be happy. There's a ring for keys where I tether my wallet as well. The bag is unlined, so the color on the outside is the same on the inside. I just traveled by air with this bag, and was pleased that I could put it into my day pack with the flap folded back so that my stuff was easily accessible. The leather does show scratches and will look beat up after a while. If you're looking for a bag that will become an old friend, this is a good one.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Dinka Boot
review_body:
I first ordered these boots from Zappos.com and ordered the \\"wide calf\\" version in a size 11, medium width. I figured I needed wide calf because my calves were 17\\" circumpherence and about 95% of the boots in stores I could not get zipped up all the way because of my calves. The description also said that they had a 17\\" circcumpherence at the opening. I got them in, tried them on, and found that the boots were at least 2\\" bigger around than my calves. They looked rediculous any way I wore them other than with regular jeans tucked inside, because that was all that would take up some of the extra room, and then it made me look like I had elephant legs. I measured them and they actually did have a 19\\" circumpherence. I returned those and since Zappos no longer carried them, I ordered these regular-width-calf from amazon. Since the original boots, I've lost an inch in my calves, making them 16\\" around. These boots fit perfectly. They are form-fitting, but don't cut off circulation to my feet, and there's a small elastic wedge in the top of the boot, which makes it possible to tuck leggings into them.

The calf diameter given by the manufacturer is for a size 8, so expect to add on about 3/4 inch circumpherence for every size larger than that (not sure about smaller sizes.)

Also, these boots have a cute little heel that is feminine, but not so tall that I feel like I'm going to sprain my ankle (aperantly very hard to find in a boot these days!) I've worn them to school a couple times now, which involves walking around a rather large college campus, and so far they are very comfortable and I haven't had any problems with blisters or rubbing on the ball of my foot or the back of my heel like I do with just about every other pair of heels I've ever worn! I'm considering buying another pair in the oxford brown before they're gone, they're just awesome boots.

product_title: Geox Men's Snake Sneaker
review_headline: Great sneakers, and they really do help keep your feet dry too.....
review_body:
Well, you never know what you're going to find. In the last several years I have problems with my feet sweating. Not sure why, but since it started I've experimented with many shoes and socks to find out what works best to help keep my feet dry. In general, socks with nylon in them seem to help. Shoes are hit and miss, but usually sneakers with mesh uppers and insoles that are at least partly made of leather help. I was very intrigued with the Italian brand Geox when I recently learned of it online. The claim that Geox shoes contained a breathable membrane in a perforated rubber sole really got my attention. I purchased a pair of Snake sneakers. Mine look just like these, but are white with Red Bull Formula One race team logos on the heel and tongue.

The shoes fit well and appear to be well made, but the first time I wore them the insoles felt kinda hard and not very padded in comparison to other shoes I have. This has not proven to be a problem of any kind and I do find the shoes extremely comfortable, even for long days. I've also noticed that the toe box is roomier than similar sneakers I have from Puma and Boss Orange.

The claim that the shoes are breathable seems to really be true. In combination with my favorite [[ASIN:B0058ZJAUI HUGO BOSS Men's Axel Crew Sock]] socks, these shoes do about as good of a job that I've found keeping my feet dry. My feet even feel a bit cooler, but not wet.

I've worn the shoes frequently in the past month or so I've owned them and they seem to be holding up well from a quality prospective. Also, the insoles are removable, so they can be taken out at night to help the shoes dry out.

A note on the sizes. I usually am a size 12 in American shoes, but with some European brands I wear size 13. Usually this is also known as a size 46 in European sizing, so I tend to look for size 46 in European-brand shoes no matter what the brand specifies that a 46 translates into in American sizing. This rule holds true for me with Geox, Boss Orange, Boss Black, and Diesel. It doesn't with Puma though, with that brand I need a 47.

review_body: My husband bought the men's version of this shoe and couldn't stop raving about how comfortable they were. I was reluctant to get them because of the high price tag, but after doing some additional research, I decided to buy them. I golf between 4 and 8 times per month and often walk 9 holes after work. I have plantar fasciitis and am required to wear orthotics with all athletic shoes. And sometimes even with my orthotics, after walking 9 holes with my old golf shoes my feet will hurt. I tried the Ecco Biom's with my orthotics and I didn't instantly realize how great they were. I took my orthotics out and immediately knew what my husband was talking about. It felt like I had nothing on my feet. The shoes are very lightweight but still supportive. I've worn them for several rounds of golf with a cart and have had no problems, and I don't anticipate having any foot pain when I walk a round. They are described as water-resistant but I wore them on a very wet golf course and my feet stayed dry. They are European-sized; I normally wear an 8.5-9 and for these, I ordered a 40 (9-9.5) and they fit perfectly. I'm very happy with these shoes and would order them again in heartbeat.

product_title: The Sak Artist Circle NaNo Cross-Body
review_body:
I already owned the black version of this purse so was looking for another one in a similar style, but in a different color. The red and brown color in this work great for fall.

This purse is surprisingly useful since I can fit so much into it - the purse itself weighs so little that, even when full, it still isn't too heavy. I originally bought one of these for traveling since I wanted something small that didn't take up too much room when flying, yet was roomy enough to carry all I need to take with me.

I love the tiny pockets on the front: the zippered one is exactly the right size to carry an iPhone, and as there is a zip it is secure and the phone won't fall out. The smaller, open, pocket on the front is the perfect size to tuck tickets, receipts, even a small emery board. This is particularly useful when I travel in cities that use subways since the ticket or rail card need to be accessible to run through machines frequently - it fits perfectly in this little pocket and saves me having to open up the whole purse to search for it each time I want to use it.

The pockets and the space inside are plenty big enough to carry keys, wallet, etc. The only reason I gave it four stars instead of five: the black version of this purse stands up much more easily on the leather base - this one, for some strange design reason, won't stand up straight, it leans slightly, no matter how you load it up. I think the base has been applied slightly off center, but this is not a big deal since most times I am wearing the purse anyway or prop it up against something when I am not using it. I am pretty sure this is probably only an issue with mine (or some) so don't let this put you off buying it if you like it - it's a great purse and definitely the most useful one I have ever used. If they bring out more colors then I will buy more, especially as the price is pretty good compared to other purses.

I have also washed my black purse ona cold wash in my machine and it came out looking brand new - haven't tested out with this one yet but I would expect it to come out the same since the fabric is the same.

product_title: KEEN Women's Bern High Boot
review_body: Ladies,...if you have been thinking that you couldn't find a boot that is both stylish and comfortable, look no further.  I was so depressed with my search for boots that had a nice width for my toes, (since I stand all day doing hair), were cushiony, and could accommodate my sole orthotics.  After searching through mall after mall, I had resigned myself to the fact that I would just have to forget the whole idea of wearing cute boots ever again.  Nothing fit my orthotics!  My fashion days were over.....sigh!  Well, not with these.  I took a chance and ordered them. They were a birthday present from my husband.  WOW!  Upon opening the box, the leather is a deep,rich color. Not a dull plastic look.  Absolutely beautiful stitching can be seen up the center front and part of the back heel.  Slipping them on was like wearing a slipper!  My feet said AAAHHH, not OWWW!  The sole is removable so you can place your orthotics in without any problems and still have plenty of wiggle room.  It's just an excellent boot, with style and comfort.  If you have been debating,...DON'T!  Just try them, you won't be sorry!!!

product_title: FRYE Women's Veronica Short Boot
review_body:
In a nutshell I'm happy with my purchase because of the quality, versatility, and pull on styling of this boot. The comfort is ok and I think will improve with time.
I usually wear a size 8 but after reading reviews I opted for the 8.5 and I'm glad I did. I definitely need the extra room if wearing thick socks and even a size 9 would have been workable. I am very self conscious about my feet looking too big since I am 5'3 but I don't think they look too bulky. As mentioned by others they definitely require breaking in. Mine are still new and they are fine for an hour or so but then they start to feel uncomfortable. I attribute that to the stiffness which I anticipate will improve with time. This boots are great with leggings, skinny jeans and dresses and I'm looking forward to working them into my wardrobe in many other ways. I waterproofed them as I plan to use them through the winter here in Michigan.
As far as heel slippage which many mention, when I tightened the strap along the front it took care of the issue but then I had to bend down to pull the boots on and off. I like that I can just step into the boots and not have to bend down to pull them on so I leave the front buckle a little loose and deal the with my heel moving in the shoe which doesn't really bother me.
I'm thinking I'll be wearing these boots for years to come.

product_title: KomodoSport Shoe - Women's by Vibram FiveFingers
review_headline: excellent, for circuit/crossfit, but not solely for running
review_body:
Hi i'm an avid barefoot runner, crossfit/circuit training athlete, & as well as a strength & conditioning coach. I previously wore the VFF KSO which were great & simplistic. I just bought these komodos and been using them for about a week.

These offer far superior traction for your stride as well as more cushion than the KSO. You still have the freedom of feeling barefoot but once you put them on you first notice the traction along the ridges/edges of your feet.

I have amazingly arched feet causing a slight over pronation in my stride with other shoes. These offer excellent arch support to help increase your balance and strength.

This is an all-around EXCELLENT shoe especially for the circuit/crossfit community. The support/breathability is phenomenal and helps circulate airflow as well as keep your feet relatively dry. The traction (outer sole) is great for cutting directions and agility exercises, but the traction does hinder your barefoot stride while running compared to the KSO.

Although there are downfalls specifically for Trekking/trail running activities. The opening at the heel does not possess the elastic band to help prevent foreign objects go inside. There is a bit of chafing when I run past 3-5 miles due the absence of the elastic band.

Overall this is a great all-around shoe, the jack of all trades. Otherwise, if you're purchasing these simply for running I suggest the KSO or bikilas instead.

product_title: Columbia Men's Techsun III Water Shoe
review_headline: Great Water Shoe or deck Shoe
review_body:
I have flat feet..and so very thin natural patting on the bottom of my feet it is hard to walk bare foot, so when I walk around a pool or across the room I need something on my feet, other I have great deal of pain.

So when my old pool sandals, deck shoes is a more appropriate name, finally wore out, not bottom, but the way the straps were attached to the base' I began looking for a replacement.

I shopped Big 5 etc.. but could not find anything in my size,,, (15), or what I even wanted, they had sandals that go between toes, I did not like those because they hurt in between my toes. I looked on Amazon. an found these water shoes.

To my surprise they fix perfectly, and I did not need socks on to cushion my feet.

I would walk the length of the pool to strengthen my legs and my feet would hurt, yesterday I have a brain Storm, Dave, try using the water shoes in the pool, I remembered in years past I would wear my walking shoes to go up ladders to dive, and keep them on in the pool, in Palm Springs, that is when they had a High Dive at the Motel we stayed there when the kids were small 50 years ago, I put them on went in the pool and they worked great. so now I have pool side shoe, and a shoe to use in the pool.. So if anything I have said about these shoes appeal to you.. GET THEM.

If they do not work the way you expect, don't call me, send them back at no charge, I think? [[ASIN:B0057NCB3E Columbia Men's Techsun III Water Shoe]]

review_body: I have wide feet and was really worried that these shoes wouldn't fit. After reading lots of customer reviews, I ordered them in a half a size up, and to my relief, they fit perfectly. product_title: Hobo  Women's Anya VN-20011AMB Wallet
review_headline: Compact Basic Wallet with Plenty of Room
review_body:
I love Hobo wallets and bags. I like the quality of leather which feels substantive, the details like metal zippers, and the beautiful rich colors. My old coach wallet is wearing out and I wanted to find a wallet that was smaller than the clutch style wallets that seem to be very popular this year. My first choice was Hobo but over the last few months it seems like they've phased out several of their smaller wallets such as the Bette without replacing with newer styles.

The clutch wallets are beautiful but too big. Some of my purses are on the small side and a clutch wallet won't fit. Although the Robin wallet is very cute it's too small. I don't like the idea of having to fold my currency to fit in a wallet.

So I was delighted to see the Anya wallet on Amazon. This wallet is perfect. It's compact but there's lots of slots and room for my credit cards, membership cards, receipts, and pictures. The only reason I didn't give this wallet 5-stars is as nice as it is, it's not very exciting from a style perspective. It's a little on the basic side. In addition the card slots are a bit stiff but I expect them to get a little looser over time.

I guess my last comment is Hobo wallets strike me as being on the expensive side. But maybe my perception is frozen in time and I need to get used to paying for real leather and quality.

So a great basic wallet in a nice compact size.

review_body: I usually do not order shoes online because my feet are very difficult to fit. product_title: FootFitter Premium Professional 2-Way Shoe Stretcher- Stretches Length and Width
review_headline: Happy with the Mens Small Size cause the Mens Medium Size would not fit into my shoes
review_body:
My shoes are a size 8.5 to 9 and I purchased the medium size stretcher. I returned it for a small size because I could not get the heal part into any of my shoes. I tried with loafers, shoes with shoe strings and slip on shoes. When I pushed the front part of the footfitter into my shoe, there is no way maneuver the heal part into the shoe because the front part fills the shoe and you can't tilt or manipulate the stretcher in order to get the heal part in. Get the small size, you will be happy you did. The heal part is slightly shorter on the small stretcher and therefore you can get it in the shoe without a problem. Both the medium and small stretcher have same size front part (expander) and they both open to the same length. The only difference is the heal part is slightly shorter. You can stretch the same size shoes as the medium stretcher but without a problem getting the heal part to fit into the shoe. The vender I bought it from did pay for the return shipping (or a portion of the shipping). The quality is very good and not like the cheap ones made out of pine. The footfitter is made out of birch or some type of hardwood. I would recommend it and only gave it 3 stars because of the size issue. Get the small size so that you won't have a problem getting the heal portion in.

The small one get 5 stars.

product_title: Scarpa Men's Fuego Mountaineering Boot
review_body:
This is my wife's profile, so don't be misled by the name. I have worked in the woods as a forester for over 25 years and have owned all kinds of boots: White's, Hawthorn's, Buffalo's, and recently some Asolo mountaineering boots. I have only owned these boots for about a month and have not broken them in yet, so this is an early review.

The first thing I must say is that Amazon in incorrect in saying that these boots are Gore-tex. Scarpa makes no claim that they are and there is no indication on the boot or tags that they are. I knew this when I bought them and am fine with it, just thought others should know.

These boots are generally very stiff (more than a \\"hiking\\" boot) and I think they will work well off trail in the woods. They still have flex though, in the parts of the boots that have the black leather. This is different than the Asolo's that I have, which were completely stiff and took almost an entire summer to break in. I would not recommend this boot for casual hiking, as they do not have a lot of shock absorbsion under the foot. They are designed for support on uneven terrain, which is where I do all my work. As I mentioned, these boots take some breaking in, as a good, stiff boot should. I made the mistake of not duct taping my heels on an uphill hike and paid the price with a blister. I am sure this is just part of the break-in process, as I had to do the same with my Asolo's.

The other thing that I like about this boot so far is how high they are. My Asolo's are only 6 inches, these are closer to 8. One problem I had with my old boots was that rocks and debris came in through the top. I don't think this will be such a big problem with these.

Another feature I like is that the hooks extend down farther on the boot than any that I have owned before. The first 5 sets (from the top) are hooks, the last 4 are d-ring. This makes the boots very easy to take on and off.

Even though they are not Gore-tex, they are very water resistant at this point. I was walking around in wet grass for quite a while the other day and they stayed dry inside. I'm sure they will leak eventually, but I plan on using the recommended leather treatment to mitigate it. Gore-tex boots leak after a while as well.

I will update this post later in the summer as I get more use out of them.

UPDATE 11/2012: Well its almost winter now and I am updating this review. Unfortunately I had to give up on wearing these boots this summer, they just hurt too much. product_title: Clarks Men's Girards Slip-On
review_body:
I was initially very pleased when I got these shoes. They fit me perfectly and were very comfortable. However, within a week after I started to wear them, the right shoe developed a hole at the toe and the left one is showing signs of wear as well. Considering that I had only been wearing them to and from work (while changing them at work) for a week, this is absolutely ridiculous. What is even more appalling is that this was not sold by a private a seller, but was rather sold by Amazon itself. Personally, I have always held Amazon to a higher degree as I thought that they would not put their name to what is clearly a very bad product, and more importantly there appears to have been a very clear deficiency in the due-dilligence process of quality assurance. Because I was initially very pleased and thinking that there would not be any issues with a product bought from Amazon directly, I threw out the original packaging and even left positive feedback for the transaction; so I do not think that I can even return this.

Overall, very displeased with this experience.

product_title: Anuschka Check Book Cover PPS
review_body:
I purchased the Anuschka Check-book cover (Premium Peacock Safari) to go with my Peacock Lily handbag. It is as beautiful as my bag (which is saying something!); the pictures do not do these works of art justice.

The peacock feather is iridescent, and the colors are vibrant. The leather is very soft and supple, the stitching is beautiful, neat, and even. I was pleased to see that the same artisan that painted my bag also painted my check-book cover (these are signed pieces of art, after all!). I have caught myself taking it out of my bag so I can see how the light plays on the colors. It is a joy to look at.

The ID pocket on the \\"back\\" (really, you could make either side the front) is well made and appears to be sturdy. The \\"pockets\\" for your checkbook register are just right; they slide in easily, but with not a lot of extra \\"play\\" -- they will not readily fall out.

My only \\"complaint\\" (and it isn't really) is that this checkbook cover is made for those who do not write \\"duplicate\\" checks. While it would be nice to have had the option of a regular vs duplicate checkbook, I've solved the problem by cutting an old plastic checkbook cover so that I have the writing panel. One could have done just as well with a stiff piece of poster board cut to size.

I would highly recommend Anuschka products, and absolutely love the artwork on this particular design.

product_title: Aetrex Men's Rx Runner Running Shoes
review_body:
I bought these locally at a going-out-of-business sale, so I was fortunate to pay only $25 for them, which is probably about what they're really worth.
The first time I took them off, I noticed that the little fabric loop on the tongue that lets the laces keep the tongue centered had popped off. Sometimes stuff like that randomly happens, so I didn't think much of it -- after all, it's an easy fix with a needle & thread.
Now, after having worn them roughly every other day for about 2 months, the plastic sides are starting to come off. Those colored swooshes on the side are clear plastic underneath with a glittery colored plastic layer glued on top, and the motion of walking makes them separate. Both sides of both shoes are coming off at once, so I'll probably just finish yanking the colored part off rather than try to re-glue it.

Long story short, if you can pay less than $40 for these and don't really care how they look, they're probably worth it; they ARE very comfortable. I don't run in them (I imagine they would've fallen apart much sooner if I did), but I have an otherwise-active lifestyle. It's a nice design, but with anything made in China (which these are, of course), you'll have workmanship issues.

product_title: ECCO Women's Biom C 2.2 Running Shoe
review_headline: Great fit and feel, bad durability
review_body:
I have been wearing Ecco Biom for the past two years now, and have gone through three pairs due to durability issues. The upper part of the shoe is very durable, but the rubber pads on the bottom of the shoe begin to crack and break off after just a couple weeks of wear. I use super glue to \\"fix\\" the pads temporarily, but eventually they break off completely. I don't run, but use these shoes only when working out in the gym, usually five times per week. I can't imagine how poorly they would hold up if I was actually hitting the asphalt in them.

I cannot wear any other shoes after having worn these shoes. They are very comfortable, light-weight and have a fantastic heal grip to prevent slippage. After wearing these shoes, any other type of shoe feels as if I'm wearing the box the shoe came in - big, clunky and unflexible. I really wish they'd fix the defective pads on the bottom of the shoe, because these shoes are way too expensive to have this sort of problem.

I ordered these because I also ordered and love the Clarks Bloodhound shoe [[ASIN:B003V9FV88 Clarks Men's Bloodhound Slip-On Shoe]] which is similar to this shoe. product_title: New Balance Men's MT20v1 Trail Minimus Shoe
review_headline: These shoes have changed how I feel about  running
review_body:
My friend who owns a pair of vibram five fingers finally talked me into trying their new cooperative trail running shoe made by New Balance. These shoes have a breathable upper that lets in tons of air, with a vibram sole. This is where the magic is, everything that vibram advertises in its testimonials for their products I experienced. My running form improved and I began to want to run outdoors more often. Now I'm knocking miles down like nothing. By far my favorite feature is that you don't have to wear socks with the shoes. This adds to the feeling of being barefoot. Though be careful about running through loose dirt as it will get kicked up and into the shoe staining the inside. Though this might make it so you clean them more often, because even with the anti-bacterial coatiing on the sole, with heavy use the shoes will get smelly. I find that leaving the laces loose after use, thus allowing them to air our more efficiently greatly reduces smell and allows the shoes to dry faster. The grey and red color scheme make it so you can wear these shoes out in public and not feel like you just came from the gym. Word of advice, I am usually a 12, but ordered a 11 as the fit is supposed to be almost glove like, with only about half a thumb's width between your big toe and the front of the shoe. Also works great as walking shoes.
These shoes will change how you feel about running. Like barefoot, only better.

product_title: Oakley Bottlecap Sunglasses
review_body:
The polished black frame with the G30 Iridium lenses make for a nice combination.

They were shipped very quickly, and arrived safely.

They appear to be genuine [[ASIN:B000IWKIOI Bottlecap by Oakley]]. I compared them to the Oakley Bottlecap sunglasses I got from the Oakley store and, while there are some discrepancies, they are very minor.

I like the way they fit. They are for people with a small to meduium width face. They have been discontinued and the [[ASIN:B007EN42XW Oakley Men's Bottle Rocket Oval Sunglasses]] is the new model. The Bottle Rocket fits me a little better but it is twice the price.

I like the Bottlecaps just fine. These will do as a good pair to grab on the go that I don't have to worry about too much. Replacement lenses ([[ASIN:B002EL2ZU6 Oakley Bottle Cap 13 Polarized Rimless Sunglasses]]) are still available from Oakley, so I can customize them easily in the future.

The G30 lenses are great. I have no complaints about them.

From the Oakley store, the G30's appeared to be more of a blue lens when looked at from the front, and a rose lens when looked at from the back. These seem to just be a rose colored lens, through and through.

Either way, they work fine and they look good.

product_title: Corcoran Men's 10 Inch Historic Jump Work Boot
review_body:
Sizing of this product should be determined by using a Brannock device. At the time I purchased these the sizing chart on the product description was not at all right.

This is my second pair of this boot in 10 years. The first pair is still in great shape after 5 years of daily wear. The only reason I needed a new pair was because my shoe size changed pretty drastically and I just can't wear the old ones anymore.

The spit-shineable leather gives this boot a great appearance. The high rise provides great ankle support. Oil-resistant outsoles are fantastic for walking on otherwise slick surfaces like tile, steel, and cement. The new polyurethane foam insoles are very comfortable and will survive years of abuse, making for a more than adequate replacement of the originals.

These are historic reproductions, made by Corcoran, of the boots Corcoran made for U.S. servicemen during the 1940s and '50s. The look and fit are great, and they only get better with age.

These boots will take a while to break in. And they will hurt a lot while you are breaking them in. After that though, these will easily be the best shoes you own. Many people will suggest soaking in water during break-in, but do not do this; toughen up and wear them a few hours a day under normal use and they'll ease into a natural, comfortable shape.

Finally, after 3 or 4 years of daily wear your halfsoles and heels will likely be pretty worn. Any shoe repair shop can fix this, but they'll likely not have access to OEM parts. You'll get the best life out of these boots by regularly cleaning with saddle soap, polishing with wax-based polish, and seeking professional repair with OEM half soles and heels (contact the manufacturer for service providers).

review_body: Very comfortable right out of the box! They're excellent quality and seem like they'll be durable. I have plantar fasciitis, so I have to wear orthotics, and they fit well in these shoes. The liner comes out, so my orthotics slide right underneath. Also the liners really wick perspiration. These are toning shoes and it says right on the box that they are not to be worn during exercise other than walking. They feel very stable and supportive, so they're not like those rocking toning shoes that I'd probably sprain my ankle with in 5 minutes. They're cushy, almost bouncey - exceptionally comfortable. In fact, I love these shoes so much, I ordered a pair of the same ones in brown. I wear them to work with my dress slacks and no one even notices. I guess if you're one of those people who's fussy about having the latest fashion statement on your feet, you wouldn't wear these to the office, but at 5 p.m. my feet still feel great and I don't hobble to the car like everyone in their stilettos. I also wear these with shorts and they look stylish and appropriate. Great shoe!

product_title: New Balance Men's MT572 Trail Running Shoe
review_body:
Ditto to all the comments on sizing. My street shoe size is a consistent 9.5 E. This shoe in 11D had the same heel fit and toe box - that's quite a difference. What appealed to me, besides its attractive and non-bizarre styling, was the solid sole material and the lightness of the open fabric. They required no break-in whatsoever.

I used them at the gym for a couple of days and they were very comfortable and, considering the light weight, plenty supportive, which surprised me.

Then I took them on a trip to our \\"farm\\" and spent nine days from sunup to sunrise doing carpentry, field, and clean-up work, in \\"the warm California sun\\". My feet never got sore, tired, or sweaty, and the breathability was a big help. On the negative side, the fabric also provided an ideal surface for the attachment of all sorts of seeds and burrs. When I got home and washed the shoes, not all of the wild oat seeds came out, and there are some that seem now to be printed on the insole material. It's pretty hard to have it all, but I like these shoes well enough that I'm going to get another pair to wear around urbania.

I picked thse up at Nordstrom Rack (only one pair in the region, unfortunately) for a great price, which I will not divulge as it will only make you feel bad. I was also happily surprised that these were Made in the USA!

product_title: Lake Men's CX330C SPDPLY Cycling Shoe
review_body: These fit well, and I hadn't had the BOA lace system before.  It's nice! Albeit minor, you'll notice the 'log roll' effect of being on a higher stack and you'll know why the trend is toward lower stack height.
