review_headline: Shoes are way too small, and return processing is horrible
review_body:
Prior to ordering this shoe, I read the other reviews indicating that the sizing was small. I normally wear a 9, so I ordered a 10 based on the other reviews. The shoes looked great upon arrival (although 9 days seems like a long time to arrive given today's shipping industry). The size 10s were still too small for me. I loved the look of the shoe, so I continued to try to them on around the house, and see if they would loosen up a bit. Of course, they didn't.

So now I am at the point of returning them, which has become an annoying hassle. First of all, there is only a 30 day limit for returning shoes with this seller (and Amazon as well). One of their largest shoe competitors allows up to a year to return a shoe as long as they have not been worn outside. 30 days is not industry best practice. I followed the protocal for \\"requesting a return authorization\\" from Costumes4Less.com. The website indicated that they would send an email with the instructions for how to return, but did not provide a timeframe. So I waited a day & a half for this email, which of course never came. I then called the Customer Service number about my return request and instructions. He instructed me that they normally will send the email within 24 hours of receipt. Before I could make my next comment, he said \\"Is there anything else I can help you with today?\\"... clearly implying that he had no intentions of speaking with me about this issue anymore, and I should just wait for my email.

So bottom line of my review.... Order about 2 sizes bigger than your normal size, and don't order from Costumes4Less.com.

review_body: I am so thankful in the creation of this sandal . This is the only one that makes my feet pain free. Since I have heel spurs and fasciitis. Thanks dr Weil . Please do not stop in making this sandal.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Kayano 17 Running Shoe
review_body: These are a really great running shoe but I find the inner fabric wears out really quickly.  This is the second pair of Kayanos I have owned now and I have found that the fabric at the heel of the shoe wears out way before the soles or any other part of the shoe does.  This ends up causing blisters on the back of my heels, even if I try taping/strapping my feet.  They are a joy to run in but they really don't last me very long at all.  It doesn't end up being good value for money when you have to keep replacing them every couple of months.

product_title: New Balance Women's WL101 Slip-On Sneaker
review_body: I bought these shoes for a vacation that we had coming up and was not sure about them.  I tried them out at the zoo before the trip.  I wore them all day walking around and my feet never hurt.  Comfortable and cool for hot weather! I plan on buying more in a different color!

product_title: Mary Frances 09-110 Hall Of Fame Shoulder Bag
review_body: This bag is not only useful but a work of art.  It is a beautiful design and beautifully crafted. I do believe this will fit right in when travelling to Nashville, TN or Austin, TX, actually this bag could go anywhere.

product_title: Nina Women's Oscar Pump
review_headline: Nina Oscar Platform Pump in Red
review_body: This is what Dorothy (Wizard of Oz) would have worn in 2012. This shoe is sophisticated, chic and sparkly. The sparkly part in the platform front and heel. I have walked around in the shoe for a few minutes without any issues. The fit is true to size, the color is spot on and the feel of it on the foot is precise. I had tried a few red shoes before choosing these. I found the perfect shoe to be worn a the end of this month. It also helps me by adding some much needed inches to my short stature. Ladies if you want cute and elegant, choose this one. Found a great little red bag to match also on Amazon. Thanks Amazon for having what I need and for a good price too.

product_title: Rockport Women's Marta Walking Shoe
review_body: The shoes fit well and are greating walking shoes.  I have been purchasing Rockport shoes for many years and every pair has been excellent fitting and have been very durable.

product_title: Milwaukee Boots - Milwaukee Outlaw Motorcycle Boots 8
review_body: The boots are very stiff, they are true to size.  I don't really like the size of the toe, makes it harder to shift.  That may get better as they break in, not sure.  This is my first time buying Milwaukee brand boots, they are just OK.  Great service and shipping though.

product_title: KEEN Men's Targhee II Mid WP Hiking Boot
review_headline: Excellent. Just be sure they are absolutely comfortable for you.
review_body: Excellent, excellent boot. But as with all shoeware, it's gonna depend on your personal feet. In my case, I have narrow flat feet, which means that I do not like an arch - which the Targhee doesn't have, good - and I don't like a shoe that's too wide. Unfortunately this boot is a wee bit scrunch up towards the front - the wide part of my foot - and I notice it a little while hiking. In fact any time I go on a hike that's longer than a mile, I become concerned that my will be sore afterwards. But amazingly, they are not, even after the last backpacking trip where we put on about 10 miles. So I guess that means the boot is doing something right, even when it doesn't fit properly. I haven't returned them for this reason. I guess I'll keep using them.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's January Platform Sandal
review_body: I love this shoe! I'm so glad I bought these shoes  and would recommend them to all. Good quality and worth the price  It says they are only 4\\" but they are 5. I recommend ordering a half size larger than normal

product_title: Saucony Men's Grid Excursion TR6 Trail Running Shoe
review_body: Always been a fan of Saucony. BUT, got swayed by other brands and their promos. I've achilles tendon problems. These shoes are fantastic. Why have I left it 20 years to get back to them ?

product_title: PUMA Core Lite Shoulder Bag
review_body: I bought this for my sister and she loved it... good and complete product, good quality for a very good price

product_title: Wolverine Men's W05107 Fulton Boot
review_body: The boots fit perfectly.  Usually I have to break the shoes in but these boots are ready to wear right out of the box.  They are very comfortable.  Size was true to my usual boot and running shoe sizes.  Vendor was true to the ad on Amazon.

product_title: New Balance Men's M730 Running Shoe
review_body: Great minimilast shoe. Very light and the extra width is perfect. Lots of compliments from people whenever I wear them.

product_title: New Balance Men's MW950 Walking Shoe
review_body: Good Shoes, comfy, they fit well. At the size(15EEEE), I didn't have much choice, so I lucked out. They're a bit ugly though.

product_title: Floral Embossed Business Card Case (Silver Tone)
review_body: Exactally what I wanted. Need I say more. It holds business cards securly and is easy to open, light weight and looks nice.

product_title: Minnetonka Women's Woodstock Boot Moccasin
review_body: These are super cute boots.  But caution... they run small and narrow.  I have size 9 feet and ordered a size 9... I haven't decided whether I should keep them and hope they stretch out or return them for a size 10.  Just wearing them around my bedroom, the ties do come untied very easily... I'll probably have to double know them which isn't as cute.

product_title: Northside Men's Burke II Sandal
review_body: I love this Item, Very comfortable, keep my nice and cool, wish where leather, but for the price is good

product_title: L.B. Men's Altin BOA Slipper
review_body: I ordered these for my Dad. The shoes are very nice for the price. The suede is nice quality and the sole is a hard sole that will hold up to some occasional outside wear. I ordered the brown which is actually a golden buckskin color with a chocolate brown trim,just as pictured on my monitor. My Dad is hard to fit in a shoe. He has a narrow foot and wears a 1/2 size, so ordering shoes requires guessing about the size. He received the shoes and really liked them but they were too big. He lives several hours from me. My Mother found the info sheet included in the box with the shoes. She called the number and was told the company would ship out a smaller size and included return shipping labels to make the exchange so easy. The shoes arrived in just a few days, just as promised. I so appreciate the customer service we received. If only all companys were as easy to do business with. I will definately be doing business with them again.

product_title: D&G Dolce & Gabbana Women's 0DD8085 Sunglasses
review_headline: Nice but looked better on the site
review_body:
In all fairness to the seller, sunglasses really need to be tried on prior to buying. As I did not have that option, I went on and purchased them. Needless to say I was disappointed. They did not fit my face (though round glasses usually do) and they really look better on the site.

I had to return them. :(

product_title: Irish Setter Men's Black Bear Waterproof 10" Big Game Boot
review_body: Great fit. Waterproof...really great quality leather...such a nice boot...if they weren't for work, I'd definitely wear them "out"....great buy...pretty color, very comfortable. I wear them at least 8 hours a day, 5 days a week...

product_title: Crocs Women's Patricia Sandal
review_body: Bought these for my mom. She loves them. She wears them everywhere. Definately can't go wrong with crocs. Soft, comfy and stylish.

product_title: FitFlop Little Kid/Big Kid Electra Sandal
review_body:
First I love my flip flops. They provide wonderful support for my feet.
When my daughter started complaining her feet hurted, I decided to buy her one.
She loves them and her feet does not hurt or tire quickly like before.
I highly recommend them. We are now officially a flip flop family. Even my son and husband have them.

review_body: I bought three pears of shoes because The shoes are very nice very comfertable. And I would buy for him ...

product_title: Dan Post Men's Falcon 11" Cowboy Certified Boots
review_body: These boots have quickly become my favorites. They are very comfortable and look good with almost everything. I have received a lot of compliments on them. They arrived in perfect condition. I recomend dan post cowboy certifieds to anyone who wants a great pair of comfortable boots and likes a low heel. I also like the tread on the sole of the boot. It takes away some of that tap dancing sound when walking on hard surfaces and doesn't slip so much.. Great quality boot... I will buy another pair!

product_title: Seychelles Women's Stroke Of Midnight Pump
review_body:
This is an awesome shoe. The sizing is pretty much right on. I find the heel is a bit loose, not uncommon for me, so I stuff the toe box and it improves the fit.

The midnight pump is a perfect color - it is a midnight navy, a blue black. The color is incredibly versatile and the toe cleavage adds just a bit of sexy to what would be an otherwise boring pump. Comfortable too.

My first pair of Seychelles - I'm buying more!

product_title: Timberland PRO Men's Direct Attach Six-Inch Soft-Toe Boot
review_body: The boots are very comforting. The size is great because I have a 2EE with foot. I am up and on them 8 hours every day and my feet do not hurt at the end of the day. Great shoes.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Buff Oxford
review_body: The shoes are gorgeous. Unfortunately, they fit so long. I've had 2 pairs of different brand dress shoes prior that were size 9 and fit fine. I went down to 8 in these (after 2 attempts) and they were still too lengthy. I ended up buying a couple of other brands at DSW and these shoes were there, or a Steve Madden style just like them. The only sizes they had left were 9-12 and they filled the shelves. Apparently it's a known issue.

product_title: New Balance Men's M990v3 Running Shoe
review_body:
The shoes arrived in a brand new condition and the delivery was fast.
These 990 are my third pair of NBs and I have to say that they are brilliant as always.
For the first time I see carbon fiber pads on NB shoes. Although the size of them is not big, buy it will improve the stability. And the shoes themselves are light and comfortable. I'm glad that I've made a good choice.

product_title: Air Shox Turbo 12 454166-007 Nike
review_body: I bought a pair of these at an outlet mall in Vegas. Nike reminded me again why I need to be loyal to their brand. The shoes are very comfortable,you don't feel them at all when you wear them, and the mesh allows for ventilation. Absolutely love this shoe! Five stars!

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Driver Sandal
review_body: these are so comfy and such good quality i couldn't be happier, they are true to size for me that don't have either super skinny or wide ankles the fit was great, but for people wide wide ankles they might be tight.. :p i got the natural color and they are a little bit darker than the picture but just as gorgeous :)

product_title: Rockport Men's Basalt Rugged Boot
review_body: These are great boots. Comfortable, warm, water repellent and attractive. I bought them for winter casual wear and they work perfectly for that.

product_title: Columbia Sportswear Men's Shasta Ridge Low Omni-Tech Hiking Shoe
review_body: These fit really well out of the box and are still comfortable, but are already falling apart after less than a month of wear.  If you look closely at the laces, half go through eyelets in the material but half go through little red cloth straps.  Two of these straps have already broken on my pair leading to loose feeling shoes.  Just a poor design for an active hiking shoe.

product_title: Gootium Retro Canvas Handbag ,Garment Washed
review_body: A very nice bag. It is good looking and light. Inside pockets are structured nicely. The leather straps are soft to touch.

product_title: ASICS Women's GT 2170 Running Shoe
review_body: great product, I must have about 10 different pairs of Asics.  They fit well, give great support (for weak ankles) & they look great!  I highly recommend these shoes.  I also love all the different colors I have found.  I am always searching for more colors.....:-)))  Thanks for a great product!

review_body: These shoes are rather lovely and fit very well! They'll go with anything in my wardrobe and make me feel like a Native American girl when wearing them:)Very satisfied!

review_body: I purchased these for my wedding and they were perfect. I ordered them and they arrived earlier than expected and the style was exactly what The style and comfort was perfect and it was more reasonable than going to a bridal specialty store. The width and height of the heel are perfect. I was very happy with them.

product_title: Earthies Women's Siena Platform Shoes,Alpaca Soft Calf,8 M US
review_body: I can't say enough about how much I love the arch support in this shoe brand! You'll like them best if you have high arches and need plenty of support.  Most comfortable high heel on the market--IF you can get a good fit.  I wear an 8 in just about every size, and in some styles of Earthies, but this style was too small (too short to be specific).  And for some reason, this particular style just didn't flatter my foot.  So I had to return them.  But I have to say that the craftsmanship on these shoes was exquisite, and the leather quality and color was beautiful.  The style and fit was just not for me.  If you order them, you'll need to size up 1/2 to a full size.

product_title: ECCO Women's Street Premiere Lace-Up Fashion Sneaker
review_body: The shoes are very comfortable and attractive. I use them for golf, but would not wear them in wet conditions as the soles don't have enough traction. The other Ecco spikeless golf shoes have a better sole.

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Cumulus 13 Running Shoe
review_headline: Great value on this closeout purchase
review_body: ASICS GEL - Cumulus 13 shoes are comfortable and reasonably light. Getting them for about 50% off retail price in a closeout sale makes them a superb value. Good cushioning and the 2E model is perfect for my wide feet. The mesh upper allows the shoe to stretch and make room for my wide feet. I tried the Nimbus but the stitched upper around the widest part of my feet was definitely tight and binding.

product_title: B.O.C. VARINA BC3530 Black 8 Medium
review_body: When this shoe came in the mail I was disappointed because it is NOT LEATHER. I don't know if the shoe is a counterfeit BOC but the I own many pairs of shoes by this maker, mostly because they are usually HIGH GRADE LEATHER. They are cute sandals, and I will probably keep them, but being 100% plastic, my expectations for comfort and wear are VERY LOW.

product_title: New Balance Men's MO1000 Multi-Sport Boot
review_body: This product is everything NEW BALANCE says they are, plus out-of-the-box comfort. If you have arthritis from the lower back on down, this boot provides great cushioning and stability.

product_title: Nine West Women's Sharina Platform Dress Sandal
review_body: These are the perfect shoes for summer work attire.  They go with everything and are very comfortable.  I travel for business and only need to pack these shoes.  Professional and not too high a heel.

product_title: Crocs Women's Jayna Slingback Flat
review_body: I was a bit sceptic to buy crocs- I mean the original styles are UGLY- these are nothing like that.  They are super cute and I get many compliments.  They feel cushy yet supportive.  I can run around in them, garden, go to the beach all much easier than flip flops, which is what I previously wore.  These actually have decent traction.  I've used these walking around quite a bit and no pain or overly sweaty feet.  As for the size, I'm usually a 9M and my toes just touch the end, which isn't a big blister causing issue because they stretch out.

product_title: Baby Banz Sunglasses Color: Pink
review_body: These sunglasses are nice for babies, since they have the strap. They do seem a little snug even though they have an adjustable strap. They are cute and seem durable!

product_title: Oakley Men's LSA Water Boot
review_body:
I live in Florida and frequently hike through very wet/swampy areas and have a difficult time finding a boots that can drain water and dry out fast enough to keep my feet comfortable. Water proof boots don't work in many of these areas because the water goes over the top of the boots and then they take forever to dry out and leave you with swamped feet. For a while I have been using Vietnam style jungle boots, but I sure am glad I found these as they are much more comfortable. The LSA Water boot drains water incredibly fast and also dry out extremely fast. In addition, they are very comfortable. The second day I had them I took them out into the sticks and wore them for about 8 hours and had no blisters or hot spots on my feet, and this was without any sort of break in period. They are great for warm weather climates because they breathe exceptionally well, keeping your feet quite cool. They are also very flexible and feel like you are wearing a comfortable sneaker more than a boot.
Overall, these boots are absolutely wonderful if you live in a wet and warm climate. I highly recommend them.

product_title: Saucony Women's ProGrid Guide 5 Running Shoe
review_body: Great looking shoe. Very light weight and comfy considering it is a much less bulkier shoe than some of the other styles of Saucony. I will probably purchase another pair down the road. Very fast arrival at my front door as well : )

product_title: Soft Camo Initial " B " Thick Flat Wallet Clutch Purse Hot Pink Camoflauge
review_body: I bought this item as a gift, and my daughter was thrilled.  It is stylish and unique.  There is plenty of space for all of your personal documents without being bulky, and compared to other clutch wallets of comparable quality was a fabulous deal for the price asked.  Would definintely reccomend it to others who enjoy camouflage accessories.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel Resolution 4 Tennis Shoe
review_body: On the advice of my podiatrist, I purchased these sneakers because he told me that they would be good for the kind of foot I have and would also accommodate my new orthotics.  I am very happy with these sneakers as they are very lightweight and allow me to move easily on the court.  Several people I know have these sneakers, but Amazon had the best price for them.  I am very pleased!

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Tornament Boot
review_headline: Wore them all winter and most of the spring
review_body: I got these in black. They're beautiful, comfortable, and go with everything I have. Top that off with the compliments I get every time I wear them, and you've got a real winner.

product_title: World Industries Men's Shogun Mid Skate Shoe
review_headline: Coffee in my cup World Industries on my feet.
review_body: I love the way they feel, now my nephew has them . They will be enjoy'd from one to another.  Now what to do about his pants.

review_body: These shoes are very comfortable however there is a problem.  A week after I bought the shoes, they developed a very loud creaking noise from within the sole.  It sounds like new sneakers on a freshly waxed floor to be exact.  It does not matter if you are on a hard floor or carpet, the noise is the same.  This is the first pair of Nike shoes I have ever bought and I'm going back to New Balance.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Prepair II Sandal
review_body: Bought these sandals for relaxing at home. They're very comfortable! I have flat feet and bad knees and they offer adequate support. Based on other reviews saying that these sandals run small, I bought a pair that's a size larger than my usual shoe size. They are just a little too big, but I think that they would have been too small if I bought them in my regular size. Very happy and highly recommended.

product_title: Big Buddha Women's Baily Flat
review_body: I own two pair, a cream canvas and the black fuzzy ones.  Okay, they run small, I went a 1/2 size up. But, this is something that I have experienced with most of my Big Buddha shoe purchases.  Nonetheless, once you find your right size, these feel like wearing a house shoe or something. I kid you not! Simply put, these are the most comfortable flats I own and very stylish too.  At first that big bow looks funny, but when you get them home, it is quite flattering and unique. I love these shoes!

product_title: Yellow Box Women's Custard Flip Flop
review_body: These are the most comfortable sandals! I never liked sandals with the strap between the toes but I decided to try them again since it's hard to find cute sandals without the toe strap. After a day of getting used to the toe part, these are so comfortable I wish I could wear them year round! The sole is firm, but soft, and the crystal design is elegant. I get tons of compliments on these. I will be buying more Yellow Box sandals next summer! Highly recommend.

product_title: Buxton Heiress Ensemble Clutch Wallet
review_body: This is the 3rd clutch of this type that I have purchased over the years.  I love the design and layout of this clutch. There are places and pockets for everything you need in a nice wallet.  There are nice places for your credit cards, pictures, paper money and coins.  I could not find one at my local department store this time so searched it out online and ordered it.  There is not another clutch of this type that compares that I have found.

product_title: ECCO Men's Yucatan Sandal
review_body: Bought these as a replacement for my previous for a similar pair of sandals which I had for over ten years, and had more than a thousand or more miles of walking on various terrains on them.  These sandals are slightly different in that a piece of material is not included on this model (as are still on the previous pair) yet it has the same model number so I suppose that ECCO took off the piece.  It is not a big deal, yet worth mentioning. An Amazon Prime item.

product_title: Bordello by Pleaser Women's Teeze-06 Platform Pump
review_headline: Sexy shoe, but doesnt fit right.
review_body: I ordered these shoes in Red pat and they are super sexy and super tall.  I read the reviews prior to purchasing and did as suggested and ordered a full size larger than my own.  Glad I did.  Length wise they fit perfectly. My only problem with this shoe is that the top of the shoe, the part that lays directly on top of your foot, does not fit.  That part sits a full quarter inch above my foot which looks rediculous when trying to show off the shoe.

product_title: Michael Kors Grayson Large Satchel in Vanilla
review_body: It is pretty in the photo but it wasn´t new! Well the one I bought is used, old, stained, and the metal is scratched.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Gota Wedge Sandal
review_body: Great casual shoe for  work or just hanging out. Works well with skirts or jeans.  Comfortable height a little hard but I guess with time and a bit more wear they'll soften-up. The fit was true to size.

product_title: New Balance MT00 Minimus Shoes
review_body: I had the MT10 for a year and a half and loved them.  I don't run much but I am a personal trainer and wear them every day.  They held up great aside from the sole getting very thin.  I was very excited for the MT00 with the 0 drop so bought these immediately.  It has only been about 5 months and the upper nylon mesh material is tearing open on the inside and outside right about my big and little toes.  I haven't done anything unusual and I know these are made to be lightweight but I wish I had gone with the road version now.  I also find the position of the rubber pads on the bottom strange.  They have more on the outside of the shoe rather than the inside.  The foam where there are no rubber pads also tears very easily.  I love the minimus concept and fit but these let me down.

product_title: Danner Men's Kinetic GTX 8" Plain Toe Uniform Boots
review_body: I got one pair from a local retailer.  They are comfortable, but did not have the ankle support I wanted (not a deal breaker for me though).  Upon the first shine, the finish flaked off in a couple days.  I emailed Danner, and they gave me pointers to fix this problem.  Upon taking their advice, one boot would shine and the other would not!!.  Danner sent a replacement pair, and this replacement had flaws in the leather, glue all over, and one of the soles was molded on crooked.  Danner customer service is not what it used to be.  I swapped the boots for some bates at my retailer, and am sending the old ones back to Danner.  It took me over a month to get this far with Danner.  No more Danners for me...I can't take the risk that I will be down a pair of boots for over a month again.

product_title: Nine West Women's Facefoward Pump
review_headline: Very Cute... but don't let that fool you
review_body: I bought these shoes to wear to a wedding and I was very excited because after looking at them online I thought they were so cute! But once I received them I was disappointed. Normally I can wear Nine West shoes, but these were VERY narrow, there were no room for my toes in the front of the shoe. I got them in the light natural leather, and when I tried them on the leather creased very badly and had lines in them when they were on my feet. Unfortunately I would not recommend these shoes.

product_title: Dockers Men's Gordon Cap-Toe Oxford
review_body: I purchased the Cordovan. Walked about 30 ft around the house and the leather/finish where your feet bend already showed signs of extensive wear/cracking. This is not the normal breaking-in wear. I own other Dockers shoes and this never happened to them. The order was returned to Amazon as defective.

product_title: Clarks Women's Polar Lake Ballet Flat
review_body: These shoes are cute and comfortable, but the material is very puffy, so it makes my narrower feet look wide. I bought the regular width, but I probably could have gone narrow because of the extra room. I'll have to wait to wear these with pants/jeans because they look too frumpy with shorts.

product_title: Vince Camuto Louise Clutch
review_body:
This clutch is absolutely BEAUTIFUL. The first one I received had a 'blemish', I advised I would be returning it for an exchange, and they sent out a new one, before they had actually received my return.

The second one was 'blemish free', gorgeous, and I'm looking forward to 'wearing' it to my affair.

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Philomena Espadrille Sandal
review_body: I love these sandals they are so comfortable I have them also in yellow, wish they came in more colors.

product_title: FRYE Women's Maya Mary Jane Pump
review_body: Initially, I was very hesistant about ordering these shoes but I must say that I absolutely love them. They are very comfortable and well made.  Very pleased with the purchase.

product_title: White Mountain 'Gist' Women's
review_body: I needed a somewhat dressy pair of \\"brown sandals\\" for a wedding. I am generally a thong, or tennis shoe kinda gal, and these were perfect. Totally got me over the whole \\"I don't wear heels\\" thing. The balls of my feet hurt after a few hours, but I am reasonably certain they would have in any elevated heel. Product is sturdy and made it through the ceremony and a pretty wild reception and are no worse for wear.

product_title: Cole Haan Men's Tucker Venetian Slip-On Loafer
review_body: Right O, these are good shoes and very well made. They felt a bit small out of the box (I was initially annoyed) but after I broke them in I was sold. I've now had them for over three years and they are my comfiest all day shoes. Best of all they are not smelly! Would highly recommend them. If they feel smallish to begin with, give them time. Will be buying a replacement pair soon as I suspect I only have about 3 months of wear left in the soles of my current pair.

product_title: Lucky Brand Abbey Road Cross-Body Bag
review_headline: This is a FAKE Lucky Brand Bag
review_body: I was very excited to get this bag but when I received it and opened the box I realized it was a fake as I already have an actual Lucky Brand Abbey Road bag in Bourbon. Note the strap with the sliding leather band, in the original bag you will get a hook and clasp so that you can adjust the strap of your bag. Also the inside tag should be leather and not metal. This is still a nice bag but certainly not worth  it for only an $8.00 discount when you could have the real thing and the convenience of shortening or lengthening your strap. Will definitely be returning. Company should  state that this is an imitation and lower their price accordingly.

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Shirley T Boot
review_headline: They're so much prettier in person!
review_body: These boots are absolutely beautiful, comfortable, are of wonderful quality, and go with so many things it just ties the whole thing together!  They fit fairly true to size for me, and they are fabulous especially for the price.  I couldn't be more enthusiastic.  I really love Naughty Monkey shoes, and these boots really are wonderful!  I would totally recommend them, but the calves are a bit small.  That's fine for me because I happen to have small calves, but for those who do not have small calves, I would say these might not be for you.  Overall though, I absolutely adore these boots, and will wear them often in the fall and winter.

product_title: Nike Girls Air Jordan 3 Retro Gs White Crimson
review_body: I had to wait for the price of the shoes to lower because of purchasing for a child.  Once they arrived, my daughter was so excited that she has been wearing them religiously!  They look nice!

product_title: adidas Women's Marathon 10 Running Shoe
review_body: The shoes are very confortable, light weight. Got them 4 weeks ago and since that time I can not complaint about this purchase.

product_title: LARGE LEATHER HANDBAG
review_body: Perfect size, it has plenty of compartments. Not only two sides but a zipper pouch inside and a strap to close the whole thing. Very trendy, goes with me everywhere..

product_title: Dansko Women's Sonja Clog
review_body: Excellent product. Very comfortable to wear, especially for nurses. I highly recommend them. Also I live overseas and Amazon ships very quickly without any hassle, even shoes.

product_title: C Label Women's DITA-20 Sandal
review_headline: not what i was looking for
review_body: I wanted some black flat sandals for the summer. These were flimsy. The zipper seemed as if it would break with continuous wear. The fabric was synthetic with a brushed suede feel and the sole was very thin. No arch support whatsoever. And they were extremely snug on my foot and between the toe. My feet are average size but I'm sure even a narrow foot person would find it difficult to find comfort in these shoes.

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Tappy Wedge Sandal
review_headline: AK Anne Klein woman's Tappy Wedge Sandal Black 6M US
review_body: The best shoes ever! Comfortable, stylish and goes with everything! Bought it for a wedding. I have troubles with my knees and could not wear the high heels any more so these were perfect. I danced all night!

product_title: Dr. Scholl's Men's Travis Lace-Up
review_headline: Sturdy shoes, I just never managed to break them in.
review_body: These shoes were nice enough. I just never managed to break them in. Despite my best efforts they always remained uncomfortable. They are excellently constructed and even though I returned mine, I have no doubt they would last a very long time.

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Pammyy Wedge Pump
review_headline: Bought for girlfriend for her Birthday
review_body: She loves the shoes. I believe they run about a 1/2 to big. I'm not sure I know my girlfriend has small feet and they were small so we went up a size. and they were perfect. She plans to use them for teaching etc as she just finished school and doing internship and planning for a job, etc. I'm not a shoe expert but apparently wedge heels are more comfortable to work in. Take that for what you want.

product_title: Teva Women's Churn Water Sneaker
review_body: I have been searching for shoes like this for a long time! Great for multi-outdoorsy sports, pull-laces makes it very convenient, and it's also very light and can also be worn as slip-on! It is scratchy when you go sockless but what you can do is use a nail filer and just smooth out the areas that irritate you. You have to be careful filing down as you don't want to tear any threads, but it does the magic getting rid of the rough spots. The sizing tag is sewn right by the inner ankle area so I had to file the tag down a little and it's good to go! Loving it and it's also a very nice color; the picture is true to color and size. I ordered the Teva Women's Churn Water Shoe Bungee Cord in 8.5 medium.

product_title: Crocs Women's Adrina II Flat
review_body: Wonderful shoes...very comfortable. I use for casual outings,rainy day wear, poolside and gardening. Easy to clean.I plan to get in other colors.. I order 1/2 size smaller.

product_title: Dr. Martens Men's Heritage Steel Cap Oxford
review_body: I am finally replacing my pair after almost four years of use because the leather finally wore through in a few places and the holes don't give the best impression. I wear these in a factory/office setting and the soles still are in good shape. I have worn Doc Marten shoes & boots for years and this is the only brand I will buy for work wear. As the other reviewers stated these are heavy shoes(~4 lbs) so at least you will burn some calories wearing them. The air sole lends a lot of comfort especially when you need to stand/walk for hours. They are also warm during the winter. The only issue I had breaking them in was that the top of the cushioned heel rubbed against the back of my ankle pretty hard at first. I have converted a lot of redwing/caterpillar/timberland people to these shoes since theirs wear out in less than a year while mine kept on trucking.

product_title: J.litvack Women's Bali Ballerina Flat
review_body: In person these shoes look just as good as their picture, maybe better if that is possible. Super cute! However they do run very small for the size. I ordered up a half size since I plan to wear without hosiery. The 9 was so small that my mom who can barely keep a  8.5 on her foot is now happily wearing them. I know I could have returned the small 9's without a problem ( cause Amazon is awesome Iike that) but these shoes are so pretty I didn't have the heart to send them back. Mom is a happy lady and I'm going to reorder in a 10(!) for myself. Bon chance!

product_title: Tretorn Skymra SL Puffer Lace-Up Fashion Sneaker
review_body: first time to buy tretorn shoes,very comfort, but you should take 1/2 size up, worth its price i will buy another one :)

product_title: Banana Republic Men's Gibson Whiskey Driving Loafers
review_body: I bought the shoe from BR online and bought two pairs. At first I was afraid that the shoe wouldn't last because of the design, the front of the shoe will make contact with the pavement as you walk. Since the front part of the shoe isn't protected, I thought the shoe will wear out in a relatively short period of time. However, I've worn the shoes for about half a year now and they still work and look great!

product_title: Antonio Zengara A401554 Men's Dress Slide Tan Size 7M New!!!
review_body: I which they came black and Dark brown

product_title: Iron Fist Turquoise Muerte Punk Platforms
review_body: I was surprised how stable and comfortable they are. They are super cute, but they say if you are a half size to order up one. My feet are wide, and they still smack off my heels when I walk. So I'm going to need to put some insoles in them to fill them up a bit. All and all though, not bad. I'll definitely order a 7 on my next pair though.

product_title: Ed Hardy Women's Celestial Heel
review_body:
I just got these this week, and I am love with them~
The size 8 is just a tad too big, so I had a little heal slippage, but with inserts they fit better.
Such a comfy shoe for being so high and man made material. I will definitely purchase another pair, but maybe in a size 7.
With all the colour combinations, the selection is endless : )

product_title: Crocs Men's Yukon Slide
review_body: I have been a sandal wearer for years.  This one rises to the top.  Endless comfort.  I normally wear a 9.5; as directed, I ordered a 9 and it fits.  Worth every penny.

product_title: Teva Women's Hurricane XLT Sandal, Hazel Black, 9 US
review_body: These sandals are very comfortable and fit me perfectly. I love the way Teva sandals conform to your foot. They also have great treads that hold when you are walking or hiking on varied terrain. My last pair lasted through 4 years of fairly heavy abuse (including wearing them to wade and swim into rocky rivers) before one of the straps wore nearly through and I'm hoping for the same from this one.

product_title: New Balance Women's WL201 Lace-Up Sneaker
review_headline: New Balance: One More Great Item
review_body:
My daughter was asking for New Balance sneaker for her shool.

When she tried the shoes, feel great and she loved it very much.

Thanks Amazon!

product_title: The SAK Casual Classics Small Hobo
review_body: The SAK is a great bag.  It holds a ton of stuff and has a wide opening so you can see and grab any of it easily.  There's an outside pocket big enough for a smartphone and more.  There are also 2 slide pockets and one zipper pocket inside in the silk-like lining that are also roomy and very functional.  The design is such that you just plunk down the bag and it flattens out and stays  .. no more fumbling with a purse at the store registers.  I like the pattern and colors of this bag, it's great for summer.  I've also seen the same style in a taupe and it looks great as well.  Highly recommend.

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Badlands Wedge Sandal
review_body: I LOVE THESE! and hate it that no one carries my size any longer.  My foot is broken down and this is the only dress shoe I can wear.  I found a second black pear in 8.5 but can no longer find brown or bone.  I even wrote to Aerosol.  They seriously need to make the Badlands style available again.

product_title: Charles David Women's Alani Wedge Sandal
review_body: Great shoe. Can be worn to work or out with a maxi dress. Very light weight. Straps are soft and won't give you blisters. One star off as it make the flip flop thacking sound when you walk and I don't like to be heard coming and going. They are very pretty and look durable.

product_title: Men's SKECHERS GO Run
review_body: This shoe is incredible. I have worn sketcher shape ups for a few years and enjoyed them. The go=runs are just as well made and have virtually no weight. My size 13 shoes weigh about 7 ounces each. Support is solid. Takes a little getting used to but the investment of time is well worth the effort.

product_title: Dr. Martens Women's Triumph 1914 Boot
review_body: I have 18\\" calves so I searched and searched and searched and searched for a pair of boots that would be comfortable in when riding my bike.  I finally settled on these because they were lace-up and I thought they might do the trick.  I love these boots, but unfortunately, I cannot lace them all the way up around my tree-trunk calves.  They are super-comfortable around the feet.  That part is perfect.  I can get them laced up to the 4th eyelet down.  Since I'm wearing them with jeans, I'm keeping them.  There is a break-in period while the shaft softens.  I just wore tall socks and folded them down to protect the back of my ankle. That worked just fine.  As to the color (black noir), I get lots of complements on them.  The way they are wearing the white wax off makes them look kind of silvery and cool looking in an understated way.  If I had normal size legs, or if they had fit around my calves they would have been given 5 stars.

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Guess What Wedge Sandal
review_body: When I saw the product on the page, it sounded sooo good, stating they were leather, they looked beautifull, etc... So I decided to buy one pair for me and another as a gift for a friend for her birthday. I received the product and eventhough they didn't feel like real leather I decided I might be mistaken and still gave the shoes to my friend. My huge surprise which at the same time was one of the biggest embarrasment's of my life was that my friend called me and told me that they deceived me since she used the shoes ONLY once and they started to fall apart, THEY WERE ACTUALLY PEELING OFF!!!. Since I hadn't wore mine yet, I decided to try them on for a day and the same thing happened. They are not real leather. I was really pissed OFF to find out like this since the main reason I bought them was because the amazon page stated they were leather....

product_title: adidas Men's +P Absolute XTRX SG Soccer Cleat
review_headline: My favortie shoe of all time
review_body: I had a pair of these and whore them totally out.  I'm so glad to finally find another pair!  Super soft and comfortable, my favortie boot of all time.

product_title: KEEN Sula Shoe (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: Keen makes sturdy little shoes for toddlers.  I got the camo style for my daughter.  She's 18 months and walks everywhere.  These shoes hold up well and will certainly be passed on to future kids.  After a month of hard use, the only sign of wear is some slight scuffing at the toe.  The actual shoes look just like the picture.  The top strap is the only one that actually tightens, the bottom one is just for decoration.  Still, the shoes never fall off unexpectedly and we bought a size up.  Excellent choice, in my opinion, especially if you like to pass out-grown stuff on.

product_title: Poetic Licence Women's Exclusive Delight T-Strap Sandal
review_body: Saw them last year but did not have the extra cash to purchase.  I was not able to get the color that I wanted but brought my second choice - pink.  Love the shoes but the fit is not all that I expected.  Had to order insoles for a more comfortable fit.  They do not run true to size but a little larger.

product_title: Naya Women's Lark Ankle Boot
review_body:
Ordered the Naya Women's Lark Ankle Boot,Black,10 M US
Received a sandal, Naya Alpine Womens Open Toe Sandal, Medium
Of course these 2 look so much alike, I can see how they confused them hahaha.
Shame on me for not reading the previous review.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Incites Fitness Walking Shoe
review_headline: Comfortable for long walks and easy to clean
review_body: Got this pair of shoes for workouts after my husband recommended Skechers Shape-Ups. He has been wearing them for quite a while now for long walks. He is suffering from plantar fasciitis and the rubber soles really helps to ease the pain under the heel. This is a much affordable alternative to other shoes sold in the market for his condition. I am enjoying it too myself as they are really comfortable. It's also easy to clean! - Vivian

product_title: Kavu Seattle Sling (Forest Paisley)
review_body: I bought this for when I travel. I love everything about this bag, except the fact the on the 2nd day I had started using this the fabric near the zipper broke and I had to safety pin it for the rest of my trip.  otherwise, I love this bag, it has a ton of storage and hangs perfectly on your body (I wanted something that hung in front of my and not behind).  It's great for travel and light weight.

product_title: Clarks Women's Trophy Prize Slingback Sandal
review_body: These shoes were all I expected, having bought other Clark shoes in the past. I have a narrow foot, so it's hard for me to find shoes that I like in my size. I bought the sand color and it has a contrasting brown trim, so I can wear them with brown or tan slacks. I am very pleased with these shoes. Great fit, great look.

product_title: Merrell Men's Moab Ventilator Hiking Shoe
review_body: Overall a good shoe for my intended purpose. About 50% asphalt and 50% trails made mostly of fractured rock and decomposed granite. First, the fit. My usual shoe size was a little snug right out of the box. The shoe loosened up within a couple of days, but I probably could have tolerated a half size larger. Width across the toe box is a little more on the snug side. Comfort: Really not too much break-in required. Comfortable yet solid. Note that I immediately removed the Merrell insoles and inserted Superfeet (black). Feet don't get abnormally hot or sweaty. I don't know why they call them \\"Ventilator.\\" They certainly don't have any magical foot cooling properties, but they are not abnormally hot. Traction: I would have to say the traction is very good. I'm usually ascending or descending loose rock trails of up to 10% grade and the soles seem to have very good traction on this type of surface. Haven't done any mud or wet grass. In summary- good value for the price paid. I would suggest ordering a half size larger.

product_title: Brinley Co Womens Strappy Platform Stilettos
review_body:
These shoes are so comfortable! I just tried them when they got here, but did not have the chance to really go out wearing them. So far, they are incredibly comfortable even though they are amazingly high!(which is not a problem for me since I am short)

I got scared at first and I thought I wasn't gonna be able to wear them, but as I already said lots of times, they are really comfortable. I don't know if I will be able to dance with them, but I will give them a try. Most likely, I will.

Oh, and they are just beautiful!

The seller is reliable, and the product got here fast.

product_title: OluKai 'Ohana Sandal - Men's
review_body: probably the most comfortable sandal ive ever had. from FL so pretty much live in sandals so comfort is key and these are perfect right out of the box, no breaking in bs like with some other brands. Good in and around water, no slippage. Light weight materials but feel durable and well made so i am more than satisfied with my buy

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Branchlet Thong Sandal
review_body:
I bought a pair of these in black last summer before a trip to Las Vegas (which anyone who has been there knows that it is a ton of walking!). Every year before this I mangled my feet in shoes and sandals that I thought would be comfortable only to end up buying the gift shop's entire supply of bandaids. Because these were so darn cute in the picture, I bought them and am so glad that I did. Despite all the walking, I was comfortable and my feet were happy. I did have a slight bit of irritation on the top of my foot from the flower however, that has never happened again and I have been living in this sandals all of this summer so far.
I ended up buying another black pair as a backup for when my current pair gets too beat up and I couldn't resist this bone color and the price was too good to pass up. You will not regret these sandals, they are as comfortable as they are cute.

product_title: J. Furmani Women's 19292 Satin Flap Clutch
review_body: Beautiful bag...looks just like the picture!  I buy all my evening purchases from Amazon.  It holds everything you need for an evening of fun and glamour!

product_title: Saucony Men's Progrid Ride 4 Running Shoe
review_body: I bought a new pair of the ride 4 and it has been disappointing.  the heel and outside edge of my whole shoe flattened out within the first weeks of having the shoe.  The 3 was a great shoe for long distances and for neutral and mild protonators. I am a neutral toe runner and the prior version lasted for 4 marathons and training miles still. The new version has an uncomfortable upper and seems to have a more solid midfoot than front or heel.

product_title: ECCO Men's Ultra Terrain 1.1 Hiking Shoe
review_body: Looks really sharp and fits well!  Always been a fan of Ecco and will continue to buy their products.  Used to only buy dress shoed but this athletic shoe will be a staple in my closet as well.

product_title: Crocs Women's Adrina Flat
review_body: I love these shoes! Remember when we were kids and you wore those jelly shoes that cut your feet up? Well now they are back but they are comfortable! Love love love. Right fit right size

product_title: Beeko Osimo Sneaker  (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: My son has been wearing these shoes pretty much full time for the past few months. He loves the fit. He even commented on the fact that they haven't fallen apart. We just ordered another pair of this brand for Fall.

product_title: Harley-Davidson Women's Simone 8" Boot
review_body: I love wearing my Harley Davidson boots, no they're not for riding a motorcycle but I didn't buy them for that purpose either. Also I love wearing them on a rainy day they kept my feet dry, well made.

product_title: Teva Women's Hurricane XLT - Hazel/Black
review_body: This classic Teva is so comfortable. They last and wear a very long time. They are great for all outdoor activities.

product_title: Sanuk Women's Yoga Spree Thong Sandal
review_body: These shoes are very comfortable but after having them for a couple months now the bottom is separating :( I would also say they run a little big the strap doesn't fit my foot that well.

product_title: ASICS Men's Gel-Blur33 Running Shoe
review_body: All I can say is these shoes feel fantastic for the light running, rope jumping and treadmill work I've used them for. I wish I had shoes that felt like this when I used to run a lot more than I do now! These shoes really do fit like a glove and absorb shock quite well!

product_title: Bakers Womens Dominic Platform Bootie
review_body: Love these boots they are sleek, sexy and go with anything. Really feel good on your feet. Love them get a pair if you want a awesome boot.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-DS Trainer 17 Running Shoe
review_body: I love these shoes, Asics just keep getting better and better.  I have had multiple pairs of running shoes and these never give me blisters, shin splits or pain anywhere.  They are narrow, light weight and the colors are great, the front is darker gray than the picture shows which I like.  SUPER COMFY!

product_title: Ashworth Men's Cardiff Golf Shoe
review_body: Purchased from Zappo's, on sale.  Out of the box and on my feet.  Feet said, \\"Thanks, these feel great!\\"  I've been wearing the shoes around the house for most of the day to break them in and so far, no problems.  Tomorrow, I'll try them out on the golf course.  The waterproof guarantee, rather than water resistant, was also a feature I wanted.  I'm not sure the lack of spikes will affect my game, but with my handicap, I'll risk it. -:)  The style is also a definite plus.  Hope all your putts are for birdies!

product_title: Sanuk Men's Standard Denim Slip-On
review_body: They work with jeans, they work with shorts!  You can wear them anytime and they are wonderfully comfortable.  Just like all other Sanuk products they are well made and look great!

product_title: The Flexx Women's Rapid Espadrille Flat
review_body: Shoes stretch and should be bought one half size smaller. Good quality, but the black color comes off on your feet.

product_title: Sanuk Women's Ibiza Sandal
review_body: I've never been able to wear flips before now!  These shoes have become my summer uniform!  They are soft, light, squishy, and the Ibiza strap keeps them on my feet without putting pressure on that tender skin between my toes.

product_title: Sakroots Artist Circle Large Wallet
review_body: Love it--exactly what I was looking for for a summer wallet. I usually won't get a wallet that isn't leather, but this is very cute and, since it's coated fabric, should stand up fine. It isn't quite as roomy as I like, but maybe that's a sign I need to carry less crap:)

product_title: Prestige Medical Colored Full Frame Adjustable Eyewear
review_body: I bought these thinking they would be good for soap-making (and cheaper than the goggles sold on soap-making sights) but I don't think they are going to work.  Don't get me wrong, these are GREAT inexpensive safety glasses, BUT there are still gaps when you are wearing them.  Not good when working with a lye-mixture and a stick blender :(  So, I've since bit the bullet and bought 'onion goggles' which do NOT have safety glass but are completely sealed all the way around the eyes while still slipping on and off like glasses.

product_title: Franco Sarto Women's Axel Open-Toe Pump
review_headline: Cute, not the color for me
review_body: I think that these shoes are adorable, but as I continue shopping for a darker brown shoe, I couldnt help but notice the slight red hue in these... They are comfortable on, dressy enough or casual enough for either night out, but the hue wasnt the right color.

product_title: Messenger Like Purse with 2 Tiers of Ruffles and Studs - Black
review_body: Love the purse and style except what ruined it is the cheap gold rings on the ruffles are falling out and I have only used the purse for 2 days...  Ridiculous

product_title: Georgia Boot Men's Muddog Work Boot
review_body: Used Amazon App on my I phone . Scanned the bar code and found a $10 savings at Tractor Supply In Millville NJ. $89.95 . http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004AU4KUW/ref=cm_cr_rev_prod_title

product_title: Under Armour Men's UA Micro G Split Running Shoes
review_headline: Good shoe that holds up to a lot
review_body: My husband goes through gym shoes like nothing I've ever seen before.  He just wears them out so quickly.  We bought these a while ago for him to work out in (he ended up not liking them for what he was doing, but that was his own fault for buying running shoes for cross training).  Instead of wearing them to work out, he wears them for work or bike rides or on the rare occasion that he goes running.  They have held up really well - going on 6 months (maybe more) and not many signs of wear yet.  He says they are really comfortable, and he's pretty picky about that - it's hard to find shoes that fit his feet correctly.  These are his third or fourth pair of UA shoes and he continually goes back to the brand for comfort and quality - and at a good price, too.

product_title: Bostonian Men's Dennison Dress Lace-Up
review_body: Have owned many Bostonians over the years. Predictable high quality, classic look. Consistent sizing. Comfortable all day. Will last with minimal care for years. Difficult to find a quality men's dress shoe with a leather sole for a reasonable price. Looked in several shoe outlets stores and got the best price on Amazon. Highly recommend.

product_title: 2 Retro Style White Frame Clear and Dark Lenses Sunglasses
review_headline: I guess you get what you pay for..
review_body: These glasses look really cool out the box.  They have a great, snug fit when you put them on and they definitely make a statement.  They are just made very, VERY cheaply.  If you drop them, or mush them against anything in the slightest, expect some sort of damage.  I would have given them a 4/5 easy if they weren't so fragile.

product_title: Carrera WSJ Black Forever Mine Aviator Sunglasses
review_body: I still doubting of their authenticity they don't have the tag where they were made from.... maybe they are fake...

product_title: Dirty Laundry by Chinese Laundry Women's Beka Thong Sandal
review_body: I give them 4 stars for comfort, but only 3 for looks. I wore them all day at a wedding and they were perfectly comfortable. I was glad I was wearing a long dress so that the shoes weren't all that noticable.

product_title: ASICS Women's GT 2150 Running Shoe
review_body: I love the GT-2100 series of running shoes. They keep me stable when I run and last a long time. A lot of times on other shoes the mesh will get holes very quickly. The mesh on these shoes last longer. Over a 5 year period I bought the GT-2100's, the GT-2130's, and the GT-2150's. I am on my feel all day at work, plus I am up and down steps all day. I use my older 2130's for work and I bought the newer 2150's to run. It's just an all-around great sneaker.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Lennox Pump
review_headline: Comfortable - until the right shoe fell apart!
review_body:
These shoes were so comfortable, which were surprising given how tall the heel was.

However, after wearing them 1-2 times a week for 3 months, the bottom of the right shoe started to peel away...and within a few weeks, the stitching started to tear. The shoes are now unwearable.

This was strange as I bought the same brand, same style in a different color and have had no issues with that pair.

product_title: Tretorn Skymra Puffer Slip-On Fashion Sneaker
review_body:
Oh, how I loved these Tretorn when I got them. So perfect! But it is almost exactly two months later and the soles are pulling apart from the rest of the shoe in the exact same spot! They are starting to flop and make noise when I walk!!

I am really upset that I can't really do anything to fix and/or return them. I was even looking at more styles because these were, at first, so great.

product_title: FitFlop Women's Supertone Luxe Fashion Sneaker
review_body: Whether going for a walk, working around the house or just doing nothing, these feel good. As usual with FitFlop, the support is great, you get a little exercise if moving, and I think it just looks really cool.

product_title: Capezio Daisy 205 Ballet Shoe (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: Ordered these shoes for my granddaughter's first dance class.  They run a little small so I had to send the first pair back and get a size larger.  Perfect for a 3 year old.

product_title: Neil M Men's Rome Slip-On Loafer
review_body: This is my second pair (different color from my 1st pair). The fit is great for my foot which is slightly narrower than a D width. I've worn the previous shoe for two years on a near daily basis. It's worn well and still looks great. Comfort on both pairs is superb. This shoe felt like I was wearing slippers after putting them on for only a few minutes.

product_title: Hush Puppies Women's Dhyana Slide Sandal
review_body: fit great & are very comfortable....my feet swell every day so I really need a comfortable shoe & the price was cheaper on Amazon than other sites..so 5 stars all around!!!!!

product_title: Steve Madden Kid's Stephi Ballet Flat (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: Bought this for my daughter - wish they made them in adult sizes as they are really cute and well made. As for the sizing, I feel that they are on the big side - my daughter is actually a size 3 at the moment and this 4 is rather big(I'd rather big than small since she can grow into them). But, even I can just squeeze into them, and I'm a wide EU 37/US 7!

product_title: Pleaser Women's Seduce-420 Pump
review_body: These heels were awesome at prom. I turned heads and got so many compliments. My outfit was the talk of the night. My main concern was losing sequence from the shoes on the floor, but they're pretty strong and I've only managed to lose 2 or 3, and not noticeably!

product_title: Pearl iZUMi Men's All-Road Cycling Shoe
review_body: These shoes are indeed versatile. Very well made, easy to slip in and out of, and great for indoor and outdoor biking, even if you still don't have clipless pedal cleats bolted in. They could be a little rough to use on the first couple of days though, will give you some soreness and maybe blisters, but your feet will get used to it in a couple of days' use.

product_title: Ash Women's Divina Platform Bootie
review_headline: Beautiful but half size too small
review_body:
The leather is supple and beautiful, a testament to Ash's quality.
The only problem is with the size. I wear size 8 (38) in boots and other Ash styles and this style is half size too small.
I think it might have to do with the narrowness of the toe box.

review_headline: Can't walk without my Mephisto shoes/sandals
review_body: For years I have worn Mephisto shoes/sandals for 21 years.  Having weak ankles and other joint and back problems I struggled to find a shoe that helpd align my body right when I walk.  For a while the Nike Tennis shoe with the air support helped, but then they started cutting the opening different and they just didn't fit right around the ankle.  They had good support, but I couldn't wear them.  I tried \\"Birks\\" and they were too wide, tried Bass and they were so-so but not enough arch support, then bought a pair of Mephisto Heidi Sandals and they were \\"just right\\"!!!  I have bought Mephisto every since.  If I try to walk across the floor barefooted, it's hard, if I put a pair of them on there's no problem. That's why there is a pair beside my bed at all times.  I have had NO back problems since wearing them.  Do still have some ankle problems and knee from time to time, but I shutter to think how bad they would be with another shoe.  I'd rather have less pairs of shoes and have them comfortable, than more \\"cutie\\" shoes that kill my feet and reek havioc on my body.  Theses sandals, Hanka are great for a lil more dressy sandal.  I liked them so much I got both black and blue glossy.  I like the clogs for the cooler months.  Give them a try and I don't think you'll be sending them back.  Oh and the company has a great \\"retread\\" option that is quick and easy to do.  Enjoy

product_title: Squeeze It Coin Purse
review_headline: Good Product, But Shop Around for Best Price
review_body:
When I lost my 20 year old squeeze spiral coin purse last month, I searched far and wide to find a suitable replacement. I found this one, and another one: [[ASIN:B004FEXXUG Leather Squeeze Coin Pouch / Coin Purse by CTM]]. Because of the considerably different prices between these two seemingly identical items, I wondered if they were actually somehow different from one another- so I ordered one of each. I can now say with complete confidence that these are both EXACTLY the same product. They both come in the same yellow box labeled \\"Squeeze Coin Pouch\\", Item #92808. The UPC on the box is 008721928085.

This coin purse is a little smaller in diameter than the one I lost, and doesn't fold quite as flat. But it does the trick. Another reviewer mentioned an odor, but the two I received actually smelled good to me- like a brand new leather wallet.

Overall, this is a good product, but be sure you order the one that comes at the lower price.

I must say I love these glasses and feel that they rank among the best frames I've used, even better than some of the other metal framed Oakley's too. Now before you get your pitchforks and torches! Please hear me out as to WHY I like them, THEN feel free to burn me.

Firstly, they're comfortable... I have a big head (not my fault, I blame genetics!) and the shape and construction of the frame accommodates my face so well that at times I forget that I'm wearing them. They don't fit loosely, they fit snug, and this is because the frames expands slightly while gently applying tension to sides of my head effectively hugging it, plus they're very, very light. With the exception mirror coating the added touches are strictly aesthetic...but still pretty sick.

Thirdly but most importantly, the lens quality... Oakley in my opinion has always delivered the best in the lens quality department consistently. Once you've worn Oakley's (in case you haven't) other glasses tend to seem muddy in lens comparison whether it may of be $10 \\"gas station\\" quality, or in my experience, the $200 designer (I'm looking at you Bolle!). I simply love these lenses, and if you can, go for the polarized. The equiped lenses are on the darker tint so I find them very effective on sunny bright days, and the clarity and contrast is amazing! product_title: Vibram Fivefingers Komodosport Mens Running Shoes
review_body:
Short story: Yes, Vibram's are awesome, they have given me a new running life, and if you've been plagued with running injuries I'd suggest trying them.

Long story: I'm 47 years old and have been a \\"gym rat\\" since high school. About ten years ago a coworker told me about a local \\"Mud Run\\" and I thought it sounded good. Knowing I' was creeping up on the 40 year old mark and knew it would be a good time to start mixing in some cardio, so I signed up.

I went to Road Runner Sports shoe store, did the treadmill foot examination thing, and left with a pair of \\"Stability\\" shoes. I started slow and built my running up to ten miles a week by the 8th week and it was at this point my ITB started giving me problems.

Being a gym rat and somewhat of an athlete who understands the body and injury I began a long process of trying to run without pain. I did a lot of research on running websites, at running stores, and read books like Chi Running by Danny Dreyer. In the following years I tried to perfect Chi Running and tried every ITB stretch routine, roller pads, ice + Ibuprofen, countless shoes, and even took 4 months off of running. And although I was able to improve my pain free running distance, I still could not run 5 miles without experiencing a lot of ITB knee pain, so much that I couldn't run more than 6 or 7 miles on a good day, and my top pace was around 8:30 min/mile.

About two years ago I read a blog from a runner who said barefoot running eliminated his ITB issues by forcing him to run with a natural gait, stride, pace, etc. I figure I had nothing to lose, I've spent a fortune on shoes and a lot of time running, stretching, rolling, and eating Ibuprofen, so I bought my first pair of Vibram shoes, the Komodo sport in 2009.

Again, I'm a gym guy, so I know the risk of jumping into physical activities and doing too much too soon. I walked in them and wore them to the gym for about a month before attempting torun in them, and even then I started running on the treadmill first. I ran on the treadmill for about another month before my first road run. My first run was two miles and I monitored my body, specifically my feet, the whole way. It felt great!! I kept my runs short for the next four weeks, never running more than 2 miles, but increasing my pace (I use a Garmin GPS watch) and eventually got my two mile run down to 14:18, by far the fastest I've ever run.

I now own three pairs of Vibram shoes, the KomodoSport, the TrekSport, and the new SeeYa. I've only wore the SeeYa once, so I can't give a review yet, but I can say this in general, I have been running without ITB problems ever since. I live near Mission Trails regional park in San Diego so I've added trail running to spice things up. I'm currently training for my first half marathon this June, the Rock n' Roll in San Diego, and will be running the Camp Pendleton Mud run the week after that, all in my Vibram shoes.

BUT, and this is an important note, I've had one minor foot injury from stepping on an uneven road surface that kept me from running and was limping around for a few weeks, it hurt like hell! I'm also just recovering from a moderate calf strain that sidelined me for 5 weeks (probably was over doing it). Here's the deal folks, our feet have been in the equivalent of a cast for our most of our life. Our foot tendons, ligaments, muscles, and bones have not been used much and will take a while the strengthen, but the good news is they will strengthen and adapt if you're patient.

For me \\"barefoot\\" running changed virtually everything in my running economy. I believe I achieved \\"Chi Running\\" naturally because when I run in Vibram's I don't have the option of a heel strike, long strides, and I don't have the unnatural heel to toe drop of running shoes. I don't have to think about most of bad running issues because my natural instinct takes over the moment my feet sense the terrain. It's like being a kid again, running barefoot makes me feel like I'm playing again. My new goal is to improve my running economy even more by finding a way to lessen the strain on my calf muscles. Vibram's have definitely increased the use of my calf muscles, very sore, and getting more muscular, so be ready for that change too, a lot more calf stretches in your stretch routine will go a long way.

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Armenda Bootie
review_body: They look amazing, fit true to size, add an awesome six inches to my height, and have a tough rubber sole that doesn't skid or tick when I walk. The first day I wore them, I got a lot of compliments, and their uniqueness attracted a lot of attention. I love the way they look, and the added height. That being said, the first day I wore them is the ONLY day I've worn them, because I hate almost everything else about them. There is almost no padding inside, so the balls of my feet got really sore really fast - it was like standing on wood. I first tried them on with thin socks, and literally within the five minutes I spent walking around my house trying them out, my feet started to hurt. I switched to thicker socks to add a little padding, which only helped for about ten minutes. With a decent insole, they could be bearable, comfort-wise. The big problem with these boots is the way the heel is designed: the tough rubber sole plus the platform plus the covered wedge makes them very clunky, but the heel and instep are so tapered that the whole boot ends up feeling unsteady. I've never had an issue walking in heels, even very high stilettos, and I have excellent balance, so it was really unnerving to walk around in these things feeling like I was about to fall over at any second. The base is way too narrow for such a heavy shoe, and makes me walk in a really stiff, unnatural sort of way. Trying to go down stairs is slow and hellish, and although going up is much easier, it's still an awkward, wobbly adventure in which I cling to the handrail and pray I don't tip my foot sideways and sprain an ankle. Maybe with some good insole padding and a lot of practice, I'll get used to them, but as of right now, these are officially the most uncomfortable boots I've ever owned. :(

product_title: Dockers Men's Bastille Center Seam Run Of Toe Ox
review_body:
I'm a wedding photographer and I wear these shoes when I work. I'm on my feet for literally 8-10 hours during a wedding. Sometimes the only chance I get to sit down is at the reception - and only for a few minutes. For the rest of the day I'm walking, kneeling, and climbing with 20-30lbs of gear. In general, this is very tiring and hard on my feet and joints. Regular dress shoes kill my feet (they are sore for days, literally). These shoes are far gentler. While nice by themselves, I use them with a slim insole for even more padding. Note that the heel on these shoes is fairly low so you won't be able to run a very thick insole without your heel slipping. A thinner one is fine though and really makes these shoes comfy for demanding days.

In addition to ample padding, the sole of these shoes is as flexible as many tennis shoes. The compliant sole reduces stress points on your foot even further.

As far as looks go, the best way I can describe them is \\"modest\\". There are far fancier and better looking dress shoes out there, but they are either far more expensive, far more uncomfortable, or both. That said, these shoes are dressy enough to match well with black dress pants, fitted shirt, and tie.

The finish of the shoes has some texture to it. This is good because it hides creases and scuffs better than highly polished shoes. I find that while working I scuff my shoes up a fair amount. This would be heart breaking if the shoes were some fancy, $300 polished Italian leather shoes, but they aren't. These shoes polish right up with a little shoe oil and continue to look great.

If you find yourself working on your feet a lot and need to look good doing it, these shoes are a great investment.

product_title: Wanted Shoes Women's Babe Oxford Shoe
review_body:
Ok, if you like these kind of shoes, they are cute. They fit decently and are reasonably comfortable. But they have a strong odor that smells to me like gasoline. When I opened up the box, the gasoline smell seriously slapped up my nose. I thought that after a couple of days the smell would go away. It is perhaps less strong, unless I have somewhat become habituated to the smell, but the shoes still really stink. I got in the car wearing them and they made the inside of my car smell like gasoline. They are up in the bathroom right now and the bathroom smells like gasoline. Seriously.

When I did a Google search there are some listings about plastic products from China (like these shoes) being really smelly, especially since around 2005. The thought is that something about their manufacturing processes changed around then. One commenter wondered if the outgassing from these products is toxic. There doesn't seem to be a definitive answer for that. Another poster suggested putting baking soda in the shoes or wrapping them up in newspaper.

The bottom line is this: only get these shoes if you are willing to have and wear shoes that have a persistent gasoline smell from an unknown chemical or chemicals.

I would hope this shoe manufacturer could do better than to produce such stinky shoes!

product_title: Body Glove Edgewater Polarized Aviator Sunglasses
review_body: I was pleasantly surprised at the quality of these shades. A pair of polarized aviator's, for just under 30 bucks? I wasn't expecting much at all, but I was very pleasantly surprised. The fit nice. They look nice. The lense coatings were applied well.....no noticeable waves/runs/lines/etc ....Clear, sharp lenses and seemingly well made frames. The one kick in the pants I have for them, and the only reason they got a 4 instead of a 5, was their less than intelligent method of shipment. They put the glasses in a platic bag, dropped them in a super thin bubble lined manila envelope and shipped them UPS. No protection whatsoever! No....the thin bubble wrap doesn't count, when its lining a paper envelope! The glasses were amazingly \\"OK\\" when they got here, but it was PURE LUCK on the shipping departments part, and my good luck on the handling by UPS! They did need a bit of adjusting from where the frames had been bent a little, but when I saw what was in the envelope, I was shocked at how lucky I was that they weren't completely ruined. So...the moral of this story is: Hire someone to run your shipping department, who has the same common sense as the designer of these glasses, and you'll be in great shape!

I love that these are casual enough for jeans but also go with business casual for work.  I wish more shoes were as well made like this one.

product_title: Drew Shoe Men's Rockford Boot
review_body: If 4E widths have seemed to be your only choice and your shoes are still too tight, then search no more.  These are the most comfortable and roomy shoes that you will find.  I am in heaven.  I only wish that they made a non-insulated version with a higher ankle support for hiking and backpacking.

product_title: Clarks Women's Wish Mood Boot
review_body: Never unhappy with Clarks and these are super comfy. I wear them with slacks and jeans and they are super cute!

product_title: Lucky Women's Emmie Ballet Flat
review_body:
I ordered these in an 8.5, which is my usual size, and found them to be true to size.

I thought these were cute, but ended up returning them because the shoe is a very soft leather, and I prefer shoes with more structure.

If you're looking for a delicate leather slipper, this may be for you. They have a 'split' sole, making it possible to flex and point your foot with the shoe on (which might make these great for dancing) but for daily wear, these seemed a bit flimsy.

product_title: Seychelles Women's Dolley Mary Jane Pump
review_body: Comfy shoes, and they look great too! They feel true to size, the width is ideal, the leather is super soft, and does not bother the front of my feet. They look great with jeans, dresses and slacks. I wear them for over eigth hours a day and I'm always on the go at the office. My feet don't hurt at the end of the work day! Love them, greatly recommend them! great price too!

product_title: Anne Klein Sport Women's Dax Stretch Wedge
review_body: I really like the feel of these shoes, they are very comfortable. However they do have an horrible smell that nearly would give me headaches. I have worn these everyday to work for the past 3-4 months and the smell has slowly faded. However just yesterday the heel on the left shoe collapsed. Now Im debating to buy an new pair or search for something simular.

product_title: Bobster Eyewear Sport and Street Goggles/Sunglasses BSSA001AC
review_body: The item and what came with it was great! The only thing that was TERRIBLE was the delivery and how long it took for it to arrive. The item first was not delivered on time and when I entered the tracking number to search for the item it was not available for three days. Please fix. I would recommend the item but not with this company!

product_title: Vera Bradley Villager Bag in Jave Blue
review_body: Really nice bag, it has lasted me a long time.  The only thing I do not like is it is too big, so I ended up using it as a diaper bag instead.
