review_body: Ordered these boots on Mar.1, arrived march 5, good timing, I eagerly awaited for these boots, the picture looks like a deep navy blue black,  they are nothing of the sort, I could not zip them up all the way, due to my thick calfs, looks cheap, not like the piture, so I'll be sending them back tomrrow.

product_title: Jo Ghost Men's 1224 Boot
review_body: The quality of these shoes is just great, as a Italian shoes should be, the style and  fit are great, true to the size...

product_title: Isotoner Men's Microsueded Boot Slipper
review_body: Was the perfect gift for my 87 year old father at Christmas, he loved the slippers and the soles have good traction

product_title: New Balance Men's MX623 Cross-Training Shoe
review_body: I have worn a white pair of these type shoes for years and wanted a brown pair for work. They are just as comfortable as the white pair I own.

They were a little snug across the arch for his wider foot but fit very well after he took out the leather tie.  Nice support inside and reasonably soft outside.  Not so stiff they are uncomfortable (or feel like a regular shoe), not so soft that they won't hold their shape.

product_title: Reef Women's Gypsylove Sandal

review_body: I love the look of the flip flops but the strap is coming apart after only wearing them 5 times. I believe the ones I got were defective because otherwise they seem durable. I posted a picture of the strap.

product_title: Sanuk Men's Vagabond Slip On
review_body: These are cool, comfortable and stylish. Husband just loves them and will be buying more in different styles and colors!!

product_title: Franco Sarto Reba-Barley Womens Size 8 Tan Wedge Sandals Shoes
review_body: These shoes are so fun and comfortable.  Love the style.  They match everything!  The strap around ankle fits great.....love love love them.

product_title: Matisse Women's Thunder Road Boot
review_body: These boots are super style-y and really comfortable. I love the metal flat stud detailing and the dark, rich color is so nice. They are flattering and totally wearable. They look great with leggings, skirts, and skinny jeans. My 14 year old son and husband both liked them too (hard to get them to agree!) I have a medium / narrow foot, calves and thighs, and they fit nicely. The leather is a good, supple but smooth quality. I'm totally happy with them!

product_title: DC Men's Lieutenant WR Water Resistant Shoe
review_body: These are great kept me warm in the montreal quebec temperature, but they dont last long, the sole tend to lift up and the inner material get used fast.

product_title: New Balance Women's 550 Sport Shoe
review_headline: Great shoes, but not for me.
review_body: First of all, I really liked the shoes.  They looked great and seem well made.  I ordered a wide size, but they still seemed very narrow to me.  My feet aren't really THAT wide.  They fit my daughter, who has narrow feet, perfectly.

product_title: Salomon Women's XA PRO 3D ULTRA 2 Trail Runner
review_body: I love these shoes! They are quite possibly the nicest running shoes I've ever owned. Took my feet a little time to get used to the arches in them (I'm practically flat-footed), but once I did they are extremely comfortable. The laces are fantastic! What a great design, no worries about them getting loose during my workout. The only small problem I found was that a few of the minor aesthetic threads became loose within my first month of use, but didn't affect the shoe at all, just the look.

product_title: Prada PR27NS Sunglasses
review_body: I absolutely love sunglasses, especially designer shades! So when I saw these on pinterest, I knew I had to have them! I actually bought mine off ebay (brand new still in box with cert. of auth.) for $192 and free shipping... I am in love! The lenses are definitely oversized, which I LOVE love LOVE!!! They are sooo cute and really look great on any face shape! My only complaint is that the frames seem to be a little large too, I'd say I have an average sized (female) head and they are constantly sliding down my nose, especially when I look down or even lean forward slightly.... But for these, I can deal :) happy birthday to me!!!

product_title: Loungefly Hello Kitty Quilted Face Tote Handbag
review_body: I love love love this purse. It is beautiful, especially for us older girls that love Hello Kitty! The product came in excellent condition and packaging. The fabric is awesome and the interior is too cute! Nice sized purse that can hold lots of stuff lol. I definitely enjoy this product!

product_title: NIKE RONGBUK (MENS)
review_body: These shoes meet my needs. I sometimes run on gravel and unlevel ground. These shoes take the difficult terrain very well. They help me keep balance while running/walking.

product_title: Reebok Men's Club C Classic Sneaker
review_body: I'm 64 and I've been wearing this exact shoe for over 40 years now. I buy a new pair every April and then use the old pair for yard work or anything else that's going to get them dirty. Absolutely love them! Most comfortable shoe in the world, at least for me. A plain and simple shoe that always looks good with jeans. Before I retired the very first thing I did when I got home was change clothes into jeans. Now that I'm no longer required to wear a suit I wear these shoes almost all the time. For the last several years I've bought them on-line from Amazon. No longer have to shop several stores to find this style in stock and in my size and usually save a few dollars this way too. Order them on the PC and about five days later they are at my door. I've had many salesmen in stores around the country tell me over the years that Reebok no longer makes the Club C which is bull, that store just no longer stocked it. Maybe I've been lucky but Amazon has always had it in my size when April comes along and it's time for a new pair.

product_title: Columbia Women's Switchback 2 Omni-Tech Trail Running Shoe
review_body: These shoes are very comfortable and light, perfect to take long walks.  I really like wearing them anytime.  100% recommended

product_title: Teva Women's Tirra Athletic Sandal
review_body: I love this sandal.  I have to wear a brace on my right foot/leg, so the sandal has to fit both feet, and this one works perfectly for me.  It is also very comfortable. I search for so long to find a summer sandal that I can wear, and with this one I really got lucky.  I got the green one just to save the money.. cannot believe you had to pay so much more for a different color. I am not really wild for the color, but it is growing on me, because it feels so good.

product_title: adidas Adiquestra 11 Soccer Shoe (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: Nice shoes, good deal! Everything perfect with the product, the shop and the shipping. I do recomend this soccer shoes for kids who loves kicking the ball!!

review_body: Bought the 10.5's, they were gigantic. I usually wear 11 or 10.5, so I thought these ran big. I had to return.  The style was ok, not overly impressive, but they were well made.

Be sure to order the right size, I had to return a previous pair and order a 4E size.  This type shoe seems to run a little small for the size but the 13-4E was big enough!

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Neo33 Running Shoe
review_body: Good value for the money.  Light weight, great arch support and look cute too. Highly recommended for running and going to the gyms

product_title: See Kai Run Morten Loafer (Infant/Toddler)
review_body:
Be forewarned, there are two very different types of See Kai Runs shoes--ones that are \\"cemented sole\\" shoes and one that are \\"stitched sole\\" shoes. These are the \\"stitched sole\\" type, and all of there stitched sole shoes are USELESS outside unless you live in a desert. The stitches let in water, even if you waterproof the shoes. The manufacturer even told me, after I emailed to complain, that the stitched-sole shoes aren't meant for outdoor play. Uh, hello? These are for toddlers. No outdoor play? Seriously?

What's worse is that if you live somewhere where it rains, you'll have trouble with these type of shoes even just walking to a car. The stitches let in the rain and then poor toddler's feet are soaked, even if your walk is short, even if it's not raining hard, even if they don't step in a puddle.

Totally impractical. I have no idea why they just didn't make *all* their shoes cement-soled shoes that would be suitable for outdoor use.

product_title: FASH Zebra Print Clutch Wallet with Checkbook Holder and Brown Trim
review_body: I love this wallet,it was exactly what i expected the only downfall about this product is the coins part its just a button to close no zipper but i would recommend it.

review_body: These Rocket Dog flip flops are, hands down, the most comfortable I have ever owned. They have enough cushion to keep you from feeling every pebble you step on, but not enough to make them bulky and difficult to walk in. product_title: Reebok Men's Classic Supercourt Sneaker
review_body:
I have many pairs of athletic/sports/walking/running/court shoes for various purposes but these particular Reeboks are the winner for total comfort, utility, and durability. The gummed outer sole is tough but grips well. The shoes are flexible for any activity but the main thing for me is the outstanding comfort level they provide. I have bad feet that ache all the time for various reasons, thus the ongoing search for the better pair of shoes that allows me some relief which these Reebok Supercourts most assuredly do!

They're my top choice among the stable of shoes I own for most anything I plan on doing that day: Weight training, elliptical, walking and even jogging around the outdoor track. Perhaps not optimum for running but the comfort is undeniable and to me, comfort trumps all other attributes in a shoe. So, slip them on, feel the nice fit and take 'em for a test drive as these are more than up to any daily task you ask of them. Highest recommendation.

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Vision Boot
review_body: I received this in an ultra timely manner and from day one it has not disappointed me yet. I bought it a half size bigger, because that's what I've always done with boots, but this time I should have gotten my actual size. So now I just wear a thicker pair of socks and it's fine. There will be no \\"breaking in\\" period, the comfort level is perfect right out of the box and it's easy to get on and off. Don't second guess yourself on this one and if you can, get the other color as well. Happy shopping and enjoy this one. :)

product_title: Height Increase Elevator Shoes Insole - 1 to 1.5 inches Taller
review_body: I ordered the adjustable 1-1.5 inserts. When I tried them in my shoes, my ankle came out of the shoe. It would be nearly impossible to wear these inserts (at the 1 or 1.5 inch level) in any of my shoes. However, I can wear the 1/2 inch attachment in my shoes comfortably and will be doing just that.

product_title: New Balance Women's WT20v1 Trail Minimus Shoe
review_body: I love these shoes.  I wear a size 9.5 or a size 10. Usually a size 10 in running shoes.  I bought these in a size 10 and there is a little room in my toes which I love.  NO squish!  I use them on the trail, on sidewalks, for step aerobics.  I have to admit, they do take getting use to.  The heel of my foot is tender in the evenings sometimes.  I am not a avid runner, although I pretend to be.  I am running a half marathon in March and plan on wearing these shoes, but I am working up to that distance.  This is my first pair of Minimus shoes.  I love them.  I would definitely recommend them to a friend.  In fact, I did, and she might purchase her own.

product_title: Drew Shoes Women's Angie Slip-On
review_body: These are a very good looking strong shoe, however they were just too narrow for me so I sent them back and promptly received a refund from Amazon

product_title: Ben Sherman Men's Arista Brogue Wingtip
review_body: I got these for my bf's 30th b-day and they were perfect.  The quality is great and the classic style make it a shoe that can be worn for years to come. I chose the Bordeaux bc it is more versatile than the black or tan and it is a more unique color. My bf has an oxford shoe that cost around $90 and they feel so cheap compared to these. review_body: I discovered these sanita anemone boots a few months ago during a random internet search, but couldn't justify paying full price for them. I am very, very pleased with my purchase!

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Rhythmic Cross Trainer
review_body: I love Asics and have owned more pairs than I can count. I was looking for a pair of shoes for Zumba and ordered the Gel-Rhythmics. I was a bit disappointed in this style. review_body: I am absolutely in love with this purse; however, within a week of receiving the purse, it is falling apart in two significant places that hold the bag together. product_title: Slim Jim Yellow Lens Tint Night Driving Sunglasses
review_headline: Slim Jim yellow night driving glasses
review_body: These glasses are great. They really sharpen things for me in low light conditions. The wrap around style is great and keeps my eyes from tearing due to the wind. I'd buy these again.

product_title: The Cool People Totole Men's Boot
review_body: I previously purchased two pair of boots by The Cool People in the Rodger, black and cognac.  I ordered this boot, Totole, in dark brown because the Rodger doesn't come in dark brown.  There is definitely a difference between the Rodger and Totole.  The Totole is less expensive and run true to size.  I ordered a 11D and it is an exact fit.  Unlike the Rodger, this boot does come with foot padding that is not removable. If you would like to add your own foot bed insert, order one size up, the boot is a little narrow in comparison to the Rodger; a little simpler in design, but is still very stylish. The leather is soft and the boot will require a relative short break in period.  The boot strings have a vintage appearance to them.  Like the Rodger, they look great with jeans. The pull tab on the back of this boot is made of leather, while the Rodger, more expensive, has a cloth pull tab; go figure.  The boots are comfortable enough for me not buy another foot bed.  The price difference between this boot, Totole and the Rodger, is very visible in person and according the pics of each.  Again, I didn't pay $199.00 for them which makes me very happy to have purchased them.  This boot was made in Romania.  I do think that it is possible to find a similar quality boot for at least 1/2 the cost without really looking too hard.  However, if your are big fan of The Cool People by Aldo, $199.00 shouldn't be an issue. The boot is constructed of leather, with a leather lining, both soft as stated earlier.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW927 Walking Shoe

product_title: Crocs Women's Patricia II Wedge Sandal
review_headline: Be careful with size - and a way to stretch those straps
review_body:
I read some reviews and on that basis, bought a size larger than usual. I wish now that I had not. They were longer than needed (of course, being a size larger) but still as tight in the straps. So I did the heat-and-stretch trick (I've written about this before in a review for another Crocs shoe a few years ago. I did not originate this solution, but am happy to publicize it, because it works!)

Put the shoes in the dryer for 3-4 minutes and while you're waiting, put two pairs of thick socks on. Take the shoes out of the dryer and immediately put them on. You can grab the straps (not too roughly) and pull them up over your socks. Leave the shoes on for a good half-hour. They will cool off leaving much more strap room.

Having done this, I now love the shoes. My feet have room to breathe. No blisters. I wish I didn't have the extra 3/4 inch of unnecessary shoe hanging out the heel, but oh well! I'll know to buy my usual size next time, and just stretch them to fit!

I probably should give the shoes 5 stars now, but I did have to do a little prepping before these became wearable.

I should also mention, the heat-susceptibility of Crocs is a factor to keep in mind (especially living in the Southwest heat.) Don't leave them in an enclosed car on a sunny day, or out on the patio when it's 110! They will shrink to little kid size! I tried heating them and stretching them out, and that worked to a degree, but they didn't feel or fit quite right afterward.

product_title: KEEN Men's Newport H2 Sandal
review_headline: Great for comfort, but not durable
review_body:
I don't write many product reviews, but I thought I'd chip in my two cents to help the next guy. I loved these sandals for their comfort and fit. I wore them on a couple of backpacking trips with 40 lbs on my back tromping through streams along the way, and I never had the slightest hint of a blister on my feet. My review of three stars is four three reasons: First of all, they only lasted about 18 months. Keen has an 12 month warranty, so don't expect them to outlast that by much (my day-to-day use was more sitting in a cubicle than backpacking through wet terrain). Second, they are heavy. These weigh a multiple of your standard flip-flop sandals and probably more than your tennis shoes. Third, and this is probably more me than the shoe, they tend to get very stinky. I don't know if they need a wash out hole in the toe or what, but they tended to build up gunk in the toe and really smell up the house.

All in all, I'd buy another pair, but for the price you should be able to expect more durability. They are cheaply glued together and will start the clock to fall apart the moment you put them on your feet.

product_title: Merrell Women's Moab Mid Waterproof Hiking Boot
review_body:
I've owned these shoes for about six months, and I've done everything I can think of to make them work for me. On our last trip, I was so frustrated that I ended up throwing them away while we were waiting for our flight in the Oakland Airport. So I'd say to think carefully before you purchase these. Or make sure you buy them at REI so you can return them if they don't work out.

When I tried these shoes on in the store, they seemed very comfortable. They had a nice wide toe box and seemed to have pretty good ankle support. I liked that they are waterproof. So I bought them, and the next day we went on a 14 mile hike. At the end of that hike, I had a HUGE blister on my left heel... I mean gigantic.. it covered almost my entire heel. And my toes felt weird and achy. I've never had this problem while hiking in any of my Keen shoes. I wrote it off as being a break-in process and tried again.. each time that same blister would reappear on my heel. I went into REI to ask them what they thought I should do (sadly I didn't purchase the shoes at REI or I could've just exchanged them).. the salesperson told me that this brand is known for having this issue, and recommended different insoles. So I spent another $50 to switch the insoles. This made the shoes more comfortable, and stopped my heel from blistering, but my toes still ached terribly after hiking in them. So I gave it several more months, but I finally had a meltdown while I was waiting for a flight and my toes were just aching aching aching. So I took them off right there in the airport and pitched them in the trash. What a waste of money.

review_body: I am wearing these boots now and are confortable enough to wear all day long.  The best part of these boots is their fit. If you intend to wear only nylon hose, then order a 1/2 down. Also, bulky pants leg will not fit into the boots.  They zip up the back which is great.  The inside flap that covers the zipper tends to get folded over when zipping up-- make sure it is lying flat against your skin.  If you have big calves, these are not for you.  I wear a size 4 in clothing and am petite with average size calves.  For me, the size 8 was a perfect fit. They are high boots and come up just below the knees, so when wearing skirts and crossing your legs, the buckle at the top is uncomfortable over the crossed leg. These boots do not have tractor bottoms, so they are good in the snow, but do not grip the snow.  I sacrificed a bit of traction for more style. I would recommend these boots.

product_title: RYKA Women's Radiant Shoe
review_body:
First pair of Rykas, but definitely won't be my last. Really fine set of shoes. Quickie points:

1) Ball of the foot area: I prefer more cushioning. A quick trip to the drug store killed that concern, via a ball-of-the-foot set of gel pads. Placed the gel pads under the insole. (May be fine as is for most though.)

2) Indulging fitness walks of 3-5 miles near daily means I go through athletic shoes quickly. Despite all those shoes, these are the ONLY ones which make it *impossible* to have pain under the shoe-tie area. There's a patch of what appears to be leather, atop the tongue. When you tie the shoe, the knot situates itself directly above that patch. So, because this usual irritant is missing, no need to me to use Lock Laces on this shoe. (I've got em on just about all my other sneakers.)

3) The shoe strings actually stay tied, even throughout a multi-mile walk. No double-knot, or Lock Laces, needed.

4) These bad boys are not only super comfy (they cup the heels in a truly glorious fashion!), they look dang good as well.

5) I have mild over-pronation tendencies. I was concerned that there might not be enough support. The support is great, even though these are the lightest shoes I own.

6) Sizing: I always buy 1/2 size up from my true size, to ensure I have a thumb-width of space from toe to shoe tip. Fit exactly as desired.

Conclusion: You really owe it to yourself to try these. Amazon makes it painless for returns, but I suspect you too will deem these stone cold keepers. (Purchased out of pocket; no Vine Membership involvement in this case.)

product_title: Timberland Men's Earthkeepers 6" Lace-Up Boot
review_headline: Functional, not a hardcore boot, but they look great!
review_body:
I have wanted this pair of boots for a long time. I finally gave up and decided to sell one of my arms and legs to pay for them. Although they are a bit pricey, they are WELL worth it.

The only boots I have ever owned have been from the Timberland \\"Pro Series\\" with the steel-toes, i.e. a work boot. Thus, I have been used to being able to kick stuff, drop sharp/heavy things on my feet, and remain comfortable in cold weather. THESE ARE NOT WORK BOOTS. If you drop something heavy on your toe, it will break your toe. They are not insulated well, so do not take them to the North Pole.

However, they are exceptionally comfortable, lightweight, and real good lookin'. As for functionality, they are not useless. You can definitely hike, mess around in the woods, and do many other things outdoors, as they do provide decent protection and ankle support. Actually, I would recommend hiking in them due to their light weight (at times I thought I had concrete blocks on my feet with the old work boots).

Now lets be honest - I bought these boots because they are attractive looking. When I received them, I was not disappointed at all. I mean, they are almost like a hybrid between a brown dress shoe and a boot. I would feel comfortable wearing these out to most places, and not worry about looking like I came straight from deer hunting in the mud.

Buy them!

product_title: Salomon Men's Speedcross 3 Trail Running Shoe
review_body:
I ordered these because of positive reviews like this one. The Salomon Speedcross 3 is amazing! I intend on using them in an upcoming obstacle race (and hopefully many more) and I think they will be perfect. I've been training in them and running in grass, across random Arizona desert, and through mud. The grip is UNREAL and it feels like you can run over anything in these. I recently got them soaked in water to simulate being drenched in the race and they drained very quickly with no issues. I have slightly wide feet but they fit nicely with no pressure points. I've had no rubbing at the Achilles. The lacing system is simply great! I have snowboarding boots with the same pull system and it transfers nicely to the Speedcross. It should be used by more shoe makers. The forefoot-heel rise took some getting used to since I normally wear Vibrams or Newtons but it is a HUGE benefit to have that heel cushioning when going down hills (Fell Running). They do not feel \\"tippy\\" as in earlier versions according to friends. I think they are MUCH more comfortable than Innov8's and more grippy that EVERYTHING I have tried (besides some hardcore hiking boots.)

To sum up, these Speedcross 3's are great and I definitely see myself trying other/future Salomon trail running shoes despite the relatively steep price. Worth the money.

product_title: Western Chief Youth Neoprene Woodland Camo Rain Boots
review_body: I own the women's version of these western chief neoprene rain boots, I also own a pair of Bogs. I've had my western chief boots about a year and a half. In that time the thin rubber has cracked in all the places it bends, and is now starting to break off in pieces at those bends. (However despite the cracks in the rubber my feet still stay dry). In the first week, the fabric on the heel came off. Eventually the inside of the heel ate the heels of my expensive smartwool socks, and the bottom of the sole has warn down almost completely, making walking in mud or snow a slippery and stressful event (no traction whatsoever). I had to get some insoles to put in them. If you can get them on sale, they're worth it, but they're certainly not worth their insane retail price. These boots are a low quality Bogs boot. The advantages to these over bogs is that they're narrower (bogs tend to make feet look like clown feet), they're lighter (bogs are heavy and heavy-duty), they're slightly cheaper and they're (in my opinion) a bit more comfortable because they have more flexibility due to the thinner rubber. However if you're looking for longevity, these are not the boot. These are better urban boots than work or farm boots and I'll be looking to replace them when I find them cheap.

product_title: Saucony Women's ProGrid Mirage Running Shoe
review_body: These shoes are really awesome. They are light and comfortable. I wear an 8 in street shoes, but ordered a 9 in these. I would suggest to order a 1/2 size to a full size over your normal street shoe size, deprending on how you like your running shoe to fit. These are wide enough that my toes cn spread while running, I also find my stride takes a natural midfoot strike in these without me having try or really think about. I have slight underpronation in my right foot and these guide my foot perfectly. So far my longest run in these have been a 10 mile run, in other shoes I've gotten shin splints or soreness in my shins during and after, and that did not happen in these. Ive always been plagued by shin splints, its awesome that so far it has not happened, and I attribute that to these shoes. I would suggest slowly incorpoating these into your running, as these are more minimalist shoe and it may take time for your achilles to adjust. It only took a few runs for my body to adjust, but I'm barefoot pretty much 90% of the day, and do short runs time to time in vibrams. product_title: NIKE WMNS AIR PEGASUS+ 28 (WOMENS)
review_body:
I've been running for a number of years now and I have gone through many brands of running shoes including Nike, Adidas, and New Balance. However, I still remember fondly my first pair of running shoes. My father had bought me a pair when I was 17, gave them to me and said, \\"Here you go!\\". I remember looking at them in puzzlement, then looking at him and asking, \\"What is this for?!\\" As you can tell, I had no idea what running was.ha! Guess what pair of shoes I was given? Yup, the Nike Air Pegasus! My first foray into running, and it was with the trusty Air Pegasus shoes.

In the years since, I have not come across another shoe as good as the Pegasus. It is a very comfortable and light running shoe, and fits perfect with the first try, a nice snug (but not too snug) fit. Like I said, perfect!

The Air Pegasus 28 is my third Pegasus shoe (I've also owned the +26 version), and so far my favorite one. I love the color options, I bought the turquoise and pink. It caught my eye and screamed, \\"Buy me!\\". I think the colors has made this great classic running shoe more fun and eye-catching (if you're into the bright colors, there are also more sedate colors offered too). I'm glad Nike has realized a good thing, and haven't changed the Pegasus at all.

This is a tried and true reliable running shoe that will appeal to beginner and experienced runners alike.

product_title: Spy Optic Murena Rectangular Sunglasses
review_body:
This is my second experience with SPY Optics eyewear, and I must say that I am once again let down by the durability of the lenses and mirrored coatings.

I bought these glasses for a trip to the Cayman Islands, and I hoped they would last me for several years. They lasted only a few days in salt water before the mirrored coating became so scratched that I ditched them, for the remaining 4 days of vacation, in favor of a cheap pair from a tourist shop.

Perhaps you won't have the same back luck I did, but I would not recommend anything SPY for wear during active sports in salt water or snow. Even their snow goggles scratch very easily.

This was my last purchase of SPY ever, as I expect more durability out of products sold through supposed active sports companies.

review_body: Very easy to slip right on and the comfort is second to none.  I like the Dark Earth color with my khakis for work and the sole allows me to stand for hours in comfort.

review_body: I really like this item. My purse is so much easier to get into and its easier to find stuff when in a hurry. I got the smaller one so that it would fit in all of my purses. product_title: K-Swiss Women's Tubes Run 100 Athletic Shoe
review_body: My mom insisted on buying me a pair of tennis shoes when I was expecting my 4th (and last) child. I had been complaining with my feet, knees, toes, ankles, back, etc...(LOL) hurting at only 4 months pregnant. (I was quite huge). I chose these because I really liked the arch support, and the colors matched all of my maternity clothes. (I got the black and pink color). Oh my heavens!! They far surpassed what I was expecting in a pair of shoes to get me through my pregnancy. I wore them almost every day,and I'm still wearing them...my son is nearly 4 months old. The arch support is still supporting and my shoes still look great! I am presently going online to purchase the black and blue pair to match some of my other not-pregnant clothes. If you're looking for a comfortable, cute pair of shoes that will hold up well, I would highly suggest these. Why not buy two pair to make sure you have a pair to match everything!

review_body: I paid $50 over a year ago. I think I got my $50 worth. NOT WORTH the $100 they are charging now. Made out of poor material, deteriorate if you use them with frequency. Am writing this a year later because I have to look for new cowboy boots now.

product_title: Baggallini Everyday Crossbody Bagg
review_headline: GREAT BAG!!  Best of the four Baggallini bags I ordered
review_body:
I LOVE THIS PERFECT LITTLE BAG, particularly in the fun red color.

We're planning a Disney vacation soon, and I wanted a functional, lightweight, crossbody bag to take along -- something that wouldn't weigh me down, would hold the essentials (tickets, camera, sunglasses, sunscreen, money), and I wouldn't need to worry about. I ordered four different styles of Baggalinni bags -- and this one is definitely my favorite!! It is small, not too complicated (some of the baggs have so many slots and pockets and zippers I can't imagine I'd remember what I put where), and cute. The purse has one large zippered compartment, large enough to hold a kindle or paperback, water bottle, camera, and other essentials. The large main pocket has a single zippered interior pocket, large enough for a passport or camera or something of that size. There is an exterior pocket that functions as a wallet, with lots of slots for credit cards or ID, cash, and coins. The \\"wallet\\" pocket has two interior zippered pockets. And the \\"wallet\\" pocket has a single zippered compartment on the front, and easily accessible spot for an ID, tickets, lip balm, or a cell phone. There is also a large open pocket running across the back of the purse, big enough for a paperback book, handy for holding papers, maps, receipts, whatever.

This purse seems small on -- the straps is relatively narrow and the purse has a small profile. It doesn't get in the way at all. I think it will be perfect for travel and shopping, running errands, etc. I can sling it across my body and forget about it. The strap is adjustable and quite long. I ordered the tomato -- it's a nice, not-too-bright red color (ladybug is a much brighter red) with a light orange interior. Fun colors for a fun bag. The zippers move easily, the zipper pulls and hardward, all a brushed silver color, seem to be substantial, and the bag seems to be well made. Overall, I am very pleased with this purchase and would recommend it.

In case you're trying to choose between Baggallini -- I really preferred the looks of the City bag, but it was much larger, with a much wider strap that could not be adjusted much, and it didn't seem like a throw-on-and-forget-it bag; it had more of a presence. A nice purse, but not ideal for travel, particularly a Disney vacation. I thought this Everyday one was much cuter, easier to wear, and a little more functional than the Zipper bag. And I didn't really care for the hardware on Sydney, and it was much bulkier. I think that this Everyday Bagg will be perfect for my vacation; can't wait to use it.

UPDATE: I've had this bag for over four months now and pretty much use it exclusively. So much for the fancy bags sitting on my closet shelf!! This was GREAT for our Disney vacation. I didn't want to give it up when I came home. It is so conveniently sized -- holds all of my cards, sunglasses, makeup, pens, a notepad, phone, etc. It is small enough to throw in a larger tote if I need to. And I can leave it on, cross-body, all the time when I'm out and about. I really never have to worry about my purse when I'm carrying this, as I can just leave it on. I've washed my bag in the washing machine twice and it cleans up just fine. It looks brand new. The zippers and hardware are holding up great. I really like this bag and enthusiastically recommend it.d it.

product_title: Mil-Spec Plus Desert Tan Tactical Boot with YKK Zipper
review_headline: It's OK (much better with aftermarket insert)
review_body:
I bought this boot through Surplusplanet360 ($40+$10 s/h). First thing I noticed when I walked them was the lack of cushion. The insert is paper thin. I replaced them with Rocky inserts which made a world of difference. After one day of wearing them, a stich over the rubber on the side got loose and stuck out about an inch. The stitching here appears to be more form than function; I cut it off with no problems.

My size, 11, was accurate but they come a little wide. Other than that, it's a relatively good value and they are very light for a 9-inch boot. Time will tell on the durability.

review_body: Bought this shoe for my daughter at Christmas. She absolutely loves them! The shoe was true to size and didn't take her much time at all to break the shoe in.

review_headline: Going to send back for a 1/2 size up
review_body: I realize that I should have taken the advice of the other reviewers and ordered at least 1/2 size up!  I ALWAYS consistently wear shoe size 7 1/2 - even on shoes that advise sizing up - I STILL wear shoe size 7 1/2.  BUT - this time - the size 7 1/2 seems to be a 1/2 size too small!!!  So - I'm sending these cute shoes back and have reordered them in a size 8.  Fingers crossed that the 8 fits - as they seem like very good dance/workout shoes...just too small.

product_title: XS Sport Wrap TR90 Sunglasses UV400 Unbreakable Protection for Cycling, Ski or Golf
review_body:
I bought the TR90 sunglasses for walking my dogs. Generally, I hate sunglasses, but these are the best pair I've ever owned. The tint is so light, you don't even have to take them off right away when you go inside, but at the same time you can walk directly into the sun without squinting. I looked at these specifically because they advertised anti-glare, and they hold up to the hype.
I noticed a lot of people said they weren't for people with smaller faces, but I can tell you that's not necessarily true. I'm 4'10', with an appropriately small head, and they fit me great--I can hang my head upside-down and they don't move. They look a LITTLE big for my face, but not overwhelmingly so. I've already bought a pair for my husband, since they work so well for him, too!

review_body: I bought the tan boots at a ridiculously cheap price...$65...before an unexpected price hike, and am I glad I did.  These boots are so beautiful, so unique, and so comfortable, that I'm grateful I grabbed them when the price was lower. I will not pay $200 for them, though, no matter how much I love them.  I'll either wait until the price goes down again or will go without.  I adore them!

review_body: Shoes were pleasant, to go conveniently, the size corresponds to the specified. Delivered quickly, as well as it has been specified. With all it is happy.

review_body: I guess I should have read the reviews first! I ordered the boots, they arrived and look really fabulous. However, when I attempted to try them on, I could not get my size 9.5 foot into a size 10 boot. The ankle part is too narrow and the zipper does not open all the way. My legs are slim but the problem is in the lack of an opening at the base of the leg shaft. What a shame!

product_title: AVIA Women's A9995 Avi-Motion iShape Toning Shoe
review_body: I have osteo-arthritis in both knees and suffered knee, hip, ankle and back pain for many years. Swollen knees and ankles have also been a problem. I have been much more mobile since wearing these A9995 Avias. I am on my third pair and recently purchased three spare pairs as I was worried that Avia had stopped doing the all leather uppers. I find all leather more comfortable than the mesh ones I tried. I have also tried MBT's and Skechers but the A9995's suit my high instep and wider foot shape best. I know there has been much debate about whether or not shoes like this really can 'tone' but for me the important thing is that I can participate in basic walks and shopping and be sociable without anyone knowing that I used to be miserable and in pain and now feel 'normal' when I go out and I am not worried about how long it will be before I am reduced to tears or become irritable with pain and make excuses to opt out of activities. My UK orthopaedic surgeon is impressed with my mobility improvements too and more research should focus on the medical benefits. I would be mega-grateful if Avia considered making a summer sandal style with this footbed technology for wearing around the house as they would never be off my feet! Fit-flops would be closest but they do not have a high enough instep for me so come on AVIA think up some summer toning shoes now please, and don't stop making the all leather ones either!

product_title: Saucony Women's Progrid Kinvara 2 Running Shoe
review_body: I've been wearing these shoes at my (mostly indoor) boot camp for two months, and I love them.  They are very comfortable, needed no breaking in, and work well across a variety of exercises.  Although completely out of character for me, I bought them in the \\"citron\\" color.  I can't tell you how many compliments I get on the color of my shoes.  Everyone loves them.  I've had many people ask jokingly, \\"Wow! Do those things glow in the dark,\\" and I've always responded with a good laugh.  But tonight I walked outside in the dark with them for the first time, and yes, you guessed it--they really do glow in the dark.  I love these shoes!

product_title: Mens UK Gear PT-1000 SC
review_body: The tread on these shoes is great. Great traction but not too tough that it can't go on the road or track. After 600 some odd miles in less than a year the carbon rubber holds up just great, but the foam rubber is starting to rip apart pretty badly. The top of the shoe is very very weak, particularly the stitching around the toe. In colorado we have a lot of rocks and cactus, and they shreaded the toe of the shoe and ripped the stitching out in other spots. They're great shoes with phenomenal tread, but the rest of the shoe is not as tough as advertised and in my opinion is not worth the price tag.

review_body: First of all I love this brand, I have yet to go wrong with this brand I have purchased their sandals-eldger, Boots-bacab,boots-sidon. I wear size 8 and order size 8 and they fit fine.The sandals I own  8 and 8.5 just simply because when I ordered they had no size 8 but again they both fit fine.  Give this brand a try....I have tried many and this is my favorite!!

review_body: After walking downtown msp in these shoes nearly every day for 3 months I ordered another pair as back up!  They are so comfortable and look good with business suits and jeans.

product_title: Diesel Men's Excurse Athlesure
review_body: These are definitely well made shoes.  I wore these to mexico and walked all around and are still in great shape.  They are a bit uncomfortable for walking long distances though, but for just wearing around they are nice good looking shoes.

product_title: Toms - Tiny Classic Glitter Shoes in Pink
review_body:
At 2-1/2 my grand daughter is quite a fashionista; she loves shoes!

This is the first pair of Toms shoes we purchased and extremely happy! Of course any two years old girl would love anything pink and sparkle, but the best part is they fit well for narrow feet, easy to slip on and off with the velcro buckle. Very true to size.

I just bought her another pair in red and plan on buying the aqua blue also sparkle, of course!

Can you tell that we love Toms shoes?

product_title: KEEN Women's Paradise MJ
review_body:
I love Keen, but these shoe fit different from my other Keen shoes. I usually wear an 8, so I ordered an 8 in these. They are VERY tight. I ended up punching another whole in the strap and they are ok now. I can only wear light socks. They have loosened up with some wear, so I hope with time, they will break in before they break me!

Make sure you have \\"low volume\\" feet before ordering these!

product_title: Ros Hommerson Women's Strap Boot
review_body: I've been looking for some nice quality simple dress boots, and already ordered one pair which didn't fit and had to be returned. Retail stores are hopeless. Nothing but vinyl crap. And so expensive! I didn't really notice the \\"WW\\" designation in the sizing, and even if I did, there is nothing in the product description to tell you what it means. Wide shaft or wide shoe? I said on the last one that there should be a \\"calf\\" measurement on all of these, but I haven't noticed any vendors including this vital information. The only way to know is if someone has written a review. There are not many reviews, and obviously none for this product. The size 6 WW which I ordered are very roomy. Not just in the shaft, but in the foot, too. Plenty of room for some thick socks. Really TOO big, though. If they weren't so nice in other ways, I'd return them for sure. But the leather is soft, the design simple, clean, and classic. I'm just not used to seeing my foot in such a large shoe! I probably have a good 3/4 inch that I can literally grab from the top of the foot. Still, the last ones fit great in the foot, but were way too tight on the leg, and that's worse. (I am a dress size 8, with a 14\\" calf.) This price was right. I will be out money on the shipping if I return them. And I was really trying to be more careful, since the last ones didn't work out. Perhaps I will try the socks.

product_title: adidas adiSpeed+ Running Shoe (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: I bought my son shoes at Payless for the same price as the Adidas, and the overall quality and durability of these shoes is definitely superior. review_body: These shoes are fantastic.  Very comfortable and stylish they are well made and crafted.  Would (and have) bought other shoes from Boss.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Banelli Slip-On
review_headline: Decent shoes if purchased at decent price
review_body: Please note that these shoes do not come with laces, nor do they need them. I received a few comments at work asking where my shoe laces were - i dont think anyone realized that they are meant to be worn without laces and it is just the style. I like the look of the shoe, but the size runs tight. I wear size 13 and it took a week to break them in. They're still tight compared to my other dress shoes. The other reviewer is correct in saying the heel wears out easily. The heel has actually started to come off for me - seems like it was glued on. The shine also wears off quickly (But you can get polish for this obviously). Otherwise, I like the style, and I got them at a reasonable price (under $30 on Cyber Monday). If you have high standards for dress shoes, however, stay away!

These shoes are not only adorable as is but the barn opens (velcro) to show all of the cow who's face you can see when the door is shut.  He loves them and I love how cute he looks with them on.

product_title: Hush Puppies Men's Wayne Oxford
review_body: These shoes are nice and comfortable. Also they look good. The only thing I did to make them last, is  to nail cleats to the heals or they'd wear down fast. I get rubber ones that work well in Walmarts shoe dept.

product_title: Propet Men's MPED25 Pedwalker 25 Walking Shoe
review_body: Okay it was time to get some new shoes so I decided to get them thru my favorite store, you guessed it Amazon.  I looked the pair I had and saw what size and ordered the same size again.  It was actually the second pair I ordered but the first was too small so I had returned them without wearing them.  Then I ordered a second pair and they turned out to be way too big.  I decided to wear them and see if they were going to work or not.  I have one foot larger than the other and with too small it is easy to tell, but too big needed a bit of a test.  I went out for the evening, probably gone a total of 2 to 3 hours.  Of course I wore the shoes.  It was obvious to me that they were too big.  What is it with shoe sizing anyway, why is there no standard that people can count on.  Anyway I decided to send them back.  I naturally assumed (ass u me) that the company guaranteed my satisfaction and I wasn't satified.  Well not so, they refused the return and sent them back to me.  So now I am stuck with a pair of shoes I can not wear and out the money.  So I say what is the point of buying shoes online, you need to try them on or at least find a company that cares enough to give you a shot at it.  Heck we bought a $2000 mattress once and they even had a 90 day return guarantee.  So Goodwill get's the shoes which is good for some big footed person in need some help and I get the box.  No biggie, this company will never see my money again.  But then they probably could care less.  And oh yea read the warrenty before you buy.

product_title: Georgia Boot Men's Georgia Giant G6374 Work Boot
review_body:
I've been wearing this boot since 2005. Another geologist I work with turned me on to them, and I am forever in his debt.

The Georgia Giant is sturdy and well built, but the real selling point is its light weight. These boots are very light. Think walking-shoe light. It's the lightest steel-toed boot I've found.

But somehow the designers managed to make it sturdy and supportive. Just a really good boot.

product_title: Calabria 721 Flexi Light Round Reading Glasses - Black
review_body: Cute glasses with big lenses but the frames are so thin and flimsy they fall right off my head. I also don't expect them to last long.

review_body: i bought this shoe just under 3 months and the side is busted out.........very comfortable,But it did not live up to my expectation.

product_title: Betsey Johnson Women's Serenn Platform Pump
review_body: I LOVE THESE SHOES. They were surprisingly comfortable and obviously SO cute. However, the heel broke the first time I wore them, and they couldn't be fixed. So sad.

product_title: Pleaser Women's Teeze-04R Platform Pump
review_body: I love these shoes!  they are a gorgeous color, look good and are very comfortable to wear, but I am used to wearing 6inch heels everyday!  Get a size up because they are small!

product_title: adidas Originals Men's Campus 2 Sneaker
review_body: I had great experience purchasing the product, arrived on time, exactly what I ordered. the information I got prior to the purchase as size conversation tables helped to make the right choice. nothing else...

product_title: Capezio Women's DS11 Fierce Dansneaker
review_body: I love to dance and practice all kinds of music and rhythms, with these shoes lightweight and easily combinable feel good exercise. The size is actually a number more than the common shoe I use 5 and a half and bought a 6 and a half ... perfect!
