review_headline: Love these but color is not as stated
review_body: These are really cute and fit great.  Very comfortable. But....I really needed a navy sandal. These are advertised as navy but they NOT navy.  They are absolutely charcoal gray!  I'd like to keep them but not sure I'd get the wear out of them for the money.

product_title: Mix Studded Tote
review_body: I have loved this bag since day one and receive many compliments on it.  Had I written this review a month ago, I would have only raved about it.  However, in the past few weeks I have noticed that the material is cracking and peeling off.  It seems as though the purple is a topical coating and with wear, it is \\"chipping\\" away.  Very disappointing!

product_title: Charles by Charles David Women's Legit Wedge Sandal
review_body: Love wedges and this one is neutral but with tons of color that can match many outfits.  It has some elastic in the weave of the foot and ankle so it is comfortable.  I sometimes need wide but the give in the elastic did help accomodate  my foot nicely.  I wore them once and some of the color threads on the heel came loose. I glued them back down, but took away one star for this.  I did get lots of compliments on them.  Even though the heel says 4\\" the platform levels it out making it comfortable to wear and walk in.  The size was right on.  This shoe is very cute and stylish too! Overall a good purchase!

product_title: Kamik Women's Jennifer Rain Boot
review_body: These boots are the perfect combination of style and comfort. I wore them recently while hiking and on the beach with my dogs and they kept my feet perfectly dry and were extremely comfortable. I also have small calves so it was nice to find a boot that has more of a tapered fit.

product_title: Nine West Women's Lilacit Platform Pump
review_body: I am really pleased with this shoe. I am not a big high heel wearer, but needed some black heels. Even though I'm 40, i still like to feel sexy. These shoes do the trick. My husband loved them and I think they look awesome. I did have to walk around for 10 minutes or so before I got the trick of walking in them, but they are great. They are not too high that they kill my feet or anything. I couldn't wear them all day(again, i'm not used to high heels), but for an evening out or special occasion, they are perfect. They also fit true to size.

product_title: Betula Women's Granita Sandal
review_body:
I'm not a real big fan of Crocs, or foam resin footwear generally; the description of this didn't accurately convey that's what this footbed is constructed of--Crocs style foam resin, with little \\"massaging\\" bumps all over the surface.

If I didn't have a friend who said, \\"OH! Birkenstock Crocs!\\" who was willing to buy them off me, this would have been my first Amazon return.

Foam resin = YUCK!

product_title: VIBRAM Mens FiveFingers KomodoSport, 43, 85BLK/SLVR/GRY
review_body: I first saw these and thought dang they are ugly but I read a few reviews about them and thought I'll try them. I had to buy a half size smaller than I normally would wear. They are the most comfortable running shoe I've ever owened!

product_title: Gentle Souls Women's B.Ridge Quarter Strap Wedge
review_body: Because I am on my feet a lot at work and need to go out to warehouse and have my toes enclosed these shoes are perfect.  The give me height and are so comfortable I can stand in them all day and satisfy the rules of OH&S as well as looking slightly stylish.  As far as work shoes are concerned I highly recommend them.  My feet are never sore or tired by the end of the day.

product_title: Thorogood Men’s 8” Side Zip Jump Boot Gen-flex
review_body: A must have boot. These are very comfortable and look great with my uniform. The toe has a nice shine that take very little maintenance in upkeep. However, if you do order this boot be sure to get a half size smaller. Appearantly the other reviews were correct when they stated they run a little bigger. Great boot and will buy them again.

product_title: Polo Ralph Lauren Men's Vaughn Fashion Sneaker
review_body: My son's grandmother got these for him as a surprise. When we received them, they came with white shoe laces not leather. What the heck!  How do I complain?  In all my son loves the shoe.  But mad she didn't get what she paid for.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel-Frantic 6 Running Shoe
review_headline: I never tried them on just listen to reviews.
review_body: Never bought sneakers on line before but I listened to the reviews and I know Amazon makes it easy to return if they weren't as reviews said.  I gotta say I love them thinking of another color now and and I wear them everyday to give me incentitive to walk more.

product_title: Dr. Andrew Weil Women's Rhythm Lace-Up Walkers
review_body: I literally took them out of the box, put them on and took them for a 2-mile walk around my neighborhood and am really happy with this purchase. I had read on their website that the shoe ran a little small so I ordered up half a size and the fit is perfect for me with a thin Lululemon foot sock. So I normally wear a size 9 narrow and the 9.5 shoe fits nicely. They're very lightweight yet quite supportive. I have flat feet, so my arches will start to ache after a while - not so with this shoe. I'm so glad I got these!

product_title: Timberland PRO Men's Pitboss 6" Steel-Toe Boot
review_body: So my husband has been wearing these for 3-4 weeks and he has decided he just can't wear them anymore they are so uncomfortable.  We were quite happy with them when they first arrived for looks and materials, however, they don't fit right.  The length fits for his normal size but the steel toes are pinching his feet.  They are not big enough in height for his toes and have been rubbing them raw and causing cramps.  And because he wore them for a couple weeks I don't know if we can return them.  :( He did like the inserts in them, but otherwise they were uncomfortable.  He has actually gone back to wearing his boots that have a hole in the sole.

product_title: Brooks Men's Beast Running Shoe
review_body: From the moment I tried my first pair of Brooks Beast shoes, I never went back to the \\"other\\" popular brand names. These shoes are very comfortable to walk in. I initially bought them to help eliviate pain from my heels from constantly walking on a hard surface elevated/raised floor in a clean room environment and they did the trick. I use them at home and at work all the time now.

product_title: Nine West Women's Packurbags Ankle-Strap Sandal
review_body: I bought this sandal in black, and I have to say I am really happy with my purchase. I use them for work. They are very comfortable and at the end of the day my feet dont hurt. I highly recommend these sandals if you want to use a comfortable and not too high shoe for work.

product_title: MIA Women's Masterpiece Tall Shafted Boot
review_body: Im really happy with these boots, real bargin too. Some other reviews have said they are scuffed and this is true but is just from them rubbing inside the box...it looks like the boxes have been thrown about quite a bit.

product_title: Penny Loves Kenny Women's Flock Boot
review_headline: could have been a cute boot
review_body: Unfortunately I was sent a size 8 when I ordered a size 6, the boot appeared to be well made but I returned them for a refund due to finances.  So I couldn't tell you about how they fit and wore etc....

product_title: Callisto Women's Knotted Wedge Sandal
review_body: These shoes are unbelievably comfortable and I highly recommend them. My feet are on the narrow side and these are one of the few slip-ons that stay on my feet.

product_title: Bordello by Pleaser Women's Spectatcular-300 Sequin Gogo Boot
review_body: Got these for my wife for DISCO NIGHT.  Cannot recommend enough.  Nice heel, easy to walk around in (for FREAKIN' HUGE PLATFORMS) and they look HAWT with her sequin-y disco dress.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW855 truebalance Walking Shoe
review_body: Was training to walk a half marathon and got these shoes because they were cute and designed for walking. Broke them in over a couple months with no issues and they are very cute. Unfortunatley, today was race day and my feet have never been in such pain. The other four coworkers walking with me did not have the same experience. I am so frustrated, I don't think I'll ever wear these shoes or shop the brand again. Buy only if you need a cute pair of shoes to walk the mall cause these certainly aren't fitness shoes.

product_title: Crocs Littles Clog (Infant/Little Kid)
review_body: My 11-3/4 month old granddaughter is walking in her new pink crocs and loving it.  They are the first shoes that stay on her little feet!  Thank you!

product_title: White Mountain Women's Tramway Boot
review_body: These boots are very comfortable.  They are true to size and look cute on!  They do set off metal detectors though because of the embelisments on the side.

product_title: Madden Girl Women's Zextor Wedge Boot
review_body: These are comfortable boots.  I am 5 feet and they went about 1 1/2 inches above my knee.  Amazon offered them for an unbeatable price.  These were worth the price I paid.  The ran true to size and I was able to wear them with socks without them fitting tight.

product_title: New Balance Men's MO900 Outdoor Multi-Sport Shoe
review_headline: Not wide in the right places!
review_body: The product is well made and will doubtless be satisfactory to many, but, while it was clearly \\"EEEE\\" at the level of the metatarsals the shoe narrowed down distally towards the toes. I have the need for a wide toe box and consequently I felt a rub on toes #2 and #3. It would undoubtedly have caused problems during serious walking so I returned the shoes.

product_title: Brooks Women's Green Silence Running Shoe
review_body: I absolutely love the Brooks Silence Running Shoe. It is so light weight that you feel like you're running on air. The shoe is very well ventilated thus your foot won't sweat and you won't get blisters. This shoe is made for someone who has a normal foot strike because it only offers minimal support. However, this shoe does run on the small side so I suggest you purchase a 1/2 size longer than you normally wear. It is an excellent shoe for a multitude of activities. I love this shoe so much that I plan on buying another pair in the spring. Highly recommended.

product_title: Rockport Women's Eva Pump
review_body:
Nice pair of classic shoes. The only reason why I gave 4 stars is because
I had a bad blister on the first time I wore the shoe, but it was alright after that.

product_title: MG Collection Tweed Floral Bow Shoulder Bag
review_body: Purse was cute but when it arrived it was smaller then expected and broke two days later. The company was great with the return and refund so I was still happy.

product_title: Columbia Men's Ravenous Trail Running Shoe
review_body:
Fit true to size.Great for general running and on unsealed surfaces such as sand,parks,forest trails.Most comfortable sports shoe I have worn.
Well made and excellent quality.Eye catching design and graphics without being gaudy.Dry quickly after running in the rain.Good lacing system. Easy to get the right fit. Amazing value for a serious off road shoe.

product_title: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Lo Top Black Canvas
review_body: I was very pleased to get these shoes, they're very iconic no matter where you go and look great with just about any casual outfit. But after about 10 months of having these, rips between the rubber parts of the shoe and the cloth began to seperate. I'm not sure whether this is due to how my feet fit within the shoe. After trying to fix the seams myself, the shoes soon began to just fall apart really and just became really unwearable. If they were cheaper I would consider getting a second pair and maybe another different pair of shoes along with them. Overall they're still nice shoes, but they may need to be pampered somewhat for them to last a long time.

product_title: Born Women's Chacha Thong Sandals, Mirto Purple, 11
review_body: This was my first Born purchase but certainly will not be my last. No break-in time needed for this one, comfort right out of the box. At first I tried to have on clothing that matched but gave up on that. They're so comfortable, I don't care if my clothing clash! No regrets about this purchase. I bought the purple.

product_title: Rockport Women's Ainly Tall Shaft Boot
review_headline: Very comfortable and great for wider calves!
review_body: These boots are comfy and versatile. They work as well with a casual skirt or dress as they do with jeans. I can wear them all day as the heel isn't too high. I have wider than average calves and the shaft circumference is perfect (you could even tuck your jeans in them). So if you tend towards thinner calves, these might not work out for you. This is my first pair of Rockport boots and I'm very happy with them!

product_title: Propet Women's Sapphire
review_body: I just received this shoe the other day and I am in love with this shoe. I did not want to take the shoes off once they were on,they are that comfortable. The shoe is true to size in the fit, and very lightweight, you forget you have them on, this is how comfortable the shoe is to me.I honestly did not want to take the shoes off. I am not making any medical claims, however, I have MS and finding shoes to take off and put back on is a nightmare. I also have to wear a leg brace and this shoe works just fine,as the shoe stretches to accomodate the leg brace with ease and comfort. I am recommending this shoe for anyone with MS, like myself or anyone who has trouble with lace shoes, getting them off and on is easy if you have no assistance or just like shoes that easily slip of and on. I  wish Amazon had this shoe in other colors, I would buy them all in a NY minute.For now this one pair will happily do. Thanks Propet, thanks Amazon for the best prices ever, this was a shoe well worth my purchase,please get more colors.

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Duble Trouble Ankle Boot
review_body: I was dissapointed with the flimsy fit of these boots.I liked the color purple. I bought wide size and found it was narrow compared with other boots.

product_title: Trotters Women's Katarina Sandal
review_headline: Stylish but not worth the price
review_body: I looked at these sandals for a long time before buying them.  They are very stylish and fit true to size for a wide D width gal.  The downside is they offer no padding underfoot and do not have non slip bottoms (handy when climbing the hills of sf). They look like cheap vinyl with stray threads. This is not worth the price and is basically a $20 shoe sold for $70. I bought a cheaper pair of Easy Streets that completely fit the bill!

product_title: Ros Hommerson Women's Peaches Pump
review_body:
As another review said. They split in the middle, with only 3 wears.
I unlikely would byuy another ros hommerson again.

product_title: Stride Rite SRT SM Ava First Walkers (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: These were the first real shoes we bought our toddler who now walks and runs everywhere in them. They are super-cute and comfortable, the color goes with just about every outfit and they're holding up well so far to all the use they're getting. Size runs true as well. The only downside we've noticed in the last few weeks is that our baby can unvelcro them pretty easily which led to a recent situation where her dad dropped her off at daycare, came back home and found one of the shoes in the carseat...

product_title: Saucony Kids' Grid Ignition 2 Athletic Shoe
review_body: These are very cool Saucony's. I love the red color and so does my 4 year old son. No one at preschool has these, and they are easy for him to put on and take off. They are flexible and perfect playground shoes. I never buy any other brand of gym shoes for my son because these work so well. They have great support, but are breathable, and wash well. I've gone to Stride Rite and tried their brand, but their boys shoes get terribly stiff feeling after your child hits the 10-11 size range. My son is a bit clumsy, and I don't worry about Saucony shoes tripping him up.

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Beccentric Ballet Flat
review_body: I bought these to wear during a recent vacation and really enjoyed them. They're quite attractive, fit well and are very comfortable.

product_title: KATHY Van Zeeland  Kiss & Fly H64810 Hobo
review_body: This is a stylish bag as are all of Kathy Van Zeelands bags,a good size and a comfortable bag that is nice to use.Unfortunately when it first arrived one of the side zips was broken but fortunately we were able to fix it.This was probably a bit of bad luck,as I have had a few of her bags with no problems.

product_title: Jessica Simpson Women's Comaso Flat
review_body:
I sure love love my new flats. I would honestly order al the color if i still my size.
I surely recommend this. Im happy for my purchase:)

product_title: Bordello by Pleaser Women's Rosa-01 Sandal
review_headline: perfect, so happy with my purchase!
review_body: I really love the shoes, they are exactly what I was expecting and they were shipped so quickly.  i wore them to a wedding I was in and they were very comfortable for the most part

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Girl Talk Boot
review_body: The quality of the suede is EXCELLENT. However, the shaft is extremely narrow. I'm a true size eight, but my feet are wide. However, with some tug and pull, I can always get most all high shafted boots on. These were extremely narrow, they never made it past the heel part. I was not happy having to return them, but no level of stretching would've allowed my foot in. If you have narrow feet and small calves though, these boots are BEAUTIFUL so go for it!!

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Ya Give Me Fever Platform Pump
review_body: Love my new sparkling platforms! They are well made and comfortable, easy to walk in. A nice touch of flare to any outfit. I am very happy with my purchase!

product_title: HOBO INTERNATIONAL Rachel Tri-Fold Wallet
review_headline: Perfect size and so many compartments...
review_body: This tri-fold wallet was the perfect size. I tend to carry a big everyday purse but love the ability to just crab my wallet and leave my purse behind.  It serves as a clutch and it even has a small mirror. Love the color and texture, I'm very happy with it!

product_title: Grasshoppers Women's Stretch Plus Lace-Up Sneaker
review_body: I purchased a pair of these several days before leaving for a 2-week \\"active\\"/fast-paced tour of Europe. They felt great in the store, but I was a little worried since they weren't fully broken in. However, I had nothing to worry about! I was on my feet all day, every day and my feet felt great! Aside from the expected fatigue from walking all day, my feet didn't hurt at all, and by the next morning I would feel refreshed. 2 weeks of active walking everyday, and I never had any problems. Shoes have excellent support, and they're nice and soft. Very easy on your feet.

product_title: Crocs Girls' Emelina Sandal
review_headline: Not a Crocs fan but love these sandals
review_body: I have never bought a pair of Crocs in my life but when I saw these online they looked lightweight and cute! When I got them in person, they were exactly that. I ordered the 5 Toddler hoping that my daughter will grow into it. It fits her (she is about a 4.5) but it is a little loose on her now. The quality is good. I don't think that the rubber will rub against her feet.  Seems to be made quite well. Cute color too!

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Tetris Flat
review_body: These look great, fit great, and I really like them.  They were true to size, and are very versatile, look good with socks, tights, or bare feet, dress or jeans.  I also like that they are not leather (I'm a vegetarian).  Also the woven style is very breathable for the feet.

product_title: TSUBO Women's Cori Mary Jane
review_body: These shoes are great.  I would recommend them to anyone needing a good walking shoe or someone planning a trip where a lot of walking is expected.

product_title: White Mountain 'Hotel' Women's Flat
review_body: These shoes are awesome. Glowing copper and nicly shaped to my foot. Look very cute-sie and will look great with black slacks in my office.  I love this maker and have these great suede boots made by them. The boots fit so well, that i looked them up on amazon. Which brought me to these flats.  Cushy, roomy in the toes. Nice arch support. True to size, not too small like most flats are, that i try on. They look too nice. Ha :-D

product_title: Tommy Hilfiger Large North / South Tote with Patent Leather-like Handles and Trim in Black / Alpaca (TH PURSES, HANDBAGS, BAGS, TOTES)
review_body: My wife wants a good , fine ,and not expensive handbags and this is the right item , she is happy and like so much.

product_title: Ryka Women's Ultima Run 2 Running Shoe
review_body: These shoes are as light as a feather. The fit is great. I wear a 7 1/2 and that is what I ordered. If you do not like any metallic touches...be aware that there is a little silver here and there but very subtle. Best of all, my new Ryka sneaks arrived just one day after I placed the order. Thank you, Comet Shoes, I'll be checking out your website soon. These are the first shoes I have ever ordered sight and fit unseen and untried and I am very happy with my purchase.

product_title: OKLAHOMA Womens Suede Leather Clogs with Shearling, Bordeaux Maroon, Tatami licensed by Birkenstock
review_body: The Oklahoma by Tatami has been the best shoe I have found to get me through a rough case of Plantar Faciatus.  The color is great and the shearling is really warm...making these great for winter.  I'm very happy with them.

product_title: Miz Mooz Women's Fanning Spectator Pump
review_headline: Comfy, Fun, Fashionable and Sexy Cute!
review_body: This pair of Miz Mooz pumps rocks! The skinny straps are fashionable and funky, but they also hold your foot snug in the shoe so you can wear these sexy pumps in comfort! The whiskey color looks great with jeans, but I tried them on with a little red dress I have and they looked equally as cute. The leather is all quality and what I've come to expect from Miz Mooz. You won't be disappointed.

product_title: Klogs USA Women's Dusty Dragonfly Clog
review_body: These are great shoes.  I was a little skeptical at first, as I usually stick to names I know, but these were pretty cheap and best of all, made in the USA!  They are cute and my kids like the dragonfly.  Very comfortable to wear around the house and to do errands in.  I am on my feet a lot and have a history of issues with my feet and these help alleviate them!  They are easy to clean too, reminds me of my kids' crocs.  Love them!

product_title: Teva Dozer 3 Kids Sandal
review_headline: Nice sandals- narrow, but true to size
review_body: After reading other reviews for these sandals, I decided to order one size up for my son.  I was disappointed when they came and were too big.  I returned the larger pair and ordered again in his true size and they were a perfect fit.  They are a bit narrow, and my 4 year old cannot put them on by himself.  But he loves the sandals and says they're very comfortable.

product_title: Shimano M077 Mountain Bike Cycling Shoes, Dark Grey, 44
review_headline: Comfortable shoes with hardly any noise
review_body: Shoes feel comfortable. Like the fact that it looks like normal sneakers and hardly make any noise from the cleets when walking.

product_title: Everybody Women's Gabbia Ankle Boot
review_body: I had these in the wish list for a while but eventually decided to go ahead and buy them.  They are great - true to size and comfortable - in fact they fit like a glove.  The leather is good quality.  The workmanship is also v good.  I thought the pictures make the heels look a bit too thin/narrow but they are actually in proportion to the shoe and quite stylish.  The toes are more pointed than I realised but OK, the shoe shape is contoured to the shape of your foot so the points of the shoes are not in the dead centre but are closer to the big toe - gives them a bit of a granny shoe look but is not daggy.  The first reviewer had a problem putting the shoes on but I have not had this issue at all and have found them easy to take on and off.  I have not given them 5 stars only because I have not had a chance yet to wear them outside.

product_title: Sorel Women's Joan Of Arctic Boot
review_body: I tried this on in a store (in a different color) and thought my normal size 9 felt a bit snug, so I ordered a 10. They are too big, but i had to use them in the snow. My feet stayed dry and warm and they look nice. The only thing about ordering them too big is the plastic ridge above my heel in the back cuts into me when I bend my toes forward. It is annoying, but maybe if I wear thicker socks, it will be ok.

product_title: Merrell Men's Jungle Moc Slip-On Shoe
review_body: I bought these for my husband who is extremely picky about shoes because he has heel spurs and bunions.  He loves them. I have always been a fan of Merrell shoes. Always great for comfort and durability.

product_title: Men's Handsewn Suede Leather Slipper
review_body: The slippers don't breathe at all.  Unlike a good pair of Minnetonka Moccasins or Uggs, the footbed in these (which is simple flannel) soaks up moisture and the insides get damp after only a couple hours wearing.  Unfit for an evening's lounging.  Forced to wash and dry these several times just to keep them \\"civilized\\".  Would not have needed to if they breathed.  Footbed is shot. Stitching is frayed and coming undone. Sole is cheap foam which is pitting...small pieces are coming off.  Easily the worst footwear I've ever owned, these slippers should be priced about four bucks...something you buy for vacation and don't pack up to bring home.

product_title: BC Footwear Women's Sure Thing Wedge Pump
review_body: I ordered the Whiskey and Black Satin which are both adorable. I ordered my normal size 7.5 and they both fit perfectly. My only Issue is that they are a little stiff right now but hoping I will be able to break them in. I have added a new comment below to this review and have changed from 4 stars to 1 star.

product_title: New Balance Men's MT20v1 Trail Minimus Shoe
review_body:
I'm a woman and I have a wide foot, so I went to these because I had a hard time getting the size I needed in women's minimal shoes (tend to be very narrow). The 8EE fits my feet perfectly (I wear a 9.5D in women's running shoes).

I like wearing these to run in-- the forefoot is wide and lets my toes splay for a natural fore/midfoot strike, but the shoe is secure on my foot and extremely light and flexible. (These are my go-to shoes for packing for running while traveling.) There is a bit of padding in the back of the heel that I love-- I have a heel spur and it really cradles and cushions. The rest of the shoe is very flat and thin; not supportive but it is a minimalist shoe. I usually run on pavement, but they've done fine on the occasional dirt/rock trail with a bit of vigilance for pointy rocks.

They're also great at the gym and around town too-- very comfortable for casual wear. They grab attention too; I have the grey/red laces and get compliments on them constantly.

CAUTION: If your 2nd toe is LONGER than your big toe you may have problems with the cut of the toebox; it curves shorter from the big toe area. Take a careful look at the top view of the shoe before you buy.

product_title: Mizuno Women's Wave Enigma Running Shoe
review_headline: Love my new Mizuno Women's Wave Enigma running Shows
review_body:
I live in New Zealand and tired of not having the choice down here I decided to shop at Amazon for my new running shoes. After trawling thru the online selections I was overwhelmed by choice and went to the Mizuno site to do their best fit test. I couldn't believe it when Amazon had the exact shoe for me at a ridiculously fantastic price. After reading the reviews on the shoe I took note and ordered half a size larger than what I normally wear and the shoes fit perfectly. Amazon informed me of a 10 delivery and I was surprised to receive them by day 4.
Excellent service excellent shoes = I'm one happy customer

product_title: DKNY Women's Sophie Flat
review_headline: Great shoes, half size smaller would be perfect
review_body:
These are great shoes, very comfortable and soft, covering toes fully (which I really like :) )
The only thing is that they are slightly big. My European size is 40, which was shown in sizing info as 10 US. On the box it says US 10 and EU 41....probably 9.5 would fit perfectly, but I will wear them anyway :)

product_title: Puma Ferrari Replica PMAF1005 Backpack
review_body: There is a lot of room in this backpack, and I love the laptop sleeve.  The backpack is very sturdy and I really love the design.  Puma knows how to create an appealing design, and the pictures online don't do this backpack justice.  Great value purchase.

product_title: DKNY Women's Brandi Flat
review_body: These shoes are sooooooo cute!!!  I hate to send them back, but the size I ordered are TOO TIGHT!  If I try the next size up, I'm afraid they will be too loose.  Wonder if I should give it a try?  They are really, really cute.  The padding/support inside the shoes seem to be very good.  The \\"flower\\" is a little dorky, but that's okay.  I'm secure in myself and can get past it ;-)

product_title: Mizuno Men's 9-Spike Lite Vapor Elite 5 Baseball Cleat
review_body: I decided to try these with no big expectations. However, they are probably the most comfortable and lightest cleat I have. Great traction with the 9 spikes. I will see how they hold up but they look great too.

product_title: Genuine Pebbled Leather Purse w/ Flap Pocket in Choice of Colors
review_headline: I should have listened, mine broke in two months too
review_body: I love this purse for it's looks and the many ways to organize your belongings, however one of the grommets on the strap broke and I have only had and used the purse for just over a month.  Fortunately, my husband has a pop rivet gun that he has been dying to use so he popped a new rivet into the spot where the old one was and it is fixed.  It doesn't match and doesn't look exactly the same but it is usable again.  I should not have to be fixing a brand new purse!  I would forgo this bag unless you are only going to carry a few very light items...

product_title: Lucky Women's Norice Boot
review_body: This shoe is not at all made for comfort because of the the way it arches but I have to admit... I love them. They are very stylish and I received a lot of compliments. The shoe runs a tad bit small so I had to order a 9.5. If you want comfort... Order Easy Spirits instead. You can get about 6 hours on this shoe before the ball of the foot begins to feel the pressure of your body weight. This is not a walking or dancing shoe. It was made for style not comfort. I hope this review helps.

product_title: Ray-Ban RB2132 New Wayfarer Non Polarized Sunglasses
review_body: I got the Black Frame/G-15-XLT Lens, 55mm from Amazon. Just got them today, i checked them and i am 100% sure they are original. Also they are awesome, you can't look bad with these

product_title: Kamik Men's Lucas 2 Waterproof Boot
review_body: Great price and great fit. I have no negatives on this boot. I feel very protected when walking out in deep puddles or mud. Great to have! Sizing, I bought one size larger and it fits perfectly, with enough room for a thick sock.

product_title: Allen Edmonds Men's Combination Cedar Shoe Tree
review_body: This shoe tree smells great and it keeps the leather on my shoes from getting creased. Using with a pair of 13D Johnston and Murphy shoes.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Prepair II Sandal
review_body: This is the most confortable flip flop I have ever owned. This is my second pair. My first one lasted  five years, and still going strong!

product_title: Thorogood Men's American Heritage 6" Safety Toe Boot
review_body:
Have been wearing these for about 3 weeks now. Perfect fit, very comfortable and extremely well made. There is nothing like a quality American crafted boot made from real cowhide. A little pricey, but well worth it. One reviewer wrote earlier that his were not broken in after three weeks and my guess is that they never fit properly to begin with. My boots fit perfectly right out of the box, no break-in required.

[[ASIN:B002QQ8V20 Thorogood Men's American Heritage 6\\" Safety Toe Boot]]

product_title: Fila Men's Skele-Toes 2.0 Slip-On Shoe
review_body:
I workout in a Kettlebell gym regularly. Footwear here is either barefoot or shoes that are as close to bare as possible. My toes are sensitive so I opt for the latter.
Been using Vibram 5 fingers for the last 6 months. In the last week I have tried in addition to Fila Skeletoes 2.0, the Adidas Adipure Trainer and the Fila EZ Slide.
The 2.0's are the most comfortable and protective of the lot. The EZ Slides hurt the top of my feet, the Vibrams pinch my toes. The Adidas are a nice effort but the design and lack of velcro leaves the shoes disconnected from the whole movement of the body. I should add that visually the Vibrams are way more attractive than the rest especially the Komodo model. However, the pain is just not worth the Rock Star good looks.
The Skeletoes low price is a bonus, but even if they cost as much as the Vibrams, I would gladly buy them. Ordered a 2nd pair today in a shocking shade of chartreuse.

product_title: Sorel Women's Sorelia Earhart Mid Laredo Boot
review_body: I love these boots! I needed boots to replace my Ugg Belfair (Ugg duck collection) and these were even better! Getting them in dark brown now! I bought a size 10.5 because I'm always in between a 10 to an 11 but I think the 10 would've been fine because I think they run slightly larger then most Sorel boots. review_body: Those look nice and are well made but run very small and narrow. I returned them for the next bigger size. Only 3 stars because of the lack of a true size chart.

product_title: Nine West Colorado Mini Crossbody
review_body: I bought this Nine West crossbody in yellow.  This little purse fits a whole lot of stuff.  I can fit cards, cash, and an iphone (with a case on it) quite comfortably.  The only reason why I don't rate this purse a 5 is because it does get dirty easily. When I wear jeans, the purse gets blue on it.  It's hard getting the dye off of it.

product_title: Roxy Women's Sangria Thong Sandal
review_body: I received these sandals today, in white. They are *very* comfortable, way more comfortable than I thought they'd be. My only suggestion is to order a size larger than you would normally wear; I wear a size 6-6.5. I ordered these in a size 7 and they're perfect.

product_title: Skechers Mens Mover Lace-Up
review_body: Excellent Prompt delivery ,great  looking shoes very comfortable and  good value for the price they were sold at my husband loves them wears all day no more aching ankles yippie

product_title: New Balance Women's WX409 Core Training Shoe
review_body: I'm very happy with this purchase. These shoes are comfortable, true to size and a really nice color.  I love New Balance.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Mirana Flat
review_body: Fits true to size.  I wear a 9.5 medium and it's a perfect fit. Shoes are super chic and comfortable.

product_title: Badgley Mischka Women's Star Open-Toe Pump
review_body: I love everything about these shoes! One of a kind. They run bit on a smaller side. Very comfortable for me. I like the shoes so much that I just wear them around the house sometimes :)

product_title: G&G Black Mesh Zipper Glasses Sunglasses Case W/ Belt Loops
review_body: This is exactly what I was looking for: relatively sturdy soft cases to replace those shades that only came with microfibre bags so as to provide bit more protection when the shades are not being worn.  For the price you really can't beat what this offers.

product_title: Rockport Men's Eureka Walking Shoe
review_body: I purchase the shoes because we were going to italy and were going to be doing a lot of walking. this is a very poor ankle support and my feet were hurting bad after wearing them for 2 days. my foot size is a 9 eeee and I ordered 9ee and it was still too wide. obviously the sizes run to wide and I have not been able to wear them since. they're sitting in my closet and I intend to give them to the local shelter. product_title: Womens Designer Sunglasses Shades Block 100% UVB UVA 2718
review_body: I bought these for my girlfriend to replace her old sunglasses. The lenses are nice and dark which is great because we live in Arizona. They don't feel cheap or fragile, none of the stones have fallen out or anything like that. Definitely worth it, would buy them again.

product_title: Teal Color Block Strappy Feather Platform High Heel Rabia
review_body: These shoes are very cute in person. They are high but the platform helps it easier to walk in. I wear a true size 9 in most shoes, but I wish I went up a half size they run small, so I need to decide if I will send them back for a bigger size. But probably not because of the shipping fees!

product_title: BIRKENSTOCK Men's Arizona
review_body: Glad to have found these on Amazon BWO Shoes.com. I'm on my feet much of the day and most footware, even with gel inserts, cause me discomfort by day's end. I discovered Birkenstocks a few years ago and found them to be quite comfortable. My feet sweat in most sandals but not the case with these. I can't find them in local stores so Amazon was the logical choice. Price was right and free shipping sealed the deal.

product_title: ESNY Totes Isotoner Satin Ballerina Bridal Shoes w/ Rhinestones (Large, White)
review_body: even though my shoes rhinestones fell off i am happy with them they asre cute and comfortable. and the color matches what i bought them for i am ok with that will try to reglue them myself.

product_title: Allen Edmonds Men's Park Avenue Cap-Toe Oxford
review_body: This is a high quality, extremely comfortable shoe. It gets more comfortable the more you wear it, as it has a cork footbed that lacks a metal shank that most other dress shoes have. A negative review on stated that a salesman likened these to birkenstocks and used it as a slam against Allen Edmonds shoes.  It is not a negative, but rather a feature that makes them more comfortable with wear, as the footbed molds to and cushions your foot. If you are looking for a little more flair may I recommend you check the fifth avenue model before buying this which has some slight broguing along the edge of the cap on the toe.  Allen Edmonds will recraft these shoes for a slight fee, refinishing the leather and replacing the sole and heel, which means these shoes will last 20-30 years, so they really are worth the price, and a great bargain when you think about it like that.

product_title: Columbia Sportswear Women's Bugaboot Plus Zip Omni-Tech Cold Weather Boot
review_body: A little bulky, but not too heavy to be comfortable. Wife was happy with the appearance and comfort level.  Can't comment on durability at this point.

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Younique Sandal
review_body: I will probably wear these to work everyday this summer. They are very comfortable and dressy enough for work. The heel is high enough to be stylish but not too high. The fit is true to size.

product_title: Oakley Men's Airlift Sandal
review_body: The sole of this sandal is too thin -- not enough cushioning.  It's deceiving from the photo, but the sandal is very, very flat.  It's comfy, but I would not walk all day in them.  Disappointing!

product_title: Sesto Meucci Women's Odette Fashion Sneaker
review_body: These shoes are very cute and stylish.  The shoes seem to be very high quality and are wearing very well (I purchased them over a year ago).  The only drawback is they are not shoes you could wear for duration walking or to a theme park.  They are very cute, but just ok on the comfort.  They are not uncomfortable by any means, but just not the cush you might find in tennis shoes.

product_title: Mizuno Men's Wave Creation 12 Running Shoe
review_body: great product. great store to do business with. i would definitely recommend to potential customers. would come back to shop for more interesting merchandise.

product_title: Naya Women's Tova Sandal
review_body: I have purchased two different Naya styles.  This one is my favorite.  I got the taupe leather.  This color goes with so many different colors.  I could almost wear this one with every outfit I own.  I have wide feet.  I was so happy to get a cute Sandal, that is extremely comfortable and in a wide width.  I am back to find the same shoe in Lavender because I have purchased several outfits in purple.  BUT I was disappointed they are out of the Lavender in Wide...  These sandals can be worn with skirts, shorts and pants..

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Nimbus 17 Running Shoe
review_body:
I'm not a runner; however, I have plantar fasciitis. Wearing a running shoe all day long -one that fits my running gait, significantly reduces the pain I feel in my heel. I wear these shoes all day long, every day. I love them.

Size-wise, they fit on target. I didn't have to purchase soemthing smaller or larger.

product_title: Cushe Men's Urban Vessel Lace-Up Boot
review_body: I've had this pair for almost a year now and I've worn them a lot. I'd suggest getting good insoles for them, but they break in beautifully and they are super comfortable. I get a lot of compliments when I wear them.

product_title: Ariat Women's Legend Tall Boot
review_body: These boots are absolutely beautiful but most of all they so comfortable. Literally needed NO break in time. I'm a size 7 and the fit was pretty perfect. I almost thought it felt a tad big at first but it ended up being perfect. Love them and can't think of anything that could be better about them.

product_title: Nike Air Pegasus+ 28 Running Shoes
review_headline: Phenomenal Shoe, I recommend to all my friends and family
review_body: I initially bought myself a pair of these Pegasus 28's, and couldn't believe how comfortable they are.  Like walking on marshmallows.  Since then, I've ordered two more pairs for myself (I like different colors for different days of the week).  I've ordered a pair for my dad, using NIKE-iD (you can make your own custom color combination).  I've ordered a pair for my son.  I've recommended to friends and family, and they've all indicated they love them.  Now, as far as durability?...  My son is the best test...  He's 14 years old, and literally beats up on shoes in usually a few weeks.  He's had these for 5 months, and they are 90% completely intact (scuffed up but not too bad)...  The 10% part that wore out the fastest was the cushion insert, directly under his heel.  Otherwise the shoe is fine and completely wearable.  This has never happened before with Nike.  Usually he wears out the outside of the shoe long before the inside.  I hope this convinces you to get a pair.  Of course there are always some folks with odd shaped feet that they won't work for, or those who hate Nike, but even my sister who doesn't care for Nike, thought they fit and feel great.

product_title: Finn Comfort Women's Arlington Fashion Sneaker
review_body: For orthotic shoes, these really are not bad looking with jeans or dress pants. The usual Finn Comfort insert is marvelous. Follow the directions to take the inserts out to dry out and your shoes will last longer and won't have an odor.  These shoes are keeping me from having surgery. The top of the shoe does look a little cheezy with what looks like cheap embossed patent leather, but the first time I wore them, I walked into someone's home with a dog who BITES peoples shoes. Had I know about the little monster, the last thing I would wear would be Finn's due to the high cost... Almost fainted flat out, thinking how much these shoes cost, but not a mark on the shoes, yet little yapper left a red mark on my foot. Needless to say, very forgiving leather. Though I won't forgive the dog. Geesh.

product_title: KEEN Whisper Sandal (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: My kids have been wearing Keen sandals for 4 years. Over the years we have had 7 or 8 pairs in the house at any given time. They are worth every cent. My kids usually tear up shoes and so far Keen have won this battle. I have even been able to hand them down to my younger son. He complains that he never gets \\"new\\" Keens because his older brother never wears them out. The boys wear the H2 and my daughter wears the whisper. They protect the toes, are secure enough on their feet so they can run, and look high quality. Buy them, you will not be sorry.

product_title: Mojo Moxy Women's Maven Pull-On Boot
review_body: What previous reviews said about the big ankles are true! My heels can move up and down in the shoes as I walk - not a good feeling if you like your shoes to snug your feet. I feel the ankle could be at least 3 inches smaller in circumference. But the overall design is cute enough & I bought them on sale. Keeping them.

product_title: Nine West Women's Rocha Pump
review_body: I had been looking for a basic black leather pump for work, so I was excited when I found these on discount. When I tried them on, I immediately wanted them off my feet. The arch was way more extreme than I expected, so i felt like I was waling on my tiptoes; the platform in front didn't help. The heel ran large, so my feet were falling out. I had this same issue with another Nine West heel. I don't understand how a shoe can be tight in the toebox yet large in the heel? I quickly returned them.

review_body: Great shoes but they do not come with the clips ready for spin class. The clips are cheap so its not a big deal

product_title: Capezio Women's CG16 Flex Mastr Tap Shoe
review_body: Due to foot surgery, I was looking for a nice and flexible tap shoe. These shoes have a very soft upper that covers the foot and the tap sounds are nice and strong. I am very happy with these.

product_title: Iron Fist Women's Gold Star Pointed Toe Platform Pump
review_body: I absolutely love these shoes!! I feel super sexy, and super tall in them! :) only downside is I have thin ankles and long feet. I ordered half a size down to try and fit better. A little uncomfortable,  but worth it (for a brief period of time) ;)

product_title: Teva Psyclone 2 Sandal (Toddler)
review_body: These sandals are really cute, easy to put on and comfortable. They are perfect for wide or narrow feet because the entire top adjusts with velcro for a snug fit. I would definitely recommend. Fits true to size.

product_title: Baggallini  Zip 'N Go Slim Profile Bag

review_headline: Great Shoes once they're broken in
review_body: When I first got these shoes they looked great, but after wearing them the first two days the back of my heels began to rub and I did bleed.  Never the less, once these shoes are broken in, especially the heels of the shoe which are especially stiff at first, they are great.  Stylish and comfortable after about a week of breaking them in.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel 170TR Cross-Training Shoe
review_body: I have been looking for a training shoe for a while I decided to purchase this shoe and am glad I did,my foot is stable and my ankles do not roll during fitness classes. I would buy again.

review_body: I received this sandal today. I received it so FAST through PRIME therefore, it's good. I was looking forward to having one since I saw at a store. product_title: Naturino 4431 Mary Jane (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid) (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body:
What a beautiful shoe! My 2 year old daughter grabbed it out of my hands and insisted on wearing it to preschool that same day.
By the end of the day she had blisters on her toes and the insole came out of one shoe.
It's so fun, with the sequins, it is unfortunate that it is not the most comfortable shoe.

product_title: Corso Como Women's Delicious Pump
review_body: These shoes are very comfortable and have nice padding inside. I love the little diamond detail on the bottom which has nothing to do with how they wear but makes a neutral pump just a bit more exciting.

product_title: Patagonia Men's P26 Mid Hiking Boot
review_body: Boots are awesome and comfortable.  Seller was superfast on shipping...very pleased would recommend and do business with again.  Just what I was looking for in a hiking boot, waterproof and comfortable to wear for long periods of time.

product_title: Teva Men's Zilch Flexible Sandal
review_body: Beautiful, Light and Fitting. Exactly what I expected. I have been wearing Teva for a while now and I think this model is perfectly the future of the brand's sandals: Design and Light. I love it and wear it whenever and wherever temperature are above 20°. Only trouble is that when walking in very fine sand, the grains stick a little between your foot palm and the sandal's interior. But anyway I love this.

product_title: Dr. Martens Men's Orson Loafer
review_body:
I have problems getting a shoe that is wide enough for me.
This shoe works. There is plenty of room for my feet to move inside my shoe.
That works with the comfort a Dr. Martens gives, when one is standing for long periods during the day.
I also think the price is a fair one. I have since purchased another pair. Two thumbs up!

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Upshot Training Shoe
review_headline: This is a very good cross training shoe.
review_body:
This is a cross trainer with a court type bottom. It is very good for agility and lateral movements. If you wear orthotics, the orthotic raises your foot up to high for comfort. I wear orthodics and that is only drawback to this shoe.
If you buy regular comfort type inserts they will work in this shoe. For the price you can't beat them. Shoe runs true to Asics sizing and is much better than most cross trainers for feel and comfort.

product_title: Bandolino Women's Positive Thong Sandal
review_body: I bought these in the white and medium brown color. I wore these all day walking, shopping and lunch and had no problems with comfort and I have lots of trouble with my left foot (injuries). Good foot cushion. My friend just loved them. I found them true to size. I wear a medium width, size 8-8.5, got these is 8.5, just to be safe and they were perfect.

product_title: Sansha Hi-Step Dance Sneaker
review_body: These shoes are great for Zumba! They could have a teeny bit more tread for the lunges and such, but they're perfect for the turns and the rest! LOVE THEM!!

product_title: Icebug Women's Ivalo BUGrip Studded Traction Winter Boot
review_body: My third pair of Icebugs, (after 3 years although the studs are still present they aren't as good on ice as when new).  I can't imagining not having a pair.  I live in a small town where I rarely drive and hence am walking icy snowy streets all winter.  what a joy it is not to have to worry about slipping and falling every time I leave the house.

product_title: Rockport Men's Basalt Rugged Boot
review_body:
These boots are great for me who has been looking for a good pair of motorcycle boots. Having wide and large feet (13EW) I couldn't find a suitable pair at the stores and online that were suitable for riding, I have done a lot of looking around and the only boots that would fit me were the Steel Toe, Heavy duty work boots. After purchasing the Rockport walking tour shoes, I became a fan. I ordered these and was pleasantly suprised, These boots look great, I wear them to work and wear when i ride. The front is thinner than most boots which is a good thing for me when riding so you can feel the shifter. The leather seems like a nice quality.
The cons are that it is still hard for me to put my foot in the shoe even after about 5-6 months as the lacing stays pretty tight so I have to loosen the lacing after each time. Although once the foot is in the boot it is very comfortable. Also these are not waterproof and should be cleaned often to keep them nice as they are leather type boots.
If you are looking for waterproof/hiking boots I suggest looking elsewhere.

product_title: Northside Kid's Burke II Sandal
review_body: For half the price of Keen's, these shoes are really nice.  They are lightweight and not clunky.  All material looks to be waterproof- neoprene, rubber, etc.  The fit is great.  I have been wearing them while cycling with toe clips and they have been really good for that purpose.  They also look really nice with dresses and skirts!  Great product!

product_title: Thorogood Men's American Heritage Boot
review_body: Was looking for a durable cool looking boot and really like these...they do run a bit large and like others have posted if I went another size down they would have been to tight but with some thick socks they're fine and that's what I'd intended to wear when I'm in these boots. Mine will need a little breaking in but I can tell once done they'll be great. They're made in the US and quality...they look and feel strong and well made and they're very well priced for how quality they're built...go get yourself a pair! They're more comfortable than my sneakers and I'll be in these all day and then some!

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Bran Flake T-Strap Sandal
review_body: I live in Australia and you can't get Aerosoles here. I discovered them when in the US a few years ago and have been a fan ever since. These shoes are exactly as described and exactly what I was looking for.

product_title: Sorel Men's Caribou II Boot
review_body: The Sorel Men's Caribou boot was the perfect protection needed during the winter months. I recently spent the day sledding and the protection this boot offers is incredible. For example, the boot kept my feet extremely warm and dry. The laces are round and thick to make tying with gloves easy. Also, the boot is very stylish and I definitely would recommend this product to anyone in search of winter boots.

product_title: Robeez Soft Soles 3D Puppy Crib Shoe (Infant/Toddler)
review_headline: Now made in China, stinky leather, poorly sewn

Surely enough, Robeez are now made in China instead of Canada. This new pair stinks to high heaven of something artificial and plastic. Shame on you Robeez for charging the same price for a vastly inferior product.

I've had mine for two weeks now and haven't had any trouble opening or closing it. The leather is really sturdy, so I know I'll be able to use it for a long time to come. I can really only recommend it!

product_title: Minnetonka Men's Sheepskin Softsole Moccasin Slipper
review_headline: The VERY BEST MOCCASIN YOUR MONEY CAN BUY

review_body: I ordered these shoes for my son, who has always worn XW shoes and we found these shoes to be medium, if not, medium-narrow width.  Unfortunately, we were in need of soccer shoes and I didn't feel like dealing with packaging up a return, so regretfully, I kept them.  We usually buy NB or Stride Rite XW shoes so that is my point of reference - these shoes definitely did not have the extra wide width that we need.

product_title: Solid Neon Wayfarer Sunglasses, Yellow
review_body: I ordered neon yellow glasses with some doubt because I didn't think they would actually be neon. They weren't. They're more of a mustard-y color. I love them though. I wear them everywhere. I highly recommend these!

product_title: Reebok Women's Princess Sneaker
review_body: I bough this pair of shoes for my 65 year old mother. Living in Manhattan makes people walk a lot; however, with this pair of shoes, my mom can walk for 2 hours straight. Even after a 8 hours outing, her feet still feel nice and  comfortable. This is indeed a great pair walking shoes.

product_title: Baffin Men's Impact Insulated Boot
review_body: I got these boots for my son for Christmas and he was super satisfied to finally have a warm boot that fit.  They seem heavy until you put them on, he was surprised that they seemed much lighter on his feet.  We live in the midwest and it gets below zero a lot...the main reason for purchasing these.  Altho we haven't had that cold of weather yet, these boots seems to be what he needed to stay warm.  The Seller is very cooperative as well.  I ordered these in November and asked if i could possibly exchange them if the size was incorrect and they had no problem with that.  The sizes are what they should be and there was no problem with what I had ordered.  I would 100% recommend these boots and this seller.  Can't go wrong with either!

product_title: Hush Puppies Men's Gil Slip-On Shoe
review_body: I have a swelling problem and find it hard to find shoes with enough \\"clearance\\" in the top to fit properly.  These shoes are wonderful.  I slipped in an insole under the shoes own insole on one foot to make it fit properly and the other with the swelling problem fits perfect.  I am buying another pair of these in brown.  They were comfortable right from the beginning and feel like walking around in slippers,but offer me the support that I need.  My podiatrist recommended these shoes to me and I'm so glad that he did.  You can't go wrong with these shoes.

product_title: Rialto 'Sweet' Women's Flat, Black - 10 M
review_headline: I like it and will keep
review_body: It will be fine to wear with jeans, but I wish the toe wasn't so rounded.  I like a rounded \\"point\\" or arch to the toe.

product_title: Clarks Women's Desert Trek Boot
review_body: My wife loves this pair she bought. Having read they r big for sizing, she bought size 7M but wears 7.5 usually. It fits like a glove, but very comfortable, as the front is nice. Only very thin socks then. Overall, they look like becoming her favourite shoes. One more, the SAND pair is darker than in pics. THAT looks more beige, but it really is sand.  Amazon is awesome in delivery. Very fast for international orders!! Many thumbs up !

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Premium Sneaker
review_body: Haven't been able to find this specific pair of Skechers in any of my local stores, was quite pleased to find a new pair in my size. When they got here, they were exactly what I wanted and received in a timely manner.

product_title: Funtasma by Pleaser Men's Halloween Walker-130
review_body: I bought these boots a week before Halloween and ordered it with the standard ground shipping. These boots came so fast to my door in good packaging. The boots are very well made, I bought them to use with my Thor costume and they will work great. I am a size 11 so I bought the XL size. The extra leather in the front is removable so they can be used as Batman boots or Jedi boots if needed. Great boots for the price. It's a little tight on the sides but that's probably because they are new. You can just add some Dr. Scholls in there for some extra comfort.

product_title: Easy Street Women's Softly Bootie
review_body: What you can't tell from the picture is there's cushioning inside, making it very comfortable to wear. I wore it whole day long and i do a lot of walking. my legs feel perfectly fine by the end of the day.

product_title: Pour La Victoire Women's Irina Platform Pump
review_body: I got these PLV shoes a while ago in Grey Nappato. That color is so gorgeous, and since it's neutral it goes with all outfits. The shoe is definitely true to length (or if anything might run a little longer than normal for some people), I got my normal size 10 and they are perfect. However, the toe box is somewhat narrow. I read the other reviews and the majority of people believe the shoe runs small, however if you go a half size up, the shoe will be too big. The issue is definitely from the toe  box..I had to slightly stretch it in order to wear them the first time. Now the shoes are perfectly molded to my feet. They are very well padded so that makes them super comfy. I am about to order a different color now, still hesitating between the camel and the cobalt blue...or maybe I'll get both... :)

product_title: Manitobah Mukluks 20152 Boot
review_body: I ordered these boots in an 8 -I usually wear a 8.5/9- and they fit perfectly. They are really loose around the calf, however, so if you are concerned about width, you needn't worry. My only issue is that I ordered these in charcoal, which shows blue beading in the photo, but I received beading in shades of grey. They are gorgeous and I'm not returning them, but its not what I ordered.

The sizing is confusing. Make sure to order at least a half size up. They run a little small. I usually wear an 8.5 in sneakers but saw the sizing comments when I ordered the mid-shoe. review_body: My husband has been wearing the Irish Setter Men's Soft Paw for quite a few years  and just loves them.  Very comfortable and they hold up very well.

product_title: Columbia Women's Shastalavista Mid Omni-Tech Multi-Sport Shoe
review_body: Fit big and are comfortable after putting in some athletic insoles.  the laces always untie too.  Light and feel like slippers but I think the tongue is rather clumsy, too thick  Good traction on the sole.

product_title: Identity P2225-3 Polarized Aviator Sunglasses
review_body: I live in Florida where sunglasses are a necessity, not a fashion statement. These lenses were so dark that even in BRIGHT daylight I could hardly see through them. They are what they are advertised to be -- polarized aviator sunglasses. But unless you just came from having your eyes dilated, they are probably too dark to be useful.

product_title: B. MAKOWSKY Sadie Draw-string Shopper
review_body: I saw Makowsky handbags for the first time this year and was/am impressed with the styles; so I bought one. I purchased, on sale but still costly at least I think so, the Sadie Drawstring Shopper,   in the beautiful 'stone' color. Beautiful color and beautiful bag. I used it for the very first time today. All I did was carry it into a shop with me and put it down. When I picked it up I noticed immediately that black had rubbed off on to the bag from my jeans. The jeans were expensive and so I'm assuming a good dye was used in coloring them. I was NOT amused to see the color on my bag especially after so little handling of it. I don't remember the last time I've even heard of fabric color rubbing off on leather. When I got home I used a damp white cloth with a mild hand soap to rid the blackish stain that is now pretty well gone; but not entirely.  I can only imagine that I can expect this to happen again in my next use of the bag. I guess when you buy a handbag at the prices Makowsky commands one doesn't expect these types of things to happen. The jeans have NOT rubbed off on anything else. Other than that disappointment, I like the bag altho it is heavy even when empty. MY mistake too was not getting a bag with a zippered center piece so as to organize items. But I'll work it out. I will try Makowsky again I'm sure, but this was not a great first impression.

product_title: Columbia Sportswear Women's Snolucky Cold Weather Boot
review_body: im so extremly happy with these boots. i ordered a half size bigger then i would wear and they fit perfect with a thin or heavy sock. also they keep your feet warm and also very dry. i stepped in a huge puddle when i tested them out and completly waterproof. i would recommend this product. worth every penny

product_title: KEEN Women's Paradise Sandal
review_body: I really like the shoes, they are comfortable and attractive. I was glad I read the reviews and ordered a 1/2 size larger. I usually wear a 7 1/2 and the 8 is great. I love that I have enough room in the width to wiggle my toes. I am not sure that if you have real narrow feet you would like them. I have medium width to a little bit wide. I like to have room for my toes. They are great for walking. I wear them with dresses as well as pants. I will wear them lots. I am saving to get another color. I have the black.

product_title: Sunglasses JR85 Juniors Ages 3-8 Beachcomber Mirror lens
review_body: I bought them for my 2.5 yrs son and they fit him well. I read some reviews before saying the glasses were relatively small (not as advertised 5-12). It's true. So they are great for 3-5 yrs old. Definitely not for 12.

product_title: Teva Men's Mush Frio Canvas Shoe
review_body: The delivery process went great not complaints there at all.  The product did not meet my expectations.  They are comfortable but not much grip, which is why I was purchasing them.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups S2 Lite Lace-Up Fashion Sneaker
review_body: Wow, wow, wow I am amazed love my runners just what I needed and very comfortable. I cannot believe how quickly they arrived at my home, it took 2 days from the US to arrive in Australia, how did they do that. Absolutely highly recommend, want to buy another pair.

product_title: Ed Hardy Women's 10FBX103W
review_body: I really like this shoe! It arrived very quickly. Only problem I have seen with this shoe so far is that the writing on the side of the shoe (in black) peels off. They offered me a $5 credit for this issue.

product_title: Kipling Duobox Pen Case
review_body: I originally bought this bag to have at the office for my pens, pencils etc...It didn't work out for me because I needed quicker access to my stuff instead of opening the bag and looking thru the case, so I brought it home.  I decided to try it as a cosmetic case and works beautifully.  This bag is well made and super cute with the gorilla.

product_title: Bearpaw Womens Emma Tall 12-Inch Suede Sheepskin Boot, Hickory, US 7
review_body: My daughter hasn't stop wearing these since I bought them for her! The price was great, they fit true to size, and they keep her nice and warm! The shipping was fast! The color is amazing! It looks better than the picture! I will be purchasing other colors since the price is so reasonable for a quality boot!

product_title: Khombu Women's Arctic Boot
review_body: I bought these boots wanting something waterproof for the infrequent snow days we get around here. Boy were these a great purchase. Feet stay warm & never get wet. My daughter borrowed them recently to go snow tubing and said \\"Wow mom, I need a pair of these!,everyone was complaining about their cold feet but me!\\" I think I will get her the white pair. I went one size up to be able to wear thick wool socks and they are a perfect fit. I must say though, I purchased them at a local dept store for $60 and wish I could find them for that price here.

product_title: Fullum & Holt Vachetta Belt
review_body: I must have at least 20 belts but time and again I always reach for this one. I won't go into all of the details but it is a soft leather belt that can be dressed up or down. So good I now have 2-- black and brown. Trust me you will not be disappointed with this belt.

product_title: Ryka Women's Transition Fitness Shoe
review_body: These are a great pair of fitness shoes.  They run true to size and are lightweight and very comfortable. I bought them for my Zumba classes and they are just perfect. These are a great price and I would definitely recommend them.

product_title: Miz Mooz Women's Gayle Boot
review_body:
Usually wear a 7.5 in Miz Mooz, but these ran a bit larger so I had to return and order a 7 - voila perfect! Unfolded, the shaft of the boot ends at the bottom of my knee cap, making it a bit uncomfortable when knees are bent (binding behind the knee), however the leather is soft enough to make a smaller top fold on the boot. Nice solid heal, great value.

Update April 2012 - one negative to such soft leather is that the cuff fold slips - so the cuff is now sliding down the boot to the point where the zipper begins to unzip. Not a deal killer but annoying - akin to having to pull up socks that keep slipping down :-/

product_title: nicole Women's Ageless Knee-High Boot
review_body: The fit of these boots are very sexy, however you should order them at least a 1/2 size larger. I didn't and had to exchange them. The color is true according to the displayed picture and they are just as cute in person. The shaft fits your calf with about an inch of room left, now the diameter of my calves are 15\\". The back of the shaft is about mid-calf length and the front of the shaft is a little higher, about 2 in. from the knee. They are a narrow width so if you have wide feet I wouldn't get them unless they offer them in wide width. The fringes add an extra cute detail that sets them apart from a normal pair of leather boots, but doesn't make them look like \\"western\\" boots. Also I couldn't beat the price, I found them here for about $30 cheaper! Oh, and nice leather too. Good buy!

product_title: Teva Women's Hurricane XLT Sandal, Hazel Black, 9 US
review_body: I had my first pair for at least 15 years.  When I looked for a new pair, I couldn't find them in the stores.  I checked with Teva's website and was very excited to know that they were still being made.  They are the perfect shoe if you are looking for a comfortable walking sandal.  My old ones endured getting wet and light hiking too.

product_title: Chippewa Men's 20071 8" Lace-Up Boot
review_body: I've had these boots for going on a month, and they are great. The first few days your feet will hurt, as to be expected, but after the initial break in, they are very comfortable.   I just purchased some Dr.Scholl's inserts that I'm going to have to return, as when I tried to put them in the boots already had an arch support and very good padding that is already heavily conformed to my feet.   Chippewa is a great brand, made in the USA, of great quality. I would highly recommend these boots to anyone who needs a general-purpose boot.  -Just in case anyone is wondering, these are in fact steel toed boots.

product_title: adidas Men's Tyrint V Wrestling Shoe
review_body: Good fitting shoe.  First time trying wrestling shoes and they have better support than I thought they would.  I even wear them when not wrestling!

product_title: NIKE WOODSIDE MENS 386469-202
review_headline: NOT WATERPROOF IN RAIN, SNOW, OR WALKING ON WET GRASS
review_body: Terrible.  Bought these for the winter and couldn't be more disappointed.  They are completely useless as the sole is \\"breathable\\" and has holes all over the show that lets in water and leads to soaking wet socks.  They are way less waterproof than normal patent leather sneakers of any type.  Do not purchase if your intention is to brave the elements. They are comfortable for normal purposes.

product_title: Mizuno Women's Wave Inspire 7 Running Shoe
review_body: I always run in the Mizuno Wave Inspire.  I recently completed a marathon and that basically killed my shoes.  When I went back to my regular running store they were all out of my shoes.  I ordered them here, they came quickly and they were perfect  Great experience.

product_title: Kenneth Cole REACTION Women's Little Chicky Pump
review_body: I love this shoe,  it's very comfortable; i like it a  lot, the high of the heels are perfect for me

product_title: Columbia Men's Outpost Hybrid 2 Water Shoe
review_headline: Columbia Sportswear Men's Outpost Hybrid 2 Water Shoe
review_body: I bought these for my son-in-law and he loves them.  He is a Florida fisherman and boats every weekend.  They are exactly what he wanted.  I price shopped and Amazon had the best price I could find.

product_title: Merrell Women's Pandora Ventilator
review_body: Waterproof as long as water is coming from ground up (ie:puddle) but not so much the other way around (ie: big rain).  Water seeps in that upper toe box bit....That being said my Merrells always last waaaaay longer than any other hiking shoe (even sister company Patagonia?!)

product_title: EquiRoyal Ladies Leather Paddock Boots
review_body: I've been looking for this style of boot in brown for quite a while, and these paddock boots fit the bill wonderfully!  I purchased these boots for fashion purposes and do not ride horses, so I can't speak to that aspect.  But as an overall boot, these are great.    The boots are leather, good-looking, and sturdy.  The brown is a darker chocolate brown color.  They look equally great worn casually or \\"dressed-up\\" in more formal settings.  The only drawbacks I have found thus far are: 1) the boots are not well padded and for longer walks tend to be uncomfortable, and, 2) the materials and worksmanship fall short of what I would prefer.  The box indicated the boots are Made in India, and the leather seems to be somewhat \\"dry\\" of a cheaper type/quality than most leather shoes in the U.S.  I am waiting the test of time to adjudge how the workmanship and materials hold up.  Bottom line is for the price, this is a great-looking and versatile boot.

product_title: Port Authority Microfiber Tote
review_body: I am so happy with this bag. For the price I was really worried it was going to be some cheap bag but it is not. It is adorable plus it has the pocket as seen on the pic but that pocket is huge and has credit slots for credit cards, pens, cell, etc. Then there is the inside large section with cell pocket & another zip pocket and the middle section does zip. On the back side there's another pocket the width of the bag which fit my 10 tablet perfectly! There are two pockets, one on each side of the bag. I am thinking perfect for water bottle. It seems like it will fit. Both front and back have Velcro closures but seem pretty secure. Love this bag. It really is cute enough to flaunt for every day use around town. I highly recommend and may even get in another color for that price.

product_title: EMU Australia Women's Aurora Boot
review_body: Pleasantly surprised and received lots of nice compliments at work when I wore it with jeans. I would have given the boots all 5 stars; however, it's not quite true to size. I normally a size 8 and bought a size 8, but when I tried the boots on, it was a little big. So, I had to purchase foot insoles to make it a little more snug and wear thicker socks. Other than that, happy with the purchase.

product_title: Dansko Women's Abby Mary-Jane Loafer
review_body: My feet have been hurting for a long time.  I think I have spurs on my heels and need to go to a foot doctor.  I wanted to try these shoes and I'm so glad that I did!  I had immediate relief when I put these shoes on.  No, it did not take away the problem and I still need to see the doctor, but these make walking tolerable.  They are comfortable and look nice too.  I have two pair.

product_title: Reebok Men's Lifewalk DMX Max Walking Shoes
review_body: these sneakers are already coming apart--have purchased this sneaker many times before and been very happy with them but this pair is not satisfactory,Have never had this happen before

product_title: Clarks Men's Portland Oxford
review_headline: Clarks Portlands - Well made comfort shoe
review_body: Well made comfort shoes  Like  - Thick soft leather. Does not require wearing in  - Very comfortable. Fits like a glove on day one  - rubber sole has very good grip  - leather is breathable  - non leather material around collar makes it very comfortable for long walks. Good design.  - leather is darker than pic. makes it suitable for business casual. Looks very good with jeans  Dislike  - rubber on the heel has a very very slight hardness to it if you tend to land hard on your heel when you walk.  Suspect because of the extra thick rubber padding at the heel for added durability  - front design of shoe is a little flat and old school - retro \\"grandpa shoes\\" ;-0  Conclusion  This shoe runs half size big I think. Typical Clarks. I purposely bought my usual size so that I can add in an extra insole. It fits perfectly even with the insole.  One of the most comfortable shoes I've ever bought. Great Clarks design and quality.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW1615 Toning Shoe
review_headline: ok for walking, not comfortable for standing long-term
review_body: These are comfortable to wear and walk in for short distances, a 1 mile walk was fine and I did notice some toning maybe, but one day I wore them for several hours standing during shopping and work, and the unnatural construction of the shoe for toning purposes becomes VERY uncomfortable/painful to the foot after awhile.  I think they are ok but I don't think I will buy another toning type shoe again, because I want something I can wear all day for all kinds of activities and these are not it.  If you want to buy them just for when you go on your daily walk or whatever, I think they would be fine and even beneficial.  But they are not a practical all-day long comfortable shoe to wear.    Also in my opinion, New Balance shoes are pretty much all ugly as sin, and these are no exception.  I do not find them attractive.  Bought these for around $30.  I have gone back to the Sketchers I used to wear; reliably comfortable and very good looking but a little bit more expensive (around $50 for the Energy/D'Lites/Premium models); I tried to be cheap and try out other shoes but they just don't work, and it's worth it to spend a little more and get something I will wear everyday for years and never fail to look good.  I think my last Sketchers Energy type shoes I had I wore for almost 10 years, only threw them away this year after a ton of use.

review_body: These MN boots are fabulous. I've not yet worn them for daily use, but I have tried them and I rate them very very high. The craftsmanship, design and quality all are excellent. product_title: Ryka Women's Downbeat Fitness Sneaker
review_body:
Just got these in the Black/Purple combo. Have to say I was surprised how much smaller Ryka's size 9 is in this style, I have the Studio Flex Low and that was a much bigger 9. product_title: Tingley Mens 1400 Pull-on Work Overboot
review_headline: Good Overshoes -- But beware sizing mistakes and black marks on shoes
review_body:
I can't speak for the smaller sizes, but starting with X-Large and going up I believe this is what has gotten confused:

X-Large is as it states in the main drop-down menu (i.e., Mens size 9.5-11 B-width/Women's size 11-12.5 B-width).

XX-Large (or 2X) is listed as Men's 12.5-14. In other words, the Men's sizes 11.5-12 are NOT LISTED ANYWHERE. My guess is that they really go like this:

XX-Large (2X) is Men's size 11.5-13 (or Women's size 13 and over if there is such a thing)

XXX-Large (3X) is Men's 13.5-15 (not 14-15.5 as listed).

This would also explain the reviews where some of the larger men's sizes were found to run small. I got the 2X size for my son (who wears men's size 11, since I would rather they run a bit large than too tight) and I got X-Large for myself (a women's size 11) for the same reason.

I hope this helps. The people at Toby's Tool Shed are very nice and I highly recommend the boot as well as the company that is selling them as very helpful and kind.

Later addition to this review: After wearing these more times I have discovered that black rubber comes off onto my right heel at times (very hard to wash off) and also onto the tops of whatever shoes I am wearing inside of these shoes. For this reason I recommend wearing only scruffed-up shoes inside these boots!
