product_title: Combat Boot, "Mickey Mouse" Extreme Cold Weather Boots, Waterproof Rubber, Genuine U.S. Military Issue
review_body: I live in Alaska and work on an oilfield at the northern tip. These military style bunny boots are THE boot to get to keep your feet warm no matter what the conditions. They are all rubber and therefore waterproof. They are not fancy or have fur or anything lining the inside. I have found that the BEST way to ensure they stay warm if you're going to be working outside during extreme cold, is to \\"preheat them,\\" which basically means throw them by the heater or use a blow dryer for a minute or so on the inside. They are so well insulated that if you put them on and they are a little cold on the inside, they will just keep being cold and you will hate them. Another tip I have is to get some parachute cord or something to put in place of the laces. The ones they come with I feel are too short. The boots are heavy, but not uncomfortable to wear. The traction is pretty decent on ice. Another thing to remember is to NEVER get diesel fuel on them! This will eat away at them and basically ruin them. Another thing you're going to want to know is that your feet will get hot and sweat and stink like a bastard! The boots are NOT breathable! So some sort of Dr.Scholls absorbent liner will help. I wear a size 8.5 work boot, and I have a size 8 of these bunny boots. They fit perfectly. They are pretty comfortable and also offer great ankle support. These boots are THE winter boot to get if you're going to be spending a lot of time outside. If you want the warmest boots and don't care about them being a bit heavy or not \\"fancy,\\" I would pick these over any other winter boot. Highly recommended.

review_body: The shoes are good...but they are NOT size 8....not even 7! Probably fits sz6?..Now I'm stuck with this, because is not worth it to pay shipping to return!

review_body: hurts my ancles , I would not recommend anyone,to me,you can not do any sport with it,just waste of your money

product_title: Lucky Women's Bambi Boot
review_body: I LOVE these boots!  Walked all over Manhattan in them and my feet felt great.  Love the color and the heal is just the perfect height!!!

product_title: Emma Tall 612W Bearpaw
review_body: I think these boots quality are equal to that of UGGS.  The only diffence is one has a high priced label.

product_title: Magnum Men's Work Horse 8.0 Waterproof Comp Toe Boot
review_body: Magnum is a guarantee and these boots do not let you down. Good for work but they also look great that you can wear everyday even to the office

product_title: Bamboo 'Caesar-01' Platform Wedge Booties
review_body: I have these boots in the tan/brown color and the black. They are comfy and cute and can be worn almost everywhere! I've worn them to the club and work! The style of the shoe is so versatile, that you can wear them with slacks, a mini dress and skinny jeans. They're really great!!

product_title: Sperry Top-Sider Women's Authentic Original Two-Eye Boat Shoe
review_body: I ordered these for my daughter for Christmas and she loved them!  They were the exact color she wanted and fit perfectly.

product_title: Ariat Men's Heritage Roper Western Cowboy Boot
review_body: Now I don't normally wear western type boots so maybe there is a rule on how to size them.  I wear a 9.5 shoe but I could not get my foot inside a pair of 9.5 boots.  I'm returning the boot and I will go to a boot store to get sized and try some on before I order online again.  Again, nothing wrong with the boot itself...just sizing issues for me.

product_title: Rosetti Miracle Minibag - Bone
review_body: I purchased one of these little purses about 5 months ago. It functions as a large wallet, with pockets for essentials such as keys, cell phone, and other small items. Given the size, it's impossible to cram in large or heavy items, which is a good thing if you tend to shove everything in your purse. The other advantage to the size is that you can toss it into a larger bag.  Unfortunately, I noticed tonight that the stitching on one end of the purse has completely pulled away, and the only thing holding the strap to the body is the lining. I expect to get more than 5 months of use out of a leather bag before it starts to fall apart. I've had Rosetti bags in the past, and have almost always been pleased. Either this one is a dud, or manufacturing quality has decreased. I'm going to try and repair this bag, and if I buy another Rosetti in the future I'll definitely check to make sure that everything looks sturdily constructed.

product_title: Rockport Women's Ainly Tall Shaft Boot
review_body: These boots are awesome. No breakin time needed, comfortable from the moment I put them on, no sore feet at the end of the day. heel hight is just right. Calves are wider, I measured before I ordered so knew what to expect.

product_title: Reebok Women's DMX Ride Reefun Low Training Shoe
review_headline: Not an athletic shoe- more fashion than fitness- lightweight
review_body: Ordered these in black and they are quite cute but a tight fit (esp across the front) and not suitable for exercising. The soles have a high arch and they are not well-cushioned. I may try to add an insert if I can squeeze one in. However, with socks, it will be a very tight squeeze. The tread on the bottom of the shoe is good- much better than a Ked, but not as durable as a trail runner.  Despite these shortcomings, I'm pleased with the purchase. They will work well for my long walk/commute to work and a casual bike ride. I also intend to place a shoe horn in each sneaker to help stretch them into a more comfortable shape. The back of the sneakers are fairly stiff as are the sides of the shoes so do break them in unless you enjoy cutting up your feet with blisters. :)

product_title: FitFlop Women's Walkstar Sandal
review_body: Bought these fro my wife on-line from Australia. Fits well, very comfortable. She wears for all leisure walking as well as taking them on holiday. Only slight issue is the silver colour gets dirty easliy. Overall, very happy with the sandal.

product_title: Madden Girl Women's Intro Pump
review_body: The color is exactly what I wanted but the actual shoe does not fit correctly. I ordered an 8 and 8 1/2 size shoe and both sizes would slip out the heal and the front was really uncomfortable.

product_title: adidas SS Inspired II CF Graphic Basketball Inspired Shoe (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: These shoes are perfect in every way! Great make, great colors and awesome Super Symbol.  My little man will be running around in these shoes one day! Something that won't be made forever so buy them now!

product_title: ACORN Women's Tex Bootie
review_body: The soles are not as thick as I would like but, they are warm and keep ankles well covered.  Not a \\"slip on\\" I must use both hands to pull them on, at first  with some difficulty.  Can wear them outside only on dry days so must change before heading to mailbox.  Nevertheless, nice, warm indoor slippers.

product_title: Skechers for Work Women's D'Lites Slip-Resistant Steel-Toe Work Shoe
review_body: I am a Nursing Assistant and was told that it was going to be required to wear slip resistant shoes to work by a certain date. At this price, I couldn't resist these shoes. I love them. I would like to buy the exact same shoes in different colors, although I am waiting for the more stylish colors to go down in price. The advantages are that they are slip resistant, of course, and that they have a metal toe, which has saved my feet a few times, and that they do not absorb water when it is raining outside or when I am bathing patients. They are easy to keep clean, just a quick wipe will do, and for the soles, I just run the bottoms under hot water for a few mins. At first I thought that the insoles were too firm and were going to hurt my feet, but that is not the case. Very satisfied.  : )

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Frida Bootie
review_body: The suede is nice, but the stitching collects dust: which is noticeable on black suede boots.  Another drawback is the ~thin~ soles = no support.

product_title: R2 Women's Bronx
review_body: I bought these from a different website because they were a little bit cheaper. I love them. The only thing I don't like is that the faux leather isn't very convincing so I wish it was a little more like real leather. Also, they run a little big but I would still order your normal size so you can wear thicker socks because they don't keep your feet warm in chilly climates. I really love them with sweater tights and a casual dress.

product_title: ECCO Women's Kaylor Moccasin
review_body: I had back surgery and wanted comfortable shoes that did not have to be laced up.  These shoes are great, I have them in red and brown.  In addition, I typically have problems with plantar problems and shoes are difficult to find.  Great buy, the shoes run a half size larger, so if you were a 10 get a 9.5.

product_title: Roxy Day Off Cross-Body
review_body: this roxy handbag is wonderful.  nice looking and roomy. long shoulder strap that is easily adjusted is very handy.  i do love the looks.

product_title: adidas Men's Adipure III TRX FG Soccer Shoe
review_body: Great cleats for hard cuts. Very light yet very supportive. Nice looking too. (I play ultimate frisbee in these cleats so I can't speak to their \\"soccer ball striking\\" support.)

product_title: Sam Edelman Women's Orlando Faux Fur Boot
review_body: I got these boots as a present. They are beautiful, and so fashionable. I get a lot of compliments when I wear them.  However they have one problem: They don't stay up. Perhaps my legs are too slim, but I have tried everything, even rubber bands to hold them up.  They slide and I end up walking with a slouch boot and I hate it!  If you have an idea to keep them up, they are nice and warm.

product_title: elope Bat Glasses
review_body: I bought these for my kids who love batman and don't like wearing the face mask. They fit an adult head and are very cool!

product_title: Modern Vintage Women's Denise Slingback Sanda
review_headline: Get tons of compliments, but a little tight on top of feet
review_body: I get tons of compliments every time I wear these!  And they are quite comfortable at first.  Towards the end of the day the leather feels a little tight on the tops of my feet making them a tad uncomfortable.  If you have a skinnier foot may be perfect.  My foots not really fat or anything, just normal, I'd say.  But overall a good purchase and I'd buy them again.  Especially if they get cheaper!

product_title: Columbia Women's Romero Trail Trail Running Shoe
review_body: Producto de excelente calidad, a buen precio y es igual a la información de la web   Mi esposa los siente muy cómodos

product_title: Timberland PRO Men's 54567 Endurance 6" Boot
review_body: I bought these January 2012 size 15 medium  so far seem durable  Pros Comfortable shoes    Wide space for toes  Cons It runs a half size to a full size big

product_title: Salomon Men's Wings Sky GTX Fast Light Backpacking Boot
review_body: I bought these boots a couple of months ago, I've taken the boots to Colorado in the snow.They are very light. They are definitely good in the cold weather, I've stood in them for two hours one time.They kept my feet comfortably warm. I've also ran in them, they feel just like running shoes. They are pretty much for cold weather, waterproof,lightweight running boots if you will. They also look amazing.

product_title: Identity Men's BM378-2 Classic Sunglasses
review_body: This product was exactly as advertised. No distortion in lens that I can detect. They are nice looking and have a good, sturdy feel to them.

product_title: TSUBO Women's Dufay Pump
review_body: I thought this was a beautiful shoe and it was perfect for me, except...  the opening rubbed against the \\"knuckle\\" of my big toe (the part where my big toe is connected to my foot). It's possible I ordered a size that was half a size too small, but I didn't want to do the return dance a second time if it didn't work out. Besides the big toe bone, this shoe was confortable. There was padding in all the right places. The heel is just the right size for a smaller foot like mine to be a work shoe.   Unfortunately, there are no stores within 100 miles that carry this brand so I have to go with something else I can try on at the store. My feet are very finicky. If you order this shoe, go for a half size bigger than you think you need. I've seen other people say that they feel this is a very comfortable shoe. Good luck.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel 170TR Cross-Training Shoe
review_body: I love the shoe.  Feels great AFTER being worn the 2nd or 3rd time.  The break-in time is short but definitely a good fit. Love the support and padding on the ball of the foot. Used for cardio floor work & machines at the gym.  Would recommend this shoe.

product_title: Clarks Women's Santa Fe Heels,Brown Suede,9.5 M US
review_body: I ordered these shoes because of their attractive appeal and thought they looked comfortable.  I was right!  They are very comfortable and look great with jeans or slacks.  They are true to size as well.  I recommend this shoe.

product_title: Dansko Women's Brinkley Knee-High Boot
review_body: I love these boots!  I was looking for tall boots that were dressy enough to wear with a skirt.  These are perfect for skirts or pants.  I can't wear   more than a 2\\" heel anymore and these are extremely comfortable.  I always wear a 7 medium shoe and the 37 fits me perfectly.  Nice arch support in the right place.  I have never been a fan of the Dansko clog style shoes but these boots are really attractive.  My calves are not large and the tops of these boots are just right.  With the stretch I can also wear these with jeans tucked in.  I'm a very frugal person and these are definitely worth the money.

product_title: New Balance Men's MT20v1 Trail Minimus Shoe
review_body: I really like these shoes. They are slightly small to size. I would recommend ordering 1/2 size larger or trying them on in the store before ordering.

product_title: Brinley Co Women's Melbourne 05 Slouch Boot Regular & Wide Calf
review_body: I woke up, and boom! these boots were there. I honestly thought the delivery would take forever, but it didn't and i'm so excited. The boots were packaged properly, they feel a  little bit thin, but i'm a 9 and I bought a size 9 and they fit perfectly. I haven't tried them on over jeans but that is definitely the plan whenever I go out next :) Now for your calves-- mine aren't thin by any means and they fit me pretty well, i do agree with another reviewer that the material is super thin, but they look great and if it doesn't fit your calves, esp. with jeans on which are probably and might be thicker then these boots? just slouch the middle down a bit more and you're good!

product_title: Timberland Ryan Springs Boat Shoe (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: These shoes look great and wear well. They are true to size and easy for my son to put on.

product_title: Sorel Women's Nakiska Slipper
review_body: These are by far my favorite slippers.  They are so warm and so comfortable.  I have had other fur lined slippers, but these are the greatest!

product_title: Gee WaWa Women's Whisper Boot
review_body: These boots are beautiful. The lather is soft as gloves... Very comfortable all day long. One of my best boots ever. Thank you.

product_title: J.Renee Women's Fame Pump
review_body: These shoes are a must Have!  bought them and they fit perfectly and the style was remarkably different from the other options shown.  Fit is a little snug but otherwise nice look.  Highly recommend.

product_title: BCBGeneration Devan Crossbody
review_body: Cute little purse. I love it.  Right size, right shimmer. Looking forward to wearing it.  I may get it also in other colors :)

product_title: Imoshion Tulip Tote
review_body: I knew for the description that this bag was big, but when I got it, it sorprises me because it is really big. The material looks very good and feels really soft, I believe it is good for carrying laptops or for carrying documents.

product_title: Sporto Women's Sofia Boot
review_body: Although these were comfy boots the zipper stops came off within a month so I called Amazon to return.  No problem...thanks for the great customer svc.  Received another pair within 2 days & one section of the right boot was made with inferior nappy suede while the rest of the boot & the other boot were made with smooth suede.  Where's the Quality Control, Sporto?  I won't be getting another pair.

product_title: Lennon Beatles Hippie Sunglasses Light Blue
review_headline: What you see is what you get
review_body: For the $3 price tag (with shipping) the glasses were adequate. They were a critical piece of my highly-regarded Ozzy Osbourne costume. I thought based on the picture they would have silver frames, but I guess I should have read more closely.  My only complaint is that they sat crookedly on my face, and I couldn't seem to bend them properly to correct.

product_title: Jellypop Women's Durbin Oxford
review_body: I have owned these cute little shoes for a few months now and I love them. They are quiet to walk in and so comfortable. They look really cute with jeans or you can wear them with dress pants and a sweater. Very roomy toe area and can easily be worn with dress socks.

product_title: PUMA Women's Soleil Suede Fashion Sneaker
review_headline: Cute but inaccurate size and not too solid
review_body: I had to return two pairs of this, because both were big and felt uncomfortable. I wear size 8, and even 7.5 was very big. Also the shoe is a little wider up top, and the sole is very thin. It looks trendy and all but not too solid for walking long distance.

product_title: Poetic Licence Women's Love Letter Pump
review_body: These shoes are okay. I don't think they are as attractive as the picture but they certainly looked good enough to keep. The leather is extremely stiff, especially at the heel. Also, I ordered a size 7 but they feel more like a 6.5. I'm keeping them but if I order this brand shoe again, I'm not sure if I should order an 8 instead of a 7.

product_title: Star Wars by Stride Rite Light-up Clone Wars Jedi Sneaker (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: My 6 year old son loves these shoes. I only by Stride Rite since he has flat feet and he is really comfortable in them. THe flash is not too crazy, so he can wear it with his school uniform. They look nice. I would/will buy again.

product_title: Nine West Women's Lil Mary Jane Pump
review_body: Classic and comfortable, with a higher heel that is stable enough to wear all day long and for errands afterwords. Look great with dress pants or with longer skirts and so far they have held up well and I cannot find anything really to complain about. I was worried about the strap crossing over the fore-foot area, but it is elasticized and is surprisingly comfortable. Could not be happier with these shoes.

product_title: Baffin Men's Arctic Winter Boot
review_body: Working in remote regions of Alaska for the last six years, these boots have served me well and I would gladly buy another pair if the first ever wears out.  They've been put through test after test in temperatures below -40, in deep snow and slush, on gravel and even run over once and they are still waterproof and warm.  They have excellent grip on glaze ice.  The only time I even felt a little cold in them was after working outside in Barrow, Alaska when it was -35 and I was out for over four hours and although my toes were a bit chilly, my foot was safely warm and protected from frost bite.  The fit is snug and the removable liner makes for easy cleaning and drying.  Yes, I have to dry the liner from time to time when it is over +20 deg F because my feet get a little too warm and I sweat.  Durable, sturdy, snug, warm, and dry.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Willyy Lace-Up
review_body: Love the style of the shoe but could be better. The joint with the bottom of the shoe wasn't properly assembled especially at the back. They could've been properly flushed at the sides with the sole.

product_title: Madden Girl Women's Etalia Knee-High Boot
review_body: The boot is a perfect all day boot!  I had no problems today wearing them.  The only thing I wished I would have done was gotten a smaller size.  I am typically a size 7, but purchased a 7.5 to be safe.  I should have purchased the 7.  But I will put two pair of socks on and I will be fine!

product_title: Report Women's Frisco Boot
review_body: These boots are soooo comfy. The suede is soft and very flexible. These can be pushed down to slouch or pulled up for knee high boots. FYI...the heels is a little slick on tile or wood floors, but the front of the sole is rubbery and grips. I like the \\"dirty\\" broken in look. I think it gives them character.

product_title: Calvin Klein Women's Ashley Pump
review_body: Looks like this one is a second or a knock-off. The instep separated from the shoe body after the second wearing. Disappointing because this was our first shoe purchase on Amazon. Doesn't inspire confidence.

product_title: däv Women's Victoria Knee-High Boot
review_body: This boot seems okay but it was about a size larger than normal and the advertisement fails to mention this.  I put it on and it fit like it was at least a size and a half larger than my foot - that made it uncomfortable.  Will try to order a size down.  The advertisement should warn folks to order a size down.

product_title: adidas Performance Men's World Cup Soccer Cleat
review_headline: Great Soccer Shoe, Doesnt get any better than this.
review_body: I've gone through about 4 pairs of these bad boys since they came out roughly 20 years ago. Solid construction, old addidas quality. Would never buy a different shoe unless they quit making them. May buy another pair just to ensure that I have a spare pair.  With all addidas soccer shoes with this type of toe, its always a good idea to place some shoe goo around the front to protect where the leather meets the sole. Otherwise it may rip after some use. other than that, they'll last a good 4 seasons or so with heavy wear, 6 or more with moderate. A great shoe!!

product_title: Isotoner Womens Classic Microterry Ballerina Slipper
review_body: I was very disappointed to see the back seam tear apart within a weeks time of wearing. I would not recommend the Microterry slipper for purchase.

product_title: Lowa Men's Renegade II GTX Lo Hiking Boot
review_body: Shoes fit a little tight for a couple days, but are now feeling better.  Very well made!  Most expensive shoes I have bought, but seem to be worth the cost.

product_title: Under Armour Mens Valsetz Tactical Boot
review_body: the boots are great. best pair yet. the boots arrived to my APO address days before it was expected to arrive.

product_title: Hello Kitty Women's Super Plush Tall Boot
review_body: Bought these for the cold winter months. They are VERY warm and comfy. The bottom is well padded and it feels like you're stepping on a pillow. It seems well made and it shipped here fast. I though it was well packed too. Overall I do recommend.

product_title: PUMA Men's King Indoor IT Soccer Shoe
review_body: Ive been playing soccer my whole life through college and Id have to say that Puma Kings are the best shoes Ive ever owned. I do have wider feet and Puma's definetly are wider shoes. I've never found a Nike or Addidas shoe that compares. Kings are the best.

product_title: Paul & Taylor Unisex Leather Checkbook Cover Wallet

review_body: I am so excited to dress up my son when these fit him (in the next month or so). Although I loved these shoes, they were not the ones pictured on Amazon. The ones pictured show \\"polo\\" etched on the Velcro tab. These did not have that. Instead, the Polo logo was embroidered on the Velcro fastener.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel-Domain 2 Volleyball Shoe
review_body: Es un calzado muy cómodo, tiene un agarre del pie increíble, me encanta, deja pasar el aire perfectamente y no deja que mis pies suden.....lo recomiendo para cualquier actividad deportiva....excelente

product_title: CONVERSE Men's JP Garment Dyed Ox
review_body: I love my JP coverse!!! Comfortable and versatile.  I had a man at Starbucks tell me that he wore these 60 years ago!  I guess fashion does go through cycles =0)

product_title: AmeriBag X-Small Classic Poly-Suede Healthy Back Bag
review_body:
this is my 4th healthy backpack .. i love these and organizing pockets too!!
i have had leather , mico suede, the cloth one and now the poly suede.
I did not like microfiber.. it seems to show dirt/stains and does not clean well.
cloth i think is a good choice can be washed etc. The zipper stopped working on my cloth one so i am now trying the poly suede one I am very happy with this one

product_title: Bearpaw Emma Mid-Calf Boot Black Women's Size 8
review_body:
I ordered these boots in the Maple color. The color is much darker than the picture that Amazon has. It's a very nice darkish brown. I reccommend going to Bearpaw's website and viewing the different colors there since my boots matched the Maple color shown on their website.

I normally wear a size 7 in shoes. Sometimes I can fit into a 6 or 6.5 depending on the manufacturer/brand. I was debating between ordering a size 7 and 8 since some people said to size up while others said not to since they run true to size. I ended up ordering a size 8 and am soooo glad I did. A size 7 would have been too small. The size 8 fits quite snug when I wear socks with them. It is a perfect fit. There's still some wiggle room in them if I wear them without socks, which I rarely do. The boots are comfortable to wear but not for long periods of time. My old pair of boots were from American Eagle and I could wear them all day and they wouldn't hurt my feet. I wore these Bearpaws to work and after 2 hours of standing, my feet were starting to hurt. Maybe it's because I'm still breaking them in, but they weren't as comfortable as what other reviews claim. Hopefully if I continue to wear them, it will stretch them out more and break them in!

Neitherless, these boots are a great value for the same quality and look as UGGS. I like how Bearpaw also uses rubber for the sole instead of that foam stuff which UGGS and many other companies use. Overall I'm happy with them.

EDIT 03/21/12: After owning them for 4 months, I can now say that they are quite comfy! They do stretch out a bit and my feet stopped hurting in them after wearing them for about 2-3 weeks. They are still intact and in good condition and will probably last another few winters. I'm kind of sad it's getting warmer since I love wearing them daily.

product_title: BCBGirls Women's Cross T-Strap Pump
review_body: Beatiful Shoes! They arrived on time and well package as expected. The color is more beautiful that what you see in the computer

product_title: Dockers Men's Bastille Center Seam Run Of Toe Ox
review_body: I've had this shoes for a little over a month now, and I have to say there great! I don't usually buy shoes from the internet since I've had at least one ther experience where the fit was just not there, and nothing beats tryieng them out yourself at a shoe store, but in this case I had no problem! They fit great, true to size, I se them around 3-4 day a week for looong office hours and tehy hold up great, highly recommended.

product_title: Dansko Women's Pro Shagreen Clog
review_body: These are absolutely comfortable, and exceptionally cute.  I get wonderful comments on them all the time!  It's like a party for your feet, and in a hospital that's a nice thing!  They do tend to scuff, but it comes off with a Mr. Clean eraser pad.

product_title: SANO by Mephisto Women's Evasion Lace-Up
review_body: I bought a pair of these shoes. They are very comfortable. I wore them every day for about a week. Then my knee (that I had had surgery on) started hurting in a way it had not hurt before. So I stopped wearing the shoes and the pain went away. I thought it was a coincidence. I started to where the shoes again. After about of week of wearing them every day - the same thing happened. I stopped wearing the shoes and the pain went away. I wear them sporadically.  At the most I may wear them 2 days in a row. The pain in my knee has not recurred. The shoes are very comfortable. It is unfortunate that the rocker style aggravates my bad knee.

product_title: Lowa Men's Renegade II Leather-Lined Mid Hiking Boot
review_headline: Much like the GTX Renegade, but nicer.
review_body:
This boot is much more comfortable than the GTX version. Don't get me wrong, both are nice. I like the support the polyurethane midsole gives this day-hiker. The main difference between the two is the leather lining. You probably wouldn't think it'd make all that much of a difference, but it does. It's SUPER comfy. Inside the leather lining is this foam- it feels like that memory foam inside of Temperpedic mattresses- it hugs your feet and ankles with the perfect amount of support. The ankle is never pinchey or bitey. You can snug the laces down as tight as you want, and this boot will just keep lovingly hugging your feet no matter what you put it through. the boot is also very handsome. I got the color \\"Espresso.\\" It's exactly the same color as my chocolate lab. I like that we match!

The only negative thing I'd say about this boot is that it's a bit too narrow. It does come in a wide, but you'd have to seek that out somewhere else. (Or just wait for the leather to stretch a bit.)

product_title: Gabor Women's 22501 Moccasin
review_body: These shoes are sleek, stylish, classic, and COMFORTABLE. I own them in the navy and purple suede as well as the black leather.  I have Google searched them so I could get this shoe in every color with backup pairs.  I have not been successful in finding them in my size. I LOVE these shoes. The fit is a half size bigger in this style. I'm usually a US size 7 M; but, in this style the US 6.5 (Gabor 4.5 G UK) fits me best. That's a FR 37.5 size. I purchased the navy pair in size 5G (US 7M); I say add shoe pads and ankle pads and they will fit. You can wear them all day and not know that you're not wearing slippers. However, they could use more padding on the insole to minimize my feets' contact with hard surfaces. Nonetheless, don't hestitate BUY BUY BUY. I'm praying that next season Gabor makes them available again especially in leather.

product_title: TrekSta Men's T745-Evolution Mid GTX Light Hiking Shoe
review_body: Straight out of the box, I put these shoes on and went for an aggressive, 6 mile mountain hike ... a rocky, steep trail with a 1500 foot elevation gain. I was skeptical, since these are very light and the bottoms seem the same (except that these are a little higher)as the TrekSta trail running shoes I recently bought (which I only use for city walking).   My feet are very sensitive and I need a heavy boot (like my Keens) to protect them. I did the 6 mile hike in record time and felt very spry. These are much lighter than my clunky Keens and I have to admit that my feet felt wonderful. I don't know how Treksta does it, but my feet are well protected in this lightweight boot. For once, a product meets the hype.  I only gave 4 stars because I haven't had these for very long. My only complaint is that I would prefer the boots to be a little higher to keep skree out...they are barely higher than the base trail shoe.

product_title: Blues Glasses Costume Accessory
review_body: This product is just what I expected. It fits me well and it is what I wanted. The company provided great service.

product_title: Saucony Men's ProGrid Mirage Running Shoe
review_body:
have run Saucony shoes; 4X marathons; 10 miles/day; 25 years. retired running medical issues.
Be aware Saucony is ~2 full sizes smaller than street sizing.
I only still wear Saucony for my foot; pull the insole and use custom orthotics, too.

product_title: Bonnie L&S Hobo Handbags
review_body: This bag is a bit smaller than I had thought but that's a good thing for me as it will keep me from stuffing it to the max. It comfortably holds Kindle so that is all that matters. Stitching is done well. The inside lining is fun. LOVE the button closure for the straps!

product_title: Timberland PRO Men's 85589 Magnus 6" Soft-Toe Work Boot
review_headline: Longing for the days when work boots were a long term purchase
review_body: Way back in the late 70s I bought a pair of leather work boots with Vibram soles. I wore them for years, even hiked mountains in them. Probably put a few thousand miles on them and tens of thousands of hours. The soles and heals are still great, parts like new. The uppers finally wore out. So I bought these \\"Pro\\" boots. They are OK. The interior is flimsy nylon/polyester and won't last long. The soles are urethane of some sort and after a few days are already worn. They'll last a year tops if used regularly on aspahalt or concrete, maybe longer if on a shop floor. Oh well. The days of products that last forever are long gone.

review_body: I went to a nearby shoe store where they put me on a treadmill and video taped my running style.  After all the fitting, they suggested these shoes. Overall, these shoes are very comfortable and durable.  They lasted more than a year with a moderate amount of running.

product_title: Salomon Men's Comet 3D GTX Hiking Boot
review_body:
Very comfortable! They form perfectly to my foot and are very soft and cushy inside with no pressure points whatsoever. I can't speak to durability because I have not taken them hiking yet. However, you can see and feel quality in your hands upon inspection. I will amend this review as soon as I put them to the test on a rigorous hiking trip. Consider this review a testament on comfort and initial quality impression. They are a very good looking boot as well. Probably a bit flashy and loud for a Saturday night out, but for off road use they look pretty cool.

My goal was a balance between lightweight, comfort, and durability. The first two I can definitely vouch for thus far. I've been shopping around extensively for some time now and I think I nailed it with these. The following are actual weights (on my calibrated digital scale) for all boots I've tried (size 8.5, one shoe): Scarpa Barun- 644 grams, Scarpa Kailish- 642 grams, Lowa Renegade II Mid- 594 grams, LL Bean Mountain Treds- 564 grams, Lowa Tempest QC Mid- 516 grams, Solomon Comet 3D (this shoe)- 584 grams.

A quick search revealed that I am not the only one with the same problem. Another reviewer made a video demonstrating this defect.  Also overall quality of the 1883 collection is much lower than I expected. I also ordered another pair at the same time from the same 1883 collection which turned out to be Ok but also had a minor defect with the stitching. I decided to keep it since I really like the design of the boot and did not want to bother with returns. I guess time will tell if it is going to last. Overall I am disappointed with the Lucchese quality control. On the positive side both boots were true to the size and are very comfortable initially. I can only assume that the classic line is the one that everybody raves about but it is inexcusable to sell a different line with the same brand name with such poor quality especially in this price range.

product_title: Hi-Tec Men's Midland Limited WP Light Hiking Boot
review_body: I have had several pairs of Hi-Tec hikers over the last three decades, and wear them daily.  They have always been a quality boot- they last and last.  I can't even remember when I purchased my current pair, it was years ago.  It recently became clear they were done for, so I ordered the Midland Limited from Amazon.  They came today.  They appear to possess the high quality I've come to expect from Hi-Tec.  However, the left boot had a plastic thing that looks something like a faucet handle affixed THROUGH the tongue with a nail/brad.  I e-mailed Amazon for advice on its removal and received a fairly prompt reply to do my best to remove it by with best means I could. Well, many frustrating minutes later I finally completed that job using special pliers that allowed me to get a good grip and work the notched nail/brad loose.  Good thing I have an assortment of tools.  Unfortunately, putting such a device through leather and lining does damage and leaves a hole- rendering the brand-new footwear DAMAGED GOODS!  On-line research confirmed my suspicion that this silly contraption was anti-theft, as in EAS.  Now, I can see that such might be useful in a brick and mortar store, but if somebody is smart enough to walk off with a pair of hiking boots from and on-line store, I don't think EAS is going to much of a deterrent.  Of course, smart thieves wouldn't bother with such damaged goods, either.  Wrecking new footwear to prevent theft?   FAIL!

product_title: Clarks Originals Men's Desert Boot
review_body:
I've spent most of my life in boots of one sort or another and these are by far the best casual boots out there. They are great multi-tasksers--equally at home on the trails, at work, or on the town. These are my second pair of Clarks Desert Boots. I still have my first pair--the beeswax leather--I wanted them in black too.

The boots are very durable, well made, and are made from 100 percent natural and sustainable materials. Also, they last forever, provided you take care of them--use appropriate polish, mink oil and saddle soap as needed and these will go on forever. When the sole wears out it can be replaced inexpensively at most shoe and boot repair shops.

Although there are some tasks that other boots would be better for--I would much rather have my Gortex lined Matterhorns for slogging through the snow than my Clarks (these are desert boots, not slog through the Arctic boots)--the Clarks can step in and do the job--and still look like boots--as opposed to looking like a pair of beefed up sneakers like Hi Techs or what have you.

The only drawback to these boots is that they can be hard to get for under $100 or at all in some cases. They are rarely on sale and they sell out pretty quick. I had to wait three months to get these, but they are worth it.

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Speedsters - Jazzed Fashion Sneaker
review_body: I bought these shoes because they looked very stylish and were made of leather/rubber as opposed to fabric.  The fit is a little small -- you may need a half-size up or go with a wide.  I bought my usual size and had to break them in for a while.   What I dislike most about this shoe is that the sole of the shoe is about 1 inch thick under the heel and about a 1/4 of an inch think under your toes.  So if you're planning on walking across gravel (like I had to every morning to get to the train station) expect to feel every little thing.  It's pretty obvious, but I had to learn the hard way, these shoes are DEFINITELY not for standing/walking for long periods of time.  I wore them for a few weeks at my cashiering job, and ended up having tons of leg/back pains.  After switching to proper walking shoes, the pains have since disappeared.  Ultimately, get them if you like the design but don't expect to stand/walk in them for long.  If the sole was fixed, this would be a 5-star item.

product_title: Danner Lace-in Boot Zipper
review_headline: Not a good design for the price.
review_body: I am a career firefighter and have gone through many differant boot zippers. If they had they would know that good boot zippers all have a velcro strap at the top to keep the boots from coming unzipped. I have purchased at least three sets of these Danner zippers over the years and can safely tell you they are not worth the purchase price. They come unzipped constantly. The zipper pull tabs fall off and they are obviously way overpriced. Don't be fooled, the quality isn't any better and they aren't even engineered to stay zipped. Come on Danner, some people rely on your products to work well. You can do better at a more affordable price. I shouldnt have to hire someone to sew velcro onto 37.00 dollar boot zippers. Say goodbye to another repeat customer. I think I will re-evaluate what I am paying for Danner boots also.   Try Thorogood duty boot zippers. They are cheaper have a velcro strap and last just as long. I found them at The Fire Store priced between 13.00-19.00 depending on the model. They carry 7,8,10,11 eyelet models. Some of them are NFPA approved. Sorry I haven't compared the NFPA vs the non NFPA versions.

review_body: These are great boots.  I have owned mine for over a year at the date of this review.  After a year of owning these, I'd say these boots are pretty tough. I recommend using mink oil, working the leather, and then bar-soaping the back of your heal, while wearing 2 pairs of thick socks while breaking these in.  They are on par with jump boots, only much taller, and with slightly thicker leather.  Make sure you don't lace the calves too tight, as you must account for muscle flexing and expansion while moving.  Only steam break the boot at your own discretion if you have to do it in a hurry for a gig, or a night out.  I would take the long traditional break in with these boots.  You won't be sorry.   Don't cheat yourself on your socks when wearing these, or you will be hating the back of your ankle-while still loving the boots!  They are very high quality all around.  I had the hardware on mine redone in black instead of chrome, looks good.  Its a good boot, very unique looking, and quite durable.  If I wear it about, just as a winter boot, I get probably 3 people stop me every day to ask about the boots, compliment them, ask where i got them etc.  I would buy these again!

product_title: New Balance Men's MX20 Minimus Training Shoe
review_body:
I've been wearing these MX20 Minimus training shoes for my workouts for about 2 1/2 months, and I'm very happy with them. I've worn various NB cross trainers in the past that I've been happy with, but this was my first foray into the \\"minimal\\" shoe category. I wasn't sure if I would like them when I ordered them, but I'm very happy with them.

I wear these NB exclusively for working out in a gym environment. The only running I do in them is 5-10 minutes on the treadmill, either a warmup or a few intervals. I would not try running in these shoes on pavement as the sole is very thin and feels soft and I'm guessing they would probably wear out quickly - they seem to be made for mostly indoor use. These aren't running shoes so that may be obvious, but in the past I've occasionally used cross trainers for short runs outdoors and I won't be doing that with these as I'd like them to last.

I don't do cross-fit per se, though I guess my workouts do sort of resemble it. I do mostly a combination of calisthenics, weight training, and some cardio/combo and kettle bell type exercises. For this type of workout, I find these shoes to be excellent - they're light, comfortable, and I like the flat profile, especially for squats and lunge type exercises (my feet just feel more planted on the ground with the flat profile). One issue I've had with traditional cross-trainers is it was always very important for me to buy a shoe with good lateral support - I've found with this flat profile, there isn't much need for lateral support because your foot is so flat and close to the ground, there isn't really anything to \\"roll\\" as in a traditional thick cushiony sole - awesome. For the little amount of running I do in them, I have found that it changes my stride so that I'm running much more on the balls of my feet - some people may or may not like this, and while I'm very happy with these cross trainers I'm not sure if I'd like the Minimus Road for longer runs.

I do not agree with the reviews that report that these shoes do not fit true to size. I've been wearing NB running shoes and cross training shoes for years and am consistently a size 10 - and these MX20s are no exception. I will note they are designed to be worn with or without socks, so if you wear thicker socks then maybe you would want to go up a half size. I've worn these both w/o socks and with very thin athletic socks [[ASIN:B002GWWFUI adidas Men's Climalite X II 2-Pack No Show Sock (Medium, Shoe Size 6-12)]], and they fit fine and are very comfortable either way. I think I'm leaning towards preferring to go sock free with these.
