product_title: ULU Women's Seona Boot
review_headline: The best boots I've ever owned!
review_body: These are adorable, comfortable and incredibly warm.  I live in one of the coldest places in the country and my feet have never been cold in these boots.  They also stay looking great.  I couldn't be happier with them!

product_title: Metallic Platform Pump
review_body: I really wanted these shoes because they were the perfect color and I liked the look of them.  I got them and they are the worst fitting shoes ever.  I liked the look fine (kinda cheap looking but they weren't expensive so I didn't mind that).  They are not adjustable at all and they are enormous no matter what size you get - like it is a factory defect on them - I say this because I tried 3 pair in different sizes (my normal size is a 7) before giving up.  They run huge and to make it worse, you can't simply order smaller because the front strap across toes and the rest of the upper portion of the shoes is same enormous fit no matter what size your order.  There was literally apx 3/4\\" between tops of my toes and the strap that goes across them-and apx. 2\\" between tops of my feet and upper top portion of shoe - I could literally dangle them off my feet when on.  Cute shoe - cute design pattern but horrible manufacturing!  Do not waste your time and money on these.

product_title: FRYE Women's Amelia 77205 Ankle Boot
review_body: I got these from another site for a very good deal and would have written a review there, but they are all gone and so the listing for the boot was taken off the site. My reason for posting a review is to give advice on sizing as I wish I was able to find out more before I bought these boots (if people actually put the exact size of their feet in inches). By doing this it makes the probability of getting the right size much greater which is a good thing when you are buying shoes online. I've bought many shoes online that had to be returned because the size was too big or too tight. Anyway these are my first pair of Frye boots and I must say that I was not disappointed.     I was a bit concerned about the sizing as I wear sizes 7 1/2- 8 1/2 depending on the shoe and brand. I ended up getting an 8 1/2 in these and its a good thing I did because it fits my left foot perfectly (my bigger foot which measures 9 3/4 inches). I will have put something in the heel of the right boot in order to make it fit right as my right foot is 9 1/2 inches in length.     Overall I am very happy with these boots. They are the perfect height for wearing all day and the canvas makes it wearable even now for summer (I got the grey leather/canvas pair).

product_title: FitFlop Women's Gogh Clog
review_headline: not as good as other styles
review_body: I bought some fitflop sandals over the summer and they were perfect for my sore plantar fasciitis feet. With fall coming up I decided to purchase a warmer clog and a pair of boots. The boots are great, but the Gogh clog has a hard sole and is not as soft on my feet as the other pair. I can wear them with a foam insert but they are not \\"all day\\" shoes like my other fitflops.

product_title: Pink Heartstrings Girls Squeaky Sandal Shoe
review_body: Bought these for my 22 month old daughter. She has received a lot of compliments for these shoes,and a lot of parents asked me where i got them from.She loves to walk in these.I think they are great for encouraging walking as well. I ended up buying two more pairs in different color. Quality is great,price is reasonable and kids LOVE 'em! What more can you want?!

product_title: GoLite Men's Amp Lite Running Sneaker
review_headline: Light but but hard to get on and off
review_body: The shoe is nice and light and comfortable. The shoes are difficult to take on and off. Makes it tough when you have to go thru airport security.

product_title: Black Solid Opaque Thigh High Stockings by Foot Traffic
review_body: They don't fit too right but still very nice and fast shipping. I really like the opaque-ness to it and am happy with the purchase

product_title: New Balance Women's WR1123 Running Shoe
review_body: I have never been able to exercise without having problems with my plantar fascitiis until these shoes. After a good run, my feet are as rested as they were at the beginning.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Leno-Pu Platform Pump
review_body: These shoes run at least a size small. I'm normally a 10 but had to get these in a size 11. They are stunning in person but not very comfortable to walk in at all.

product_title: KEEN Men's Newport Sandal
review_body: This is my second pair of this model of sandals.  The first pair lasted for two years through various hikes through the northeast US, from parts of the White mountains to the trails in the Shenandoah's, in all types of weather and all seasons.  Loved them.  There super comfortable, held my feet secure, and never broke down.  In fact the only reason I had to buy a second pair is because the first pair was lost in a move.  On the fitting front I'll echo other reviewers and say the sandal tends to run a half size big.  Also Keen footwear as a whole is made for a wider foot, at least on the male side.  Highly recommended.

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Yettuce Wedge Sandal
review_body: These sandals looked so cute online, and even out of the box, but I felt like they were a little too 'old' looking (I'm 37). Very comfortable, however. Hated to have to return them.

product_title: Simple Women's D-Kay Fashion Sneaker
review_body: Shoe is most comfortable walking shoe I've ever worn.  The colors are great, and the linings make them special.  It is light weight, but offers good support.

product_title: Wanted Shoes Women's Topsy Wedge Sandal
review_body: I ABSOLUTELY love these shoes! The style, fit, color and material is all very good quality!  The shoes are comfortable and the heels are perfect for all day wear.  Well worth the price!

product_title: New Balance Men's MO1520 Multi Sport Shoe
review_body: The shoe size is no longer too big. NB fixed it. I ordered one half size up and one up wider and had to send them back to get my normal NB size. I received my new pair and they fit great! I was sad to see that no one else updated the reviews as some of the reviews are years old...    Hope this helps you decide which size to get.

product_title: Australia Luxe Collective Women's Short Nomad
review_body: I love these boots.  The Australia Love (Luxe) Collective boots are the best ugg style boots I have ever worn.  Keep in mind, they are usually listed in Australian sizes that are 1 to 1.5 sizes larger than US.  So an Australian size 6 would fit a US 7 - 7 1/2.

product_title: Drew Shoe Men's Logan Oxford
review_body: It's hard to find shoes to fit my narrow feet. These fit fine. They are very sturdy and should last a long time. The shoelaces are too long.

product_title: Yin Women's Lola Sandal
review_body: What's not to love about these shoes?  They're wonderful!  I love the materials.  The suede is the silkiest, smoothest, and most supple I have ever experienced in a shoe.  It made the first wearing effortless with no break-in required, as only the suede touches the foot.  They're beautifully made as well.  The top stitching design is made with sturdy thread that's well anchored and not likely to come loose or unravel.  The wedge design is very stable underfoot with a man-made sole that is textured throughout for traction.  There's even an extra layer of the same man-made material on the bottom of the heel portion of the shoe, so they'll take plenty of wear.  I do not usually wear a shoe with this high a heel, but these are super comfortable right out of the box and very steady to walk in.  There's even a slight toe-bar designed into the bed of the shoe to aid in griping with the toes as you walk.  These are exceptional shoes at a great price.  I love 'em!

product_title: Montrail Women's At Plus GTX Hiking Shoe
review_body: I have had Montrail waterproof sneakers before and they were great, but these are even better!  I volunteer on a farm for rescued horses and in the summer it is just too hot to wear boots.  But there is always mud, muck, sand, and water.  These keep my feet dry and are so comfortable.  Yes I put a special insole in them but I'm on my feet for ~10 hours so I find a good insole is helpful to my back.  I even got stepped on by one of the horses last week and not only did the shoe not get damaged, you can't even see a mark on them.  They have a nice big toe box which I love cuz my feet sweat and swell, but they tie so the well the fit is nice and snug.  And the price I got them for on Amazon is ridiculous, I've never paid less than $85 for Montrails.  I would highly recommend these shoes.  and hopefully they will continue to make them so when this pair needs to be replaced I can get another pair.

product_title: Birkenstock Women's Mayari Sandal
review_body: I tried a million different sandals but these are the only comfortable ones that look halfway decent.  Still looking for the diamond in the rough - a sandal that is comfortable and stylish!  IN the meantime, this one is doing the trick.  The silver makes it seem almost cool - for a Birkenstock that is.

product_title: New Balance Men's MW967 Walking Shoe
review_body: I have worn new balance shoes for 10 years,I worked as a cameraman and was always on my feet,I have worn out my ankle joints and was looking for some relief,I must say i am disappointed with these shoes they flex just behind your toes,and I feel the sole is nice and spongy also the lateral stability is okay but in my opinion the  780 type shoe is a better alternative,these shoes would be good for huge people that are suffering not fit old dudes that are looking for a more helpful shoe.

product_title: Finn Comfort Men's Garmisch Hiking Boot
review_body: These are the most comfortable, and best looking boots i've ever owned! They fit like a glove right out of the box. Well worth the price.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Power Pressed Lace-Up Fashion Sneaker
review_body: This is my second pair of Skechers.   My pediatrist said they are excellent walking shoes for people with toe problems.  My husband now has a pair and loves them.

product_title: The Flexx Women's Coral Platform Slide
review_body:
This is a cute shoe that runs true to size. The cognac cashmere is a very neutral color that will go with everything. That said, I am a bit concerned about the soles. They were a bit slippery on the tile floor that I tried them with, and I don't dare wear them out just yet, and I have not yet decided whether or not I will keep the pair.

As a warning, the shoes definitely need to be \\"scuffed in\\" before wear - either wearing on concrete or using sandpaper on the bottom. The bottom of the shoe is just too slippery and unsafe otherwise.

product_title: Vera Bradley Zip Around Wallet in Versailles
review_body: This zip up wallet style is new to me but I like it. Historically I am more of a traditionalist with wallets and bags...leather, fold over. I really like this wallet though, nothing spills out.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Galactic Wedge Sandal
review_body: These shoes are super cute but unable to walk in them. I'm a pro at walking in high, high heels and wedges. But these shoes are made so narrow at the base that your ankle gives. It's like walking on a tight rope. Be very careful if you purchase and keep these shoes. I am returning as I am unwilling to walk a tight rope.

product_title: Betsey Johnson Women's Lizzzy Open-Toe Boot
review_body: Cute boots, good quality, very comfortable. I bought taupe leather size US 6 but I had to return them to buy size US 5,5. I am wearing EURO size 36. Maybe it will help european customers to decide which US size to choose.

product_title: NIKE Men's Air Force 1 '07 Basketball Shoe
review_body: I got them, and they are pretty good shoes.  I am used to the puffy shoes, so it was a little of a change, but they're good.

product_title: Avia A325M Men's Walking Shoe
review_body:
This is the second pair of these shoes I have purchased for my hubby. He works at an upscale hotel and does not want shoes that will mare tile or leave black marks on the floor. Having a non-slip sole is essential and he loves these shoes. We were buying them from Kohl's before, but they were pricier! He is so hard on shoes, but in all fairness, he puts many miles a day on them. He also has had back surgery and shoes are important part of his comfort level. These AVIA certainly have made this the shoe of choice for him.

Orders always arrive quickly.

product_title: Sanuk Women's Laurel Flat
review_body: A simple shoe with a flat no-support sole. Quality is good but you pay dearly for it. You can probably find something similar for less.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Scorpio Dress Slide
review_body: If you like to slip on your shoes and hit the road, then these are the ones.  This summer I gravitated to these shoes all the time.  Easy to wear and quick to put on and go.  Like these a lot! Comfortable.

product_title: Willits Little Kid Fringy Boot
review_body: Good quality. I got it for $17.97 and a minute later it was for over $20.00 today is for $18.00. ???? I will wait until is back to the lowest price. Not all sizes or colors are avail.   Really cute boot.  My daughter will be 4 in Sept. and use a size 10 in sandals and 11 in  tenis shoes. I will buy this product again.

product_title: Birdz Eyewear Beak Sunglass: Black Lenses with 1.1mm Polarized Smoke Lenses That Improve Vision By Reducing Glare
review_body: I have worn fit over sunglasses before and knew that they could be heavy.  I received a pair of fit over sunglasses right after I had cataract surgery.  They were inexpensive and were not polarized.  These are comfortable on long trips and look better.  Works for me.

product_title: Timberland Men's 63579 City Adventure-Front Country Clog
review_headline: Order a  size or two larger!
review_body: I do like the clogs and they do compare favorably to my other Timberland purchases.....but, there are sizing issues!  I'm a solid Size 13 in shoes.  These are smaller in sizing and with a high instep, very tight.  I returned for a   size 14 and, even still, a bit tight! If you have the same issues, get at least a size bigger, if not 2 sizes bigger.  The clogs are made in China.  Still made very nicely.

product_title: FRYE Women's Fiona 3-Strap Boot
review_body: I love love love these boots! I heard all the issues others were having, and yes they are a little hard to get on in the beginning, but they do get softer. I didn't have a problem with the calf area, they fit perfectly, so measure before you buy them. I am tall (5'10\\") and usally have a problem with the calf being too big. Just because I have big feet and I'm tall doesn't mean my calves should be huge too lol! I'm very happy with these boots!

product_title: adidas Women's adissage Slide
review_body: I love this sandal.  I have very bad feet and I need comfort.  This sandal did require a day or two but my feet adjusted well and I wear them all the time.

product_title: Camper 90095 Wabi Boot (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: These are the most comfortable rain boots I have ever seen. This year I bought the third pair of these boots. They probably won't work if your kid has wide feet, both of my girls have very narrow feet and love these pink boots very much. Also neoprene keeps warm well, so we use these boots from mid-March to mid-October. True to size (in European chart) And I'm thinking about buying an adult version for myself)

product_title: Minnetonka Women's Kilty Suede Moccasin
review_body:
These shoes are just plain great. They are really comfortable and look cute with any outfit. I reccommend them to anyone in the market for moccassins.

They also came packaged very nicely; in the orginal boxes and wrapped in tissue paper.

product_title: Stride Rite SRT Ellete H&L Sneaker (Toddler)
review_body: He wears a 7xw, and these shoes were one of our last resorts! Thankfully they fit him great, easy to put on, and I think they're cute. Lightweight and easy for him to walk in as well.

product_title: Allen Edmonds Men's Bayfield Boot
review_body: I wear my AE Bayfield boots on casual Fridays with blue jeans. Everyone thinks they are dress shoes until I pull up my jeans a little. Really comfortable right out of the box. You can't beat the Allen Edmonds quality.

product_title: Sorel Women's Joan Of Arctic Boot
review_headline: Size 12 True to size, high quality, warm and comfy shoes
review_body: I love the shoes. I'm normally a size 12 and was worried they would be too big because of all the reviewers saying they run a size too large. But I'm SO GLAD I got my normal size becuase these fit me perfectly and there would be no way that I could fit into a size smaller. I've worn them for a few days now and after getting used to the feel of a tall boot they seem very comfortable. My friend said they even look cuter in person and my husband (whom doesnt usually like fur or animal print anything) said they are really cute.

product_title: Pro Step Shoes: Men's Black Non Slip Nursing Shoes 8000001
review_body: After reading some reviews, suggesting that size might not be correct, I was very happy that it was a perfect fit! Extremely comfortable even after 10 hour shift behind the Bar!Great quality and good looks too. I would always buy it again!

product_title: BALLY Women's Stawell 47 Pump
review_body: I love my red bally pumps.  The quality is amazing and they fit true to size.  You can dress them up or down and they seem to go with anything i put them together with. Too bad amazon is sold out but i am glad i have mine.  Thanks amazon

product_title: Chocolate 60119 Aubrey Tote
review_body: I love the way this bag looks inside and out. The material doesn't feel like leather but has held up well. I prefer a stiffer bag that stays upright but I used this for travel and it was fine. The two choices of handles is great.

product_title: FRYE Women's Annabelle T-Strap Sandal with Wooden Wedge
review_body: This was my first pair of Frye's and I will have to admit I bought them for the brand name and the cheap price. But the high quality is very evident.  The shoes feel great and are very easy to walk in.  I bought these in the papaya color and the only thing that I would say is that the color is a lot brighter than pictured here.  I know it depends on your computer and the brightness of your screen a lot, but they are more of a hot pink/orange color.  Really cute but brighter than I thought they'd be.  I know the other review on here says they run small, but I'm always always always a size 7 and the 7's fit me perfectly!

product_title: Ray-Ban Aviator Large Metal Sunglasses
review_body: I've always liked Ray-Bans and these sunglasses do not disappoint. The lens color is perfect--not too light or dark, and the glasses are lightweight and durable. I love everything about these sunglasses. I highly recommend them to anyone who is interested in buying aviators. Shipping is very fast, as well! :)

product_title: FitFlop Women's Hooper Sandal
review_body: FitFlops are absolutely the best sandal ever.  They are so comfortable, like you aren't wearing shoes at all.  I have many different styles of the sandal and intend on buying more.

product_title: Economy Womens Ballet Shoe
review_body: thanks for your promptness it is greatly appreciated I don;t know of twenty more words to say thank you......not really liking the way amazon is doing this

product_title: Teva Men's Churn Performance Water Shoe
review_body: Purchased these for a trip to kauai.  My only complaint and it is a pretty big one....two days into the trip the stitching for one of the eye loops that holds the laces came apart.  Very disappointed.  Would have thought that would have held up for the life of the shoe.  Besides that, I was pleased overall with the shoes.  I went swimming, hiking, and just wore them for normal use.  The shoes are almost as comfy as sneakers.  The shoes would always be dry and ready for use at the start of each day.  As for sizing.....I wear a 12 and the size 12 I ordered fit just fine.  Overall a good shoe.

product_title: BCBGeneration Women's Bg-Talnia Wedge Sandal
review_body: I love my new shoes! They are the perfect color to match with everything! They are solid, well made and will last a long time!

product_title: Teva Women's Mush Adapto Flip-Flop
review_body: I read some of the negative reviews. However, I've never had Teva Mush before - so I wasn't expecting a wider shoe. My foot is \\"normal\\" width. I've never had to buy wide or narrow shoes. I've always fit perfectly in the standard size. This flip flop didn't seem narrow to me at all! The seperated straps are so cute! They are sporty but have a little funness to them. I'm very happy with this purchase!

product_title: Jambu Women's Journey Open-Toe Pump
review_body: Love ~ Love ~ Love these shoes.  I have them in every color.  The adjustable strap is basically invisible but truly lets you get a custom fit on these shoes. I wear a typical 71/2 to 8 but in this shoe I wear a 7.  My foot is slightly wide but these are perfect for me.  A person with a narrow foot my have a problem with them. The grey goes with everything and I get more compliments on them than any other shoes I've owned.

product_title: Cobian Fiji Women's Sandal (Silver) Size 8 - 8
review_body: These are the best.  I purchased a pair in Florida and loved them so I purchased a 2nd pair at Amazon.  I have problem feet and these were like walking on air!  You will not be disappointed!

product_title: New Balance Men's MW967 Country Walking Shoe
review_body: Hard to believe these shoes are waterproof and hike-able. They are excellent to wear and instill confidence due to their \\"grippy\\" sole.

product_title: PUMA Women's Zandy Ballet Flat
review_body: I purchased these shoes because I wear a lot jean and dark blues. Because I'd already bought the black/pink/grey shoes (in store) identical to the blue/yellow, I felt it was safe to go ahead and order the same size. Unfortunately, I had to break them in on account they were a little short. If there is anything more annoying when purchasing shoes (besides settling on a color) it's breaking them in. Advice...order the next 1/2 size up.

product_title: adidas Women's Predito_X Trx Tf W Soccer Cleat
review_body: I'm glad there is medium 5.5.  They fit great.  I've used these shoes to play on turf field and they work well.  I'd recommend them.

product_title: Grasshoppers Women's Sailor Slide Sandal
review_body: Just what I was looking for...a summer canvas slide to pad around the house. Would also be great for the beach, etc. The canvas needs breaking in at those spots around the big and little toes that tend to rub, though.

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's D'Lites-Raptures Sneaker
review_headline: Cute shoes, just not what I wanted
review_body: I love Skechers, they are my favorites!  But the description for these gave me the impression that they were slip-on, and not lace-up.  I returned them  :(

product_title: Crocs Women's Carlie Sandal
review_headline: Never been a Crocs fan, but I like my first pair
review_body:
Never a fan of Crocs, I decided to get a pair when a couple of my flip-flops just started breaking at the straps after wearing around the house for just a month or so. I like rubber flip-flops but I thought my previous pair of Havaianas would be more durable than the cheap ones I buy at the supermarket, but it also broke at the straps (I don't believe I walk like Godzilla), so I decided to try Crocs and see if they work.

It's very comfy, I like the way it hugs around my feet, not too wide, and the straps are shaped in such a way that it wouldn't be prone to breaking at the toe part. I probably may not become a Crocs clog fan, but I am definitely liking the flip-flops.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Tamra Platform Sandal
review_body: Muy buen producto, envio a tiempo, entrega eficiente, no tengo ninguna opinion negativa, de verdad estoy complacida con el articulo que recibi en mi hogar, en resumidas excelente servicio!!

product_title: adidas Master ST
review_body: I'm a big fan of the non-sports-geared Adidas line, for it's comfort and accommodating of my wider foot.  The fresh whites are exactly that and look like top notch shoes. The grey accent makes them look absolutely stunning as this particular grey just has something about it more appealing than other shades.  The shoes are crazy comfortable, crazy stylish, and a crazy good deal.  I'll probably buy a second pair so that when they're worn out I can start enjoying all over again, as I've done with several other pairs of Adidas leisure like these.

product_title: Maxstudio Women's Czech
review_headline: Nice, but not intended for wider foot
review_body: The shoe is nice, although quality is generally low (hey, price tells everything). I don't wear special wide shoes, but this one was difficult to stand as the leather will cut right on the toes. You can stand it, but is not quite comfortable to wear it for long time. One good thing is the balance and the heel height: definitely well done on that front, feels stable and sustains the arch.

product_title: Sam Edelman Women's Hadley Kitten Heel
review_body: Love this shoes, I got them in Mineral blue and the color is beautiful, show fits very well and I love the little heels. Nice working shoes, nice with denim.  Thanks amazon

product_title: BCBGeneration Women's Kelsi Ankle-Strap Sandal
review_body: This is a really beautiful shoe!  I almost bought the black ones but I'm so glad I didn't.  This shoe is more of a pewter/silver color which is a perfect neutral color.  The foot bed has more cushion than any other BCBG shoe I've ever worn & BCBG is about the only brand of shoe I wear.  It fits very true to size. All the straps are very soft & are not tight at all.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups XW Dyanamo Wedge Sandal
review_body: I have a lot of knee problems.  I have found that Skechers Shape Ups have given me considerable relief from the pain that I experience when I wear other shoes.  They do take a short period of adjustment the first time you wear a pair of them, but it is well worth it.

product_title: Natural Steps Logan Boot (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: These shoes are DARLING. Bought as a gift for my nephew - versatile for dressy or every day. My only complaint is that the description of the item doesn't mention that these are made in China. Thought some people might want to know this before purchasing.

product_title: ZiGiny Women's Ruble Ballet Flat
review_body: I bought these not from amazon, and they are super cute! i get compliments all the time. but the stones do fall off quickly and they aren't super comfy, the edges rub a bit and dont seem to loosen after wear. but a fun shoe if i dont have to do much walking

product_title: Lowa Men's Elite WXL Work Boot
review_headline: Extremely irratating Lace System Otherwise great Boot
review_body: These are great boots that provide a stiff solid footbed, and are very light weight.  They seem to breath very well and are great during the summer months. I really despise GTX boots because they are hot in most all conditions except below freezing temps.  The worst part of these boots is the lace system. I seem so have to fight with it to get the boots laced up tight.  The lace does not slide very well through the eyes and is constantly loosening as I release it to pull the lace tight.  Really bad design.

product_title: Columbia Women's Shastalavista Omni-Tech Multi-Sport Shoe
review_headline: size is little small than other brand
review_body: size is little small than other brand, it is about 1 size smaller. but there are really comfortable and look nice.

product_title: Portlandia Women's LaJolla Dress Sandal
review_body: This shoe can be worn all day, super comfortable.  It runs pretty wide though.  Color is not a true red, more of a brick red.

product_title: Guess Women's Basile Wedge Sandal
review_body: This shoes are really nice ..... the hills is more higher than on the picture but they are very comfi. Just the price is to expensive.

product_title: Coclico Women's Zela Sandal
review_body: I am a huge fan of Coclico shoes, having bought a pair of boots online that fit perfectly and are comfortable enough for long walks in the city. So, I thought it would be safe to buy a pair of Coclico sandals online. I was thrilled when these arrived, actually more beautiful than they looked online. Unfortunately, the thick metal ring proved extremely painful, digging into the top of my foot no matter how I adjusted it. I even took it to a shoe repair person, who added leather around the rings to provide a cushion - no better.     I'm really disappointed because the shoes are so pretty, I just can't walk two steps in them. I've learned my lesson - if you're going to invest this much money in a pair of shoes, better to try them on in store. ) :

product_title: Annie Shoes Women's Blanca Wide-Calf Boot
review_body: I too have wider calves and was thrilled to see this pretty boot on Amazon. The delivery was amazingly fast but disappointment quickly followed. The shoe part fitted perfectly but I could only do the boot zip up about half way. I did measure my calves (16\\" at widest part). I am investigating boot expanders but this will cost around $60 so I may be sending them back if this doesn't work out. Sigh!!

product_title: Seychelles Women's Chant Platform Sandal
review_body: I purchased these to go along with the season's 70s trend (bell bottoms, floral tunics).  They are surprisingly comfortable, though a bit awkward to walk in.  I can hear the chunky heel when I walk, and the zipper in the back was rubbing my ankles after a few hours of walking around in them.  However, the platform saves my feet from pain even after hours of walking around in them.      These fit true to size.

product_title: Zumfoot Women's Daniela Criss-Cross Thong
review_body:
I really haven't had much luck with Zumfoot and I will never purchase another pair.

The first two styles I purchased were ill-fitting, the removable sole wasn't stable and left me feeling really unsteady and my foot kept falling out the sandal, they were very large for size.

This pair, beautiful to look at, I was very excited when I took them out the box, I thought finally a pair I can wear, that was until I tried to put them on, this pair runs small to size and I couldn't get my foot to slide in.

Sigh...........Zumfoot are just not for me.

product_title: G.H. Bass & Co. Men's Brockton Oxford
review_body: I've owned four pairs of Bass \\"Bucks\\" and have worn each until they were literally falling off my feet. The pair that I am returning today is the first pair that I've purchased with a new design. While the shoes are advertised as \\"leather\\" and past pairs have been almost all suede, the balance of these is \\"man made materials.\\" They are rigid and uncomfortable. Moreover, there is a bizarre new tread that look like golf cleats. I'm switching brands.

product_title: Vintage Classic Leopard Tortoise Horn-Rimmed Style Sunglasses
review_body: I bought these glasses thinking they were going to be unisex -- I was wrong.  These are glasses definitely for girls.  Also, beware that the \\"tortoise shell\\" looks more like a leopard/giraffe pattern on the sides of the glasses.

product_title: Kork-Ease Women's Madalena Buckled Sandal
review_body: I wore these shoes no more than fifteen times over the summer.  The elastics that connect the buckles have stretched and basically disintegrated.  As a result, the shoes are so lose, they come off my feet, which is very dangerous considering the height of the heels.  I have now tripped or rolled my ankle enough times that I am afraid to wear them.  I contacted the seller to report the problem.  They have ruled out the possibility of a manufacturer defect and told me that the problem stemmed from \\"heavy wear and tear\\".  The sole, leather and heal still look like new but I can no longer wear these shoes because of this little bit of elastic that has stretched so much the shoe has become unwearable.  At this price, I really hoped that I could wear these shoes for at least another season.

product_title: Miss Me Women's Sora-2 Boot
review_body: Nice quality boot fits well and is very attractive.  The chocolate color is rich, and I love the style and cut of the boot as well as the flat sole.

product_title: Rockport Men's Hydrotrip Boat Shoe
review_body: this a wonderful shoe i go right from my boat to a restaurant and it works just fine, well made and quite comfortable

product_title: Dolce Vita Women's Crosby Boot
review_body: These boots were for my sister, they fit true to size and are of great quality. The leather is slightly perforated which gives them some character, and the suede is super nice and soft.

product_title: Crocs Women's Malindi Flat
review_body: My wife loves these shoes. They are comfortable and sassy. Love them for the beach. Can get them wet and if sand gets in they are easy to slip off. She did slip and actually sprained her ankle while wearing the regular croc, but have never slipped in these. Only problem is our 14 month old beagle thought these were the best toy ever: and really they are a lot like a rubber dog toy.

product_title: Timberland Women's Teddy Fleece Ankle Boot
review_body: I have been looking for a boot like this for a long time. This is a chic, stylish, unbelievably comfortable and practical boot. It feels like you are wearing sneakers. The construction of the boot is Timberland at their best.  I love this boot in the Wheat color. It is like the original Wheat Timberland boot that was given a more practical and stylish makeover. Somehow, the color is brighter, smoother and, in my opinion, has a more feminine look.   I originally purchased this boot in black and I am just adding to that review.  The fit feels true to size and the boot is incredibly warm. You can easily wear a thick pair of socks while ordering your regular size with these boots.  I have not experienced any tightening from the boot to any part of my foot or ankle. Gone is the extra thick leather on the back of the boot that hurt your ankle top.  Gone is the heavy weight of the boot that your foot and leg had to drag around. I have worn them at a full day's length now many times over and my legs and feet never tire.  These boots have good arch support built into them which is important to me since I suffer from a bad back. They feel like butter yet have the nerve to be made extraordinarily strong. What a boot.  I wanted the wheat color so that I could sport them for show with my jeans and I wanted the black color so that I could wear them when it snows since they are waterproof and I won't have to worry about getting them dirty.  The black color that I purchased is simply gorgeous. Made of a rich, elegant black suede on the upper part of the boot and a slightly lighter shade of black on the shoe part of the boot makes for an attractive look.  It is this contrast of the two colors of black on the boot that make the boot so eye catching. It's as if Timberland found a way to make a rugged boot put on an evening dress. It's pretty. The inside fur on the boot is nice as well. The fur is a 'just right' charcoal grey color that can't possibly get dirty. It will go with ANY color clothing you put on. How smart is that?  The wheat color is equally flattering. Again, it has a lovely wheat suede color on the upper part of the boot and a slightly lighter color on the shoe part of the boot. The inner lining of the boot is a clean, breezy light cream colored teddy fleece.   I can wear them all tied up to the top...or flapped down so that the fur will show... or up without having to string it all of the way up to the top. Whatever...It's my thing...I'll do what I wanna' do...Ha!  Whoever designed these boots should get an award. They feel so good on my legs that I just want to cry.  Bring the cold on. I'm ready for it and I'm gonna' be cute to boot.  Pun intended.

product_title: CTM Leather Squeeze Coin Pouch
review_headline: An Inferior Version of this Type of Purse
review_body: I have been using this type of coin purse since 1994 when one of my hands was injured.    I ordered this purse to have one on hand in case I loose the one I am currently using, and I am extremely disappointed with it.  This purse has a foul odor that does not dissipate over time.  The leather is stiff and, lacking pliability, it does not close completely or lie flat as do these kinds of purses when they are made of good leather.    When I reported these deficiencies to the seller, my money was refunded promptly.  However, I am still not happy because having made made purchases on Amazon.com, this is the first one that is clearly of inferior quality.    The purse I am using now I purchased on Amazon.com, and it is made of good, pliable leather.  I don't know who the seller was.  A good purse of this type is made of pliable, sweet smelling leather and it lies flat when it is empty.

product_title: Birkenstock womens Madrid from Leather Sandals
review_body: Comfy fit.  Perfect sandals.  I absolutely love them.  I would highly recommend them.  My feet are happy.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW606 Country Walking Shoe
review_body: Haven't worn them yet... Nice looking, great price...  Have had tons of New Balance over the years, so expect them to be fine.

product_title: ZiGiny Women's Meredith Motorcycle Boot
review_body: I have been searching for boots like this for a while now, and couldn't decide between these and some Madden ones, but I'm so glad I got these! I love them. It's true that the color of the boots in the pictures are not true to what they actually look like, but I am happy with that. I got the cognac color and the pictures of it look a little too orange to me, but the actual boots are a great color. I love the `distressed' look, as other reviewers have called it. I disagree with a reviewer as far as sizing goes though. I wear a 7 ½ so that is what I ordered. The toe area is a little slim, but after a couple days of wearing the boots and breaking them in, my pinky toes no longer felt squashed. The legs of the boots are very wide, but they look great with jeans tucked in and I've worn them plenty with a skirt and tights and they look good like that as well. All in all, I love these boots and I love that there isn't a zipper. It's a simple, classy style. I'm considering buying a back-up pair for someday when the ones I have die, or just another color for some variety. Anyway, get these boots, you'll love them :)    If you wanna see what they actually look like -   [...]

product_title: Shoe GOO Adhesive
review_body: I used this product on a pair of summer sandles that I bought last year.  They were so comfortable that when then side strap broke; I just knew I had to try and fix them.  I bought the shoe goo in hopes that it would make a quick fix.  It did; so far so good.  I have been wearing the sandles for about a month now and the strap is still holding.  This is a great product and it really works.

product_title: Timberland Men's Earthkeeper City Cap-Toe Chelsea Boot
review_body: I love these boots. I hate laces and these slid on and off very easy. Super Comfortable. Have had mine for 6 or 7 months and I think they are even better now that they are worn in. Would definitely buy another pair but, I see them lasting for a very long time.

product_title: Merrell Women's Barefoot Pace Glove
review_body: These are great minimalist shoes.  They were comfortable from the moment I put them on, with no rubbing, tight spots, or stiffness.  They are also sized well.  Best deal around and fast service...arrived a day early!

product_title: Teva Women's Pretty Rugged Sandal
review_headline: Nice-looking but seem to be damaged/sub-quality
review_body: The sandals look nice, especially for the kind of style. The problem is that they are uncomfortable. Well, it's more than just uncomfortable: The left sandal arch seems to be misshapen and sticks up too high and a little too close to the front of the sandal (so, out of position with the natural arch), making it too painful to walk on. The right sandal seems fine in that respect. Additionally, these sandals are not very cushiony and I suspect that even if the left sandal weren't wonky, I'd probably wear them only for short periods. Note that at the same time, I purchased another pair of Teva sandals - a slightly different style in cloth. I love those sandals and they are very comfortable to walk in for even extended periods.    For these sandals, though, I'm really disappointed because I simply can't wear them. My money was completely wasted. I would have rated them a \\"0\\", but will give them one star since they look good (only 1, since looks don't mean anything if they can't be worn!). Can I have my money back please since they are apparently damaged?

product_title: Sidekicks Foldable Ballet Flats Shoes w/ Carrying Case
review_body: I bought these to wear when I am a guest at others' homes so I can don't have to wear my shoes on their carpet. The idea of these flats are great and I love the carrying pouch. However, they are SO uncomfortable around my feet not because of the size but because of the elastic. I pretty much have to take them off of my heels to even be bearable!

product_title: Classic Tortoise Wayfarer Style Sunglasses
review_body: They're cute, and they have been my only pair of sunglasses for a few months now and still holding strong.  They do a great job for someone like me who has pretty sensitive eyes to the strong summer sun.

product_title: DVS Men's Daewon 9 Ct Skate Shoe
review_headline: what I expected from this brand
review_body: I always look for skate shoes, in this case it result in a really good buy, low price, excellent product and fast delivery.

product_title: Lock Laces - Purple - Purple
review_headline: Exactly what I was looking for.
review_body: These are my second pair of lock laces.  Bought the second pair to match my new running shoes.  I bought the original pair to make triathlon transitions faster - and they do just that.  They were easy to put in my shoes, the directions were clear and the lock stays in place.  I would suggest anyone using them for a race should give yourself a couple of weeks to use the laces before your race because initially its easy to get your laces too tight or too loose.  Once I figured out the perfect place to lock my laces, I marked the laces with a permanent marker so I knew where to pull the lock.

product_title: Vince Camuto Women's Majorca Sandal
review_body: The shoes are a nice leather quality. They seemed true to size but the heal strap is not tight around my heal and slides off.  Oh no!

product_title: adidas Originals Men's Ciero Lo Retro Sneaker
review_body: These shoes were purchased for a young skateboarding friend. He thinks they are great!They fit well, are the colors he chose and they perform well with a board.

product_title: Rocket Dog Women's Malinda Loafer
review_body: The shoe is fit perfect, looks great with jeans and skirt, and price was right!! The leather is soft and supple, the style is comfortable.

product_title: Ariat Women's Heavenly Boot
review_body: The Heavenly boot by Ariat is a great fitting, comfortable boot. I have a high arch and the top of my foot usually does not slide into a boot easily. I found these boots to be an accurate fit size wise. I sometimes have to go up a few sizes just to get into a boot. Love the brown suede top. A nice blend of very rich looking colors make them very stylish. LOVE THEM!! The turquoise accents add just the right touch of color. GREAT price too!!!

product_title: Charles Albert Women's Track Boot
review_body: I was disappointed because they are more costume-y then every day wear.  I can use them for Halloween though.

review_body:
I just went to get the cheapest asics for running and I got this incredible shoes, great just great
the first time I used them was in a 45 min running and was perfect

product_title: Johnston & Murphy Men's Shuler Side Gore Slip On
review_headline: The most comfortable shoe I ever wore
review_body: These shoes are great! Casual dress shoes that work with jeans too. Standing or walking in these shoes is very easy on the feet. They are the most comfortable shoes I ever put on my feet. The padding inside is so comfortable and very well made. Dillards has them for $135/pair, but on Amazon, I was able to save at least $50.00. I liked the black ones so much that I had to buy the brown ones too. I deep sixed all my other work shoes. I highly recommend getting a pair, you won't be sorry.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Sayuri Running Shoe
review_body: So far, I am thrilled with these shoes. I think it's been several years since I found a shoe this comfortable to walk in. My ankles and ball of foot aren't hurting after a long walk, which has been a problem. Honestly, for the price, if they wear out in 6 months I won't be too upset if I have to buy another pair. Strangely enough, the last pair that impressed me this much (10-freaking-years ago) were asics. I just couldn't find a pair with the correct soul anywhere when they needed to be replaced.    One thing: I have slightly narrow feet, but narrow shoes tend to be too narrow. I don't know if feet that fit comfortably in most shoes would be too wide for these or not. So I would suggest finding them somewhere to try on before buying them online.

product_title: Annie Shoes Women's Leana Low Heel Slide
review_body: These shoes are very stiff.  I was expecting the straps to be just that but there is a clear plastic piece under them... it is very stiff too.  The platform has absolutely no form and because it is so hard, there is no way it will be able to be broken in.  I am going to try an insert to see if that helps but not sure if I will be able to find one that can be hidden... very disappointed.

product_title: Palladium Pampa Hi Casual Boots
review_body: My Palladiums just arrived today and I was very pleased as soon as I opened the box.  They look even better in hand with the contrasting sole and body tones.  The canvas body and boot strings have a high quality look and feel.  The rubber insert and sole combined create a buttery comfort as you walk.  They look great with faded blue denim jeans.  I've already set myself up to purchase another pair of a different color.  Last and certainly not least, the shipping was free and fast.

product_title: Keds Anchor Chukka Canvas Casual Canvas Mid Mens
review_body: Got these for my boyfriend and he absolutely loved them. if your going for a classic clean look these are the shoes for you

product_title: Clarks Bermuda Daquri Womens Slip On Sandals
review_body: i wear a size 8.5.  i got to try these on today at the clark's store in our city.  it's hard to find shoes/sandals that don't make my big feet look even bigger.  therefore, these sandals somehow make my feet seem smaller since they're not too clunky in design.  these sandals are also very light in weight, making them very easy to walk with.  they do \\"mold\\" to my feet - the straps are made of soft leather.  there's some elastic on the strap nearest to the ankle, making it flex when you walk.  the taupe color is very nice.  the tan color is also nice too, but i decided on the taupe.

product_title: Lucky Women's Gildan Single Banded Mule
review_headline: A Lucky girl wears these well...
review_body: These are far and away the prettiest, most well-made sandals I've ever owned. I'm also a klutz and cannot wall very far in them... if you can handle heavy heels, these would be worth it.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW1442 Rock & Tone Shoe
review_body: I am on my feet all day at work as a nurse, and these shoes are great!  They are moderately supportive, light weight,  and comfortable with the soft thick rocker bottom soles.  These shoes put a bounce in my step!  I am a repeat customer, this is my second pair. True to size, and expected New Balance quality.

product_title: Saucony Women's ProGrid Hurricane 12 Running Shoe
review_body: I had bought my previous pair of Saucony when I was fitted for my orthodics--I tried on pair after pair before deciding on a Saucony pair.  This time I knew what brand I wanted--the price was lower than at the orthodics store---& they came swiftly!! I put my insert in the shoes & they fit perfectly.  I a completely satisfied!!!

product_title: Fitflop Women's Walkstar 3 Sandal
review_body: This is second pair ... my wife won't wear anything else from April to November (and has a furry version for those months)! Great for posture, durable, comfortable.

product_title: Rocket Dog Women's Memories Ballet Flat
review_body: These flats are cute! But, they have very very limited padding so when I walk they make my sole pain - (whisper) I think I'm even getting corns/calluses because of them... They are cute, but they hurt...Not happy :(

product_title: AmeriBag Healthy Back Baby Tote
review_headline: great bag (especially if you have multiples!)
review_body: I bought this bag when I had 3 in diapers.  It held all the diaper changing necessities plus bottles, changes of clothing, snacks, small toys-- whatever I needed.  There are multiple pockets of different sizes inside which make it easy to organize everything.  It also has the parent/organizer pocket on the outside, so I didn't have to carry a purse as well.      I found this bag very comfortable, much more so than the backpack style diaper bag I had tried previously.  I liked that I didn't have to take it off to get to the items I needed, whether they were inside the main body of the bag or in one of the outside pockets.  I just shifted the bag around a little and could reach everything I needed easily.  This bag was a good investment.

product_title: Pura Lopez Women's T802 Platform Pump
review_body: These are really gorgeous shoes. The platform gives you extra height without sacrificing comfort. The only problem is the sizing. These shoes run really small. I ordered a full size larger than my normal shoe size. The shoes also run a little on the heavy size, probably because of the platform.

product_title: Teva Women's Olowahu Flip-Flop
review_body: These are really cute shoes and comfortable.  The straps can be a tad bothersome until they are broken in a little and stretched to conform with your foot, but it didn't take much time to do that.  I have a couple of pairs and really like the way they look on my feet.

product_title: Sanuk Women's Yoga Mat Flip-Flop
review_body: Love these Flip Flops. They are like walking on a wonderful soft cushion. Wished I had them years ago. My daughter had me try on hers and was hooked after that. Sooo happy I found them on Amazon at an affordable price.

product_title: Men's 5.11 Tactical® 6" Company Slip - on Boots
review_headline: These boots are made for working
review_body: As a firefighter paramedic I am up and down and moving a lot on my feet. I was looking for a boot that would slip on and off quickly and also be comfortable around the station or on EMS runs. They are all of that and more. The size runs about 1/2 size large, but with a nice thick sock my pair fit well. They have broke in easy and have a great feel to them. I am not sure I will go back to lace ups again.

review_body: OMG I purchased this shoe with several others because I was going to Vegas, I thought I got an amazing deal( I was so wrong) The first day I put them on I walked down the Vegas strip by the time I got to the end of the strip the whole sole of the shoe lifted thats right the black part had completly lifted from the wood bottom I had to buy flats at walgreens to make it back to my room. review_body: Make sure you get the length before buying. The seller didn't provide this info, and I assumed the shoes would be sized like other shoes I wear. These turned out to be one size too long, even though they were labeled the size I would normally wear.

product_title: adidas Women's Pro Model 08 Team Color Basketball Shoe
review_body: Daughter wanted these for basketball and loved them.  They are a very well maintained shoe and still look like new.

product_title: Ray-Ban 8306 Carbon Fiber Polarized Sunglasses
review_body: Fantastic shades.  Litest mose confortable sunglasses ive owned.  These RB even have a gradiant or graduated lens. Little darker on the the top and litens up towards the bottom.  A little sensitive to smudges and scratched or I would have given them a 5 out of 5.

product_title: ACORN Women's Faux Chinchilla Collar Slipper
review_body: This is the second pair of acorn chinchilla slippers I've ordered and I just love them:)  They are comfy,warm and I wear them outside to get the newspaper even if it has snowed alittle.

product_title: Anne Klein Sport Women's Macademia Wedge Sandal,Black Patent,10 M US
review_body: I got the white ones and they look so pretty on my feet! I got lot of complements from other women, too! I have a slim foot so they fit perfect but I don't see them fit on more chubby feet. I have a size 10 and they don't look big. I'm thinking of buying them in black as well.

product_title: STEAM-30, 30 Eyelet Metal Plates Steel-Toe Leather Knee Boot
review_body: I ordered these boots (in the black) and anxiously awaited their arrival. I received them about 2-1/2 weeks later and couldn't wait to try them on. Let me start by saying that I normally wear a size 4 mans boot very comfortably, these seemed to run a little small to size. Although I could put them on without difficulty, I don't think I could wear them very long before they would become uncomfortable, so keep that in mind when ordering especially if you are a 1/2 size. Out of the box, they were awesome, nice detailing with a very industrial feel to them, easily transitioning between steampunk, goth and cyber-goth looks. They appear to be well made but again I haven't actually walked in them as yet. The zipper seems to be a heavy duty one, it is very stiff and tends to drag but I'm thinking it could be dressed to slide smoother. I've read that these boots tend to squeak so I'll be checking that out as well. I'll update with results and any other comments once the size 5's arrive.

product_title: Miss Me Women's Rachel-2 Platform Sandal
review_body: The shoe is very nicely done, I love the colors and even the materials it's made off. The heel is really high plus the platform so buy it only if you knowhowto walk on high heels  On the negative sides, the straps on your ankle don't fit perfectly so they might form a little mess around your foot which doesn't look to pretty but I still like how they look  I would definitely recommend the product

product_title: Badgley Mischka Women's Humbie II Pump
review_body: Planning a night out on the town and need a shoe that will give your look a quick POP!! Get these ultra sexy shoes - so comfortable too they are the best.

product_title: adidas Originals Men's Samba Sneaker
review_headline: Look good, comfy but man do they squeek
review_body: I usually don't buy clothes or shoes off the internet, but I figured I'd give it a try this time. The shoes look really nice, but they squeek like crazy. My co-workers can hear me better than George Costanza with corduroy pants and a pocket of tic tacs. I thought they just needed to be worked in a little, but weeks later and the squeeking is getting worse. Also, the one design complaint I have about the shoe, is the huge pull on the back, it sticks up at least an inch above the side. Luckily I wear pants with these shoes, so you can't see, but I've noticed it wearing against my ankle and that's quite annoying.

product_title: Pilar Abril Narciso 439320006 Shoulder Bag
review_body: This is a must have white bag,sexy with a pair of studded white shoes or sandals u will rock,nice party sized bag too .

product_title: Peace Moccasins by Old Friend Women's Jamie Fringe Flat Boot
review_body: Comfortable.  They run about 1/2 size small to true size, but they were good for me.  Comfortable, fashionable, but my only disappointment was that they were advertised as knee high, but are only about calf high.  SO, still looking for some true knee highs.  My next purchase will be some Minnetonka knee highs (I hope they are true knee-high).  Regardless, I love the look of these boots and comfort.  If they hold up like Minnetonkas, I will be very pleased.

product_title: Crocs Women's Cobbler EVA Lined Clog
review_body:
This is my second pair of Crocs, both shoes are the Cobbler Clog. I like the the durability and professed comfort of Crocs but because the garden type croc is so darned ugly I pretty much wrote them off. But I fell in love with this shoe and was not disappointed after ordering it. First it is cute cute cute. It is also very warm and lightweight.

The upper looks like leather, not plasticy at all.

I have had lots of compliments on this shoe and would highly recommend them.

product_title: KEEN Coronado Lace Shoe (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: My Grandson loves them and we are happy to see Keens in stylish types. He wears Keens because they are extra wide and fit his feet.

product_title: Skechers Twinkle Toes Shuffles Startastic Sneaker (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: I got these for my daughter a couple weeks ago and she LOVES them!. Perfect fit, nothing torn off, no complaints of her feet hurting. These shoes are adorable!

product_title: Skechers Toddler Deflecktord-Turbo S Sports Car Light-Up Super Z Sneaker
review_body: They are great, My son its really special about shoes and sneakers, but with his skechers he is so happy and sometimes the problem is that he just wants to wear those. They look really comfortable, something that i really like is that the lights are in the front part and not in the rear as in most sneakers so it's easier for him to look the lights.

product_title: Tom Ford Sunglasses TF 221 BLACK 01A ALI
review_body: I was VERY apprehensive to buy designer sunglasses online, as I usually ONLY buy from the big dept stores, or boutiques themselves....however, I took a chance.  And I am very pleasantly surprised and pleased.  Sunglasses are exactly as shown, advertised, and expected.  They fit fabulously...I saw these on Nene of the Atlanta Housewives on Bravo, and loved them...and had to have them.  Great glasses...great service...fast delivery, and packaging was great with the case, cloth, and authenticity card and manual.  LOVE. Fast delivery as well.

product_title: Merrell Women's Whiteout 8 Waterproof Boot
review_body: I just received them (earlier than estimated)and am totally in love with them. They are so much better then they look in the picture. They will be perfect for some 'serious' hiking. And it won't matter if it's dry, rain or snow. Haven't tried them out yet, but I know a good boot when I see one. It nicely 'hugs' your foot but yet leaves enough space for breathing. There is no possibility that you foot slides inside the boot. They are very nicely reinforced on the outside, and yet comfy inside. For boots like these, I would have expected to pay a much higher price than this. I cannot express how happy I am that I got them. Anyone out there who needs something practical, durable and inexpensive, these are the boots to go. Don't let the price fool you, they are much better than the price and then the picture shows.

product_title: Stride Rite Dynamic Sneaker (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body:
Much better quality than those available at big box store with a red target for a logo.

My son would wear through those shoes in a couple of months ... these have lasted close to a year.

product_title: MG Collection Everyday Faux Ostrich Purse Shoulder Bag
review_body: Received the purse on time and in excellet condition.  Love the bag and started using right away.  I can find anything in it because it opens up so wide.

product_title: FRYE Women's Carson Pull-On Boot
review_body: I wanted these boots for almost two years before I finally bought them. They are gorgeous, comfortable, and really high quality workmanship. I wear them as often as possible!

product_title: Skechers Twinkle Toes Groovy Baby Light-Up Sneaker (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: A well recieved gift that is popular among classmates, fits and wears well. Great colors and style, very fun for kids.

product_title: Clarks Women's Wave.Wheel Sneaker
review_body: I have big, wide, fat feet, so I wasn't sure about this one. I've been buying a different brand of walking shoes for the past few years; my feet look huge in them, but for comfort's sake, I was willing to look like a clown. I've been used to buying size 10W in order to have plenty of toe room, so that's what I bought in these. I could have actually worn a 9.5, but I'll keep these. These shoes feel very good on my feet, and they're much more flattering, making my feet look slimmer and more feminine. The \\"Wave\\" style with the curved sole actually gives a little more spring to my step. The insole is nice, with a little extra padding under the ball of the foot. The leather outer looks to be of good quality, too. I'm going to give these a few more weeks, and may look at ordering another color. At this price, and for this quality, it's well worth it!

product_title: Birkenstock Sandals ''Florida'' from Leather in blue 41.0 EU N
review_body: I am VERY happy, this company is great!  They fixed  my order when I made a mistake and were very quick contacting back. I would do business with this company again.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel Rocket 5 Volleyball
review_headline: Great, ONLY if you follow general Asics sizing issues!

review_headline: They help me to see more
review_body: I purchased these stick-on lens enhancements to prepare myself for glasses. I have used contact lenses for about thirty years, now, and I was beginning to have problems with irritations inside my right eyelid. I wanted to see how certain types of lens layouts would work with my daily routine, so I purchased these lenses to stick onto my \\"drugstore magnifying glasses\\". I have to say, they work pretty well... but I'm still not happy with wearing glasses. They tend to pick up a lot of reflections and in bright sun, it's even more difficult to see than with the contacts. For working on the internals of my computers, which I do fairly often. I find it daunting to get the reading magnification I need in the exact spot I need it, at times.   I think the term used is tri-focals for how I arranged the lens enhancements. I cut the lenses in half, horizontally, and placed them high and low on the magnifying glasses I wear, leaving the horizontal center slot open for distance viewing. This keeps me from having to crane my arthritic neck up and down to read a computer monitor or work on things at different elevations.  I have dislodged one of the \\"lens stickers\\" while cleaning, but it was pretty easy to reattach. I see others having problems keeping them adhered to their glasses, but I have had no problems with that, other than that one cleaning incident. I just use warm water and clean hands to affix the lenses on the back side of my +2.00 magnifying glasses, which I need to see distant objects... and with the 3.00 enhancement applied, I get the +5.00 reading magnification I need to read and do detailed close-up work. It's not perfect, but if I am never able to use contacts again, I have done my homework in getting used to wearing glasses, when the time comes. At least I can function, without having to wear two pair of glasses at the same time, so I can read... then remove one pair to see distant object. Carrying a pair of glasses in my pocket is not good for the longevity of the \\"pocket pair\\".

review_body: I needed a pair of summer shoes that were comfortable enough to wear while on my feet all day yet dressy enough to wear to work in an upscale retail store. I have very high arches and had heard great things about Chaco so I decided to give these a try. Figuring out how to adjust the straps the first time I wore them was darn near impossible and for the first day I nearly killed my toes with a too tight toe-strap. However after looking them up online (at Chaco's website) I was able to get them adjusted correctly and now I can fiddle with the fit whenever I feel like it. I have been wearing these shoes nearly daily for a few weeks now and I love them. My feet no longer hurt at night and I have gotten many compliments on their appearance. The first day I wore them I wore them for 9 hours straight...and hated them, my feet were killing me and I limped around the house barefoot wondering if there was any way to return them, but I read product reviews and realized that they would take some time to get used to. So I waited a day to give my feet a chance to recover and wore them again, by the third day they felt so comfortable that I was very glad that I had kept them, and I became a full on Chaco convert. My only issue with them now is the toe loop. I have never worn shoes that have a toe loop before and I am finding it a bit difficult to get used to, however it does keep my feet firmly in place (and they have had a tendency to slide foreword in the past). If you don't like the idea of the toe loop I recommend the other Chaco style that comes without it. The bottom line is, these are great shoes. Just expect them to take a bit to get used to.
