product_title: Naturalizer Women's Alina Slingback Pump
review_body: Very good shoes. Soft, convenient, super! I have bought at first to myself. And then and my mum same and we are very happy.

product_title: Robeez Mini Shoez Lil Half K Slip On (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: I love Robeez, but these just don't fit the bill. Whatever was used on the inside makes it impossible to get these on my son's feet. With socks or bare foot, it does not matter. It's like they used a non skid material on the inside. I cannot slip these on him, and I have other Robeez in the same size that slip one easily and fit just fine.

product_title: Capezio Brite Lites Unisex Dance Sneaker
review_body: These shoes are very comfortable and stylish!  Be sure to order up a full size.  Makes dancing more fun to have the proper shoes ;-)

product_title: Men's Sperry® Tremont Kiltie Tassel Loafers
review_body: I still like the look of these shoes but was disappointed in the quality of the materials and workmanship (relative to an earlier pair I had purchased).  They still look ok from a distance but a close inspection reveals flaws and they don't feel as sturdy as I recall.  My impression is that the manufacturer has been cutting corners.  I would only purchase them again if they were on sale.

product_title: COACH 15142 Womens Authentic Signature Purse Tote Handbag W/ Tags
review_body: Excelente producto, tengo varias cartera de esta marca y prefiero esta porque es muy fácil de llevar, es ligera, amplia, con departamentos para cada necesidad.  Ademas el suplidor la empaco de una manera muy conveniente, estaba bien protegida y  con poco volumen lo que me permitió ahorrar en el envío.   bye

product_title: Polo by Ralph Lauren Bal Harbour Repeat Slip-On (Infant/Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: I brought these for my grand daughter who will not stop wearing them she loves these shoes and the color holds up well after a lot of washing

product_title: Native Unisex Jefferson Slip-On Sneaker
review_body: I saw these shoes on the morning Today Show...I had to check it out and found Amazon carried them. They look just like the classic low cut All Star Converse, which I have a few pairs. The price was less than $20 a pair online and I ordered 2 pairs. I usually wear 10.5 size shoes, but this brand only offered whole sizes, 10 or 11, so I played it safe and got the next size up, 11. They came and I slip them on and the fit is a bit bigger than I thought, but never the less they were comfortable. They also look cool because it's so different...the holes make these shoe unique. Highly recommend them.

product_title: Pampili Angel 69.162 Sandal (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: This sandal is a treat for the eyes.  My little girl wanted me to put them on her feet immediately.  As she danced around the room she looked very comfortable.  But that did not last long.  To my surprise, I noticed something was missing.  One of the delicate pearls had fallen off.  I located the pearl and packed the sandals back in the box to be returned.  Such a shame because they are soft, feminine, cushiony and adorable.

product_title: Miss Me Women's Skid-1 Platform Sandal
review_headline: Miss Me Women's Skid-1 Platform Sandal
review_body: These are really cute and run true to size.  However the straps are not very strong, so I don't know how long they will last.  The price was right and I don't wear them very often.

product_title: Charles by Charles David Women's Krave Boot
review_body: I purchased these on sale.  In regards to quality and sizing the boot was fine.  However, I found these a little too high in regards to the boot shaft.  It sat mid calf for me as I am very short.  I didn't like to look of it one me.  Heel wise, the shoe was easy to walk in and I found it a comfortable shoe overall.

product_title: Columbia Men's BM3628 San Gil Mid Omni-Tech Hiking Boot
review_body: I BOUGHT THESE BOOTS FOR THE TERRAIN OF AFGHANISTAN. THEY TRULLY WORK! THEY BLEND IN WITH UNIFORM AND AMAZING ANKLE SUPPORT FOR SUCH A LOW CUT BOOT......GREAT BUY!

product_title: adidas Men's Powerlift Trainer Cross Training Shoe
review_body:
I've been lifting in a pair of Safes for powerlifting for the last few years. They were solid shoes, but they were wearing out, and I wasn't too keen on picking up replacements for $190. I'd been looking at the Adistars as well, but similarly, they were expensive and hard to find.

Then, I was browsing Adidas' website, and came across these. They looked like just what I needed. Picked up a pair and tried them out - I love them. Definitely a better fit than the Safes. I feel very well supported in my squats, and way more supported at the transition point than I did in the Safes.

I've seen some people complain that the heel isn't stiff enough for powerlifting - it hasn't been a problem for me. Perhaps not quite as hard as the block of wood in the Adistars, but I definitely have not been having a problem with the shoes feeling soft or losing any stability for that reason. Definitely recommended, especially for the price.

product_title: TOMS Women's Classics Flat
review_body: Love these shoes!! It took about a week for the shoes to get to me, but once I got the shoes, I was in love! I prefer wearing Tom's over the summer to flip flops. I also wear them to work and basically EVERYWHERE!! I love TOM's and I will be purchasing my next pair soon. This color actually matches with quite a lot of different outfits as well.

product_title: MG Collection Lucca Designer Inspired Glamour Shopper Tote Handbag
review_body: Received the bag today and I'm very happy with my purchase. Nice size, not too large and definately not too small. Will see how it holds up over time but for the price you just cant beat it!! Still cant believe how fast the shipping was! Thank You!

product_title: Zengara Men's Z30008 Slip-On
review_body: I was looking for some light weight plain black shoes for everyday use. This item is plain alright, but pretty damn heavy. I ended up returning it so can't comment on the comfort.

product_title: Saucony Women's ProGrid Omni 9 Running Shoe
review_body: I use my own arch supports

product_title: Roxy On The Go Satchel
review_body: Has a lot of compartments and good interior size. My girlfriend uses it constantly and I have yet to hear a negative remark about it. Good buy.

product_title: Sperry Top-Sider Cutter Hook-And-Loop Boat Shoe (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: I purchased these shoes for my son for an event in June (for which they actually did not arrive in time).  When they DID arrive, they were ever-so-slightly too big, but I had purchased them with the intent of them being his school shoes for the fall as well, so it was no biggie.    Fast forward 2 months and *maybe* 5x wearing the shoes.  The strap has come unstitched and is coming out of the shoe!!!!  This is MOST CERTAINLY not the quality I expected or paid for when I bought Sperry Top-Sider.  I'm not even sure after a few wears that I can return these, but I'm sure going to try!!!!

product_title: Drew Shoe Men's Traveler Velcro Walking Slip On
review_body: I've worn Drew shoes before most recently the Force v and they fit great but these were under-sized as to width and the Velcro straps were too short and there was no way to tighten the fit as these were just a lay on top of the shoe strap with no loop hole to run threw for a tight fit. So a tight fit and poor design for this model.

product_title: Gentle Souls Women's Iso Slip-On Mule
review_body: Very comfortable and cute! I wear this all the time - with casual as well as work clothes. Highly recommended.

product_title: Teva Women's Omnium Sandal
review_body: I got my Teva's a week and a half ago and put them on my feet and they fit so perfect. I have wide feet and have to usually buy shoes a 1/2 size bigger in order to compensate and give me plenty of width.  I read all the reviews and decided to get my original size which is a 7 ½ and they fit so perfect.  They are so comfortable.  I will defiantly continue to buy Teva's.  Thank you

product_title: Handy Manny Boys Large Blue School Backpack with Detachable Lunchbox Kit
review_headline: More Space, Very Cute, Vibrant Colors
review_body: If you're looking for a backpack that's a bit bigger than the regular kid ones, this one is for you! It has more room than most so that i can fit in towel and swimsuit, a spare outfit and 10 pullups in it just fine. the lunch box is insulated which is nice for keeping food. plenty of room in it for an apple, yogurt and sandwich. a very good purchase. The lunch box attaches with two velcro straps so it's easy for little ones to undo to get there lunch. Colors are vibrant and the bag can be wiped down easily for cleaning since it has a shiny surface.

product_title: Volatile Women's Stardust Boot
review_body: I love these shoes. They fit great and were true to size for me. They are a little stiff at first so I would make sure you wear them a few times to break them in before any major walking around is done, but that goes for any boot really. Over all a great shoe for any Punk rock chickie :)

product_title: Columbia Men's Globetrekker Rugged Casual Shoe
review_headline: these are great! i use them the whole day!
review_body:
I live here in the Philippines so whenever someone I know heads off to the US or comes back, I make sure I make a couple of shoe purchases.
It's hard sourcing my size here as the sizes only go up to 12 (at the rarest; I roughly fit anywhere between a 14-15 depending on the design) which makes purchasing in the US the better option.

This pair is light and very comfortable. Commensurate to it's price, this is a great buy. I broke it in in only half a day but it didn't feel like it was the first time I wore it. I use these most of the time in the office and I don't tire in them.

product_title: La Regale 28904 Clutch
review_headline: it shows gold beads with silver  ,but it is all silver
review_body: I ordered the bag to be able to wear it with gold or silver beacause the picture showed a silver bag with gold beads,  but when I got it, it was all silver.  Beautiful evening bag, but not what I wanted or ordered.  I returned it

product_title: adidas Women's Supernova Sequence 3 Running Shoe
review_body: I tried many different shoes before the local running store fitted me with these (actually another pair, this pair from Amazon is actually my 2nd pair).  From the very first run, I had NO PAIN when I had been plagued with shin and knee pain before.  I highly recommend these shoes.  And better to snap them up now since the new model is out and is not as good!

product_title: Reef Women's Seaside Sandal
review_body: Absolutely love these sandals!!  They are super comfortable and fit my fit wonderful.  I wore them for over 10 hours one day and my feet weren't even sore.

product_title: Skechers Women's Tone Ups Run Lace-Up
review_body: I saw these at DSW and found them $16 cheaper on Amazon.  I have a hard time with shoes and these fit very well.  I use them for my work shoes - I am a RN.  One thing I really like about them is that they are light weight so being on my feet for 8-12 hours a day this is a plus.  At the end of a shift it doesn't feel like I'm lugging cement blocks around at the end of my legs.  Size is true to fit & they have a fairly good arch support.  I would purchase these again.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Melbourne Flip
review_body: These flip flops are very comfortable. I wear them all the time. The only thing I don't understand is why there is carpet in the middle. I have the black ones, so you don't notice it so much. But any other color you would.

product_title: Red Large Vicky Giraffe Print Faux Leather Satchel Bag Handbag Purse
review_body: Is a very nice bag, I just like the style, even I'm not a fan of animal prints, u also have a lot of space. I like the metal details at hangers. The faux leather looks like very good quality, expensive bag but the price was unbeatable! I can't hardly wait to wear it this fall and winter!

product_title: Timberland Pro Men's Direct Attach 8" Steel Toe Boot
review_body: A bit heavy but well insulated and very sturdy.  Got these for winters in the northeast and I think they'll do fine.

product_title: Miz Mooz Women's Violet Wedge Sandal
review_body: I think it would be a lot cuter if the wedge was a few inches higher. The bottom strap is really loose so I had to weave the top strap under the bottom one to make it appear snug. Exchanged them and got the Miz Mooz Kaylee wedge sandal instead; love them a ton!

product_title: Cole Haan Women's Air Natalie Low Wedge Sandal
review_body: Like the colour and the quality of leather on this shoe.  They are just a bit slippery when wearing them so I will probably buy a couple of gel pads to keep them in place.  But, they look great on the foot and have a comfortable bed due to the Nike technology.  I wanted a stylish shoe that I could wear all day while on a trip and these will do the job.

product_title: Vibram Lady Fivefingers Bikila Sports Shoes
review_body: The most comfortable shoes I've ever worn! I needed to get a new pair of running shoes. As in other reviews I had read that many runners had had problems with shin splints, sore ankles, etc. and once they purchased these shoes, all the issues went away.  My own mother bought these when she started doing triathlons.  Prior to the Bikilas she was having issues with her back, now she has none.  I am a mother of two (14 months and 4 years) and started training for my first mud run.  I was having problems with shin splints and sore ankles.  I purchased the Bikila shoe and gradually began running with them to break them in.  I had no issues with blisters, loose shoes, nothing.  I live on a gravel road as well and it wasn't really an issue.  Finished my first mud run with these shoes and loved it! Highly recommend.

product_title: Rainbow Sandals 301ALTS Mens Single Layer Premier Leather Dark Brown Leather Large / 9.5-10.5 D(M) US
review_body: a little uncomfortable while breaking in the sandals, but after wearing them for a week or so, they are the most comfortable sandals ive ever owned.

product_title: Capezio Women's DS11 Fierce Dansneaker
review_headline: Comfy shoes NOT FOR STUDIO USE
review_body: These shoes are very comfortable (although be sure of sizing.  Order 1 - 1.5 greater than you usually wear) and do have good arch support.  HOWEVER, they scuff like crazy.  I wore them to my studio once and left black marks all over the floor.  Do NOT buy these for studio use unless you plan on scrubbing the floor afterward.

product_title: Pour La Victoire Women's Erika Flat Sandal W/Bow Detail
review_body: I was at the mall and a woman approached me and asked if my sandals were Valentino! I looked at her funny and she seemed real serious. I told her i got it from amazon and told her the brand. she whipped out a pen and paper and jotted it down. she said it was so beautiful. It really is! im an 8, i ordered a 7.5 and it fits perfect. Perfect! get half a size smaller. Buy these!

product_title: Teva Men's Dozer III Closed-Toe Sandal
review_body: After reading all the reviews I could find on this product, I was fairly confident in buying these shoes. However, when I got them, they rubbed blisters after a few hours. I tried to push through them thinking that the shoes needed to be broken in. After a few days wearing them, there was no change. I had the fit right, but it didn't help. They look great, the soles are good, but the straps were unforgiving.

product_title: Designer Inspired Abigail Shoulder Handbag - Colors Available
review_body: Parts started falling off this bag. Very poor quality I   returned it and was given an immediate refund.

review_body: What a bad experience with such an expensive shoe, the design does not allow feet perspiration out of the shoes.

product_title: Perlina Women's Moda Loafer
review_body: This is a very comfortable shoe. Fits very snugg as first but wears into comfort.  I have no negative comments to this shoe other than the laces were abit too fragile, they tend to break very easily so be careful with the two bobs at the end of the laces.  Other than that, it is worth the money and I would recommend it to other buyers.

product_title: Sperry Striper Brown Laceless Shoe
review_body: These shoes aren't bad overall, but don't buy them believing that you won't be needing shoe laces because the elastic straps used to avoid them stretch and become worthless over time.

product_title: Clarks Men's Touareg Oxford
review_body: gLAD TO HAVE THEM FINALLY, ALWAYS WANTED TO  GET THESE AND JUST NEVER HAD MY SIZE ETC. LOOK GREAT, FEEL GREAT AND THEY GO WITH EVERYTHING. MOST OF ALL MY GIRLFRIEND LIKES THEM !  SHE HAS EXCELLENT TASTE, THAT IS WHY I LOVE HER!  A. HARDAGE

product_title: Merrell Women's Oceania Slip On Shoes
review_body: I have purchased 3 pairs of shoes trying to find a combination of style & comfort and the Merrell Oceana fits the bill.  I found that they run true to size, maybe a touch wide in the heel but not enough to cause any problems.  They look great with khakis.

product_title: adidas adissage Fitfoam Slide Mens
review_body: I orderd a pair in black & white for my son.  He loved them so much I had to order (2) more pair in the blue and white one for him and one for his dad.  They said they love them and that they are very compfy. Thanks a Million!!

product_title: Kids Sunglasses Uv 400 Rated Ages 3-10 Gunmetal Grey
review_headline: Never got it, never got a response about it
review_body: I contacted Amazon and the maker of the glasses about never having received these and never heard a thing. Glasses might be great but I wouldn't know!

product_title: FitFlop Women's Supertone Lace-Up Sneaker
review_body: I had a very bad break to my left ankle end of January and am still recovering.  The only shoes I can wear all day that keeps me almost pain free are my Flip Flop shoes.  Have many comments on the bronze colour but people are made aware that I am back on my feet.  I love fit flops - wish more colours were available for International shipping.  Left foot fits well due to swelling - right foot is fine - have size 7 in black which is fine but if I need to wear ankle straps the 8 is better.

product_title: New Balance Men's MR993 Running Shoe
review_headline: A 99x Fan-but I Was Quick to Judge
review_body:
I started with 991s and have followed this series along to 993s for their fit and comfort of my relatively small foot.
Follow up: Comfort was unsurpassed, however, after 13-months and an estimated 500 miles (3 miles every other day), surprisingly, the soles of these shoes wore through the black outer sole and into the soft white layer. The worn spot is as big as a baseball. I have two other pair of 991s that are several years old that I retired and currently use for outdoor workshoes. Neither pair has this type of ware. I downgraded by rating to 1 from 5 stars.

product_title: MBT Women's Maliza Oxford
review_body: I work 12 hour shifts on my feet! These shoes are the best shoes out there that help prevent back and joint pain. I have noticed an improved posture as well. I cannot speak for muscle toning because I have only had them for about 1 month. I normally wear a 7.5 shoe (medium width) and I ordered a 7.5 shoe. It fits great. The tongue was stiff for approximately 2 wears. Also, I wore them straight for 12 hours from the get-go without any trouble. It does take a little adjustment, but I wouldn't trade them for the world.

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Kismet 6 Slip-On Loafer
review_body: When I find a pair of shoes that fit well, wear well, and are comfortable, I get multiple pairs in different colors.  Such is the case with these shoes!  They are well made, very comfortable, and the animal print design also make them fun to wear!

product_title: MIA Women's Bonnie Western Boot
review_body: one of my favorite buys last year.  great shoes.  comfy and stylish.  def would buy more from this manufacturer.

product_title: Baggallini  Metro Bag
review_body: This is my fourth Baggallini and I'll probably never carry anything else. I originally purchased for a long trip but found they are perfect for every day. When I needed something to carry my iPad in, I knew right where to turn. Sleek, light, many compartments, all sizes and styles and the price is right.

product_title: Nine West Women's Kedan Knee-High Boot
review_headline: Boots are different colors from one another . . .weird.
review_body: The boots fit great, great quality . . .EXCEPT. . .one was about three shades darker than the other. I ordered the lightest option, I believe it's listed as \\"natural\\", and was just blown away that you can spend nearly $200 on a pair of boots that arrive looking like two completely different colors. They are already in the mail to be returned. QUALITY CONTROL PEOPLE! PLEASE!

product_title: Rockport Men's Cape Noble Driving Shoe
review_body:
Amazon had a smoking deal on these with great feedback/reviews so I thought I would give it a shot. They have held up good so far but the true test is now as winter rolls in. I had a similar pair last year and they did not hold up well once they came into contact with the Mag Chloride they treat the roads with for snow. I always made sure to clean them but they did not hold up.

Hopefully this pair will do the trick. Very comfortable, easy to slip on and there is no creasing of the leather from typical walking that bends the shoe.

product_title: Coleman Classic Duck Boots
review_body: I work outside as a ramp agent at an airport. I bought these boots because I work in the rain and snow and need some protection for my feet.  Anyway, wore the boots on a light \\"foul\\" day (rainy) and my feet were soaked within an half an hour of wearing them.  If you work outside I suggest something else.

product_title: ZiGiny Women's Message Sandal
review_headline: Beautiful sandal with a few issues
review_body: I saw this shoe in a shoe store, loved the look, but they didn't have my size. Based on the way the shoe in the store fit, the store clerk suggested I try to find a 7-1/2 even though I normally wear a 7. I took the clerk's advice and the 7-1/2 I ordered through Amazon.com was the perfect length. There were, however, other issues. Because of the elastic on the buckle, there was \\"heel wiggle\\" (in fairness, I have a narrow foot). Also, the insole and outsole of the shoe was very slick, which didn't help the heel wiggle issue. I liked the look of the shoe so much - glam yet casual - that I took the shoe to a shoe repair shop and they shortened the strap on the heel. I added skid proof pads on both the insole and outsole. Problem solved. My sister, who ordered a pair the same time I did, has a wider foot than me. She ordered her usual size 7 and the shoe was slightly too short and too narrow and she had to send hers back. I will also say the shoe is very flat and offers no support, so if you have arch issues, beware. I will also say I have gotten compliments on them whenever I wear them. I would give 5 stars for the beauty of the shoe, but have to take away a couple for the sizing issues.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Baya Clog
review_body: If you need a roomy shoe, these are great.  They are not a fashion statement, but if you have podiatric problems, they do provide comfort not style.

product_title: DKNYC Women's Vera Peep-Toe Pump
review_body: These are absolutely the cutest shoes.  The pic is accurate the shipping was fast and I am completely satisfied. Have received loads of compliments on these shoes!!

product_title: Crocs Women's Lenora Flat
review_body: My old crocs were getting a little worn out after 3 years of use, so I needed another pair.  These are PERFECT!  My foot size is about a size 9 1/2 to 10, but I ordered a 9 since my old crocs were a 9.  The are a tiny bit small (if they made a 9 1/2, it would have been perfect), but they are great.   I do agree with other reviews that they squeak alot when walking in them.  I'm thinking this will diminish over time (I remember my old crocs doing this when they were new).

product_title: Tignanello Women's Draw-string T89905 Small Draw-string
review_body: If you've seen any of the other purses I've reviewed, you'll know I'm a purse junkie. This purse is pure quality.  Plenty big to carry lots of stuff, including my favorite book, but not bulky and cumbersome. It's comfortable to carry and has inside pockets for all those little things that get lost at the bottom of a big bag.  There are also 3 outside pockets for those things you want quick access to. The handle is nice and strong and actually stays put on the shoulder.  Tignanello can be a little pricy, so I always wait til they're on sale, but you simply cannot beat the quality.  Even at full price, the bag is well worth the price.  It was a little stiff when I first bought it, but has quickly become soft cozy-feeling.  I love it....GREAT bag!!!

product_title: Lug Life Round-trip Moped Day Pack - Navy
review_headline: Another huge kudo for Lug Life
review_body: Bought this bag to take on vacation so that I wasn't lugging around a huge purse, and although my usual wallet and checkbook I carry were too big, I got a smaller bill/credit card/change purse that worked well.  I lugged it around Disneyland and the San Diego Zoo all day long without shoulder fatigue, and even had a small water bottle in the holder!  A good buy!

product_title: Nine West Women's Vocan
review_body: I wear platforms and wedges almost exclusively with no problem but I can't wear these at all; they are painful and very difficult to walk in.

product_title: Sanuk Women's I'm Game Flat
review_body: This is my THIRD pair of sanuk shoes and I am beyond excited to get them in the mail.  They are surprisingly comfortable.  I was apprehensive about the comfort when I wore them for an entire day for the first time.  I was pleasantly surprised and delighted.  I also have a few pair of their flip flops and they're amazing.  I am so impressed by the Sanuk brand and would highly recommend.  They are also incredibly cute and I get so many compliments on my pair of zebra print sidewalk surfers.  Can't wait to rock the giraffe print!

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Ready Set-Move Sneaker
review_body:
This is by far the most comfortable shoe ever. I bought Sketcher Shape Ups and while comfy they were hard to walk in (to tall for me). The tone ups are perfect and for anyone with knee,ankle or back issues, I have never walked over 10 miles and been totally pain free!!! They are so light weight it is like walking on air.

I am going for my second pair..and by the way they run a tad narrow which is great for me and sizing is dead on!

product_title: Mundi� Change Purse APPLE GREEN
review_body: I am very satisfied with the wallet.  I really like having a place in the wallet to keep coins.

product_title: Ariat Men's Heritage Roughstock Western Boot
review_body: I bought my pair of Ariat heritage boots on sale in 2005.  These are the only boots I can wear all day without killing my feet.  I typically just wear these with jeans, but a quick polish allows them to look good with a shirt & tie so I can wear them to work too.  After six years, these are still incredibly comfortable.  They have been scuffed and scraped, but I can always get them looking like new again.  I'm actually about to purchase my second pair (needing some black boots too); and I've always been told once you find a good pair, stick with them.  I tried them on in a store recently, and Ariat apparently hasn't changed anything about the way they're made because they feel just as comfortable as my old, broken-in pair.

product_title: Silver Leather with Sparkle 2.5" Heel
review_body: The shoes have arrived today, and I just tried them on. They are very beautiful and shiny. And that's what I was really looking for and wanted to have!  The width of my feet is relatively wide, and I have bunion. So, I was very afraid that these shoes might be tight and cause pain for me. But they are comfortable and supportive. I am very happy that I got these shoes!

product_title: UGG Australia Women's Broome II Boots
review_body: I'm happy with these boots,but I do find the the leather isn't soft and they do looks kind of stiff. I tryed putting lotion on to soften them up,but that didn't work. That is why I'm giving them a 4 star. If they do soften up, I'll love them. They are true to size, because I do wear this size in boots.

product_title: NEW AUTHENTIC KATE SPADE KILLINGTON LARGE COLIN COSMETIC CASE SET
review_body: I love cosmetic cases and have another Kate Spade one, but this one is awesome b/c it is so big and holds a lot!  When I traveled I put all makeup in the small case and then all my face products, shampoo, etc in the bigger one.  It held everything I needed so I was thrilled.  Not to mention it is super cute and the material is very durable!

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Becca Knee-High Boot
review_body: The boots are nice looking. They are very comfortable to walk in. Fits well. I've received many complements. Goes pass my knees just a little bit  I'm 4'11'').  I have big calves so they are tight around the calves. Overall, a great buy.  Shipping in 2 days. Love it!

product_title: Sugar Women's Chained Cat Flat
review_body: These shoes are comfortable for casual use. (They do not have any arch support so might not be the best for a lot of walking.) They are definitely wider than standard width shoes.

product_title: Kate Spade Macdougal Alley Metallic Stevie Satchel
review_body: I got this handbag in black and it is gorgeous! The leather sparkles and it is big enough to fit all of my things. I've even carried my netbook in it. I wanted to wait at least a month before writing a review.  It's been almost two and I still absolutely love this handbag!

product_title: Clarks Men's Wallabee Shoe
review_body: the wallabees were such a great buy!  they looked great and were just as they were presented on ebay.  Thank you so much!

product_title: Kate Spade New York Women's Vonya Sandal

product_title: Capelli New York Kids Shiny Space Chase Printed Toddler Boys Rain Boot
review_headline: Can't beat them for the price!
review_body: I looked for rain boots for my daughter for several months before purchasing these.  I am a mom who usually buys things with the price/# of times worn ratio in mind, therefore I look for used items first as long as the item is still in good shape first before considering brand new.  Thus, buying a new pair of rain boots that she will grow out of in a few months for 20 dollars was not ideal for me.  However, the time spent looking for a particular size/# of times worn ratio was also a factor!     These boots were the answer!  I bought the pink girl boots with the peace signs, stars, and flowers in size 6/7 for my daughter who was, at the time, 19 months old.  First, their sizing is for two sizes, a super-plus for those children whose feet seem to grow fast (like mine!). Admittedly, in the beginning she was still more of a 5/6 size and the boots fell off her feet a few times.  However, that stopped when her sneaker size moved from a 5 to a 6.     Second, I read several reviews for other toddler boots where they may fit well once on, but it was quite difficult getting them on to begin with.  We have never experienced that with these boots.      Third, I had some concerns about the comfort of rain boots in general having really no arch support.  These boots come with little foam footpads that, although are far from arch-supporting insoles, help with the comfort factor.  To be honest, my daughter wants to wear these all the time, rain or shine, so even though she does not have the words to tell me they are comfortable I believe that actions do speak in this case!      BONUS: if you are looking for cost-effective with the added bonus of the cute-ness factor these are a winner to!  We've had more compliments on these boots in the 3 months that we have owned them than we can count.  Also, to improve on the # of times worn factor, I had the unexpected but pleasant surprise of my daughter wanting to wear them when we wash our car in the driveway (even though she is wearing abathing suit) as well!    A possible con: to be honest, the height of these boots is really not the highest, so it is possible that she could walk through a fairly deep puddle and have wanter run into the boots.  However, this is a rare occasion where we live so this was not a factor in my decision to buy these boots.      Overall, I could not have asked for a better bang for my buck!

product_title: Clarks Men's Keating Sandal
review_body: I am 63 years old and have never worn sandals before other than as an alternative to house slippers. I have a very high instep and top of foot, normally wearing a 3E shoe to accommodate this extra height. In the hot Carolina Summers, I was looking for something cooler than walking shoes so I started looking at sandals. Several things you come across early on: most only come in D or Medium width, many are nothing more than unlined leather, many have rubber footbeds that make for a sweaty and slippery experience in 100 degree days, and few know which way to install velcro.    I had purchased a pair of Dunham (New Balance) online from DSW, thinking they would work as they had adjustable front, ankle and back straps. But when they arrived, I was vastly disappointed as the only strap that would reasonably fit was the back strap. The front and ankle straps left over an inch of velcro hooks exposed to snag on whatever might brush across them. Also, the \\"decorations\\" in the middle and end on each strap were all very much off misaligned. So I went to the local DSW to return them, thinking I would not find anything to replace them. But much to my surprise, the store had a pair of the Clarks Keating sandals. Though they are a Medium, they fit very well. I have had them for a week now, with at least 4 full days of wear. The strapping are all covered with a Lycra fabric making sure there is little opportunity for chafing. The velcro is positioned on the sandals so that any exposed parts (after accommodating the wide/high foot) are the smooth, non-catching part, and the 2 adjustable straps are generously sized to easily and comfortably fit my foot. The footbed is a soft, self-contouring suede-like fabric that is extremely comfortable, though I have not yet done any distance walking in the sandals to see how they respond with heavy moisture. review_headline: worth the price but not an ideal investment
review_body: I was looking for N.Y.L.A. Mensae, and they turned out to be out of stock everywhere. So I had no choice but seek some replacements. And finally I found Unlisted booties which had lace-up, buckles and heels, almost all the elements except the platforms, and seemed to be perfect to me. product_title: Teva Women's Pretty Rugged Sandal
review_headline: Okay, but Pretty Rugged 2 was better...
review_body:
I previously owned Pretty Rugged 1 and 2 in the light brown leather shade and I loved both of those incarnations of the Pretty Rugged line. I love these sandals for travel as they take up relatively little space (they are also great for going through airport security if you choose to wear them during your flight), work in any terrain (I've literally done everything in these sandals from climbing Mayan ruins to walking on wet cobblestone streets in the Caribbean) , and you can walk all day in them comfortably. These sandals are also pretty stylish. They work well with jeans, skirts (long and short), summer dresses etc. Unfortunately, the previous versions of Pretty Rugged had a pretty light insole that got discolored relatively quickly even though the rest of the sandal remained in good shape.

I purchased Pretty Rugged 3 a couple of weeks ago from Amazon to wear while I am away on research in the Caribbean for the next five months. I've been wearing them daily for a little over a week now and I've found that Pretty Rugged 3 is significantly different from the Pretty Rugged 1 and 2 in at least four regards: 1)the insole is now black 2)there is less cushioning under the front strap 3) because they removed the extra cushioning from the front strap, it is no longer as wide and does not feel as secure as the front strap on previous versions and 4)the sole has a different pattern and the sandal does not grip wet surfaces as well as previous versions.

Overall, Pretty Rugged is just an okay sandal. I think removing the extra cushioning from the front strap was a mistake as my feet don't fit as securely in this version as in previous versions. My toes seem to slide forward past the tip of the sandal which was a problem I never had with the two previous versions. As I mentioned before, the pattern on the sole has changed and this version does not grip wet surfaces very well. I do like the darker insole and I am hoping that the sandal will show less wear over time. While these sandals look great, they don't seem as well made as previous versions of Pretty Rugged and they are also slightly less comfortable. I am hoping that Teva will give us the quality of sandal we expect from the brand in Pretty Rugged's next incarnation because even though I am unhappy with some of the features of this version, there will always be a place in my closet for Pretty Rugged.

product_title: Bolle Edge Sunglasses - Shiny Black - TNS Gun - 10936
review_body: I've had Bolle sunglasses and goggles for 20 years or more and this is the first one that let me down. Bought a new EDGE and used it at a major Ironman triathlon in the tropics - or tried to. Went into transition and put on my helmet and then jammed on the glasses. Just like I've done 123 times before except that this time the earpiece snagged on the helmet and POW - instead of bending it snapped off. Now I'm looking at (BAD pun) 69 miles of biking and running in the Carribean sun with no eye protection. NOT good! On review, I discovered that the frameless design requires that the earpiece be attached directly to the lens. Instead of the strength of direct attachment, which would require that the entire strong lens would have to snap, they have cut out a small tab at the corner of the lens for an attach point. This tab is so small that it's breaking point is less than the force required to flex the earpiece. So, when jammed a bit, instead of the earpieces bending , the 3/8\\" wide tab just broke off.  If you want a frameless model, I would reccomend the Bolle SPORT which seems to be the same except without the design flaw.  TRIMULE

But, like I said, I took them out for a couple of true cross country(miles of off trail) excursions where even hiking boots would have gotton some wear. product_title: Men's Merrell Chameleon3 Stretch GORE-TEX®
review_headline: Comfortable From Day One and After 63 Miles 11 Days Later
review_body:
July 5, 2011, two weeks later. I have now hiked 63.04 miles (hey, if at the end of a hike, the .04 could have been the killer) in these shoes. Though a little heavier than the \\"Ventilators\\" and \\"Stretch\\" - that is what GorTex does but makes up for by added protection - I ordered another pair today! It's been 20 years since I was that enamored with a shoe. Absolutely love 'em. Stiff? Combat boots are stiff: these \\"break in\\" in a half-hour!
***

I bought these directly from Merrell because they don't charge for returns, and I fully expected to have an 80% chance that these would not be as comfortable as my 3-year old GorTex Merrell's that have finally given way. And, although I paid full price and tax, I did have a promotion that brought it down to $127.

But this is not about price. It's about me and my lousy feet and my hiking rugged hills 5 times a week where I need support, but can't stand the mid- or high top hiking shoes. Well, they came two days ago. I'd heard that there were stiff and that it takes a couple of days. Surprise! After 15 minutes, I knew I wouldn't be returning them, and within an hour, I was on the hillsides on a 4 mile jaunt.

They're a little stiff, but when you're hiking in hills, you need stiff or to be a stiff. I've had soles on some boots (usually Vibram) that are twice as stiff as these, but these have sufficient give on the soles to allow climbing and steep grades. And they're lighter weight that \\"high-tops,\\" but not so light that they're like track shoes with no support at all. Besides you may be like I in having high-tops chafing both heel and tongue.

The only question I have after my two days with them is, do I get another pair now or take my chances and hope that Merrell (for 14 years part of Timberland) doesn't cut back on quality like Ecco and others did.

P.S. Easy on and off, and love the quick \\"tie\\" which makes them snug without binding. And loops at the tongue and heel. That may not seem like much, but after walking for 3 or 4 miles, IF they or socks have slipped, you can just adjust by pulling on the tabs/loops. You can also take them off and put them back on without a shoehorn and without hassle and without breaking their backs. This is one hiking shoe that was beautifully designed and I only hope they don't try to \\"improve\\" them!ng for 3 or 4 miles, IF they or socks have slipped, you can just adjust by pulling on the tabs/loops. You can also take them off and put them back on without a shoehorn and without hassle and without breaking their backs. This is one hiking shoe that was beautifully designed and I only hope they don't try to \\"improve\\" them!

Thankfully, these are not so \\"gladiator\\" looking but quite sophisticated. My husband loves them. I especailly like the olive green since it goes with the mustard yellows, golds, reds and the other new muted fall colors.  Since I live in Florida, I will be able to wear these 9 out of 12 months. product_title: Classic Tortoise Wayfarer Style Sunglasses
review_body:
Great value. for $6 you really can't beat it. I feel so comfortable in the fact that I can wear these anywhere and not have to worry about breaking / losing them.

Pros:
Low price
Spring hinges on frames provide comfortable fit
Look way better than most other cheap sunglasses
Fairly durable

Cons:
The print is more like leopard than tortoise shell

This is my 2nd pair. I broke the first ones accidentally after 6 months and didn't even care. I can get another in 2 days for $6 with amazon prime!

product_title: LifeStride Women's Debate Ballet Flat
review_body: These shoes have a very comfy rubber sole and soft and supportive inner. They are stylish yet much comfier than the normal ballet flats that have no support or cushioning. The colour red is true to picture. I got a standard B width and although I have a broad foot, it fit really well. So if you have a narrow foot it may be a little loose. I got a size 8.5, which was a gamble not knowing the equivalent to our Australian sizes, but it was pretty close to Aussie sizes. I can be anything from 7.5-8.5 in Aussie shoes, and would say that this 8.5 is a bit big at the heel, but nothing a heel grip insert won't fix. Standard delivery took nearly three weeks (USA to Aus) which was fine. Overall very happy with the shoe (wish I'd ordered two colours now) and will be ordering more in the same brand.

product_title: BOBS from SkechersBow Down Flat
review_headline: Great shoes for a good cause

product_title: Robeez Mini Shoez High Tide Sandal (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: First of all, let me say that I absolutely love Robeez shoes, and every pair we have is beautifully made, stylish, soft, comfortable, and I'm very happy with this company in general. However, these shoes didn't work for my baby, because the \\"tongue\\" of the shoe is very, very high. It pushes into my daughter's leg, and is definitely uncomfortable to her. She only wore them for a minute, to try them on, but I immediately saw she won't be able to use them. I'm giving this product 3 stars, because it's really good quality, soft, breathable and very cute. I'm not sure whether the issue is a design flaw, or simply wrong style for my baby.

product_title: Clarks Women's Mika Beth Boot
review_body: I was very excited to get these boots.  After having my son, I now wear a 12 and can't find any decent shoes in stores.  This was my 1st time buying shoes and not trying them on first. review_body: I have weird shaped feet.  These shoes are comfortable, fit easily on my strange feet, and my feet look better in these Tevas!

product_title: Bogs Women's Becca Boot
review_body:
I just got these in the mail today! Here's my assessment...

Pros:
I'm a size 9 with a medium-wide foot, and these boots fit perfectly.
The boots are warm and the footbed is comfy.
Moderate arch support.
They don't chafe my heel when I walk, which is a problem I had with my last pair of (cheap) rain boots.
They're cute, and the extra polka dot ribbon is adorable.

Con:
The wool around the top of the boot rubs against my bare skin when I walk, which is scratchy and uncomfortable. This is easily remedied, however, by wearing tall socks or tucking pants into the boot. The problem is that I don't usually do either of those things!

Despite the con, I'm keeping the boots because they're an amazing deal. And a great excuse to go sock shopping. :)

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Cumulus 12 Running Shoe
review_body: I wore out three pairs of Asics 21xx series over the last 3 years.  No problems, no injuries. I am 6'3\\", 225lb.  Time to replace running shoes, I thought I would try increase the cushioning factor, chose Cumulus 12's.  After first run, something felt funny at the front of my knee.  2nd run, same thing.  I thought my feet & legs needed to get used to the new shoe, continued running for a couple of weeks, nothing serious, just a nagging \\"this isnt perfect\\" feeling in my knees, and calf muscles felt tight or strained.  Start out third week, went on a 5 mile run, long for me, and after I finished, during the warm-down walk my knee started to swell and have pain, I limped a half mile home.  Now I am afraid to run in them again.  Will probably buy a new pair of 2160's, and shelve the Cumulus as expensive dust collectors, and a bad experiment. Why did this happen?

review_body: Love these boots.  Good purchase. Didn't get to use them much this winter as we had a mild winter but when I do wear them in bad weather, they are stable, keeping me from sliding, warm and comfortable. Would recommend them to anyone!

product_title: Under Armour Locker Slide Mens
review_headline: Superb. Drain well. Light for travel and gym.
review_body:
The design on the footbed of these Locker Slides (perfect name!) is superb. There are drain holes under the toes and at the heels. The rest of the foot bed has nice drain channels.

If you shower in these, you don't have to point the tip of the toes down and shake them loose to drain (and maybe have it fall off, a minor annoyance with other locker and shower slides). Just wiggle your foot around and you will rinse the soap off the bottom of your foot.

There are no drain channels in the strap, contrary to the product information (implies them at least) but they are not needed. What is important is that there is no fabric backing on the strap to retain water and get groady over time, as is the case with comparable slides from other companies.

Super light, the way all shower slides should be. Who needs extra dead weight in their gym bag or travel bag? Remember you will be carrying these around more than wearing them.

They also interlock together (slide the foot bed of one, upside down, into the other) quite well, saving room in your bag.

Size is true, not small, unlike reported on the UA website by some reviewers (I think they may have been wearing them with socks? these are sized assuming barefoot, I believe). If you are slightly larger than a size, though, order up one size. I am a 9.5 but the 10's fit perfectly with socks, a tad loose barefoot. I don't mind the looseness in barefoot; since I may wear them with socks to cafe near the gym, I like the way they fit.

product_title: Geox Women's Donna Lola Ballet Flat
review_body: This is my second pair of Geox ballet flats.  They are so cute and comfortable.  I have worn them a ton and they still look like new.

product_title: ECCO Men's Boulder Water Shoe
review_headline: Bought these from Macy's last week for $62.50!
review_body: I asked the salesperson for a different pair that were selling for $130, she came back with the expensive pair and these which were 50% off!  After trying them on I was sold. Not sure why they make them 11-11.5, but they fit well.     I put at least 12 miles (20Km) on them in 2 days on New York City streets.  They're very comfortable and I like the mesh design, more for the fact that they will keep my feet cool in the summer heat. You really feel it when the wind blows.    7/11/11 - After one month of use I still love them, never have to waste my time tying these shoes. I've put about 100 miles on these shoes already including a few days in the rain.

product_title: Birkenstock Women's Madrid Sandal
review_body: this sandal is ok. I would say it gets 3 1/2 stars. It is very attractive, and is definately more feminine-looking than the Arizona, for example. The onyx color is lovely and does go with a lot of outfits. The negative is that it seems to be very stiff. I also bought my second pair of Arizonas and they are much more comfortable and have comformed to my foot so much better. It has only been a few weeks, though, so I am hoping they are just slower to break in. All in all, the Madrid is ok and does look better with casual dresses and skirts.

product_title: Aquatik Men & Women Aqua Water Shoes - Beach Shoes with Velcro Lock (Note: Order One Size Smaller)
review_headline: Too small when ordered down a size!
review_body: Per the title, I ordered these down a size to 12; I usually wear a 13 or a bit smaller (ie, in European sizes).  These arrived and they were too small.  I returned for refund and took the hit on postage.  :-(  I won't re-order....they seemed cheap and the tread is diamonds that will likely track dirt, etc.

product_title: Wanted Shoes Women's Trick Knee-High Boot
review_body: I wanted to love these boots, but alas I could not get them zipped. I have 15\\" calves & that was deffinitely too big for this boot. Plus my foot is a size 7 1/2 but I ordered that size & it felt like I was wearing an 8 (and I was wearing socks). They slipped very easily on tile floors too b/c the bottoms are felted. Other than those things the boot looks great for the money. If they fit my calves I would have delt with the other downfalls for the sake of looking good (which they do).

product_title: Nine West Women's Aloysa Boot
review_headline: Hot sexy boots. Definately must have
review_body: I love these boots. I actually have it in black brown and gray. Very comfortable and true to size,young stylist sexy boot. I had a lot of compliment on them. Highly recommend it.

product_title: Blues Brothers BROWCHO Retro Dark Black Sun Glasses (More Colors)
review_body: I like the fact that these have UV protection.  They are fun and comfortable to wear and are pretty nice quality.

product_title: Skechers Women's Reggae-Rasta Thong Sandal
review_body: I haven't had these shoes long enough to really test them out (durability and the likes) but as soon as i put my feet in i was like \\"whoa\\". They are so comfortable. The best way to describe it would be to say it feels like walking on air. The very bottom of the sole is hard for support but you don't actually feel any hardness because the top layers are like magic comfort. They fit my feet very well and cushion in the right spots.

product_title: Drew Shoes Men's Traveler Oxford
review_body: I have very sensitive feet with collapsing arches.  My shoe size is 12 Narrow. These are my first Drew shoes, and I am very happy with them so far.  They are extremely comfortable and well designed for comfort and stability.  My feet require a lot of cushion on the sole to avoid pain from the impact of walking.  The outer-soles of these shoes are just soft enough and thick enough to provide more protection than any other shoe I've worn. At the same time, the soles are not too soft to withstand the impact of walking on hard surfaces.  The two removable insoles provide a lot of arch support, while allowing customization of the inside of the shoe for insertion of a variety of orthotics.  Nice job Drew.  I'm glad I bought a few pair on sale for less than $100.  I hope the price goes back down there when I need to buy more!

product_title: Amalfi by Rangoni Women's Morsa Bootie
review_headline: W size seems to be an M size-tight and narrow
review_body: I ordered a 6,5 size in W width. Apparently W size in the country this shoes made in is the same as M size in USA. This shoes seem to be tight and there is no indication on W or M. Just a size 6.5 noted. Is it mistake of distributor or there is no size W in Europe?

product_title: New Balance Men's MW811 Walking Shoe
review_body: I am a physician who works in the hospital 90% of the time.  I am on my feet, running from one end of the hospital to another all day, 6-7 days a week...it's horrendous.  I took a chance on this MW811 show TWO YEARS AGO and I'm still wearing them every day.  My wife yells at me, saying I'm past due getting new shoes, but this pair still looks brand new and feels great.  I'm ordering a new pair today just to make her happy, but I believe I could get another year or two out of this pair (and probably will, in the garden or on weekends).  This is a great shoe.  Can't recommend it more highly.

product_title: Jessica Simpson Women's Katoy Platform Pump
review_body: Love these shoes! They are the cutest platform pumps I have seen!! Not only are they cute, but they are very comfortable as well.  Shocking, I know, for 4 1/2 inch heel, but I can wear them all day! They run true to size. Would recommend them all day long!! Thank you Jessica Simpson!!

product_title: FitFlop Women's Gogh Shearling Clog
review_body:
I ordered these because my experience with FitFlops has been very good.
These are so comfortable and support my feet, thus my whole body as I do my chores around the house. So... I am happier, back not aching... they are well made, true to size, arrived in good time and I am a happy camper.

Update: I took a flying fall in December 2011... going chin first into a tall, hard plastic dog food container so hard that it split open.

Still dealing with injury to jaw and caps, neck and shoulder.
The doctor said these types of shoes are not good to use as slippers in the house.
Too much traction so instead of a slide and chance to catch balance... one is propelled and damages can be serious.

I still do like them and use them for strolling around my neighbor hood... easy on and off and no socks needed.

product_title: Ellie Shoes Men's 3" Heel Pimp Shoe. Mens.
review_body: Bought these boots for the local Renaissance festival.  Unfortunately, I had to buy the larger size, but I had some \\"water shoes/watersocks\\" available and slipped them inside and my feet fit now.  The thigh part will not stay up if you want them fully extended, though I have muscular & short legs.  Rolled down to just above knee works great for any pirate or renaissance like costume.  Love them, especially for the price.

product_title: Sebago Men's Drake Waterproof Boot
review_headline: Sebago Men's Drake Waterproof Boot Review
review_body: Have owned for one month and have used for travel during snow and rainy days.  I walk about a mile each way from parking lot to train station.  Excellent boot - warm, comfortable, easy to slip on, easy care.  Only issue is that they slip a little when walking, which I believe is pretty common for a non-tie boot.  Note, this is a dull finish.  Overall, I would highly recommend this.

product_title: dav Women's Victoria Paisley Rain Boot
review_body: I really loved the look of these beautiful boots, and other reviewers were right on the money when they said to order one full size down - I'm a size 8 and I ordered a size 7, and the foot fit perfectly.  But I'm returning mine - they are not practical.  These boots have extremely narrow, tight calves.      If you're looking for real rainboots - the kind you tuck your pant-legs into and tromp through five inches of water in - do NOT try these.  They'll work for you if you're looking for something flashy to wear with a miniskirt and knit tights... but I wear jeans and live in the rain.

product_title: Superfeet BLUE Full Length Insole
review_body: AFter using the green version of Superfeet for some time, I figured it was time to try the blue ones for my running shoes.  The non-squishy feel takes some getting accustomed to, but just like my green version, the blue version made my feet happy to be wearing them.

product_title: Skechers Shape Ups Kinetix Response
review_body: Just a heads up these are 79.99 at academy. Just saying they are great shoes but that's a way better price.

product_title: Ballasox by Corso Como Women's Festive Ballet Flat
review_body: I strained my tendon wearing this all day while walking on cobblestones in Oxford (that's what I get for wearing a thin soled shoe for that), but other than that this is a great shoe. I'm planning on picking up other colors now that I have the black one. It's basically just a leather slipper with a good rubber split sole, but it is so comfortable and cute with jeans or a casual skirt. I love the freedom to articulate my foot.    This is a very casual sort of shoe, so I still want a more formal ballet flat, but I'm happy with the look and feel of this shoe. I love that it has a terry lining. It literally fits like a glove.

product_title: Delman Women's Makalya Sandal
review_body: This shoe style is so beautiful in real life, I was so excited when I received them. BUT wearing them is soooo uncomfortable! My feet are very narrow and thin and the band across the feet fitted very snugly. It's great, yes, but only if I'm not walking around for more 15 mins! OUCH!

product_title: Unlisted Women's Mad Dash Bootie
review_body: Purple, my favorite! Yes it is the color purple you see online. It isn't leather but I knew that. Runs true to sizes get your regular boot size and you will be fine. It has a rubber sole that grips on pavement and all slippery floors. Yes, you have to untie it to get in/out and it has not cushion inside but I put in a Dr. Scholls foot pad; the clear gell kind and it was good after that making it easy and comfy to walk on/in. I also like that the heel is the same color as the rest of the boot. All in all a damn fine boot for the inexpensive price and no shipping cost a bonus.

product_title: Pour La Victoire Women's Irina Platform Pump
review_body: LOVE these shoes. Have them in the taupe suede (perfect nude shade for me) and got an 8 (even though I am a 7.5). The fit is amazing, and not too tight. The cushioning at the ball of the foot is better in these than in some shoes that I have tried (in the same type of style) made by much pricier designers. Well worth the money.

product_title: EMU Australia Women's Bronte Hi Boot
review_body: These boots were offered at a great price, and I ordered them for my daughter for Christmas.  They came in record time, and the package was in excellent order.  She loved the boots, and they have held up well so far.  At that price they were a terrific bargain and a great purchase.

product_title: Z7 Women's Solstice Ankle Boot
review_body: These shoes are supremely comfortable. I have a wide foot so it is easy for my feet to get pinched with regular shoes. The z7 boots allow all the bones to stretch out and work correctly. They fit like a glove. In fact, my only complaint is that it is hard to get in and out of them because they fit so well.

product_title: Bogs Women's Classic High Corsage Boot
review_body: These boots were insanely comfortable but I didn't quite love the pattern.  I wanted something a little more muted and these were just... not.

product_title: Sidekicks Women's Foldable Ballet Flats with Carrying Case Pink Large
review_headline: Cute but sizing is way off
review_body: I would have given these a one... but the slippers themselves are adorable, and the seller shipped promptly.  Be warned, I ordered size large and they barely fit a size seven foot.  No way would these work for the size stated in the description.

product_title: Authentic Pigment 14 Oz. Pigment-Dyed Raw-Edge Messenger Bag (1908)
review_body: Item is exactly what I expected. It was purchased over a month ago and still looks like new (I use it everyday instead of a purse). Only thing that would make it better is if there was a divider in the main pocket.

product_title: Easy Spirit Women's Simply
review_body: The shoe is great.  Perfect for me because I NEED A WIDE TOE-BOX.    I live in New York City and walk at least a mile or two a day.  I ordered black. I really wanted the beige, but my size was not available.  The shoe is comfortable and THE SOLE is perfect for walking on NYC concrete sidewalks.

product_title: See Kai Run Eric Sneaker (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: We love this brand of shoes as they are super adorable. Be warned though, they do scuff easily. These are our son's going out shoes...def. can't play in them without getting them really messed up. They look so sweet and fashionable though, we will def. continue to buy this brand!!

product_title: Portable Ashtray
review_body: I can't believe they have the nerve to sell this piece of garbage for .90c much less $9.00. It is nothing at all like it is described...chrome over steel, bah. It's more like tin foil! The build is awful, the lid does not come close to lining up with the body of this horrible contraption but that does not matter much because a new born could bend this thing into a pretzel. When I first opened it all I could do was laugh. Well I'm not laughing anymore, this is down right insulting and as soon as I put a period on this sentence I am beginning the return procedure to Amazon.

review_body: The Lisa B bag is just the right size for me.  It holds everything tht I usually carry, and it's not too heavy.  The Symphony in Hue pattern is so filled with color that it goes with everything, and it has a lot of the Pantone color of the year -- Honeysuckle Pink!

product_title: DV by Dolce Vita Women's Dakota Ankle-Strap Sandal
review_body: I bought one in black/white snake, which is very nice.  However, because it's too narrow, I can't wear it.  My feet were hanging off the sides, and I wear a 6M, not 6W.  I'd have to go a size up to fit the width of my feet.

product_title: Sorel Women's Glacier Boot
review_body: I have never, ever written a review before. I felt compeled to do so as I don't want others to be in my position. Although they seem to be warm, they are BULKY and HEAVY!! Felt like I was wearing a pair of my husband's boots. Sorry Sorel. Think women when you design a women's boot. Slender and warm can be done- you can do it.

product_title: PUMA Men's Voltaic 2  Running Sneaker
review_body: Hard to find locally as most stores only buy one pair or 10.5 wide shoes.  Ordered off Amazon vendor, same price as locally, shoe fits like a glove and weight about a feather but has great cush in the heel.

product_title: Bandolino Women's Fortunata Huarache
review_body: These shoes are attractive but uncomfortable.  I have worn them several times and they fit me but are pressing in some points and don't seem to want to stretch out.  I only wear them to places I will be sitting mostly because by the time I get home, I can't wait to take them off!  On the bright side, they are cute and have a good heal sized wedge that is easy to walk in.

product_title: Bogs Classic High Ambrosia Rain Boot (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: My daughter loves them.  Finally her feet are not stinking from wet boots. She loves the fact that they keep her feet warm and dry. They are light and the insole wicks the moisture away from her feet.  They are also fashionable and $20 cheaper than buying retail.

product_title: ASICS Women's Gel Rocket 5 Volleyball
review_headline: A little tight width wise for an average foot
review_body: I bought these shoes a few weeks ago and I ordered an 8.5 in the White/Jet blue.  Really nice looking shoe and it is not too heavy.  I normally wear a 7-7 1/2 in flip flops.  That is where my feet measure when I use the metal measuring device in the shoe stores.  I typically wear an 8 in all other shoes.  I ordered these a little larger just in case.....I ordered an 8 1/2.  However, they are a little tight in the width and I do not have wide feet. I have the laces loosened as much as possible and maybe I just need to break them in a bit more.    Really fast shipping and it was right before Christmas!

product_title: Merrell Women's Encore Eclipse
review_body: These shoes are really cute and comfortable, but they are really loose in the heel. I probably should have sent them back but I liked the design so I decided to just deal with it. They would probably be more comfortable if they fit properly, but other than that they are a really nice shoe! Even with them being a little loose I still wear them all the time and haven't had any serious issues with them yet.

product_title: Crocs Girls' Dawson Mary Jane
review_body: I got these in a size 6 for my 18 month old. She loves them! They are super cute, and seem to run true to size. It is great to find a feminine little girl shoe that is not pink, pink, and more pink. My girl has a wide foot and they fit her well, with a little room to grow. They are lightweight like other crocs, which is a plus for a toddler. She can now put them on all by herself! I do find her feet get really sweaty in these, even more so when barefoot. Her feet perspire a lot anyway, so it might not be an issue for kids without this problem.

product_title: Sam Edelman Women's Gigi Thong Sandal
review_body: Great shoes, they look great, and are super comfy.  Can't beat the price on amazon, less expensive than the department stores.

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Fitness Ready Set Sneaker
review_body: I've been wearing Skecher Shape-ups for over a year but was ready to try the Tone Ups because they have a less obvious look.  I ordered them after trying them on in a store first.  They're so comfortable and didn't need any break in at all.  I also love the way they look.  I don't know about their toning ability because I've been wearing the other shoes for so long but I love them for comfort.  It was also a great price compared to the local stores.  Now I'd like to get another color so I can switch them out part of the time.

product_title: Dansko Women's Krista Lace-Up
review_headline: Nice Dansko shoe in a non-clog style
review_body: Ok - I'm new to Dansko. I think most people expect Dansko to be a clog-ish style....... but I really like these shoes.    The shoe itself appears high quality; sturdy leather & thick, well made soles. Appropriate packaging & shoes were well wrapped & obviously unworn.     The fit is very close to the traditional Dansko style clog, but I like the fact that these lace up and can be loosened. (my feet swell later in the day, if I have been standing a lot)  or tightened. I like the flexibility in fit, with the high quality you'd expect for the price.  Seems to run true to size......possibly a little more latitude given the adjustability with the laces.    I wore them today to work. 12 hours non stop on my feet. Some foot pain still, but frankly - not as severe as I've had. Even wearing athletic, or other \\"support\\" shoes, I will have foot pain after 12 hours.    I also wanted to mention that the style is \\"sturdy\\" but not as gram-ish or \\"stoddy\\" as Drew shoes.      I like them & I'd recommend them! (esp. if you can get them for $50 like I did!)

product_title: T.U.K. Women's A7877L Platform Pump
review_body: This shoe looks exactly as the picture, what you don't know until you get it, is that it runs very big and the heel height has to be approximately 5.5 - 6inches. The arch / heel height of this shoe is high and can't be walked in unless you are used to wearing something so high. I sent them back!

product_title: Bandolino Women's Shiante Bootie
review_body: I purchase the black leather bootie, and it is a really nice shoe.  For the height of the heel it is very comfortable and easy to walk in.  If you have wide feet, you might want to go a size larger since Bandolino shoes typically run a little narrow.  My foot isn't particularly wide, and these shoes are a little snug.  I think once I wear them awhile they will loosen up -- I've only worn them twice.  I'm really pleased with my purchase, and am considering buying the same shoe in a different color.

product_title: Versani Women's 19226 Wedge Sandal
review_body: It seems most people are not familiar with the Versani brand and avoid it because of lack of familiarity. This has been a boon to me, since many of their shoes are on sale at impressive price reductions and in all sizes! This sandal is one of my favourites.     I had some concern initially, worrying that the sandal would be heavy as well as clunky looking. This proved to be entirely unfounded. This sandal is amazingly light and looks elegant on. The best part for me is its comfort level: superb! They've somehow managed to find the secret to making shoes comfortable: letting the heel bear some of the weight (instead of it all falling on the ball of the foot) by making the heel bed horizontal instead of slanted.    I ordered the tan and white sandal and it goes with everything. I am thrilled.

product_title: Camper Women's 46285 Brothers Impala Knee-High Boot
review_body: I love them!! just the most confortable boots I've ever had...just one tip they are a little tight at the begining, I think is because of my feet, they are not slim, but later they adapt perfectly ;)

product_title: Seychelles Women's Thriller Ankle Boot
review_body: for the most part the shoes are great, except that there is a very noticeable defect on the right boot(the shoes are suede and the whole right toe is bald). Anyway, i bought them on amazon warehouse which means they had been previously returned, but they were not specific about the reason for the return, which as i can see know, was because of a very visible defect.

product_title: Dolce & Gabbana DG 2064 sunglasses
review_body: very nice glasses and a great place to buy sunglasses from  but the sunglasses came little bit tight  but over all its great

product_title: Harley-Davidson Women's Sedona Boot
review_headline: should be of better quality for HD
review_body: After reading all the reviews about this boot I thought they would be a good riding boot. I think the leather is way to light weight to be for lady riders who are operating the bike. I can see the toe getting smashed down as you shift the bike. They just would not last. Maybe I am harder on boots than some LOL. If you are the passenger then they should be fine for that, and they are light and you could do a lot of walking in them without getting tired feet. And I liked them having the tall shaft. Overall I was looking for a quality riding boot, these were disappointing. There were even some lose threads that just made them look cheap. My fashion boots have better construction and leather. Even though they were a gift, they went back.

product_title: FitFlop Women's Walkstar 3 Patent Flip Flop
review_headline: the most uncomfortable things I've ever had on my feet.
review_body: These are awful, in a nutshell. They're way too long making the toe separator oddly spaced too far out so it's painful, and the straps cut into your feet. They're oddly shaped and oddly sized; I could not even get them on without major issues. I do not have hard to fit feet or need special sizing, either. They just seemed poorly made with cheap inflexible materials for the price, and did not fit well at all. Suffice it to say I returned them and went with a pair of cheaper but much more comfortable Sketchers Tone-Ups, and am quite happy. Avoid these if you care at all about your feet or comfort whatsoever - they're so bad you won't even get far enough to tone up in them.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Excel Training Shoe
review_body: I just bought these sneakers and they are extremely comfortable. I'm all about comfort with anything I do and I take public transportation to work,and I feel like I'm walking on cotton balls.

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's D-Lux Faux Fur Boot

product_title: Large Horsebit Satchel Handbag
review_headline: Pretty Good Bag--A Few Minor Disappointments
review_body: I just received this bag today, so this is an \\"initial reaction\\" review, but I can already tell you that there are a few pros and a few cons with this bag.     PROS:    1. HANDLE DESIGN!! HANDLE DESIGN!! I love the horsebit-design handles of this bag. The last purse I had broke because the handles weren't strong enough to handle all of the crap I like to put in my handbags, but the durable handle design of this satchel is great. I'm pretty confident the handles won't give out anytime soon. That is definitely the #1 selling point for me here.     2. Material--it looks and feels very soft!    3. Space--this bag has LOTS of room. Two main zip pockets that run the full length of the bag, as well as two snap pockets on either side and the standard zip/cellphone/whatever pockets on the inside.    4. The overall design is cute and the hardware looks sturdy.    CONS:    1. COLOR: In trying to decide between the light yellow and the green, I ultimately decided on the green, but I was very disappointed to see that it is not as dark as it looks in the picture. The green color is more like something that might be seen in \\"That 70's Show.\\" This alone almost made me want to return the bag, but I think I can live with it, as I am in rather desperate need of a new purse.     2. Inside lining--The lining on the inside is brown (not necessarily a flaw, but just a piece of info), and looks as if it might come apart at any moment. It also looks like there is almost too much lining. That may sound weird now, but you'll know what I mean when you get the bag.    Apart from these minor flaws, this is not a bad handbag, though I can't honestly say that I would buy another one. I would definitely not recommend the green color--maybe yellow or orange. Happy shopping!

product_title: Rocky Duty Men's Alpha Force 8" Zipper Boot
review_body: I've worn these every day for 4 months.  On the plus side, the boots look good, are very light, and don't take much time to break in. These are my first pair with a side zipper and I'll want that from now on.  The zippers are a bit sticky at first and need some time before they operate smoothly, but that's to be expected with this type of nylon zipper.    The first problem was with the two-snap flap that locks the zipper in the full-up position.  One of those came off the second week.  They're attached with rivets and seemed strong enough to use as bootstraps, but they're not.  The flaps are largely cosmetic; the zipper stays up without them and assuming you're not wearing shorts, nobody can see that it's gone.  A bigger issue is the insulation/padding.  It doesn't seem to be secured in place well enough and it moves around when you wear the boots.  So every time you put them on the fit is slightly different.  It creates \\"hot spots\\" that rub against your foot and ankle and when the inner lining wears through it shreds and balls up, causing even more friction.  The longer I've had them, the more uncomfortable they've gotten.    My brother's a cop.  He suggested I try Bates instead, so that will be the next purchase.  I'll wear these for the rest of the winter, as that's only a few more weeks here in Chicago.

review_headline: Not the same as they used to be.

However, something was different this time. As soon as I opened the box, I noticed that they seemed huge. Second, I saw pitting and small holes in the soles and small black splotches on the cowhide. Somehow the boots have grown. I'm not sure if I missed a memo or something, but I'm really disappointed with what I recieved. The worst part is that I waited too long to purchase new boots so I couldn't return them as I needed a nice pair for a few days later. Any returns would have left me without decent looking boots. Like I said, that was my fault. So now I have a pair of boots that I don't think I'll get the field wear out of because I don't think they'll form to my foot like the others did. I guess I'll get another brand to start breaking in to use for field/ruck purposes and use these things for classroom/non-movement purposes.   This will probably be the last pair of these I'll buy. I'm going to write Belleville and see if they have anything to say.

product_title: Timberland 2.0 Euro Hiker Mens
review_body:
There are three things I look at in rating footwear: functionality, aesthetics, and price.

Functionality:

These boots are really well made. The leather is sturdy and well-assembled. The sole grips the ground very well. There's plenty of support all around, including at the ankle. When I first put them on, they fit like a glove, and they're extremely comfortable when I walk around in them.

Judging from the quality of the materials, I expect these boots to last a long time, and they're certainly up to wear in rough conditions.

Aesthetics:

My feet are size 12; they're big. The most common problem I have in buying boots is finding something that doesn't make my feet look like they have space boots on them, or that I'm wearing the boxes instead of the contents.

A lot of boots nowadays seem to be designed to be very clunky. Many have a wide or squared toe. Many have massive heel assemblies. I've tried a lot of boots trying to find something I think looks stylish.

These boots are the solution. They look even better in real life than in the pictures. They're designed to look almost elegant; I guess that's their European heritage. They have a lean profile, both from the side and the top. Quite frankly, I love the way these boots look when I'm wearing them.

After all, isn't looking cool half the battle?

Price:

Extremely reasonably priced, especially as I've compared them to other products available on the market. Are there \\"cheaper\\" boots out there on the market? Sure... but usually that means \\"cheaper\\" in every sense of the word, especially as to quality.

I strongly recommend these boots in every way. They meet all my criteria, and I think they're a very good value, and boots I'm very happy to own and wear. I bought the \\"Gaucho\\" color, and I like them so much I'm also going to order the \\"Wheat\\" color.

Kudos, Timberland!
