review_body: So I purchased a $30 pair of Tech Treads while in Florida last year, and they were very comfortable, but I didn't noticed they were undersized until I'd worn them for a couple days.  I read later that you should always go up a size when purchasing sandals, so I bought a size 9 of these for my 8 to 8.5 feet.  The day these arrived, I had to leave for Chicago in the morning, and ended up having someone picking them up and holding them for me so they wouldn't disappear from my doorstep.  They arrived on Wednesday, and I finally got to open the box and slip them on on Saturday of Easter weekend.  My first thought was, \\"OMG!\\"  I wanted to just leave them on all day, but I've already been to one Easter Egg Hunt today, and I plan on going to another, and it stormed all day yesterday and into last night and this morning, and I just don't want to trek around in the mud in these.  Keep in mind that I've had some pretty nice sandals over the years.  I lived in Florida for over 10 years through my teens, and I can't even say how many I've gone through.  I've had a pair of slip-on Adidas for the last 6 years for the house, plus I've gone through a pair of Quicksilver I bought at Ron Jon's in Cocoa Beach 2 years ago, and the Tech Treads I got in Jacksonville Beach last year.  These are $28 plus tax at Pacific Sunware at my local mall, and I got them for $22+ on here, with free shipping after including a nanostream flashlight for my keychain...and these are just the most comfortable sandals I've ever felt.  I think once I wear these out, I'll be getting a pair of Reef Fannings with the heel air cushion and bottle opener on the bottom.  Don't think I'll ever use another brand of sandal again, and I may even retire my Adidas slip-ons for around the house lol.  Just buy these...you'll love them.

product_title: Amy Kathryn Gladiola Shoulder Bag
review_body: Let me start by saying that aesthetically I love the bag. I have the black one and get tons of compliments on it. The problem is with the construction. The first bag I had lasted 3 weeks and the lining completely shredded and the strap was starting to rip on the outside. It looked like the strap hadn't been sewn right from the start. I wasn't overstuffing the bag so the fact that the lining just shredded apart was a huge disappointment. I contacted Amy Kathryn since I had bought it from another site other than Amazon. They offered to repair the bag if I paid to ship it to them. I needed a diaper bag and since this was still brand new I decided to have it repaired. They ended up sending me a new bag. I figured they would since the lining didn't appear to be repairable. I was very happy with the customer service I received and their willingness to work with me. Well, I had the second bag 2 weeks and AGAIN the lining started ripping and shredding. I was disgusted. I love the bag and it holds the perfect amount for my 3 month old, but I don't have the patience to deal with my diaper bag falling apart constantly. I sewed it together the best I could, but I would not buy another one of these bags. For the money I expect to have a high quality product that will last longer than a month!

product_title: Nine West Women's Joyrides Ankle Boot
review_body: Haven't worn them yet but seem to have very little padding. They are super cute and very stylish in person

product_title: Furge45a Buckled Strap Knee High Boots BLACK
review_body: These high heel boots are amazing! They are just the right height on my leg, just the right color, and just PERFECT!  They are relatively comfortable to wear and they look good with almost any outfit! I would totally buy again!

product_title: Maui Jim Big Beach Black HT518-02
review_body: These are the lightest sunglasses I've ever owned.  The HT lens are very clear and give true colors.  The price was $70 below retail which made it a no-brainer. Deliver was very fast.  Great purchase.

product_title: Spy Optic Clash Wrap Sunglasses
review_body: Very happy with my new sungls, I received them real fast...they were shipped May 4th and they were here by May 12th....in Costa Rica!!....great product and really like the fact that they dont look fragile or easy to brake. I am thinking on buying more in the future.

product_title: Boutique 9 Women's Marcello Espadrille
review_body: This shoe is very cute.  Kind of high for me, I stand all day, but honestly very comfy.  The color is kind of metalic  black with pink almost looks bronze like.  Love them so far, the only con is they are a little short size wise.  I'm a 7 1/2 and I feel like I'm almost an 8 in these.  worth the price, well made.

product_title: UGG Men's Ascot Slipper
review_headline: Great slipper, size was too small
review_body:
The construction of this Mens Ugg Black Ascot slipper is top notch. The exterior is a terrific looking soft, pliable leather that will probably last for years. The interior is made of plush wool that compresses (I think it will become pretty flat after a while, but it is still looking good after two months of wear). It is really warm. I like everything about this slipper...except the size. I wear a 10-1/2 Medium width mens shoe and, since they don't offer half-sizes and other reviews said they run a little small, I ordered size 11.
They are very tight. Both in length and in width. I wore them for two months thinking they will expand, and they have. They have gone from \\"very tight\\" to just \\"tight\\". In fact, I can't wear them anymore. They hurt. The construction is so good that they just didn't give very much over time.
I fear the next size up (12) would be too loose, so I am out of luck with Ugg's.
If you have a foot that is a little narrower than \\"Medium\\" you will do fine with the width. I recommend you order 1 size larger than your shoe size. If you wear a \\"Half-size\\" shoe, I fear you will be in the same predicament as me...

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Lea Pump
review_headline: Sizes are wrong and the shoe looked bulky
review_body: I bought this shoes and the looked bulky i am a size 8 1/2 and the shoes were huge! i ended up giving them to a friend that is a size 10(they fit her)so keep that in mind when purchasing this item.

product_title: Liz Rene Couture Women's Melissa Pump
review_body: The shoes are great! I am wearing them for my wedding. They fit nice. I got a size bigger than my normal size based off the other comments and it fits great.

product_title: Dearfoams Women's DS626 Slipper
review_body: I received my Dearfoams slippers (go-ahead clogs) promptly and have been wearing this comfortable and well-cushioned pair. They are warm, soft and were a good buy. They have a nice hard sole and give more support than the average slipper. Mom bought me a second pair and another for herself when I told her about them.

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Maverick 3 Running Shoe
review_body: I really ordered the wrong size, but the shoes was comfortable right out of the box and I wear them everyday.

product_title: FitFlop Women's Fiorella Thong Sandal
review_headline: Cute but priced a little high........
review_body: The Fiorella is a cute sandal and is as comfortable as other FitFlops.  They fit well.  The color is not white white - it is definitely Antique which is an off white.  The only negative is the price.  I don't understand why they are so much more than other FitFlops.   They aren't that different that they should cost $20 to $30 more.

product_title: Nine West Women's Brittoni Boot
review_body: Great looking boots, super cute ! BUT ! narrow and run 1/2 size too small, I think I'm paying for return shipping so keep it in mind when purchasing these

product_title: Irish Setter Men's Trail Phantom Waterproof 600 Gram 9" Big Game Boot
review_body: Awesome boots. Very warm and comfortable also quite light. I bought them half a size larger than my running shoes and they were perfect.

product_title: Rocket Dog Women's Satire Ankle Boot
review_body: All in all, this is a good boot. It's comfortable and really cute. The heel is synthetic, so don't expect the \\"clacking\\" noise that you get with most boots. The only thing is that I would have preferred a 6 1/2 size instead of the 7 I bought. Normally, I'm a six, but Rocket Dog tends to run a bit small, so keep an eye on that.

product_title: Baggallini Valencia Bagg - Silver Hardware
review_body: I am grateful to have this bag. It has pockets for  EVERYTHING, and I have everything for its pockets.  I would not mind if the handles were shorter, but today  it did not slip off my shoulders, so maybe that is a plus!!!  EXCELLENT QUALITY.

product_title: Skechers Shape-up Toners Ultra Fit 13001
review_body: I love these shoes! They are fantastic! They are extremely stylish, and very comfortable. I've only had them a couple of weeks and can already tell a difference in my legs and butt. They really do tone you as you walk. I'd recommend these shoes for anyone on their feet a lot. Like I said, they're extremely comfortable, and if you've got to be on your feet anyways you might as well get in shape!    Buy these shoes and take the first step to a happier, healthier you!

product_title: Helium Hyperlite Rolling Tote
review_body:
My family and I travel once a year to Colorado. The family is me, my husband, our toddler and the dog. Every year we need extra carry on space and we find ourself hauling a heavy bag on our shoulders and cursing our packing skills and threatening to leave the dog somewhere to lighten the load... Well this carry on is exactly what we needed. It's compact, but holds a ton of stuff. It's has a logical helpful design and is super easy to manuever even with a stroller, a 13 lbs dog, a kids bag and a kid. It fits very well into overhead storage spaces and its sturdy. The wheels move easy and the handle is versatile. Spilled juice on it and it was pretty easy to clean up. The zippers are solid. It really is designed well and I think it was really intended for the frequent business traveler because it has a decent amount of clothes space, but it's serving us well as an overall sturdy reliable family bag. It holds about two days worth of winter clothing including shoes, a lap top, has zipper fronts that hold's children's item's or PDA's or Ipod's or mini-DVD player's really well. Sort of a jack of all trades bag that is super compact. Definitely worth the $$, hubby was worried that we were spending too much money for a \\"tiny\\" bag... Even he's happy with the purchase.

The bags handle broke after about 2 trips. I can still carry it on but the rolling feature is now pointless...

product_title: Earth Preview Casual Shoe Womens
review_headline: not good for walking longer distance
review_body: I do not know if it is because of the design, the weight are all on the heels, which is the special feature of Earth shoes, my left heel got a blister after walking about 20 minutes in them.

product_title: Native Unisex Miller Slip-On Sneaker
review_body: I bought the black pair for my son but I think they look like womens shoes. They would be great womens gardening shoes. Their not cute enough for me to keep for myself though. They are going back to Amazon.

product_title: Steve Madden BClassy Hobo
review_body: I think the reviewer before me probably wound up much happier with this bag over time, as I initially had the same complaints.  The \\"new bag\\" smell faded quickly and it attained the slouchy appearance we expect from \\"hobo\\" style bags after some daily use \\"broke it in.\\"  I get so many compliments on this bag and its structure is holding up perfectly almost a year after purchase.

product_title: Alpro A630 Clog
review_headline: Feels as good as the classical birkenstock sandal.
review_body: My wife bought this pair of shoes, she loves the original Birkenstock sandals footbed, the only ones that solved her feet pain problems. Winter was always a problem, sandals are not comfortable in this season not even in California. Her new job was also a problem, she required tough shoes. This pair solved all problems, they have a Birkenstock footbed, antislip sole, and at least they look tough. Our only concern was that they look cheap since the shoes are made mostly of rubber, however, since they are black, you need to look very close to notice this.  After a month of use she is very happy, no more pain in the feet with shoes that are appropriate for her working environment and can be used in the mild California winter.

product_title: Wild Rose Women's Colin08 Slingback Sandal
review_body: I LOVE the way these shoes look. They are true to size which is awesome. However when I received the shoes there were white marks on them, which was the green material pealing off. I was going to return them but it was one small area so I though, meh nothing to worry about. I wore them out ONCE and the material has now pealed off the heal of the shoe and in several other place. I had planed to wear these shoes with a cute summer dress however it looks like the only thing I will be wearing them with now in long pants, to cover up the missing patching of material...FAIL. I'm guessing the material the shoes are made out of was never sealed and so they don't hold up to normal wear and tear.

product_title: Bobux Infant/Toddler Tiger Chocolate Slipper
review_headline: Great shoe for crawlers and beginning walkers!
review_body: In addition to being really cute, these shoes are easy to put on and keep on little feet. This company also makes inserts for added cushioning and warmth. We have used both Bobux and Robeez and prefer Bobux. They are less stiff (softer leather) and the animal faces look up at your little one instead of away from them (which may only matter to the parents, who knows?). Pricey, but worth the money, esp. if you can pass them on.

product_title: ECCO Womens Groove Gladiator Ankle-Strap Sandal
review_headline: Just as great as Mark I!
review_body: I was so excited to see another version of this sandal, I could hardly wait to buy them. I have two pairs of the original Groove gladiator, and I really can't say enough good things about them - and these are just as good! Not only are they extremely comfortable and lightweight but the new double straps and great tan colour make them super-fashionable. Like so many women I have problem feet and assumed I couldn't wear the gladiator style. Thanks so much, Ecco, for making fashionable AND comfortable sandals! BTW ladies, I need extra arch support and so I just put in stick-on gel arch supports. Works great!

product_title: NEW Womens GRAY w/ZIPPER Knee High Designer SNOW Boots
review_body: Boots were a gift for my wife.  They arrived in plenty of time for Christmas and look great on her.

product_title: Blair Tote L&S Bow Handbag
review_body: I recently ordered this purse because I was wanting to get a new purse. I chose this one despite there being no reviews about it. I loved the way it looked in the pictures and the price was good, so I took a chance and ordered it. When it arrived, it was packaged very nicely. And it looked exactly like it did in the pictures. It's a great size purse. It has two open pockets on the inside for your cell phone or whatever else. There is also a zippered pocket on the inside and one on the back of the outside. Plenty of storage/organizational space. The lining is nice. The handles are a great length. Overall, I recommend this bag.

product_title: FASH Limited Boxy Weekender Snake Skin Embossed Shoulder Handbag in Classic Grey and Black
review_body: I would give this product 5 stars but I was actually disappointed when the blue in the picture was not on the bag. I thought that was a cool edition to it. I gave this purse as a gift and the recipient loves it! She uses it all the time now and it fits ALL of her stuff. The quality so far seems to be well worth the price. product_title: adidas Men's adiStar Ride 2 Running Shoe
review_body: Very supportive. A little stiff. I like the stable bottom I am a little heavyset and he wide base prevents rolling.  Very happy with purchase. Runs 1/2 size small.

product_title: Reebok Men's Zig Pulse II Running Shoe
review_body: These shoes are everything that you would want for the gym. I am a gym rat so having good shoes is a must. The cushion provides great shock intake on impact, throwing the bar up and down is a breeze with these shoes. No lower calf pains while running on the treadmill. I do frequent sprints on the basketball court at the gym and these shoes provide great comfort on the hard court. They are light weight but tough and durable enough to give you all the support that you need. I plan on buying a pair of their turf shoes for baseball. I always thought that New Balance was the way to go for running until I got these. I've seen a few complaints about people tearing up their shoes while running. As far as that goes I say just take better care of them. You wouldn't buy white shoes to go run in the mud so why buy running shoes designed for hard surfaces to run outdoors unless your on pavement? That's what they make trail running shoes for. In response to the person who said his shoes tore while using them.. loosing up your lace might be a great idea. I would recomend these shoes to anyone and infact am getting my high school baseball team these shoes for our indoor practices for when the weather gets bad. Great shoes, great price, great everything!

product_title: Pour La Victoire Women's Prixie Pump
review_body: These could be the perfect patent leather shoes. They fit true to size, are super comfortable, and the heel is not too high. The bow detail is cute but not cutesy. Perfect for the office.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW410 Walking Shoe
review_body: This is the third time I have purchased these sneakers. They are very comfortable. I wear them for everyday and for hiking. They get a lot of mileage. Highly recommended.

product_title: Hi-Tec Men's V-Lite Mach 3.0 Wpi Light Hiking Boot
review_headline: Great Boots - taking heavy use like a champ so far
review_body: Had these boots for about 3 months and I bought these for everyday use on the job as an officer in the mountains of Tahoe.  Planned on warm weather use but it's mid June and it's still snowing occasionally.  Definately waterproof as that they have handled getting wet in the snow, rain, puddles, shallow water, etc.  Nice and lightweight too while providing good support especially given some of the equipment I use/carry.  Not insulated much so your feet will get cold standing in the snow for too long.  Good traction and grip. Good insole but I replaced it with a Dr. Scholl's Work insole.  No problems yet, so far so good.  If your looking for something lightweight and waterproof that can handle a decent hike while carrying a loaded backpack then this could be what your looking for. I give it a 4.5 out of 5.  Very happy with my purchase.

product_title: Mizuno Running Women's Wave Inspire 6 Running Shoe
review_body: I love Mizuno running shoes and these have been my favorite! Extremely comfortable and I love the look. They are also very durable.

product_title: Men's Tony Lama 8" Waterproof Breathable Lace Up Casual Packers Work Boots
review_body: I bought a pair of TLX work boots about 3 months ago. I wear them about 2 times a week at my construuction site. The other days I wear my Timberlands. There is absolutley no comparison between the two boots. At the end of a day wearing the Tony Lama's my feet are killing me. And it has nothing to do with being broken in or whatever, it has to do with the way the boot is made. I can feel every single rock, pebble and stone that i walk over, i might as well be barefoot. I hate these boots so much that I took time out of my day to try and warn others.     If you plan on wearing these boots in any type of work capacity, or if you plan on wearing them for more than 3 hours at a time, forget about it, do yourself a favor and dont buy these boots.

product_title: Sorel Men's Cheyanne Boot
review_headline: Great boot at the right time
review_body: I got these right before January as a boot to quickly put on to take the dog out, get firewood and any other quick outside activity that involved me walking through snow/water.  The ease of putting these boots on without using your hands is great.  They always keep my feet warm for trips outside less than 30 minutes.  One things i Would say is I bought these 1 size bigger based on other reviews and they are just big enough for me.  I would getting these 1-2 sizes larger.  Overall these boots are amazing for what I needed.

product_title: Clarks Women's Brisk Bangle Sandal
review_headline: Very cute & trendy & BONUS its comfortable
review_body: The sandal is everything described on the internet.   It looks expensive and is made of very high quality material.   I have gotten many compliments on these sandals!   They are very comfortable!

product_title: Sydney Love Stamps And Letters Foldover Tote
review_body: When this bag was filled with my personal items, the bag itself just seemed to collapse around the handle.  Felt like this bag was just unsupported and in fact, almost seemed cheap.  Would not recommend this bag.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Strength Fitness Walking Sneaker
review_body:
First the bad news: Made in China. Boooo, turning my city into a dump by closing the factories, exploiting Chinese slave labor and un-controlled pollution that's hurting us all. We also take a serious risk that the materials will not be as advertised and possibly even poisonous. But I bit my tongue and tried them anyway.

I am very happy I did. When I first bought them, I was in the throes of psoriatic arthritis, which is the same as rheumatoid but a different cause. My ankles were weak, twisty, and sore all the time. The Shape-Ups were painful to wear because I was pronating with every step. I put the shoes away and went back to my Sunrise FootwoRx for a few mmonths. But now the P.A. has gone into remission thanks to Remicade, and I have no more ankle pain. So I have been wearing the Shape-ups again and wow! I am thrilled. Not pronating at all and they feel feather-light. I also noticed that they are a great relief for those annoying heel spurs so many of us have as we get older. In fact, I met an elderly lady who told me that these are the only shoes she can wear without heel pain.

Now, as to performance. The rocker action makes it very hard to slacken my pace when walking outside, which is a problem I have when not on the treadmill. And these shoes make me crazy powerful on the hills. They just roll me right up over the top, much faster, and much less huffing and puffing.

product_title: Diba Women's Joy Ride Pull-On Boot
review_body: Super awesome boots for the price! I wear them all the time, LOVE! However, if you are looking for thigh high boots these are not it. They stop just over the knee, but still really cute!

product_title: Dearfoams Plush Velour Closed-Back Women’s Slipper – Padded Microfiber Slip-Ons with a Durable Outsole - 745
review_body: The slippers were nice, comfy but the heel on one separated from the sole after one week. The stitches all popped. I contacted the seller and will see what they say. I wouldn't buy them again.

product_title: Merrell Perimeter GORE-TEX Men
review_headline: Not good for long backpacking (or short, for that matter)!
review_body: I hate these boots!  They're too narrow, don't breath, and are very hard on the heels of the feet.  For the last 20 years I have used nothing but Timberland boots for backpacking (I'm a Scoutmaster and High Adventure Team member).  I am a seriously hardcore, wilderness backpacker.  These boots are the most uncomfortable boots I have ever used.  Period.    I switched back to Timberland.  I do not recommend Merrell boots.  Buy Timberland.

product_title: Jumping Jacks Annika Dress Shoe (Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: Love this shoes for my daughter ordered the white and she loves them. fit well my daughter is inbetween 3.5 and a 4 works just fine. i love jumping jacks i find them to be a great shoe

product_title: Vasque Men's Opportunist Light Hiker
review_body: It's great to find shoes in my size, 15. I use these for mountain biking. They grip the peddles well and are very comfortable and light weight. They are vented and breath well, so these will be my summer riding shoes. When the trails get to steep for riding up they are perfect for getting off and pushing the bike.

product_title: Eleven Toddler/Little Kid Simone Boot
review_body: My daughter loved these boots so much that we just bought the next size-up after she grew out of the old ones.  She didn't want any other style boots.

product_title: Softspots Elisa
review_body: I actually ordered these sandals in 2 colors last spring. I love Softspots sandals and these are comfortable, attractive, and a little dressy. The only problem I have encountered is that my feet tend to slide down in the sandals after I've had them on and walked a bit. To me, this is annoying. I end up with the rest of the sandal sticking out the back by my heel like they are really too big for me. They really aren't too big, and since I haven't worn them a lot yet, I will keep them. Maybe some kind of insert will help keep this slippage from happening.

product_title: Men's Merrell Bergenz Waterproof
review_body: When I first saw these boots, in a store that that didn't have them in my size (14), I thought that they would really be good so I ordered them through Amazon.com. When I finally got them, I was really disappoint in how hard they were to slip on!  I struggled and struggled and they would \\"hang up\\" on my foot! I could not easily get them on to save myself.  Merrell if they really wanted to make a home run, should put a zipper on the side!  That would make it really easy to get them on and off. Other people may like them (they seem to be made very well) but sad to say, they're going back today....

product_title: Chooka Women's Noir Lace-Up Rain Boot
review_body: These rainboots were exactly what I wanted. The color is true black, the border along the top shaft of the boot is more of a kelly green rather than the camo green that is showin in the photos. The laces aren't actually functional but I didn't purchase them for that reason.    The reason I did purchase these rain boots? I love that the lacing at the front gives an extra detail, these boots seem a bit more unique than the typical houndstooth and polka dotted fare offered in big box stores.     I purchased a size 9 and typically wear between an 8.5 or 9 in womens. For that reason I'll call these true to size.     The best way to wear these? With skinny jeans, they're also adorable masquerading as snow boots in the winter with tights and skirts.

product_title: Giuseppe Zanotti Women's I06207 Ballet Flat
review_body: I love the design. However, i just had a problem with exchange since amazon doesnt do exchanges i have to make sure from now on that it will fit me to avoid necessary returns (which takes about 3-5 weeks) and re purchase. I really dont like doing reviews but since i had several issues with the return policy i thouht this review might help other who plans to purchase this.  The leather is very soft. I usually wear size 8 1/2-9  i purchase this in 9 it fits but since the material of the leather is very soft im afraid if i break it in it will be too loose for me. I decided to return it and  try size 8.  Also, the shipping is fast the only drawback is the return and the fee.  Over all, the shoes is really nice, goes on with skirt especially  with skinny jeans.

product_title: Jambu Women's Storm-Waterproof Ankle Boot
review_body: Love 'em! I get lots of complements; especially from boys, which is funny because boys never care about shoes :) Warm, functional, super comfortable, stylish, high quality, waterproof...what's not to love?

product_title: Clarks Women's Country Meadow Sandal
review_body: I absolutely LOVE these shoes! They are too cute and sooo comfy! I'm thinking of ordering another pair I like them so much.  I followed the advice of the other reviews and ordered a 1/2 bigger and they fit perfect.

product_title: Pajar Women's Grip Boot
review_body: I live in cold, snowy Maine and I can't explain how much I love these boots!  I am in my thirties and these are the best winter/rain boots I have ever owned. They are also very stylish and I receive tons of complements.  No one here has heard of Pajar and they aren't sold at US stores, so I love being the only one to have them.  The Pajar website describes them as the \\"rolls royce\\" of boots, and they are right.  They are super soft and warm, as well as completely waterproof and are true to size. I would not recommend going a size bigger or smaller.  If you have large calves these may not be the boots for you, as they fit the calf snuggly. If you buy them don't tell anyone where you got them, I want them to stay special!!!!

product_title: UGG Australia Women's Classic Tall
review_body: Bought these boots for my daughter, a gift she wanted for Christmas. They came in record time, and were packaged perfectly & properly.  They were absolutely beautiful, just what she wanted, more importantly, they keep her feet very warm especially for the winters we have!

product_title: New Balance Men's M498 Heritage Classic Sneaker
review_body: Superior arch support, relieves my knee pains. Not the greatest style, but durable, comfortable and made in the USA. New Balance, PLEASE never stop making this shoe! In fact, a plain black or brown \\"dress\\" upper on this shoe would be a great addition.

product_title: Blowfish Women's Hanuku Ankle Boot
review_body:
Love these!!! I wasn't expecting them to be so comfortable. I guess you could compare them to a house slipper... a very stylish house slipper.

I think I fed too much into the other reviews in regard to size. I'm normally an 8 to an 8 1/2. I purchased the 8.5 because EVERYONE was saying that they ran so small. I now wish I got the 8 instead because they're a little on the big side. Oh well, they're still great shoes and I got them at a killer price. Totally happy :)

product_title: Skechers Little Kid/Big Kid Urbantrack II - Sleaks Slip-On
review_body: I think this is his fourth pair of these shoes, and I have bought a bigger pair for when he grows out of these.  He likes these even better than his sneakers, so he has even started wearing them with short sport socks and his cargo shorts - and they look great,  These are truly all occasion shoes - easy to put on, and more importantly, easy to keep looking clean.

product_title: Merrell Plaza Strap
review_body: I need good arch supports in my shoes but wanted something \\"cute\\" for work that didn't look like industrial shoes.  These fit the bill.  I wear them with jeans or black cotton pants, \\"work casual\\" wear.  they are so comfortable and I don't need to wear my arch supports in the shoes at all, my feet don't ache at the end of the day at all.

product_title: ECCO Women's Gisborne Bootie
review_body: I recently purchased this shoe for a convention I was attending knowing that I'd be on my feet for 10+ hours each day. I needed an extremely comfortable shoe that would still be bearable to wear at the end of the day. These shoes were not only comfortable after 10 hours of wear but were quite stylish under my black trousers and jeans. I've spent thousands of dollars on shoes in the pursuit of finding the balance between bearable wear and must-have style and this pair most definitely meets both fronts for an extremely nominal price. I've paid 4X this price for shoes that I've only been able to wear for 1 hour before screaming in pain. This has definitely been the best shoe purchase of 2010 for me...and that says a lot.

product_title: Daniel Green Women's Dormie Slipper
review_body: Received these today and put them on right away.  All I can say is my feet are in heaven!  If you want a quality house shoe look no further.  These are so comfortable I'm sighing with contentment.

product_title: Red Wing Shoes Men's 6" Classic Moc Boot,Black ,9.5 D(M) US
review_body: I was very pleased and happy with the build quality, stitching and feel of these boots.  Most especially when I read the \\"MADE IN USA\\" label.  Snag these guys up, they'll look great for indoors or outdoors.  i'm not entirely sure if these support the resoling service that red wing has, but either way it's really worth it.  This pair looks like it'll outlast three of my other boots!

product_title: David Tate Women's Echo Pump
review_body: I received the shoe in 8 1/2 Narrow and it is very wide. I think it's as wide as a Medium width shoe. It doesn't come in 3A so if your feet are narrow find a different shoe. Otherwise, it is very pretty in croc, has a soft, flexible sole and looks like it would be very comfortable if it fit.

product_title: DC Women's Court Graffik SE Skate Shoe
review_body: nice shoes. very pretty on my girlfriends feet.  they are better looking in person than on the computer. shoes fit really well.

product_title: Timberland Women's Earthkeepers Mount Holly Tall Lace Duck Boot
review_body: I'm really happy with this purchase, especially with the pricing purchased through Amazon.  They're warm, comfortable, waterproof and stylish.  No complaints.

product_title: New Balance Men's M587 Running Shoe
review_body: After spending a few hours doing research on mobility reduction sneakers (for my flat feet) and reading several reviews online, I decided to order the New Balance M587's. One of my concerns was that the shoe would fit wide or expand outwards once I started wearing them. I actually read that in someone's review and decided to order them anyway. Big mistake! Although the shoes are \\"comfortable\\", they have already started to widen and I ordered the narrow fit. If I were you, I would think twice about ordering this shoe is you have a narrow, flat foot as I do.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW811 Slip-On Walking Shoe
review_body: I love these sneakers.. I have been wearing one pair that I originally purchased at a New Balance store for 3 years. I wore them to work every day at a dealership service dept. They hardly show any wear other than they are not snow white anymore. I never had a more comfortable sneaker and now just puchased another pair online.

product_title: Belvedere Men's Cava Oxford
review_body: I think these are a good pair of shoes they are true size to fit they feel a lil funny at first but once you start wearing them they feel good on your feet i have bought three pair since i have gotten these

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Premium Sneaker
review_body:
Excellent quality and probably very comfortable.
But, I had to return it because they are too narrow for my feet.

product_title: New Balance Women's WR1225 Running Shoe
review_body: I got a size larger to accomodate all the running that I do.  They are extremely comfortable and haven't given me any discomfort.

product_title: Robeez Soft Soles Ruffles Mary Jane (Infant/Toddler)
review_headline: Nice shoes, hard to put on baby's feet
review_body: Robeez have a real good reputation as baby shoes so I'm not knocking that. With these shoes however there are no buckles or velcro tab for opening. The only way to get it on baby's feet is to pull the scrunched elasticated back. This made it really akward to put on my 4 month old's feet. I ended up returning them. They are quite nice for baby shoes though

product_title: Vasque Women's Briza GTX Hiking Boot
review_body: I didn't want to buy these boots. I wanted a more traditional looking hiking boot but when I put these on there was no question that I had to buy these. They are really comfy and I can go all day hiking with the support I need. My feet never feel over heated even with a wool sock on. They are so lightweight that after wearing winter boots all winter when I put these on I felt like I was flying not walking. These are an excellent value for the money.

product_title: Ryka Women's Radiant Walking Shoe
review_body: I have been reading about Ryka shoes for years: how they are designed specifically for women, with narrower heels and more space around the toes.  I sure couldn't find that extra space!  I've worn the same shoe size for years. A half-size up might solve this problem, but I am not willing to risk it and then have to spend more money returning them.     What a disappointment, especially after considering the purchase of these shoes for years!

product_title: Crocs Women's Patricia Sandal
review_body: Love these sandals!  So very comfortable. Have the lightness of crocs but not the bulky look of the clogs.  I wear them all the time!

product_title: Robeez 1st Stepz Becky Sandal (Toddler)
review_body: This pair of shoes is overpriced, it is the discontinued pattern and on robeez site clearance price is 16 dollars. Don't be fooled!

product_title: El Naturalista Women's Wakataua N442 Boot
review_body: Pictured, they're so very cute. Ordered and tried on with jeans....yea, not so much. :( Too much like a moccasin-style look, but too short of a boot to tuck pants in. Love this brand, but not this style.

product_title: Cinzia Pocket Eyes Folding Sun Readers - Sun Reading Glasses Rectangle Shape - Includes Hard Case with Mirror
review_body:
Very comfortable and compact. Excellent clerity and nice fashion. Light weight and seems to be high quality. Nice protective case with mirror. I may buy an extra and put a distance Rx into it.

4-10-11 Bought another pair and will have it made into a 'distant' vision dark sunglass Rx. Very nice and convenient, and seems quality made. Very comfortable, and can't beat the price and shipping speed/cost. Nice and fast customer service, too.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Enhancers Sneaker
review_body: Great shoes! After wearing them for one hour, I immediately felt some muscles that I was unaware of!   The shoes look great. It is not obvious on the pictures, but the 'white' part is in fact some sparkles.

product_title: adidas Women's Barricade Team Tennis Shoe
review_body: Bought for my wife and she loved the look of the shoes.  The problem is that where the white and red materials on the top of the shoe meet a crease is formed when you walk.  The crease is on the instep of the foot and not above the toe joint.  They would have caused blisters if she keep them.

product_title: Lugz Men's Drifter Lo Boot
review_body: Other reviews stated to increase a size because the sizes run small. This is not true. My husband wears an 8 or 8.5 depending on the shoe/boot, so I bought a 9. The 9 was way too big, and I threw out the invoice accidently so I could not send them back for a smaller size. Otherwise, my husband does like the look and feel of the Lugz boot. I had to special order him a thick insole to ensure a more substantial fit. He is pleased, but recommends to order the boot in the wearers actual size, especially if the wearer has a wide foot! Hope this is helpful with your purchase!:)

product_title: Ray-Ban RB4141 Round Wayfarer Sunglasses
review_headline: Trendy fun version of the wayfarer
review_body:
I love the style of these so much I bought them in black polarized and then in Havana brown. They are so fantastic on my face and feel very well made. I felt good buying these directly from Amazon and I am so pleased.

These glasses are like the classic wayfarers with a twist. They are more unique because of the slightly rounded shape, and it gives them a bit more of a feminine look. I usually find glasses that look just okay on me, but these I think these actually pretty hip without trying too hard.

Polarized are more expensive and a better investment for overall sun protection and driving, but the regular lenses are great too, are dark and provide very good protection in bright conditions. I really love these!

product_title: Capelli New York Metalic Pu Upper With Flower Trims Ladies Fashion Flip Flop
review_body: I really like these shoes, and I always get loads of compliments when I wear them. For an eight, they're kind of small though. Maybe order a size bigger. Super cute, and they match almost anything!

product_title: Callaway Men's XTT LT Golf Shoe
review_headline: if you could walk in my shoes (dylan)
review_body: the first time i wore these shoes i was impressed.  felt great, looked great & had great traction.  and even better yet, every time i put them on, they feel better yet.  great job!

product_title: MIA Women's Seargeant Ankle Boot
review_body: What can I say, I love these boots. The reason I didn't give them a 5 star is because the soles can get little slippery and although it matches the rustic look there are some stains that look more like glue (or something). BUT after a couple of wear, these 'stains' became softer and managed to blend well with the rest of the boot... I went half a size bigger as suggested by other reviews and find them really comfortable and loose. I have skinny ankles and don't mind that these boots are wide so if your after a fitted kind of boot these are definately not for you (i like that they are wide). I've been wearing them with thick stockings/tights and have found little pullies around the ankle area but they aren't obvious... It really comes down to what your taste is, but I'm happy with these.

product_title: Reebok Women's Runtone Running Shoe
review_headline: Great for legs but toes go numb
review_body: I have been using these shoes for about a month and a half and the only complaint I have is that my toes go numb. I do see signs of improvement in my legs and butt. However, if I use the shoes for longer than 30 minutes my toes go numb.

product_title: Lucky Brand Women's Valora Flat
review_body: I own a number of pairs of Lucky brand shoes and this one is not quite up to the quality you usually see with this brand. The shoes are more \\"rustic\\" than the picture. OK w/ jeans or around the house, but I wouldn't wear them to work. Fit is true to size--these are just more casual looking than I expected. Will keep, though, for those beach days.

product_title: Proenza Schouler Women's OI9706 Lace-Up Bootie
review_body: I couldn't believe the boot in person given the price, even the sale price it looked cheesy.   The patent was stiff and uncomfortable and creased/wrinkled strangely at the ankle and instep.  The boot is busy, which could have been cool but the pieces come together badly.  It was a great concept, and maybe in a non patent leather works better, but this boot is all wrong.  Also in this size (41) because of the tiered sole, the boot is huge, not just big but scary HUGE.

product_title: Harley Davidson Women's Tatum Oxford
review_body: I have worn this shoe since 2006.  I wear through them quickly due to the way I walk.  I find them to be uncomfortable for my feet (no arch support) however, there is nothing else that alleviates my severe back pain.  I buy them in bulk and don't have a clue what I will do if they ever stop making them.  I have tried all of their shoes that appear to have similar soles, but this is the only one that works.

product_title: Hi-Tec Men's Multiterra Targa Hpi Adventure Sport Shoe
review_body: I purchased the Multiterra Targa Hpi as replacements for Multiterra Low shoes. The Targa shoes are used for bicycle commuting and bicycle touring. My bicycle pedals are fitted with half clips and I tour with a single pair of shoes. The Targa Hpi shoes offer good torsional resistance and a firm sole where it contacts the pedal. The toe box is sufficiently stiff for cycling. The ventilated sides offer improved cooling in warm weather. The Targa Hpi shoes absorb less water in wet conditions - the shoes incorporate neoprene components in place of the open cell foam and fabric of my previous shoes. The shoe does not have a separate tongue beneath the laced section, this seems to increase the structural rigidity of the shoe. This should be a benefit for cycling and hiking. The elasticized lace system is well suited to cycling purposes.

product_title: Nine West Women's Skipper Boot
review_body: Love these boots. I have worn them alot!! They are holding up well. I have worn them in cool temperatures as well as hotter weather. They work well when temperatures warm up as they have the holes in the shaft. I usually only wore boots in colder weather so am enjoying these most of the year.

product_title: Domo Slippers - Domo Kun Comfy House Slippers
review_body: This was another Christmas gift for my daughter, along with a Domo t-shirt, and she put them on as soon as she took them out of the box.

product_title: Wolverine Men's Big Horn 8" Sport Boot
review_body: Let me start off by saying that I am very hard on my boots.  I live in them 10-12 hours a day, usually 6 days a week, so I NEED sturdy, comfortable boots.  I work outdoors no matter the weather, so it is very important to me that my feet are kept dry, cool in summer and warm in winter.  These boots have fit the bill perfectly, as I have owned at least 6 pair of these thus far, and am about to purchase yet another.  I honestly don't know what I would do if Wolverine were to discontinue these, as I have tried several other highly rated brands over the years and none are as comfortable, or last as long as these.  I do admit that the rubber soles are quite soft and wear quickly when used frequently on hard surfaces, but 3 seasons out the year I work on soft surfaces (grass, dirt, mud) so mine are not effected as quickly.  On average they last me 10-14 months.  Overall, good service and price from Amazon, GREAT product from Wolverine!

product_title: Crocs Women's Berryessa Boot
review_body: I bought these before I took a trip to Indiana in January. Well they did their job...easy to pull on and off in airport, waterproof for walking through snow, and comfortable on my feet after wearing all day. I actually bought 2 pairs of boots, these and a pair of cute rocket dog booties....I wore these crocs the whole time and lent the rocket dogs to my sister.

product_title: ALLROUNDER by MEPHISTO Women's Niro Mary Jane Flat
review_body: I buy a new pair of these shoes in a different color every year. My older Mephisto \\"Allrounders\\" are in perfect condition but I love the range of available colors.   They don't give me blisters and there is no 'break in' period. I put them on my feet and GO!  I have osteoarthritis in both knees ans these shoes are worth every penny!

product_title: Easy Spirit Women's On Cue Casual
review_body: I love these shoes!! I've had them for 1 year and they are by far the most comfortable shoes I have ever had.  They have held up well even with constant wearing.  I highly recommend them and only hope they get my size back in stock.

product_title: Quiksilver Men's Monkey Wrench Thong Sandal
review_body: nice quality, a little smaller sizing than I'm used to.  I would recommend getting a size larger than needed.

product_title: Silver Embossed Floral Damask Business Card Case Wallet
review_body: I just received my business card holder in the mail today and was upset when I opened it. The interior of my card holder does not have the elastic bands that are pictured at the top of the page. Instead, there is this plastic accordion folder. The folder is made so that each section only holds one card. My new holder can only carry, at max, six cards. So the 30 card claim in the product description is way off. I would have much preferred the bands to the accordion folder in mine. I guess I can rip it out and use the holder by itself, but I'm still very disappointed.

product_title: Sperry Top-Sider Women's Mallard Boot
review_body: These are really comfortable and true to size.  Perfect for commuting to work in the rain when I don't want to deal with boots. I look forward to wearing them this spring. I want another pair!!

product_title: Dr. Martens Men's 3989 Brogue Wingtip Shoe
review_body: The shoes and overall service met my expectations. I would definitely use Amazon to continue making more purchases. I loved the free shipping offer as well. I bought the shoes for my husband and he absolutely loves them.

product_title: Sanuk Women's Yoga Mat Primo Flip Flop
review_body: I am a HUGE fan of Sanuk yoga mat flip flops.  This is my 5th pair!  These are extremely cute and comfy!  The only negative is the strap had to stretch a good bit since it is leather.  Once that happened, they are great!

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's Bikers Aspire Sneaker
review_headline: great for bike riding in the hot summer
review_body: These shoe's aren't the most comfortable over all, but they are great for riding my bike in the summer. They look cuter than I thought they would, and they stay on my foot well during rides, and keep my feet cool. Almost as good as wearing sandals.

product_title: Dansko Women's Volley Clog
review_headline: Love these so much, bought a pair for my mom!
review_body: I saw these clogs in a magazine and thought they were so cute! I then found a store who carried them and once I tried them I thought they were even better. Super comfortable and not too unlike their traditional counterpart. I have really high arches and own two pairs of the traditional style. I find these just as comfortable if not more so. They are a bit more shock absorbing, similar to a sneaker. I have recently purchased a pair for my mother who also has two pair of the traditional style and I'm sure she will love them just as much as I do.

product_title: VANELi Women's Jobina Ankle Boot
review_body: this boot is so  sharpjeans. also have studded purse to match.always looking for something different and this is it. comfortable also please start making purses to match your boots like these

product_title: Nine West Womens Maeble Boot
review_body:
I should have listened to other reviewers about how tight these run. My sister is wearing them now because even after stretching the toe box was too tight.

In addition the area just above the heel (not sure what that is called - the area near your Achilles tendon) is rigid so I got a hot spot. This may have been just because my foot wasn't moving well through the front half of the shoe, but could also just be too rigid.

product_title: Merrell Women's Siren Thong Sport Sandal
review_body: I love these shoes, the flower part in the middle of the strap hurt my foot for a few days because it sticks up and pushes into the top of your foot. But after about three days once the strap got stretched out it didn't bother me anymore. They are a nice light pastel color, don't expect it to be very blue.

product_title: Gentle Souls Women's Warm Me Up Boot
review_body: I have looked a long time for LEATHER BOOTS THAT WERE FLAT WITH NO HEELS.  I have worn them a couple of times since receiving them and my feet were kept warm and dry which was the reason I needed them.  Wish they had not been quite so expensive but if they last as long as the ones that I bought in the 80's from SPEIGEL CATALOGUE IT WILL BE WORTH THE COST!  I paid $100 dollars for them at that time and am still wearing them.

product_title: Golden Retriever Men's Waterproof Casual/Work Hiker
review_body: Got these for my 13 year old son.. to wear hiking, working, or fishing .. and he thinks they are great.. super comfortable.. they do look a lil wide in the front .. which he says doesn't bother him but just a warning they aren't super fitted like a merrell or another comparable hiker.. On thee golden retriever site it specifies this is to reduce injury to the front of the foot... and for the record that is a non metal protective toe.. so it does not conduct electricity and it is super light .. Thanks for the good deal Amazon.. :D

product_title: EMU Australia Women's Jolie Slip-On Slipper
review_headline: Finally stopped worrying. It's the best!
review_body: I am a picky shopper honestly. I will return any products with any problem. But for this EMU slippers I have to say it's so perfect. I bought Bearpaw Loki 2 from their website as a comparison and the Bear absolutely CAN'T defeat Emu. The foot bed is soooo soft and thick! You can't even feel the outsole cuz there is a thick layer of fur. And of course it keeps feet warm because of lots of thick  and dense fur inside. I am Size 8 (EUR 38) and i bought size 7. It fits perfectly. The only issue is it doesn't cover too much. But i knew it before purchasing. I will highly recommend this item especially it's on sale. Will buy it again. Love EMU!

product_title: Ryka Women's Ultima Run Running Shoe
review_body: I have worn Ryka shoes for years and wouldn't wear any other brand. They are very light weight, need no breaking in and are perfect for my foot.  The price I paid at Amazon was low and I received them in a few days even though I did not special order them.

product_title: Lock Laces
review_body: I am just starting out in triathlons and I am certainly no where near the fastest (usually just shy of the middle of the pack) but in my last tri and the first time I used these laces my T2 time was one of the fastest in my age group.  I would say that these laces were certainly were a big help with that.  I have the tension set perfectly to where I can quickly slip on my shoes and go with no fumbling around with laces or trying to adjust anything.  They stay where you lock them and have been comfortable even on my last 10 mile training run. The elastic is just tight enough to keep my foot from slipping around in the shoe but not too tight as to become uncomfortable over time.

product_title: adidas Men's Super Cup Low Basketball Shoe
review_body: It seems the older style with the black stripes are becoming harder to find. These shoes still have the more bulky style like the originals (not fitted - slim). Very comfortable for long hours on your feet.

product_title: Reebok Women's Walk XC III Walking Sneaker
review_body: This sneaker allowed room for my orthotics and is fairly lightweight. Only negative was that laces were super long and had to be trimmed !  Very nice looking sneaker especially for those like me for whom white sneakers get very dirty-looking. These are a nice neutral color for any season.

product_title: Keds Women's Champion Original Canvas Sneaker
review_body: I have been wearing KEDs for over 50 years, love them.  They were exactly what I odered, no problems

product_title: White Mountain "Evangelia" Women's Metallic Leather Flats, Penny - 9.5 M
review_body: These shoes are very comfortable and look great. I only wish they had another color in my size. Metallic is a beautiful color.

product_title: Cowgirl Backpack Purse Natural Western Tooled Leather 283
review_body: I have had this purse for the past five years and have never owned a better purse! The craftmanship is worth every penny. Wish they had more available, it's a great gift!

product_title: Sanuk Women's Yoga Mat Flip-Flop
review_body: These feel so wonderful!  They are true to size and the width is perfect.  I wear a 7M but most flip flops seem too wide for my feet so I must lean toward the narrow side.  Not sure if this style would work for a wider foot.  They do tend to stick to the bottom of your feet which I like but some may not.  Each step is a pleasure in these!

product_title: Pleaser Women's Teeze-04R Platform Pump
review_body: i got these shoes for my best friend for her birthday! when they came in i took them out and looked at them! they were baby pink and extremely gorgeous! im jealous i didnt get a pair for myself! she came to pick them up the day after i got them and couldnt believe how beautiful they were in person (they look way better in person then online) i would definitely recommend these!

product_title: dav Women's Victoria Karma Knee-High Boot
review_headline: Not for the rain!!!! Great looking rain boots--but not waterproof
review_body: I have only one pair of these rain boots, the Victoria in animal print.  I could not wait for the boots to arrive and did not even wait for rainy weather to wear them. Every time I wore the boots, I received major compliments.  Unfortunately, the first time it rained, my (thick) socks became wet and soggy and at the end of the day my feet were soaked in water and felt cold;  I could not wait to get home to take off the boots.  My advice:  buy the Victoria if you must, but don't wear the rain boots in the rain. My rating is half a star.

product_title: Clarks Women's Wave Bistro Ankle Boot
review_body: Ordering over the internet can be risky. Not this time these boots are true to size. They are generous in width and very comfortable.I won't hesitate to buy more.

product_title: New Balance Men's MW576 Walking Shoe
review_body: This is husband's second pair and he loves the comfort of this shoe.  He works in retail environment and the balance of these shoes keep his back from hurting when he has been on his feet 8-9 hours.  Clean up real well when they get dusty.

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Fuel Me Up Nmw0593
review_body: These are the greatest boots!  Not only are they comfortable, but they are Hot!  I get so many compliments on them!

product_title: Poetic Licence Women's Delish Mary Jane Pump
review_body: This is an absolutely gorgeous shoe! So much prettier in person then in the picture. It is also very comfortable, although I am saving it for spring, so I have not worn it for an entire day of running around yet. I can't wait for spring now that this shoe has arrived! It is also more versatile then I would have thought an orangey colored shoe could be. It is a perfect addition and it is going to add just the right of flair and personality this spring!

product_title: DC Men's Stock Skate Shoe
review_body: These shoes are so comfortable and stylish. I'm a big DC fan, to the point where the only thing I don't wear is their jeans, and the only thing that made me a little sad was that these shoes didn't come with any stickers, not a big deal but some do come with them. I'm glad Dyrdek finally made a shoe that was \\"calm\\" with no crazy colors, just plain black and white. The best part of all is Amazon's price, I saw these on DC's website for 65. If you buy these, you won't be disappointed.

product_title: Diesel Men's Hurry Up Sneaker
review_body: I bought this shoes like ten month ago and they still like new. I've used them for casual activities every week, they are very comfortable, light and beautiful. I even played soccer with them. I highly recommend this shoes!!

product_title: Earth Mirage 2 Winter Boot Womens
review_body: I love these boots!  They fit really well, very comfortable, and keep my feet warm.  I would highly recommend these boots in regard to fit and quality.

product_title: Seychelles Women's Spellbound Oxford
review_body: The whiskey is not grey-red, but dark green-brick color. I bought this color to wear it with black/gray clothes, but it's more for a brown/ocher wardrobe. I kept it nonetheless because it is so pretty and well made, and I don't care if it doesn't match. It is very true to size if you have a narrow foot, and if you have a wide foot, this may not be the shoe for you.

product_title: Nine West Women's Thelineup Ankle Boot,Brown,10 M US
review_body: These shoes are really comfortable and look great with jeans or a pair or slacks. I think if you are considering these wait no longer. They are great.

product_title: Chaco Women's ZX2 Vibram Yampa Unaweep
review_body: Loved Chaco sandals that I've had in the past but this is the first time I went for the toe strap. I took these along on a camping trip and they were really great- but I would not recommend them for the beach or sandy environments. Sand gets in these so easily and you have to floss it out, which can be a huge pain. Also would not recommend these for hiking in heavily forested areas- the toe strap makes it impossible to wear socks and if there is poison ivy, you're screwed.     All in all, love these but wouldn't wear them on a beach again.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups -Action Packed Fitness Walking Shoe
review_headline: Sketcher Shoes for Women- Shape Up
review_body: I bought these shoes for my mother and she loves them because they are so comfortable. Before, she was unable to walk for a long period of time, but with these new shoes she is definitely able.

product_title: Funtasma by Pleaser Women's Dame-115 Boot
review_headline: Perfect for Victorian Wedding or fun
review_body: The picture doesn't do this heel justice. I fell in love after putting them on. I can't wait to wear them with my wedding dress and as a fun accessory.

product_title: Fallen Men's Forte Skate Shoe
review_body: I bought these awhile back, and their probably one of the my top shoes to CRUISE in, really comfortable shoe definetly worth buyin'.

product_title: Timberland Men's 63579 City Adventure-Front Country Clog
review_body: I bought this clog as a Christmas gift and the young man has told me that it is an excellent product. It is warm, comfortable, and easy to walk in. He doesn't wear them when he has to wade through snow, but on shoveled walks, they are a fine winter clog. His feet stay warm even in an upstate New York winter. I would definitely buy another pair.

product_title: G.H. Bass & Co. Women's Margie Sandal
review_body: I love the design of this sandal, and I like the red cinnamon color.  I just had a couple problems: it was a little smaller than expected; usually I get a medium width 8.5 or 9 and I gambled and got a 8.5 M.  It's OK, just the fit is a bit short and a bit narrow.  I'd say overall it's slightly smaller than a true-to-size.  Also, as another reviewer mentioned, you might have problems with the cushiony foot bed making airy noises.  It's not a definite fault---actually, only one of my sandals makes the noise---but it's a possibility you might get that odd shoe.  I think the sandal will improve with time: the leather will stretch and I imagine the noise will eventually go away, in which case I give it 5 five stars rather than 4.

product_title: adidas Women's Attune ClimaCool Running Shoe
review_body: Love these shoes!  They are light weight, cool and breathable.  They are the perfect workout shoe for the hot and humid Houston weather. I use them for weight training and cardio workouts.

product_title: UB Classic 3-pack Retro Fashion Style Sunglass
review_body: i thought that they were all suppose to be different tints...they are all the same dark tint!!! what do i need 3 of the same glasses for !! ugh irate!

product_title: Skechers Sport Men's Stamina Approach Slip-On
review_body: Just got these shoes a few days ago and I must say that I am very pleased with the fit and function of this product.    The shoes themselves fit well and the tread, though a little stange looking, track well too.  I use these around work where my job needs require me to not only stand for hours on end but run and climb shelves from time, thought all that these shoes (and my feet) feel well at then end of the day.    The only complaint that I have is that the shoes do not have a decent size \\"pull tab\\" on the back (heel) to make putting them on a little easier.  I used a couple of smallish key rings and found that worked well (there is a spot for them belive it or not) but that solution may not be for everyone.    Overall I would recommend these for anyone looking for a easy and comfortable slip-on footware

product_title: Crocs Crocband Clog
review_body: Excelente precio para estas crocs, muy cómodas, muy bonitas, lo único que debes tener en cuenta es la talla, yo soy 8,5 en US y compré 8m/6W y me quedaron justas, al poco tiempo se estiraron y ya me quedan bien!

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Hickory Sandal
review_body: I bought this shoe in black for work.  I have slightly wide feet, and the straps do not dig into them.  After reading the other reviews, I was expecting a lot of cushion in the padding.  This is not the case.  However, they are comfortable for 8 hours and the sole is soft and flexible.  I would purchase them again or another Anne Klein shoe.

product_title: Buxton Over the Shoulder Organizer
review_body: I can not rate this really well becaues I never received it .. they gave a tracking number .. they told me what day My mail carrier states that he never got any package to deliver .. so I got a refund of the cost of the purse BUT never any shipping which was about almost same cost so I had to eat it .. not happy at all about that why can't the shipping also be insured ..

product_title: PUMA Women's Imani Mesh Sneaker
review_body: These sneakers are extremely comfortable!  Order a half a size bigger than what you normally wear (I wear an 8, I ordered an 8.5).  I wear them all of the time, and will purchase more because of the fit and the comfort.

product_title: GBX Men's 132546 Sneaker
review_body: Yes I really like this sneaker. It's the first time I ever bought sneakers from Amazon and they knocked this one out of the park. I get a lot of comments about this shoe.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Banelli Slip-On
review_body: Overall a nice shoe, but not quite worth the price tag. These shoes bend at awkward sharp angles at the toes, they lose their shine fast, and the heels of mine started falling apart after wearing them twice. Also, the black around the heels rubs off, showing a tannish-brown.    I like how easy they are to slip on, the fit, and the style, but the overall build quality and material quality is sub-par. product_title: ASICS Men's GT-2150 Running Shoe
review_headline: Great Shoe - Great Price - Great Performance!!!
review_body: I bought these shoes because I needed a good soft, cushioned running shoe. Previously, I paid almost $140 for the Mizuno Wave and was very dissappointed with the Mizuno Wave. I need a running shoe for heavier runners - I am 230 and muscular. It's clear that price is no indication of what you will get in the running shoe world. I expected the more expensive running shoes to be better, more comfortable than this $70 Asics running shoe and that's just not true with this shoe. With running shoes, there is a point of diminishing return. A $400 running shoe is probably not 4X better and 4X more comfortable than a $100 running shoe. Think about it! This Asics was the best of threee shoes I bought - see the $80 NB 1064 and the $140 Mizuno Wave. I ran and worked out in all 3 running shoes and the Asics was the best of all three. I was most impressed with the Asics 2150, because it cost half of the cost of other \\"premium\\" running shoes and was actually a better performer. Next time, I'm going to buy two or three pairs of these Asics and just believe and know it doesn't get much better than this. That's smarter! I'm also posting this same basic review on the Mizuno Waves I bought through Amazon.

product_title: Chums Rope For Kids.  Universal Fit Adjustable Eyeglass and Sunglass Retainer Cords. Choice of Colors
review_body: My five year old got glasses last year,  and when she started Kindergarten this fall,  we had to go to the Optical shop almost weekly to get new frames or replacement glasses when she broke/lost/scratched her glasses.  Her teacher recommended some sort of band,  but the elastic ones required that you attach them every time you put the glasses on,  and the metal springs that held the silicone loops to her glasses hurt her head.     I found these are few weeks ago,  and have not had a single problem with her glasses since (I'm even considering the nicer frames next time)     The tension cord is easy to tighten,  and helps the glasses stay on her face comfortably,  so she isn't pushing them up constantly,  and therefore is not as apt to take them off and leave/step on them.  This is great on many levels,  because she could outgrow her vision issues if she wears her glasses consistently,  which she does now.

product_title: Women's Merrell Tetra Launch Waterproof
review_headline: Have I told you how much I LOVE these boots?
review_body: Ask my boyfriend, who is sick of hearing me say, \\"have I told you how much I love these boots?\\". I bought these boots for a trip to Ireland. I wanted waterproof, warm, comfortable for walking, stylish: all of the above, and I found them in these boots. I have VERY muscular calves, measuring in at 14.5\\" at the thickest part. Another reviewer stated she had large calves, too, and these boots fit her calves with enough extra room for jeans to fit in, so I thought they were a safe purchase. This was not the case for me.     I got them a few days before the trip and thought it would be best to wear them as much as possible to break them in. They zipped up all the way on the calves, which was a good sign for me (I have never been able to find boots that fit my calves) but were VERY snug. The first day, I wore them to work (10 hr day), and they looked great with my work clothes. As the day went on, I started to think I wasted my money on these boots! They were so tight on my calves, and the leather buckled around my ankles and actually left a bruise and dent by the time I took them off that night! So I zipped a wine bottle into that leg, and by morning, the leather had stretched out enough that it was not pressing into the bruise.     We stopped in NYC to visit friends for the weekend before leaving for IReland. I wore these all around the city, through the rain and snow, and my feet stayed dry and warm. Once we got to Ireland, I was actually able to zip jeans into these boots, as they had stretched out enough. I wore these boots to the rocky beachside in Ireland, and only slipped a little on the mossy rocks we were climbing on. They were so comfortable on my feet, I could hardly believe it!     So the moral of the story is, the shoe part of the boot needs no time breaking in; it is a comfortable fit right away. The leather shaft of the boot needs time to soften and mold to your movements, but once it does, you won't be sorry you bought these boots. I'm so happy they turned out to be fantastic, and I'm sure they will weather Dublin as well as they have on this trip so far! And, they are $55 cheaper on Amazon than at the store or anywhere else online! Great deal!

review_body: I ordered this boot because it looked like what I wanted in a motorcycle boot.  I had the boot re-soled so that it had the soles I needed in a motorcycle boot.  NOW it has the cushion I need and the non-stick/slip soles too.  I'd order them again (but have them resoled again).

product_title: adidas Originals Men's Samba Soccer-Inspired Sneaker
review_body: The Adidas Samba soccer shoes were recommended to me by a member of my company's indoor soccer team. There are probably other people who could tell you more about what to look for in a soccer shoe, but I can tell you that the Sambas have been good to me.    I had some concerns going into our league. My ankles are susceptible to rolling and I sprained an ankle a few weeks before the league started. The Sambas don't provide ankle support like a boot, but what I can say is their treads provide just enough grip. Some shoes I've used in the past would have a tendency to grip at the wrong time on a lateral move and I could roll an ankle.    For ball handling, I can notice a difference between the Sambas and my regular shoes. I use the Sambas exclusively for games and team practices. When I mess around with a ball walking my dog I use regular shoes. The difference in how the shoes contact the ball is noticeable.     I can't really comment too much on materials and build quality. The shoes are still in one piece after five games. None of the stitching or materials is coming loose.    In summary: I don't really know anything about soccer shoes, but someone who does recommended the Adidas Sambas. They have not injured me. I do not blame them for any of my mistakes on the field--though if you're looking for something to blame, equipment works for all sports. The shoes are in good shape after playing almost half a dozen games.

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Nimbus 12 Running Shoe
review_body: My feet supinate, (under pronate/roll outward), and as a result, I need much more cushioning than arch support.  I've had issues with just about every shoe I've tried, but this is mostly due to not understanding the needs of my feet.  I'm not a runner, but at 245, I walk a lot.  My dogs get their mile before I go to the gym, and then I do thirty minutes of treadmill prior to hitting the weights (which require different shoes depending on the workout I'm doing).      I find the Nimbus 12s excellent for both walking and extended standing.  My feet, knees and back are much better off when wearing these shoes.  I also have the Nimbus 11s, which I also like, but prefer the 12's as, for me, they feel even more cushiony than the 11s do.    Despite one negative review complaining about the color selection, I like them.  They don't have millions of choices to choose from, but I'll take the superb performance over the limited color scheme offered for this model.      I've had both the 11's and 12's for a year, and am feeling the need to get a new pair.  I rotate the shoes to extend the life, but with my weight, and use of them for more than just the gym, it's time to retire the old set to wearing at work or just bumming around in.    I see the 13's are out, and I didn't read anything that has changed from the 12's, other than they are a tad lighter.  Of course it's fun to get the latest and greatest, and ASICS rarely disappoints, but I can't see any real reason to upgrade from the 12's since they've been so good to my feet.    I highly recommend the Nimbus 12s for supinators, those with high arches, or anyone simply seeking an extremely comfortable shoe with lots of cushion.
