review_body: THESE SHOES ARE GREAT JUST DONT WALK IN A LITTLE PUDDLE BECAUSE THEY WILL SEND YOU FLYING OR DOING THE SPLITS OTHER WISE I LOVE THEM. THEY SURE MAKE YOUR LEGS LOOK GREAT.

product_title: PUMA Adult Suede Classic Shoe
review_body: Nice Shoes, Atleasr found the quality i was looking for but was little unhappy about the color i recieved.Wanted the Dark Blue but got the Royal Blue.

product_title: UGG Women's Retro Cargo
review_body: This is my 3rd pair of uggs, my previous two being the tall classic and the suburb crochet. This pair is definitely the hardest pair that I've had but now they're starting to wear in a bit, they are extremely comfortable and very warm. Very pleased with the design too.

product_title: Onex Women's Christina Sandal
review_headline: Amazingly soft, light and good looking!
review_body: I don't think I've ever tried on shoes that were as comfortable as Onex and at the same time good looking. They are a little pricey but for a great staple shoe you wear all the time - totally worth it!  It felt like sliding a slipper on.

product_title: Timberland Men's Euro Hiker Leather And Fabric Boot
review_headline: Footlocker sent me a black boot instead of the Burgundy boot
review_body: What would I have wanted to know before I purchased this product? I would have wanted to know if they didn't have the color they showed in the picture, which was Burgundy. If I had known that I would have never ordered it. I am a female and I don't want a black timberland boot. The burgundy was a really pretty color and more suitable for a lady. I am very disappointed and will have to now search elsewhere for what I want. I thought I was going to get what was shown in the picture, but it didn't work out. You live and learn - and I learned really well this time around. I am hoping for a refund as soon as possible.

product_title: Saucony Men's KilKenny XC3 Flat Racing Shoe
review_headline: Narrow, run small but for the price....
review_body: Yes these run narrow and small.  I bought these and a few other minimalist shoes ICW the Born to Run wave...Gotta say that I'm a convert but you have to do it SLOWLY, especially if you are running almost exclusively on roads. I still do a LOT of treadmill time so it's been ok for me as a 5'11'' 180 lbs guy.    I wear a size 10 and bought an 11 and STILL these run small even with taking out the inserts. That's the downsize.  The upside is that IF you have narrow-ish feet and want a lightweight, very durable racing \\"flat\\" then these are your shoes.  I use these on my treadmill workouts w/ small socks and I don't tighten the shoestrings as much as I'd like and it works for me.  I don't think I can wear these for anything over a 5K, the small size would create too many problems.  Now I see that they are trying to get rid of the inventory for 19.99.  This is definitely a \\"Get what you pay for shoe.\\" If this fits your bill, then buy 2+ pairs! I MAY buy an 11.5 for this insanely low price just to see if it will work.    Hope this helps.

product_title: Harley-Davidson Women's Alexa 14" Boot
review_body: Arrived on time. I oredered a 1/2 size  smaller as these boots run large and real leather stretches, this was perfect for me and they fit great. I decided to break these in by wearing them bartending the first night they arrived - 8 hours on my feet. End of the night my feet STILL felt amazing. Thats saying alot for a brand new pair of boots. The ONLY reason I am giving them 4 stars is because the leather tightness on each foot was different. My right foot was tight as the new leather should be, and my left was loose like they had been stretched, with wiggle room, so my feet felt really odd. If I hadnt need them to ride in right away I probably would have returned them and asked for them to be fixed. Im used to it now though and everything else about these boots I love.

product_title: Ray-Ban Junior RJ9035S Junior Wayfarer Square Sunglasses
review_body: I bought these sunglasses for my 3 year old son. He wore sunglasses last Summer, a cheap pair of Diego sunglasses, and loved them. I saw these on sale and had to have them, as my husband has a similar pair. I just hope he doesn't break them. He didn't break his last pair but has been known to break Mommy's or Granddaddy's glasses.   Overall, these sunglasses are very stylish and cute!! So happy my son has his first pair of Ray Ban's. =)

product_title: Santana Women's Vermont 2 Boot
review_body: These are the best boots I have ever owned.  Comfortable, soft, functional (waterproof) and warm they are worth every dollar.  The calf is fairly wide and they can be turned down to expose the fleece lining if desired.

product_title: Saucony Men's ProGrid Omni 8 Running Shoe
review_body: This is my second pair of Omni 8s and I'll get them again if i can. The transaction was awesome and the price was excellent. I recommend these to any runners especially if you have knee/ankle pain or a pronation problem. Good shoes!

product_title: adidas Men's Tirand III Tennis Shoe
review_body: This is the first time I buy shoes online and let me tell you. I'm very glad I did. They fit perfectly and the feel great.

product_title: Clarks Artisan Dellwood Rose Womens Clogs Mules Black 8
review_body: I have worn Clarks shoes for years and these did not disappoint me.  Fit was great and as always, they were comfortable from the moment I put them on.  I would definitely recommend these shoes.

product_title: Harley-Davidson Women's Hustin Boot
review_body: Pros:  - look great! (I've gotten many compliments)  - comfortable  - true to size (purchased size 8, typically 8-8.5, broad feet)  - excellent for snow, dirt, pavement  - soles grip well (ice is almost non-slip)  - shaft wears in well without collapsing    Cons:  - water seeps in between leather and soles (only in severe rain and puddles, have yet to weather proof them)  - no arch support (remedied with gel supports for just the arches, full insoles make shoe too tight)  - takes time to break in for broad feet

product_title: Bogs Women's Classic Hi Fern Boot
review_body: The boots are great, I am not usually a person that wears boots but I would recomend these boots they keep your feet warm and dry.

product_title: Flat Shoe Laces 45 inch, 54 inch, 63 inch
review_headline: Shoe laces are shoe laces or are they?
review_body: Within 1 month, there were two spots that were starting to get wear spots.  Within 1.5 months, there were 3 spots and the plastic end came off.  So 2 months and in the garbage they go.  I work inside in an office and I only wear these shoes every other day so they have not seen any \\"abuse\\".      If you want shoe laces to last like the ones that came with your shoes, keep looking -- these are very poor quality.  To make it worse, they are expensive and poor quality.

product_title: Skechers Sport Women's D'Lites-Airy Sneaker
review_body: This is the only kind of shoe I have worn for everyday use for the past 5 years! The only ones I didn't like were the laced up mules, but this style is perfect! My old shoes wind up as garden shoes, the new pairs go 'out' on the town! Once they are broken in they are very comfy, not hard. Offer great support for knees, feet, ankles. I walk, garden and even do barn chores. Clean up easily.  I have to buy them on Amazon an the local stores don't carry them now. Please don't stop making these shoes!  I am not a kid, but feel like one wearing these.

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Rocket 5 Volleyball Shoe
review_body: Ordered a 11.5 , too narrow and tight. Order half a size bigger for better fit.  2 Start for poor fit.

product_title: Skechers Little Kid Damager-Police Light-Up Sneaker
review_body: I just bought these shoes for my 8 year old. He was very disappointed when he came home from school the first day of wearing them because the lights on one shoe had stopped working (5 out of the 6 at least). Now, the 3rd time wearing them, the other shoe is having problems not lighting up. The problem is that the store where I got them is now out, it was their last pair. I bought the light up twinkle toes shoes for both my girls at the same time, but they haven't gotten them yet (birthday), hopefully they stay lighting up!

product_title: UGG Women's Retro Cargo
review_body: I bought these as a gift for someone. They arrived faster than I expected and she loved them. I checked the boots before I gave them to her and they were in perfect condition.

product_title: Reef Little Ahi Flip Flop (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_headline: Great Flip flop for 3 years and Plus
review_body: My 3 year old loves these flip flops.  They stay on her foot, easy to walk in and worth spending the extra money instead of the cheap ones from other stores.

product_title: Crocs Men's Santa Cruz Corduroy Loafer
review_body:
Paid just a touch over 20 bucks for a pair of these in my size. Standard Croc insole, or whatever you want to call it. I've given these a while and they do mold to my feet just like other pairs of Crocs, albeit, just a little slower than others.

Word of caution: The gray color really picks up the dirt.

Otherwise, if you can pull them off, they're a great shoe. I even got a compliment from a Croc hating friend.

product_title: Hansi Naturals Shoe Stretcher Women 5-8 2pc NEW IMPROVED version beautiful construction!
review_body: I ordered these under my husband's account after going to a few different shoe makers who said they could not stretch the length of my shoes. I am so so happy that this product works so great! I have stretched two pairs of shoes that were way too tight length wise and now they fit wonderfully. Also one was a very high stiletto platform. So now I just went and picked up an expensive pair of shoes that I had consigned because they were tight... they are being stretched right now and I am so glad! Contrary to other reviewers, I find these amazingly easy to use- though you need some strength in your hands when really making the forms fit in there tight and stretch. Great deal- better than suffering or getting rid of great shoes. -Nancy Alinovi

product_title: Dr. Scholl's Women's Dance Clog
review_body: I bought these shoes because a coworker raved about them.  She was right.  They are fabulously comfortable and very cute!!!  I have read to order one size bigger but I bought my normal shoe size and they fit great.  I plan to have more than one pair soon.

product_title: Merrell Women's 'Jungle Moc' Outdoor Slip-on Shoe
review_body:
i ordered this shoe in the cordovan colour (burgundy)in my regular 8.5 size. i usually go up half a size to accommodate for winter socks and go down a half size for slippers, but since i read these are true to size i ordered my running shoe size 8.5. waaaay to tight. i have wide feet but can sometimes get away with a regular width... but not in these. they are so tight they cut off the circulation across my toes. its a sharp looking shoe, great for hoping in the car and running errands but every time i look at them knowing how my feet are going to ache, i choose a different pair. the length was perfect however. im not sure if they will stretch, i just can't bear to wear them for long enough to find out.

the shoe itself is very nice and arrived in perfect condition. i just wish they came in a wide width. then they would be perfect.

product_title: Timberland PRO Men's 53525 Steel Trax 6" Steel-Toe Boot
review_headline: Timberland Pro Steel Trax Work Boots
review_body: got these boots after three pairs of timberland pro pitboss steel toes, those boots are great, these boots seem to be even better, work construction in them every day and they seem to be holding up a bit better, two complaints though, one being they do not have the four hooks at the top which I like better because I can get them tighter and they stay tighter, instead these have regular lace eyelets, and for the life of me I find it harder than it should be to get these tight, the second thing being is they run quite bigger than normal timberland pros for some reason, I would say get a half size smaller than you normally would, other than that they seem perfect! Highly recommended, you cant go wrong with Timberland Pros, they are the best! Also they do not have a pull tab, which these boots need to get in and out of since the shank or lack there of sucks

product_title: Azura by Spring Step Women's Cinzano Sandal
review_body: I was thrilled to find these shoes, since I bought  my first pair at a retail store in another color at a significantly higher price  . They are so comfortable I feel fortunate to have them. They arrived in a timely fashion and in excellent condition.

product_title: kensiegirl Women's Chandra2 T-Strap Pump
review_headline: Too m and b for me
review_body: I love the shoe but its not in my size. I wear a wide and the m and b wont do anything for me.

product_title: Skechers Sport Men's Shape Ups Xt Biathlon Fitness Shoe
review_body: These are the most comfortable shoes my family and I own.  Between the three of us we have 12 pairs of skechers shape ups.  Can't beat them for comfort.

product_title: Maui Jim Makaha Polarized Sunglasses
review_body: I have a pretty bad case of photophobia and I was convinced by a sales person in a sunglasses sales place to purchase these when my old pair of cheaper sunglasses broke early this summer. I was hesitant since they weren't super dark in tint, etc. I tried them on and they actually looked good which surprised me because of the sporty style and more importantly, the polarized lenses blocked out the fluorescents in the store really well. I knew if they blocked those well, they would do well outside. They have. Unfortunately my first pair were lost when I handed my bag to someone (which will never happen again :) ) and so I had to re-purchase these again. I naturally wanted to purchase the awesome pair of sunglasses that have served me so well for so months and during the summer when the sun is at it's worst here in Texas. I highly recommend these glasses, especially if you have major issues with light! They are great for driving as well.

product_title: Khombu Women's Bungee2 Winter Boot
review_body: My feet were not happy with these boots, though they looked great on the web. I think they are waterproof, and probably for most people more comfortable than most waterproof boots.

product_title: Lovely People Women's Cash Peep-Toe Pump
review_body: LOVE...LOVE...LOVE...these shoes. I have been watching these shoes for like two years. Initially I wanted to purchase these in the yellow color but was very hesitant because of the high price of the shoes. However, they recently went on sale and I just had to snag a pair. Unfortunately, they didn't have the yellow color in my size so I purchased the purple/lilac color. And I must say that I am very impressed and satisfied. The shoes are very comfortable, eventhough the strap is a bit snug on my ankle (could be that I just have a fatter ankle than most). I really like the fact that the portion of the t-strap is attached to the actual strap. I have found with other t-strap like shoes that when that portion is not attached, then it moves all over the place. But these shoes are just awesome. Another thing I have to worry about with open toe shoes (and something I can't stand seeing on other women's feet) is where the big toe hangs off from the shoe being an open toe shoe. Well you don't have to worry about that with this shoe. My big toe is no where near the end of the shoe...so that is a major plus!!!!!!! I plan on wearing these shoes with a nice purple spring dress...can't wait!!!!!!!!

product_title: Skechers USA Men's Diverts Casual Slip On
review_body: The shoe comes in at about a size too large. I'm a size 13 with most types of shoes, primarily NB, but the 13 was a little too large. Overall, I like the design and the feel.

product_title: Kenneth Cole REACTION Women's Yum-Body Luvs U T-Strap
review_body: I love these shoes and wear them all the time when it is warm. My only complaint would be that after wearing them for one or two summers in a row the strap with the jewels on it started to seperate and come apart.

product_title: London Fog Marissa Trap Tote
review_body: I love the look and quality of this bag.  I use it everyday and my only wish is that it have more compartments.  My stuff gets lost in it.  Otherwise I would have given it 5 stars.

product_title: BCBGeneration Ruby-Chambray Small Satchel
review_body: I LOVE THE PURSE, BUT IT IS DIFFINETLY NOT USE EVERYDAY. THE MATERIAL ON THE PURSE STARTED TO PEEL ALONG THE EDGES AND I ONLY HAD IT FOR A COUPLE OF MONTHS. I WOULD SAY I USED THE PURSE FOR ABOUT 2MONTHS AND I STOPPED BECAUSE OF THE PEELING.

product_title: adidas Performance Men's Samba Classic Indoor Soccer Shoe
review_body: I have owned two pairs of these shoes and lost both of them after the glue connecting the rubber and cloth parts came undone, and I lost the heels.  Otherwise they are comfortable, although the arch is somewhat lacking!

product_title: Bernardo Women's Miami Thong Sandal
review_body: I've been on a Bernardo buying binge lately and the Miami is one of my favorites.  It's a classic, well-made, COMFORTABLE and stylish sandal that has remained fashionable for more than 40 years and for good reason.  Simply put, you cannot buy a better made sandal for the price.  I also love the Matrix and Must styles and now find myself with a closet full of Bernardos for every occasion.  You cannot go wrong with these.

product_title: Rider Men's Boxer Slide
review_body: bought these because I don't like the classic thong-style flip flops.  these have great grip thanks to the tire tread pattern, and are stylish, and comfy.

product_title: Seychelles Women's Mamie Bootie
review_body: I don't have enough good things to say about these shoes: the leather is exceptional and firm and the color is perfection! These boots do have a very high arch though, so be warned if you have flat feet, they may be uncomfortable.    More importantly, I  am beyond impressed with the service I received from Warehouse Deals,Inc. who delivered me this shoe (used) for a fraction of the price and 5 DAYS BEFORE the estimated delivery (they were shipped on a Wednesday and got to me on Saturday! for FREE)! I am thrilled. They were listed as in \\"good\\" condition--so I was slightly wary of how much wear they would have. In short: THEY ARE PERFECT! They are, if you ask me, brand new, unworn and PRISTINE! I am very, very impressed with Warehouse Deals and will be ordering from them again soon!!

product_title: Gola Men's Men'S Hornet Casual Sneaker
review_headline: They may look cool but the construction is terrible.
review_body: In less than two weeks I was experience seem failure with these shoes; needless to say they went back to Amazon. Never mind that they offer virtually no arch support and little cushion.

product_title: Badgley Mischka Women's Egan Metallic Sandal
review_body: Such a beautiful shoe! I got so many compliments when I wore them. I bought them specifically for a wedding, but I already have a couple other dresses/ occasions I can wear them with/ to. They are very high and can kind of be unstable at times, so my feet were sore at the end of the night.

product_title: Baggallini New Yorker Bagg
review_body: After purchasing multiple carryon little bags for travel, I finally settled on this one. It holds all my essentials on the plane. Additionally, it fits into a larger carryon to get through security.

product_title: Kelsi Dagger Brooklyn Women's Linzy Platform Pump
review_body: I read reviews from Endless.com where consumer's had purchased this shoe, and they were all saying to get a half size larger than the usual size because it was very tight. So, my normal size is 5.5 and therefore, I got a size 6 which I was very excited to try them on but unfortunately they are an inch to big where's the end of my heel. They look very pretty and my size is hard and impossible to find now, hopefully Kelsi Dagger will come up with small sizes in time for valentine day, I really want to own one of this red patent shoes.

product_title: Size 8.5 Eddie Van Halen EVH Red/Black/White Combo HIGH Top Sneaker Tennis Shoes EV027
review_body: My husband loved them!  They are sharp looking!  Very pleased!  I would highly recommend these shoes for any Van Halen nut!  :)

product_title: Biviel Women's BV1985 Wedge
review_headline: cute but didn't work for me
review_body: These were comfortable sandals with a perfect size heel.  They fit true to size in the length.  For me, the top strap was a little big--there was a gap between the strap and my foot. It just didn't look right.  My foot is pretty narrow, so they might work out better on someone else.

product_title: Crocs Women's Havana Wedge
review_body: I love this shoes ! so confortable , and nice looking ... the only   think is that Crocs must have think about make a 1/2 number ...   I´m 7 or 7.5

product_title: Special Occasions Diamond White Silk Handbag w/ Rhinestone Buckle Evening Bags
review_body: Bought 5 for my wedding and was disappointed in the quality of the item for the price it was!

product_title: Teva Women's Mush Flip Flop
review_body: I bought these sandals for my daughter.  They are flip flops with a arch.  They are very comfortable.  The dark color hides the dirt.   I would buy these again.

product_title: Merrell Men's Hyperbolic
review_body: One of the bast pair of shoes I've owned.  I do a lot of walking(at least a mile a day) and these shoes are very comfortable.  They work well in the winter as well.  Plus they look good.  Good price for a quality shoe.

product_title: PUMA Men's EL Rey Cross Perf Leather Slip-On Sneaker
review_body: El Rey's are extremely comfortable.    Everyone knows they look fantastic and match almost any outfit, but the padding in the sole really positively surprised me. The fit is very good; your feet won't slip out when you're walking.     Can only recommend you to grab a pair of these!

product_title: Dansko Women's Bree Pump
review_body: These shoes are terrific.  I can't speak enough about them.  I wear these to work 1-3 times a week.  I'm on my feet all day seeing patients but yet they keep my feet/legs pain free.  In full disclosure, I own 4 pairs of Dansko's and wear those at my office year round.  I was suspicious that the more stylish shoes could never stand up to the comfort of the traditional Dansko clogs.  However, these shoes are just as comfortable and way more fashion forward, especially in the summer.  They look great with skirts or capris.

product_title: Chaco Hipthong Sandal (Spring 2010) - Women's
review_body: This is the kind of \\"flip flop\\" that I am happy to wear out in public.  They are comfy and fit well (the 10s are a little big, but I know that the 9s are too small...too bad Chaco doesn't make half sizes).  They also provide real support and look pretty cute, too.

product_title: Pilar Abril Dalia Hobo
review_body: Not only this in not real leather, but also feels kinda cheap. Also, material in the middle is like a stiff brush or something. I shuddered when I touched it. Needless to say, it went back.

product_title: Johnston & Murphy Men's Runnell Chukka Boot
review_body: I love these boots, can you make a pair with steel toes so I can wear them at work?

product_title: Georgia Boot Men's 6" Wedge Work Boot
review_body: I've worn this boot every work day for the past three years. They are the most comfortable boots I've ever had. They have lasted very well and are still going strong. Besides the comfort, I like the fact that the tread is shallow so they don't track mud in my truck or house.

product_title: Teva Women's Dozer Athletic Sandal
review_body: I bought these shoes a month ago and LOVE them.  I use them for long walks and hiking.  Extremely comfortable and an awesome price.  I would highly recommend these shoes.

product_title: Rockport Men's World Tour Casner Hook-And-Loop Walking Shoe
review_body: This was my first purchase of this brand.  Now I am a fan. Ideal walking shoe. Good fit, great comfort.

product_title: Reef Men's Phantom Speed Logo Flip-Flop
review_body: My advise... wear these before purchase as I have found the overall size perfect except that the part of the sandal that goes between the toes is a bit tight and my heel tends to hang over the rear part of sandal because of the part between the toes is set back 1/4 inch to far thus I would require the next size sandal provided it isn't too large like BOZO shoes.

product_title: Columbia Women's Ashlane Low Multi-Sport Shoe
review_headline: Perfect for my physical, outdoor job!!
review_body: I love the way these shoes look, but the best part really is that feel great and they are functional. I have a very physically demanding job, and these keep me moving and comfy all day!

product_title: Shimano SH-M086L Mountain Bike Shoes - Men's
review_body: This is a Great Shoe, as all Shimano Shoes. Good construction, Freshness and durability.    But there's an Issue on this shoe. If you step on Water your foot gets Wet. I'm talking of Water about 1 INCH.    The problem is that the shoe brings a Sticket to avoid Flooding in your foot, but the stiker will eventually fail and the water will flood your foot. I would like to step in a puddle w/out Flooding.    If you are ok with that, this is your Shoe, is Light and Fresh with Strong Construction.    Get a Hug.

product_title: Report Women's Kenly Boot
review_body: I have been searching high and low for a very classy and fierce pair of thigh-high boots and ladies, the search ends here.  I began my search with a pair of BCBG Flashy that I impulsively got from Dillard's but realized that they were waaaay to plain for the $140 that I spent for them so I scoured the internet and found these babies.  Ordered them on Monday and got them yesterday and let me tell you....The are PERFECT!  Great quality (for the price I paid for them and them not being REAL LEATHER), fits great (I am 5'9 1/2 and finding a pair that actually fit mid thigh has been a struggle), and very insulated as well.  They do not slouch or bunch on my legs although I am very skinny and have stick-like legs.    Trust me.  I am very finicky about what I like and what I put on my body and if you're debating back and forth with yourself I say do it!!! They are THE BOMB!!!

product_title: Crocs Women's Havana Wedge
review_body: These are so comfortable and dressy.  I am amzed to find something so great.

product_title: Salomon Men's Snowtrip TS WP Winter Shoe
review_body: The best winter shoes I've ever had. I got to test them this past weekend after we got 2 feet of snow here in CT. My feet stayed warm and dry after walking in the snow for 2 hours.

product_title: Oakley Sideways Sunglasses
review_body: Its a simple and basic sunglasses. The lens are very good. The \\"one size fits all\\" realy fits all.

product_title: Tall Canberra Boots By Cammie - Women's Australian Heritage Classic Tall Boots Faux Sheepskin Shearling Fur Lined
review_body: Ok, so the price was cheap so i expected lower quality however these are extremely cheap boots that run very small and are very stiff to walk in. The bottoms are made of some kind of foam board...    will use these as slippers, maybe. they arent that comfortable. Dont waste your money.    On a positive note, the seller did ship them very quickly. :) the one star is for quality of product not for customer service.

product_title: Fly Flot Women's Sorrento Sandal
review_body: Wearing it is like having a foot SPA! Very pretty design and I received lots of compliments! BEST shoes I have ever had!

product_title: LifeStride Women's Meg Flat
review_body: These shoes are the most comfortable flats I have ever owned, look great (and look far more $$$ than they actually cost), and wear well.  Since buying my original pair, I have purchased 3 more pairs in different colors.  Definitely worth the purchase.

product_title: Pip Squeakers Baby Boys' Denim Squeaky Shoes
review_body: My son loves them, we all do. Finally we found wide shoes to fit my son's feet. We have received a lot of compliments and everybody asks where to buy them. All the models I have bought are very comfortable and very cute, and it is great that you always know where your son is; however, I wouldn't recommend wearing them all day at the daycare (the sound could be annoying). Fast shipping.

product_title: Crocs Women's Malindi Flat
review_body: The shoe is true to size, however where I live is very hot.  although I bought the shoes for the summer time, I found the shoe to be hot.  In fact my feet sweated a lot.  Also because of the hot pavement, I could feel the heat through the bottom of the shoe.  I have put the shoes away until cooler weather.

product_title: Clarks Men's Wave.Tract Lace Up
review_body: This is one of the most comfortable shoe I own. I wear it to the office and around the house. I highly recommend it.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Foundation 9 Running Shoe
review_headline: The one that works for my wife
review_body: The one shoe that works for my wife. No complaints. We both have found that, regardless of the make of running shoe, we buy a half size bigger than our street shoe.

product_title: Pajar Men's Banff Boot
review_body: I have a pair of men's Pajar where the lower rubber is cracking and completely delaminated from the leather upper at the stitching. They are now useless. The boots are about 1 years old and have less than 8 uses on them because I only use them for snow trips.  If you haven't already bought them choose a different boot. I really loved these boots. They were comfortable and did not need a break in. I'm sad to see them go but I'm not about to replace them with the same model .....

product_title: FLY London Men's Hex Boot
review_body: I have thus far 3 pairs of fly london foot wear. the harry loafer, the herlo oxford and now this, the hex boot. i love both fore-mentioned shoes and i was hoping with this boot, to get a more sleek, dress boot that would go well with slacks for my work. they look ok with slacks but much better with jeans or other relaxed clothing. the picture they have makes the boot look a little different than if you order a larger size than say, a 9 or 10. i wear an 11 (44) and its a little tight around the toe and just over all doesnt look how i expected it. i was really hoping for a boot version of the harry loafer. pluss i should have ordered the grey or dark brown instead of the brandy.    ohh well, time for some darker shoe polish. too late to return them now!

product_title: Easy Spirit Women's Romy Walking Shoe
review_headline: Good price for a light weight walking shoe by Easy Spirit
review_body: Good product, lasts long, light weight, this is about the 4th pair I've bought in a few years. I do a  lot of walking up and down hills with my dog.   The package was promptly sent. Thankyou.

product_title: Teva Women's Kayenta Outdoor Sandal
review_body: Great shoes.  Loved the fit and the comfort.  Like wearing an athletic shoe yet it is a  cute sandal.

product_title: El Naturalista Women's Nido N721 Boot
review_body: I bought a pair of these \\"used\\" from the Amazon site, and they were perfect and nicely discounted.  The suede/leather look is striking, and I got a million compliments the first time I wore them.  The uppers were snug at the calf, but really just right, and you can wear them with tights or leggings, but cannot tuck skinny jeans into them.  Sizing was true, and they were immensely easy to walk in from the first wear.  A great brand

product_title: Vince Camuto Women's Wendy Sandal
review_body: Love the color (tan). Super comfortable !!!! True to size and the quality of the leather is excellent. I would recommend it 100% and I am very picky and always look for excellent quality.

product_title: Ros Hommerson Women's Maxine Pump
review_headline: Comfortable Shoes for all day wear
review_body: I just love these shoes.  They are very comfortable to wear all day without foot pain. The height of the heel is just right.

product_title: Chaco Men's Entrada Multisport Shoe,Walnut,9 M
review_body: I really like these shoes. The sole has god traction and the arch support is outstanding. I wear these everywhere including light hiking in the woods and mountains. I would buy these again.

product_title: Dezario Women's Bling Slide
review_body: This shoe fits me perfectly.  I have a narrow foot and the width is just right.  I really like the heel height.

product_title: Dansko Women's Penelope Knee-High Boot
review_body: I have never before spent this much money on a pair of shoes. After wearing out my Dr. Martins after wearing them daily for over two years I decided to find a boot I really liked. This was the very first Dansko product I've purchased.    The moment I slipped these on for the first time I was in love. Great shoes, I can wear them all day and all night long. They fit like a glove. I would recommend them to my friends and family.

product_title: Easy Spirit Women's Romy Sneaker
review_body: Have been wearing sneakers for 60+ years and this is the first pair that was comfortable right out of the box! Wore out one pair/ 2-3 years of wearing and so pleased to find them still available. Roomy toe area, no heel rub. Have arthritis in low back and this sneaker makes long( 4+ mile) walks much less painful. I toss them in washer/cold water and hang to dry........look like new every time.

product_title: Baggallini City Bagg
review_body: I am NOT a big shopper...I find things I like and tend to wear them out rather than drag myself through hordes of irritating people at the mall.  This was a replacement purchase for a 5+ year old purse that was literally on its last threads...the strap was barely holding on when my Baggallini arrived.  I was a little nervous about purchasing a purse online, but I had seen another Baggallini in a local boutique and thought it was cute, so I thought I'd try.  I'm a vegan, so it can be difficult to find cute, non-leather purses that will last a long time without getting the frayed/rubbed-off-color look of vinyl.    So far, I love this purse.  It's just the right amount bigger than my last one, with tons of compartments so the contents of my wallet are now neatly stowed, giving me that much more room in the main \\"bag\\" section to shove random stuff while I'm out and about.  It's even big enough that I can carry a compact fold-in-on-itself shopping bag, which I always used to forget when I'd stop at the store.  But even with all the space, it's not at all bulky - it has a nice slender profile and an adjustable strap that make it easy to carry and appropriate to bring to the office.    The only reason I give 4 instead of 5 stars is that the section that holds credit cards, coins, ID, etc. is under the front flap, which you have to lift up to get to.  This means that unless you keep the front pockets zipped at all times, things (like your cell phone, unless its a slender one that will fit in the under-sized cell pocket) will fall out whenever you reach for your debit card.  I tend to keep the front pockets unzipped for easy access to the things I reach for most, so this is kind of annoying, but for the more careful, it probably wouldn't be an issue.

product_title: Johnston & Murphy Men's Bickel Slip On
review_body: Bought these shoes for an amazing price off Amazon: the cheapest I could find anywhere. The patent leather finish on these shoes is beautiful. They glistened at me straight out of the box. Fit wise, they're a little longer than I expected but nothing too out of the ordinary for a dress shoe (they all seem to be long in the toe these days). Fit elsewhere was fine. The finish on the bottom is smooth and a little slippery, but once again that's dress shoes for you. Once these have worn in (I've done about 4 hours so far and they're slowly getting there) they will be the perfect addition to my dinner suit. I recommend them.

product_title: Merrell Paris
review_body: This pair are wider than I thought, but it's comfortable for walking. One thing is I need tiny pads to patch at the back. (The leather somehow scratches at the back of my ankle.) If I wear socks, there's no problem. Overall, it's good and comfortable.

product_title: Haflinger Women's Fletscher Slip-On Loafer
review_body: My 5-Star rating here is a qualified one. If you want a well-crafted, comfortable slipper that can be used indoors or outdoors, this is a terrific piece of footwear and well worth the high price. My qualification here has to do with arch support. Those with normal arches likely won't have an issue with this slipper. Part of my rationale for buying these, however, were the claims here and elsewhere of arch support. It's practically non-existent. The footbed is removable so those you can insert orthodics, but if folks with arch problems are looking for an out-of-the-box slipper solution, I'm sorry to say that this is not the answer.

product_title: adidas Women's adipearl Sandal
review_body: Odd little sandal. Description did not prepare me for it, but it is comfortable. Picture seems to show some support, but doesn't have it as the sport models do. Nice lazy sandal.

product_title: Donald J Pliner Women's MAUD-46 Boot
review_headline: GORGEOUS-Ladies, don't miss out on this boot!!!
review_body: These boots are absolutely gorgeous and very comfortable to boot (please pardon the pun!).  The leather is rich and supple (smells SO GOOD!). The back laces are for show...they do not alter the fit what-so-ever.  If you are a little heavy set or have athletic calves, these will be tight.  But NO PROBLEM.  Your local shoe shot can stretch them for you, or you can invest in your own boot stretcher (for the shaft) as I did.  Now I don't have to worry about narrow boot shafts...I can stretch them myself.  (Use a mixture of 50/50 alcohol and water with the boot stretcher...it did no damage to the leather of this boot).    In short, ladies...if you can grab these boots in your size, DO IT.  You will NOT be disappointed!  They look great with jeans, skirts, or leggings.  They are my favorite boots, bar none...even though my wardrobe is mostly black (therefore I've always favored black boots).  They are high quality with superb craftsmanship, very comfortable, and just beautiful!  The natural vachetta leather is such a great color and will only get better in time (think Louis Vuitton, ladies).  The more you wear them, the more beautiful and unique they will become.  I have gotten more compliments on these boots than all my other (20 pairs) of boots combined. IT'S A NO BRAINER...BUY THESE BOOTS!!!

product_title: Crocs Women's Marnie Flat
review_body: They are fine, I wear them a lot, I think the style is adorable. They are just a little bigger than other crocs flats I have in this size.

product_title: Skechers USA Women's Highlanders-Glaciers Knee-High Boot
review_body: These boots are really cute, but they are definitely not knee-high as categorized, they are mid-calf. The fur trim only goes down two inches, but the rest of the shaft is a soft velvety material. I was worried about wearing these with regular socks, but the parts of my calf exposed to the boot feel perfectly comfortable with no painful rubbing at all. I won't be wearing these boots with thick socks because they feel pretty tight with regular socks. I typically wear a 9.5 in Skechers, but I probably would have ordered these in a 10 to give more toe room for thick socks. I haven't tried these in the snow yet, but they look very well made and waterproof as stated.

product_title: Speedo Men's Seaside Water Shoe
review_headline: Not very pretty but good enough
review_body: All watershoes are pretty ugly, but these Seaside shoes are better than most.  They're also comfortable enough to wear under water and sturdy enough to walk outside.  Would be nice if they had a white or black options too.

product_title: Cole Haan Village Pocket Tote
review_body: Very nice handbag.  Love the pebble leather.  This was my first Cole Haan handbag and find the quality up there with Coach and other higher end brands.  More of a casual bag.  Large enough to carry just about everything.  Only flaw I saw was I had a hard time finding things at bottom because so deep.

product_title: Clarks Unstructured Women's Un.Aloft Sandal
review_body: This is a very comfortable sandals that I ever own. very light weight with very good cushion. The style may not be so attractive, but  the comfort it delivers worth to purchase.

product_title: ASICS Women's GEL-Enduro 5 Running Shoe
review_body: I am very happy with this purchase. I walk 3 miles a day and this sneaker is perfect. The fits is wonderful, they felt great as soon as i put them on right out of the box. And the price cant be beat.

product_title: New Balance Women's WW1100 True Balance Toning Shoe
review_headline: I tried the others and only liked this one
review_body:
I tried the skechers shape ups and hated them. I tried the MBT and hated them as well. I didn't like the feeling of unsteadiness and like I was about to topple over or throw my back out.
I COULD feel tension in my legs with these other two brands and I don't with the new balance.
I cannot attest to the fact they are doing what they claim, but they are wonderful walking shoes nonetheless.
I had orthotics in my reeboks, but these were comfortable right away, and continues to give amazing support to the heels.
They DO run slender. I got size 9B. I have medium-narrow feet (the kind that your heel never stays down in shoes)and my heel actually doesn't pop up in these shoes! They are snug, so I would consider a wider size unless you have narrow feet like I do.
I wish these were still made in the USA though. Made in China.

product_title: Salomon Speedcross 2 Trail Running Shoe
review_body: Los uso para correr en pavimento son muy cómodos y tienen una excelente amortiguación en el talón, la suela abraza el piso por lo que son muy cómodos para subir por cuestas muy empinadas, son de primera calidad altamente recomendados

product_title: privo Women's Simplicity Sandal
review_body: I have trouble with my short 6W feet. Wide up front, narrow at the heel.  Liked the comfort and cute style so had the back straps shortened by my shoe repairman.  He did a great job at a very reasonable price.

product_title: KEEN Women's Presidio Shoe
review_body: I love these shoes!  This is the second pair I've owned.  No more sore feet, as they are comfortable, durable and look great.  I recommend them to anyone who has suffered with sore feet and needs to be on their feet all day.

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Sudoku Thong Sandal
review_body: I will agree with another review that these one run big. I usually wear 7/7.5 and ordered these ones in 7 and they were feeling more like 7.5. But they look beautiful and I loved the quality! Very recommended!

product_title: Kamik Tickle Boot (Toddler)
review_body: The Kamik Toddler Tickle boots are simply the best. My kids love these boots. They seem to be absolutely comfortable. Well, they haven't complained yet. They never get cold or wet feet. Very cleverly designed! This will be THE winter boot for my kids in years to come.

product_title: adidas Men's Supernova Sequence 2 M Running Shoe
review_body: Awesome my favorite runners ever if bought like six pairs of them .. good hard wear sneakers and look cool also

product_title: Dansko Women's Sissy Sandal
review_body: I bought myself several pairs of these Dansko sandals in different colors. LOVE THEM! I wear them to work AND when I go out for an evening in the city. They're stylish, sturdy and comfortable.

product_title: EMU Australia Women's Stinger Hi Water Resistant Boot
review_body: I absolutely love these, and these wear and look as good (or better) than my daughter's Uggs. They are cute and warm and extremely comfortable.  I got them (size 7 chestnut)  for less than $60 on a post-Christmas sale.     I just wanted to weigh in on the sizing debate: I am a solid size  7 1/2 with wide feet. Sometimes I have to get shoes and boots in a size 8 (which are too long) just so i can squish my broad feet in. (I used to think my feet got that way from going barefoot on the beach my whole childhood, until my 5-pound premature son was born with tiny, almost triangular feet. Native American genetics, I'm told, like his bent pinky fingers.)     I bought a 7, wear them without socks, and I have ample room--almost too much.  The shearling lining on bare feet feels heavenly, and are warm without making me sweaty.     I have a dozen pairs of boots in my closet--these are my favorites.

product_title: Saucony Women's ProGrid Ride 2 Running Shoe
review_body: Great neutral running shoe.  Ride 2 a bit narrower than 1, but still great for wider feet.  Lots of room in the toe box, so minimal blisters/toenail problems you sometimes encounter during training for longer distances.  These shoes got me through some long hard races, and I am sticking with them!

product_title: Capelli New York Shiny Solid Rubber Ladies Rain Boot With Buckle & Pull Loop
review_body: The boots are very comfortable, except for the fact that they are quite heavy. I opened the box as soon as they arrived and I was surprised by a super super strong smell of plastic, or rubber. Of course I was expecting for them to smell like rubber, since they are plastic boots, but this smell was so strong that it was all over my office. I've had the boots for about 3 weeks not and the smell is weaker than when they first arrived but it's still pretty strong.

product_title: Gentle Souls I Shine Mary Jane
review_body: I already have owned this shoe for two years.  Love it - but it was time to get aa replacement pair to replace, and I found this same shoe on sale at Amazon.   This shoe's footbed is flax seed, and so comfortable.  In my workday, I stand and walk  for 10 hours/day.  These shoes have never caused me any discomfort, while most any other shoe does.  It also has a dressy, holiday shine. I purchased the shoe one half size larger than my usual size originally so that my toe bed would have extra space.  On my first pair, this worked great and is working great with my new pair as well.   The strap keeps the shoe snug enough not to rub.  The heel is just  high enough to look good with a dress as well as pants , while still being comfortable.  I do work in retail, and have received lots of compliments on these shoes and inquiries on where they can be found.

product_title: Clarks Women's Lucena Sandal
review_body: These are typical Clarks!  They are cute and comfy from the minute you put them on. Very stylish and guaranteed to produce lots of compliments!  You won't want to take them off!  I bought them for my trip to Greece as I thought they looked very Grecian, but they go with just about everything I choose to wear.  Buy them, you'll love them!

product_title: National Velour Ballerina Slippers
review_body:
These are really cute and I got them to bring with me when I go out and want to switch from heels to more comfy footwear :).
They offer no support and are a little flimsy, but will roll up so I can fit them in a small purse.

product_title: Sebago Women's Saranac Lace Boot
review_body: I love these boots, right out of the box I wore them all day and my feet felt great. This highly unusual because my feet are a little wide and I have a bunion. Most shoes hurt my feet either as I'm wearing them or when I take them off (my feet cramp up... very painful). They look great with leggings, jeans and long skirts. They are waterproof too! I wear an 8 1/2 wide, but I got these in 9 med and they fit like a charm.

product_title: jessica bennett Women's Keeper Pump
review_headline: Very nice shoes, but runs small
review_body: Nice well-made shoes, but runs small as mentioned by another reviewer. Recommend ordering the next size up.

product_title: Capezio Women's 191 Aerial Pointe Shoe
review_body: I bought these pointe shoes for my daughter who is studying to become a professional ballerina.  The pointe shoe manager at her ballet school fit her in these because of the shape of her feet - and especially her short toes.  While she has small, boxy feet, these shoes, with their shorter vamp, make them look long and elegant.  The shoes are well made and last as long as any other pointe shoe on the market.

product_title: Nina Women's Culver Bridal Pump
review_body: I really liked this shoe.  I only returned it because I had bought them for a wedding and they weren't going to work out.  I needed the money to fund the shoes that I still needed to get for the wedding.  Super comfortable and classy looking shoe.  Timeless, really!

product_title: Rocket Dog Women's Sheriff Boot
review_body: love these boots. they are very comfortable. wore them all day and do alot of walking. would recommend them

product_title: PUMA Women's Simplice Slip On Flat
review_body: I guess I didn't read careful enough, because these shoes turned out to be plastic.  I was surprised.  The last ones I purchased were nylon, like athletic shoes.

product_title: Servus xtratuf unisex neoprene rubber boots - Brown (12)
review_body: I was loaned a pair of these for a kayaking trip last weekend and was shocked at how comfortable they were. Even walking over sharp and slimy rocks while portaging the kayaks they were very comfortable and kept my feet warm, despite standing in an Alaskan tidewater basin. I wore them for two days straight and then again for a day of geocaching on muddy trails and they were fabulous. Looking around the town up there you could tell who was local by the fact that all of them had the same brand on.

product_title: Merrell Women's Glade Slide Sandals
review_headline: Great Shock Absorber! Comfortable sole for plantar facia!
review_body:
I am on my feet all day and we have hardwood floors at home. I discovered Merrell sandals a few years ago around the time I developed plantar faciitis, (a painful inflamation of the band of tissue, 'plantar fascia', which runs across the bottom of the foot connecting the heel bone to the toes).

These sandals cushion my feet and are stylish. I have two pairs of the Glade and another similar Merrell sandal as well.

I have wide feet and both styles are a comfortable fit. I like how easy they are to slip on and stay on.

If they get wet when I water the yard I let them dry and apply mink oil paste to renew the leather. They are very durable.

The cushion effect of the Merrell soles have saved my feet and allowed me to continue to be active.

product_title: PUMA Echo Small Backpack
review_body: I bought this backpack for my kindergardner who thinks she is too cool for the standard princess backpacks.  This bag is sleek and stylish and very good quality.  My only complaint would be that it is slightly too small for a school bag because it is a squeeze to get her daily folder into it, although it does just fit.  We get the folder and a lunch bag into it and that's pretty much it.  Still, it is a good size for her because it sits perfectly on her back, whereas a normal sized backpack is just too big for a 5 year old. I am very happy with it.

product_title: Amalfi by Rangoni Women's Mendez T-Strap Sandal
review_body: I adore these shoes, and they've become my go-to red wedge. Comfy enough to wear all day, well-balanced, good soles.

product_title: KangaROOOS Women's Magnolia Lux Sneaker,Iron,11 M
review_body: Fit my feet nicely.  The soles seem a bit hard to me.  Unlike my previous kangaroo shoes that were squishy and like walking on air.  I love the colors and ultimately, they get the job done and I have no issues walking around in them for a long period of time.

product_title: Timberland Men's Earthkeepers 6" Lace-Up Boot
review_body: boots showed up damaged with hot glue on the back.    wrong color also,    terrible.

product_title: jessica bennett Women's Marek Sandal
review_body: I purchased these in bronze for my wife and they are gorgeous and really hot. She is most always a 6.5, which I got them in, and they fit perfectly. She is walking around in them just to torture me while the kids are up but I will make up for it when they go to bed.

product_title: Report Women's Laurent Mule
review_body: I love how they look and the height doesn't feel bad.  I have yet to wear them for a full day so I can't say they are comfy yet but for couple hours they were great and no sign of being uncomfortable.  Look great with Jeans!  Must have for the fall!

product_title: Dr. Martens Original 20 Eye Boot
review_body: It seems to me that Dr Martens are skating by on name brand recognition now. The stitching on these unraveled before my man had worn them for a year. How is that acceptable? The leather is also thin and not sturdy or suitable for heavy wear. I also had a not-inexpensive pair of Docs poop out on me because of poor quality, so I guess we'll have to find other brands for our boot-wearing needs.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Strength Fitness Walking Sneaker
review_body: I got my shape ups about a month ago and I am very happy with them. greattt !!

product_title: Polliwalks Toddler Bass Sandal
review_body: These are the cutest shoes for little ones.  My 19 month old loves them.  He has a couple pairs.  They seem very comfortable for him and I can wash them up every night after a long day of playing outside.  They stay on his feet very well but may not work for a narrow foot.

product_title: Franco Sarto Women's Joey Wedge
review_body: Very pretty and comfortable shoes!  I always wear a size 6 and these fit perfectly.  I receive a lot of compliments on them.

product_title: Timberland PRO Men's Whetstone ESD Oxford
review_headline: Nice work boot -  wish it said it was steel toe
review_body: I looked again and the product description does not say these are steel toe! Are all Timberland PRO shoes steel toe? Otherwise nice, good looking just as in the pictures. A bit on the snug fit side, but I don't really notice the steel toe when they are on. Sorry they need to go back. I do not need the extra weight of the steel toe.

product_title: T.U.K. Women's A7740L Pump
review_body: Please note that the shoe pictured above is NOT the A7740L Pump - google it to see what the shoe actually looks like (it's the first shoe shown that's not a wedge, straight from TUK's website). The shoes shown above are TUK's Kabuki wedges, which Amazon does not carry - which I learned when I received my order and opened the box to find a pair of pumps instead. They were cute, but I wanted the wedges. :(

product_title: GBB Little Kid/Big Kid Jerry Sneaker
review_body: These shoes are way too heavy and leave an orange dye on socks even after over six months.  Will not recommend them.

product_title: Sorel Women's 1964 PAC Boot
review_body: I love my boots. I purchased them this past winter. They are the best boots I've ever bought. They are true to size. They keep your feet warm and dry. I live in Chicago, so it's important to have good winter boots. The only flaw is they are a bit heavy for a long walk.

product_title: pediped Originals Brady Crib Shoe (Infant)
review_body: We love our Pediped sandals, and our son looks adorable in them. We've gotten a lot of compliments on this pair. We just got a pair of Pediped sneaks for the fall. I think they fit true to size, although it's hard to say at this age. But they are definitely good for babies with wide feet. And he is very comfortable in them as far as we can tell!

product_title: Dearfoams Women's DS626 Slipper
review_headline: Soft, Comfy and tough!! a great combination
review_body: These slippers are just great. I bought 3 pairs for me and my family. They are so comfortable and at the same time very durable....The best price for these slippers is only on amazon. Love them. Definitely recommend.

product_title: Dansko Women's Professional Clog, Sage Floral, 36 EU/5.5-6 M US
review_body: I love these shoes! They were absolutely what I wanted, and true quality. I would def. buy from this seller again!

product_title: EMU Australia Women's Alvie Ballet Flat
review_body: I normally wear an 8.5 and got an 8 bc at the time there were no 9s in the chocolate color.  Fits great.  The leather is really high quality- incredibly soft, even the foot bed has wonderful leather.  I'm really happy with the shoes and will be purchasing more EMU shoes in the future.  Only drawback- the sole isn't complete- but I wasn't able to find a loafer similar in style with a normal full sole- seems the shoe making industry thinks we all live in California where it doesn't rain.

product_title: Kipling Fairfax Medium Shoulder Bag
review_headline: Entrega responsable y articulo de excelente calidad. Recomendable.
review_body: Excelente, cuando me comunique con ellos por un problema con mi direccion en miami, lo solucionaron de inmediato. Los recomiendo ampliamente. Muchas gracias. El bolso es bellisimo. De excelente calidad.Excellent, when I contact them for a problem with my address in Miami, it solved immediately. Highly recommend them. Thank you very much. The bag is stunning. Of excellent quality.

product_title: PUMA Men's Game Point Sneaker
review_body:
In less than a month the white bottom started to separate from the top black material.

Not Happy!

product_title: Island Surf Fathom Sandal Womens
review_body: This is my third pair. Same style, same color. The size is exact, they are very lightweight. I live in NC and plan to wear them all Winter. I usually buy Earth Spirit, but they are hard to come by. I am a size 9 1/2, and size 9 fits just perfect. Sandals are on my feet from morning till night.

product_title: Clarks Women's Latin Cha Cha Sandal
review_body: This is a great sandal.  Most comfortable and true to size.  Would love to have them in other colors.

product_title: Clarks Borabora Orange thongs
review_body: This is a nice sandal.  It hugs your feet.  The fabric thong is easy between the toes, the instep/arch gives a lot of support, and the sole is thick enough to ease impact on leisurely walks.  I knocked off a star (don't LOVE them) for two reasons:  1)  The seashell pattern is cute (though you don't see them when you're wearing them!), but the design is such that one of the embossed seashells falls right under a major stress point -- the padded balls on the bottom of your feet.  This is irritating if you walk too far and fast in these shoes.  2)  The color is NOT bright orange as pictured, and is more of a pumpkin hue (see image).  I almost returned the shoes based on that alone, but they feel good on and were a decent price, so I'm hanging on to them.  The pumpkin color will be fine as we ease into fall.

product_title: WORX by Red Wing Shoes Men's 5481 9" Waterproof Steel Toe Logger
review_body: Got these for a friend and he says they're extemely comfortable yet very functional, and that he can't imagine a better pair of boots.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Referee Mary Jane Flat
review_body: These shoes feel so good on.  They fit perfectly and are so comfortable right from the first.  I also get a lot of compliments on them from all ages.  This is my second pair.

product_title: 609-JULIET black/clear-size 8
review_body: Brought this and less than two months later the strap broke. Went to shop repair to get it glue back in but then a week later the clasp broke! Just poorly made. My last shoes (different brand) last me at least whole year. Probably not worth it to get it repair.

product_title: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star Ox Sneakers
review_body: I would wear Converse every day if I could - they are sooooo comfortable! They run big, which is good because it helps offset the fact that they are also a bit on the narrow side. But my wide feet have no problem with them. They come in a great variety of colors and patterns, and I have quite a few of them, both hi-tops and low-tops. I love 'em all... and would buy more if I had the money! Speaking of which, that's the one downside to Converse - the cost. You pay for the name. But you can always watch for a good sale...

product_title: Keen Women's Bali Sandal
review_body: I couldn't believe my sandals arrived so quickly. They are very comfortable and what I wanted (and expected from Keen).

product_title: Liliana Women's Catch Pump
review_headline: Sexy, but not a great fit
review_body: I got these in brown. The are sexy as hell, but I doubt I will be wearing them very often. They seem to be a little shorter than my other heels in the same size so my toes get really squished (frontward, and inward. Beware if you have wide feet.) The curved heel, while it looks awesome, also makes the shoe a bit unstable and difficult to walk in.

product_title: Kamik Women's Willow Rain Boot
review_body: I love these boots. They're bright in color and very comfy. The sole is great in slippery weather. Very good tread. The only problem is they run a bit narrow. I can only wear thin socks, so they aren't very warm for snow.

product_title: Kid Express Toddler/Little Kid Madison T-Strap
review_body: I searched everywhere for navy blue shoes for my little girl and could not find any. I looked online and could not believe the prices! This shoes was perfect. The price was not bad and it was too cute. The only problem I had was although it states that it is a wide, it really wasn't.  The shoe was a bit snug and would have loved it better if it atleast had a faux buckle.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Trini Sandal
review_body: I had an Olive green A-line dress with faint gold finishes that i needed to where for a certain occassion but i had no shoes to match. I found this shoe and I own a lot of Michael Antonio shoes so I know the price range, i found it somewhere else for about $40 (way too much). I googled the name of the shoe and Amazon came up at $22 (OMG) i first of all never ordered anything from Amazon and didn't know they sold shoes. They were the right price, shipping was extremely cheap and I got them the Wednesday before my event! I was so happy with the purchase and the end result, I will be a returning customer with Amazon from here on out!

product_title: JUMP Women's Brash Boot
review_body: I received these boots as a present from my friend! (Great friend!)     The heel is a little higher than it looks, but is comfortable to wear anyway. (Something about how round and cute and chunky the heel looks makes it appear shorter than the 3-inch height, but that doesn't matter to me, because I wear tall shoes all the time.) When I put these boots on, they make my ankles look sooo tiny and slender and delicate, especially when worn with tights. These boots are seriously made to be worn with tights of the same or similar color, because I swear I've never seen my legs look skinnier. The boot comes up right to my ankle and do not look clunky at all. They give a great silhouette from the side, and I thought that the elastic strap would make it look too sporty, but it turns out I don't notice them at all. So this boot looks really dressy with my dresses and they look equally cool and laidback when I pull my skinny jeans down over them (Seriously, insanely cool silhouette under skinny jeans).     I own several JUMP boots, and I would rate this type of heel as second in comfort. The wedges are the most comfortable and I wear them while running errands all day in the city. These heels somehow are a little less easy to wear. My feet don't hurt at the end of the day, but my calves are tired after running around the office for 8 hours. But they make my legs look so good, I just cannot resist wearing them as much as possible. LOL. I do put some gel pads into the shoes to help cushion me during the day, which helps.     Like all JUMP boots, order half a size up if you want to wear thick socks in winter weather. I own these boots in dark brown, but they are so very dark that I actually wear them with black skinny jeans and you really cannot tell that they're not black. I'm not a person who gushes like this often, but I love, love, love these shoes and how they make me feel.

review_body: I really enjoy these wedges. The foot bed is comfy, they are lightweight (not clunky and heavy), and durable and grip the floor (not slippery). They offer a support that I can't seem to find in most wedges. Finally, a pair of shoes that won't make me twist my ankle. Excellent craftsmanship and quality.

There is a tag attached to the sandals when new: Do not wear in shower. Consequently, I guess I will be buying them more often because I need to wear them in the shower. Other than that, these are, as I said previously, the most comfortable sandals I've ever worn. The dealer is very friendly and communicative. Will definitely buy from them again. I have also found out that Amazon is really a great place to do business with; the only trouble being that they sell so much \\"stuff\\" that it gets expensive just looking around.  Five stars all around.

product_title: ASICS Men's GEL-Nimbus 12 Running Shoe
review_body: I bought these as they were well rated on various running websites ... I wasn't disappointed. I underpronate, and so I chose these cushioned shoes for running.    I'm don't consider myself a \\"runner\\" as such but I do try to run a few kilometers a few times per week. I've tried a number of different types and brands of shoes over the years and I've ended up loving the various offerings from ASICS.    This particular pair are light-weight and extremely comfortable - especially when paired with a decent pair of socks (I like cushioned socks from Darn Tough).    I run in a hot climate and my feet stay cool and dry.    It pays to identify your running dynamics because since switching to cushioned shoes (as opposed to stabilsed/motion control shoes) I've had less trouble with knee pain or shin splints etc. I've experienced no knee problems with these - even with runs on 2-3 consecutive days. <-- This was previously a recipe for a week of limping for me. Additionally, I've found that my feet don't hurt and I'm able to run longer distances so all-in-all, I'm thoroughly pleased and I'd recommend these to anyone looking for an excellent pair of running shoes.

review_body: I've had these shoes for about 8 months now. Got them cheap ($90) at an outlet store. They've held up well. I'm very impressed with the lacing system. Another plus is that they look cool, so I have not qualms about wearing them when I'm not running. I'm not giving them 5 stars simply because they haven't rocked my world. I try not to rate shoes as excellent unless I'm raving to everyone I know about how the shoes have changed my life. Overall I'm quite happy.

It matches the fittings on my purse perfectly so it looks like it belongs on it. Incredible. The finish is very high quality, in keeping with my purse. I take it everywhere and use it all the time. Very easy to use, very simple and very smart. I like it so much that I just bought a second one to go with another purse I just bought. Overall, a very nice item that gets tons of use.

product_title: OTBT Women's Yountville Wedge Boot
review_body: I ordered the Yountville wedge boot in 2 colors and 2 sizes on Amazon's sister site, Endless. (I wanted to cover all of my bases!) I've been wanting a comfy wedge boot for a long time and this does the trick.  I found them to run 1/2 size big. I'm an 8 or an 8.5 in everything and even with thick wool socks, the 8.5 was too big, so if you're between sizes like me, order down 1/2 size. The suede is very soft and a nice quality, which surprised me given the low price. The insole was super padded and comfy and the height of the wedge okay given the comfort it provided on my test-run. Yes, there is quite a bit of room at the top of the shaft, but those with bigger calves will need that to get them on. I didn't feel it was so wide that I looked like I was wading in them and I have narrow-medium-size calves. The only other place that I feel people might hesitate is that the leather pooches out a tiny bit near the bottom of the zip, but not so much that it made the foot look wide, but you might not like that slightly loose feeling just above the top of your foot. As the other tester said, it is a navy blue and that's fine with me. OTBT also included a nice boot bag for storage or travel. Great quality on this boot and I'm looking forward to wearing these a lot over the years.

product_title: Nike Mens First String Slide Sandals
review_headline: They hurt my flat feet at first, but now I love 'em
review_body:
These slides are very stylish, made of quality lightweight materials, and contours to the shape of your feet. Unless of course you're like me and have flat feet. The arches stick me in the ball of my feet all day and feel quite uncomfortable after just a few minutes of wear. I would probably die if I had to wear these at the beach all day. Every other slide or flip flop I've tried was flat. Why couldn't they just leave well enough alone and make them flat like they're supposed to be? Since they are so light, and hug your feet so well, I guess they would be nice for all you normal people out there, but if you have flat feet like me, STAY AWAY!!!! Your feet will thank you.

*********** 2 Year Update**********

I kept wearing them, and my flat feet eventually flattened out the shoe. Now they're quite comfortable, and they're still holding up after 2 years with no cracks, so I upgraded my rating from 2 to 3 stars.

*********** 5 Year Update**********
These have now become my favorite flip flops. Well actually, they're my only flip flops. I've worn them every summer in the house, and when I've gone to the beach and water parks (around 3 to 5 times during the summer) for the past 5 years, and they're still holding up. I'll probably get another pair if these ever die. I guess that means I'll be upgrading my rating from 3 stars to 4.

review_body: Pros:   I love these sneakers. The most obvious difference I noticed straight away was the effect they have on my posture. I believe wearing them all day would be the greatest benefit, or wearing them regularly while walking your dog etc.  I noticed they have them in all black and different styles which would be a great idea to wear to work if you are on your feet all day. They really feel like walking on pillows, so comfort wise, for lengthy periods of time or for people with feet problems (swelling feet, aching feet etc), I think they would be very beneficial.  You must take into account that this style does have quite a thick sole and heel, so it will give you a bit of extra height, which I liked. But if you dont like the thick sole look, you would be better to chose one of the other styles than \\"fitness junkie\\".  Cons:  I only have one con for these sneakers. I chose the size based on the amazon size chart, using the centimetres measurement. They have turned out to be a bit big. It would have been better to get half a size down or even a full size down. So I believe these sneakers, or perhaps Sketchers in general, are a big make.   Besides that I am very impressed with these sneakers, I love wearing them, am very glad I finally bought them, and I am even thinking about buying more styles!! :D

review_body:
These slippers are fantastic. I wear them pretty much constantly and they're proving to be extremely durable. I wear them around the house, to the beach early in the morning, and even out in some social situations. Most people never even notice that i'm wearing slippers. I've even done some light jogging in them when i take my dog for walks on cold, late nights and he wants to run.

The most important thing to consider when buying slippers is to ensure the inside of the shoe is made with real wool. Any sort of synthetic liner will not breath and will cause your feet to sweat immediately. Also, synthetic materials will start to smell very bad very quickly.

These Bearpaws do use real wool and as a result are very warm but they breath very well so your feet don't overheat and sweat. And wool also has natural antimicrobial properties so they resist any sort of stink. When you compare these slippers to other well-known name-brands that use genuine wool you'll realize the incredible value.

Comfortable? Yes. Warm? Yes. Durable? Yes. Exceptionally reasonable price? Yes.

What more it there to say? Buy them.

product_title: Etienne Aigner Hyde Park Large Satchel
review_headline: Professional, but missing the luxury touches
review_body: I got this in black, and it has antique brass colored hardware.  The bag is designed like a doctor's bag, but the opening/top is a bit stiff and smaller than I expected.  The opening/top will NOT open as wide as the dimension of the bottom of the bag.  This means that putting files in through the opening is difficult, even though there is plenty of width at the bottom.  I had hoped to throw case files/folders into the bag as I come to and from the office, but they are hard to put in--the bag is not quite tall enough and the opening too small.  The leather is smooth and lower grade/higher durability--not lambskin--so a little rain won't be any problem.  The bag is structured and stands by itself when set down.  There are no metal \\"feet\\" on the bottom of the bag to protect it.  When placed under the arm, the width of the bottom of the bag--remember, it is a bit stiff and structured--makes it difficult to close your arm over it, and if you have a coat on, it's pretty bulky.  It's much better as a handled tote carried by hand.  It is easy to flip the latch closed over the top of the bag without zipping up the zipper, which is what I do all the time to run about town and still have quick access to the contents.  The zipper ends on the top opening are not attached to the inside of the bag, so they can pull out as you are trying to zip it.  Since I rarely close the top zipper, this isn't too annoying, but it would be if I was repeatedly opening/closing the zipper.  The outside pocket, which is also zippered, is useful and good sized, and I usually throw my BB and keys there for quickest retrieval.  The lining of the bag is Etienne Aigner print fabric, dark reddish color in the black bag, with four open pockets.  There are no security or zippered pockets or key rings on the inside of the bag.  The bag does not come with a protective dust-cover.  In all, a fashion-forward and elegant bag, but without some of the extra touches that could have made it a 10-year tote for the professional woman.
