review_body:
In reference to the title, wearing these boots make me feel like Spongebob Squarepants in the \\"Squeaky Boots\\" episode. I love these boots that much and have been wearing them for days!!

I did not buy these boots on amazon, I bought the same pair at an outlet store for $60 (which I realize I paid too much for).

I was originally looking for boots because I have poor circulation and always have cold feet. I almost bought a pair of Uggs twice, but the price tag of $130-$140 always stopped me. I'm so glad I bought these instead!

First of all, they are made of leather, which is naturally waterproof, on the outside. I have not had the chance to check on that yet. But there is waterproof spray that you can buy in certain shoe stores that will help the shoes maintain the waterproofness over time.

Second of all, they are really warm! Very furry on the inside, and good grip on the sole. Also, if you're a half size, buy the boots in the lower size. I'm an 8.5 and the 8s fit me perfectly.

They basically are everything that all the girls love about Uggs. Same quality, but cheaper price.

product_title: Bogs Women's Classic High No Handles Winter Snow Boot
review_body: Very happy with my Bogs. My feet stay warm and dry. I ordered a size up,wished I didn't. They are a little big. Other than that, no regrets-love them! I live in Minnesota, my toes have not been cold once since I got these!

product_title: Birki's Men's / Women's Super-Birki Clogs
review_body: I'm a nurse and was after these shoes for a long time until I got them!! the only bad thing is that since the insole are made of corck i had to buy a heel support insole to have a bit more cushion other than that I'm a happy camper!!!!!!!!!

product_title: Arche Women's Foggo Mid Calf Boot
review_body: I first tried these boots on in New Zealand, but thought they were too expensive, even though I really liked them.  Came home to Australia, hopped on to the internet, and lo and behold !  Amazon had them at a bargain price.  Now I have my beautiful and comfortable boots.

product_title: Capezio Toddler/Little Kid Jr.Tyette N625C Tap Shoe
review_body: These are exactly how they look in the picture.  Very cute and seem comfortable for my daughter.  They do run a little small.

product_title: John Fluevog Women's Pearl Hart Dress Pump
review_body:
The best heels I've ever owned! I liked them so much that I got a second pair! One black and one lavender.

The lavender one I couldn't wear for the whole day, but I can with the 3rd wear. However, even with the 1st wear, I was able to wear them for almost the whole day. Not only they look fabulous, but they are SO comfortable. I have people asking me where I got them or what brand it is. One of them was a person who's into the 1920s.

I'm into the whole retro look, and these look so much like these 1920s shoes I've seen before (minus the extra details). I also hate many shoes made these days with the low cut vamp and are tacky looking, so that's why I choose Fluevogs!

I normally wear a 6M or 6.5M, and the 6.5 fits me just fine.

If I have money, I'll get more of these, and I hope they will never stop making these!

product_title: Lafuma Men's Aravis OT Hiking Boot,Black,10 M US
review_body: I'm ordered a 10.5 hopin' they'd be close, but they're easily 2 sizes too big. It's easy to return, but nonetheless, buyer beware, their sizing isn't even close to accurate.

product_title: NCAA Michigan State Spartans Ladies Pink-Black Team Logo Fashion Sunglasses
review_body: So I got these for my girlfriend that for one loves anything pink, and is a MSU fan so I figured these would be perfect for her, but questioned if they were going to look cheep.  Not that case at all!  They are very sexy and have a small silver strip on the side that you can't really see in this picture but it adds a nice little touch to the sunglasses.  I don't know much about how durable they are but they look to be very sturdy so I assume long term they will hod up well.  I highly recommend these sunglasses!

product_title: BEARPAW Women's Boetis Boot
review_body: Bought these for my daughter for Christmas, in the white, but gave them to her early so she could wear them longer. She LOVES them, and they are the topic of a lot of conversations and looks when she wears them! If you are looking for a fluffy boot you won't be sorry they are very well made, and look far more expensive than the price they are selling for on Amazon. We found them to run true to size, however she does not wear thick socks with them because they are so warm!

product_title: Clarks Men's Escalade Slip-On
review_body: I bought these for my partner for xmas & he loves them, says they feel like walking on clouds.  They look very nice too, I'm so glad he has some decent dress shoes.

product_title: Crocs Men's Bahari Slip-On
review_body: After 15+ years behind a desk I recently made a huge career change to the food industry.  One of the roughest parts of the transition (aside from the huge drop in income, loss of a reliable 9-5, M-F schedule....etc.) is my aching feet.  Already being a Crocs fan I was excited to do a little research and find these shoes.  I've been wearing them for a few weeks now and my feet are in love - soft, cushiony, Crocs love.  Easy on and off, they aren't the most stylish but definitely comparable to other restaurant shoes and the Crocs footbed is heavenly.  Keeps my feet cushioned during 11+ hour days on a food truck and the non-slip sole makes walking around the kitchen much less of an extreme sport.  As long as they hold up for awhile they are well worth the price tag.

product_title: Madden Girl Women's Kalindaa Platform Pump
review_body: I was a little skeptical about buying these since I was worried they would either look cheap or be really uncomfortable. I am so glad I went for it though! They are really sexy shoes and will be great for work in the fall/winter! They are also surprisingly comfortable! And you can't beat the price! Would definitely recommend them if you are looking for a cute winter pump!

product_title: Rocket Dog Women's Satire Ankle Boot
review_body: After reading several reviews i decided to purchase the Rocket Dog boot's.I am very happy with them, very comfortable and easy to put on and off for a pull on boot.Also bought 1/2 size larger to wear thicker socks with them and they fit very well. nice boot for the money.

product_title: Allen Edmonds Men's McClain Oxford
review_body: I've been a big fan of AE for 23 years, since I bought my first pair to wear for my wedding.  I still have those shoes, and have bought a number of other AE styles over the years.  But the McClain is the most comfortable of them all; they feel like they were custom made for my feet.  It's all about the last, and I have found the one that works perfectly for my feet.  I actually bought a second pair of these, and I'm planning to have them dyed black, because they weren't available in black.  No, they're not cheap, but they are built to last (no pun intended) and can be rebuilt by AE when they need some attention.  In the long run, more economical than buying a lot of cheap shoes.  And... they're still made in the USA, unlike some other \\"American\\" brands I have bought in the past.

product_title: Diesel Women's On String Flat
review_body: These shoes are stylish and comfortable.  They didn't need any \\"break-in\\" time and I never got any blisters, etc.  I love how the soles are like tennis shoes - no slipping like in regular flats.  I would definitely purchase again... and did, in the pink color.

product_title: Kenneth Cole Reaction Toddler/Little Kid Back Tuck Hook-and-Loop Shoe
review_body: my son loves these shoes! he's really into skeletons and other scary things at this age. they seem very comfortable and easy to put on.  I'm very happy with the purchase!

product_title: Nine West Women's Escher Pump
review_body: I really like these, they feel sturdy and by the end of the day, I am not aching to get them off. They aren't too high and not too low. I also have them in black. The only think I don't really care for is the peep is a little wide, showing 3 toes, not two which is odd to me. But I still like the shoe overall.

product_title: Not Rated Women's Ooh La La Pump
review_body: Cute pair of shoes. Well made. I wore them all night and still had feeling in my feet. :)

product_title: FRYE Women's Alessia Trapunto Thong Sandal
review_body: I just got these in black; the black turns out to be more of a very dark gray/graphite metallic color; I was expecting a pure black, but I like this even better - if you're expecting a real black you may be disappointed. Fit is about normal to maybe very slightly small; I ordered my regular size; I could've gone up a size but these are fine.    I'm not sure of the way these are going to wear. With just the toe post up front and the straps coming down on the side for stability, my foot initially started wobbling all over - heel sliding sideways and toes also - sort of like the sandal is rotating around the side straps. With just a short time wearing, my feet started sticking to the footbed a bit more, but these are never going to be strong in the stability department like a Teva, for instance. Anyway, really cute and comfortable and glad I got them, but won't be a good choice for a walking sandal.    UPDATE: wore the black [graphite] sandals for a few days. Liked them more and more - I updated from 4->5 stars. Then I sent for the brown ones. Love them, have been wearing at work. Sent for the natural ones after that, and they're the cutest of the lot. The yellow ones just arrived, and I'll probably get any other colors they still have in my size! Only problem I expect to have is choosing which pair to wear.... They are so cute in a barely-there style. I also found that snugging the straps a little tighter than I normally would on a sandal helped out with the stability. Oh, and the leather on these is SOOOOOOO soft. It's really tempting to just rub these on my cheek instead of strapping them on :-). Fortunately, with 4 pairs now, I don't have to choose!!!

product_title: Tretorn Men's Strala Boot
review_headline: low quality materials make this shoe deteriorate quickly
review_body:
These shoes will fall apart after only one season. The rubber from which they are constructed cannot handle the normal, daily use. When walking in these shoes, then natural walking motion bends the rubber and the bending of the rubber eventually cracks the shoes open. At which point, rain, snow and all the other elements can enter freely.

Buyer beware: If you want a pair of boots that will protect your feet from the elements for longer than one season, avoid these boots (and likely all Tretorn products).

product_title: Omnisax Bloom Bag 1 Shoulder Bag
review_body: i love it, this was made as a shopping bag, reusable, but i wear it every day as a handbag , they are light waigth and colorfulls, great!

product_title: T.U.K Women's A7855L Oxford
review_body: After looking at a bunch of other brands, I settled on this shoe due to the cost and the - well, cuteness factor.  I was not disappointed!  These shoes are soooo comfortable.  And after wearing them for over a week, I finally noticed they have a little cat head on the outside of each shoe - cuteness factor DEFINED!  Fast shipping, a great seller, and a great product. product_title: Romano Martegani Men's Siena Oxford,Black,11 M US

For an Italian made shoe, it has an understated elegance, typically reserved for British made or designed shoes.  I typically find Italian shoes a little more fashion forward.  Not so with these. I bought these as a gift and I am told they were tremendously comfortable right out of the box, and they seem fairly well made.  What more can you ask for from a pair of shoes/

product_title: Teva Infant Logan Bootie
review_body: Just got them for my 5 month old (in the 6-12 month size) they are amazing. totally adjustable so they fit him perfect and can grow with them! i will be buying these for baby shower presents! love love love them!

product_title: Bed Stu Men's Maneuver Boot
review_body: these boots are perfect.  they're a great height, lightweight, comfortable, and can be dressed up or down.  i was looking at combat boots, Doc Martens, ..the usual, but when i came across these, i found what i was looking for.  i appreciate the hand-craftsmanship; they break in incredibly well.  they are the first pair of boots i've bought that were actually made to be worn right out of the box.  they are cute, while still being badass.  i recommend these to anyone (man or woman) who wants a comfortable boot and may want to look like a stylish hobo.  thanks, BED!  keep up the good work!

product_title: Coloriffics Women's Deena Metallic Sandal
review_body: Overall, the quality of this shoe seemed alright, but nothing special. The stitching looked strong, and everything seemed to be attached well. However, the sizing is completely off! I bought what was supposed to be a 9.5 W and they were not only too narrow, they were also too short! They made my feet look freakishly large as my toes hung over the top of the shoe and my heel hung over the back. The straps on the front part have absolutely no give, so wearing them around the house to break them in didn't help at all. I arranged the skinny front straps around my feet once I got the shoes on, but it just made them look like they were squished in there. The fact that they were too narrow convinced me to just look for a different shoe, rather than going up a size and trying this one again. I'm supposed to have open-toed silver shoes to wear in a wedding and I had to send these back! I'll have to keep looking.

review_body: Probably one of the best pair of sunglasses I have ever owned !!! Nothing else needs to be said.

review_body: They are so cute but that is it.  If you are just going to stand there it would be fine but I can't even take a step in the cheaply made shoes.  Nice idea just get a real shoe maker to make it.

product_title: Dickies Men's Copper Kettle Work Boot
review_body: The right boot had a fold in the inner liner of the leather upper, digging in to a toe. There is also a defect of the finish on the leather right at the tip of the toe. I am returning the boots. Quality control should be better for such  obvious flaws. Made in China.

product_title: Tifosi Czar T-F390 Sunglasses
review_body: I had been wearing Rudy Project sunglasses for the past 6 years. I was forced to purchase a new pair of sunglasses due to the fact that I left mine on the roof of my car and drove off!  Lost for good!  I was dreading having to spend another 150 dollars on a pair of sunglasses.  I really loved my Rudy Projects, but just didn't feel like spending that much money this time around.  So i searched for an alternative.  I found these Tifosi's.  They are fabulous!  The look almost identical to my Rudy's, at 1/3 the cost!  And, they are by NO MEANS cheap sunglasses.  Very well made, very clear and undistorted vision!  You really can get premium sunglasses performance at a very reasonable price.  The Rudy's served me well, but as long as I can buy Tifosi's for 1/3 the price, I will not be going back.    Also, I have a very small face, and it is a challenge to find glasses that look good on my face.  Most are too large.  These glasses fit very nicely on small faces!  That is something that is extremely hard to determine on many websites when you are searching for sunglasses online.  If you like this color and style, they WILL fit your small face nicely.

product_title: Dollhouse Women's Kim Ankle Boot
review_body: I wanted a purple bootie for so long! I didn't want an ultra-bright color or an open toe and these fit the bill exactly. The color is an absolutely gorgeous shade of purple, slightly subdued, but still vibrant and rich. The suede looks and feels real, not \\"cheap\\" like other synthetic suede. The side zipper makes them a breeze to put on. The heel is pretty high but the shoe is well balanced and surprisingly comfortable for the height. I found them to be pretty TTS. My favorite part is the adorable ruffle on the front that adds a little touch of femininity. A perfect contrast to the otherwise clean lines of this bootie. Soooo happy with this purchase. Great shoe at a great price!

product_title: KEEN Women's Bern Baby Bern Tall Shaft Boots
review_body: My calf at its widest is 16 1/2 and that is 13 inch from the floor. I am 5\\"7 So keep that in mind...that the widest points of a persons calf can very per height and location on the leg. There was a tiny bit of tuggin to get them zippered. But not ALLOT! They stretched out and became more comfortable within a couple of min. I had enough room to tuck in my skinny jeans. I LOVE THESE!! The arch support is perfect for me! Like most Keens order a 1/2 size up. I wear a 9 and got a 9 1/2 fits perfectly. And because of the room at the toes I can wear thick socks. I got the black pair. The leather is a tiny bit distressed but not like trashy distressed. It has a sheen to it so it can be worn with jeans, tights, skirts, dresses. The buckles are a lovely touch. My heal does kinda slide a bit in there...but not enough to complain. There is a bit of bunching around the ankle...but again nothing to really complain about. It doesn't ruin the look to me at all. I plan on using these for a LOOOOOOONG time! I love me some Keens! If you would like to see photos of my boots...I have them on the Keens website. :)GET THESE!! I want them in brown too! But I have to wait a bit for the prices to go down.

review_body: As soon as I got them I didn't want to take them off, even in the house. Normally I dislike high heel or any heels, but these were as comfortable as flats. Best I have ever had and very warm.

UPDATE: Buy a size larger than your typical shoe size, i.e, if your shoe-size is 12 US, pick up 13 US (you get the point!).

product_title: Muck Boots Daily Shoe- Lilac - DLY-560
review_body:
This is my second pair. My original ones would have lasted abit longer; however, my golden puppy decided to gnaw on one. Revised Sept. 19, 2013

product_title: Pour La Victoire Women's Rona Mid-Calf Boot
review_body: I wanted boots with a \\"lower\\" heel, and these are perfect.  I bought them in black, which has a slight gray hue...beautiful.  I like that the shaft in fuller on my legs than my other boots and only reaches mid-calf, because I was looking for something different from what I already own.  They are true to size. The leather is high quality, and the heel is made of wood, not rubber, so I will be wearing these for a long time.  I have no problem with the sole causing me to slide excessively; I even tested them out on a slippery, ceramic tile floor.  I have narrow heels, so in some brands, this one included, my feet slip when I walk.  So I put heel pads in them and wear thick socks.  I bought them during Amazon's Cyber Monday sale for a great price.  I highly recommend these, especially paired with skinny jeans.

review_body:
Love these slippers because they're warm and easy to slip on. The down side is
they're a bit loose around the ankles. I normally wear a size 9 1/2.

The bottoms are pretty stiff so my foot kept falling out when i walked.
Had to return the 10 and get a 9. It fits wonderfully with or without socks.
These slippers stand up to walks to the garbage can outside. I even wore
them driving once, pretending they were Uggs. The price is much less than most
slippers of this quality.

UPDATE: July 11, 2011
I still love these slippers but now know another reason to buy a size down
instead of up. The warm fluffy lining gets squashed down in time and therefore the
slippers get looser on your feet.

The glasses are very light weight and as I look out of them it appears as though the shades are light, but when I look at myself in the mirror it's difficult to see my eyes through the lenses as they appear to be darker. Air flows through them nicely so I've yet to have them steam up on me. I own several pairs of different quality sunglasses & these are my new favorites. Since finding these I have looked at other styles of Tommy Bahama sunglasses & found there are many others I like also. When the time comes for a new pair of quality glasses I'll definately search this brand again. Highly recommended!

product_title: Dansko Women's Sunny Sandal
review_body: I do a lot of walking and standing at my job, have arches on the high side and developed plantar fasciitis.  There were days when I would come home practically in tears because of the pain.  My doctor said I needed to switch to tennis shoes.  Well, I'm no fashionista but wearing tennis shoes to the office wasn't going to happen.  Somebody suggested I try Dansko and was I glad I did.  These scandals were one of my first two purchases.  I wear a size 8 so I purchased a size 39.  They fit like a glove.  From the first day I could wear them for 8 to 10 hours at work without experiencing any foot pain.  I ordered the chestnut and found it true to color.  My work environment is on the casual side so I wear them with navy or brown slacks or with jeans on the weekends.  Despite not having a back strap, I experience no slippage when I walk.  I would recommend Sunny to anybody with high arches, with plantar fasciitis, or just looking for a comfortable casual sandal.

product_title: Reef Men's Tobago Flip Flop
review_body: I really like them. Fit well. Came fast. I use them as shower shoes for the dorms.

product_title: ASICS GEL-Hyper Speed 4 Running Shoe
review_body: I have become a \\"Minimalist\\" when it comes to running shoes.  Even before reading \\"Born to Run\\" (by Doug McDougall) I've been running exclusively in racing flats.  After reading the book, I had to try out the Vibram five-fingers, but they just didn't work for me (I have a crooked little toe from an old poorly-healed fracture, and the five-fingers wanted to force this a direction it didn't want to go). I still wanted a lightweight shoe; roomy enough to leave my toe alone.  For me, this has narrowed down to the Asics Hyperspeed 4.    Advantages: Extremely lightweight.  Thin sole.  Low cost (usually less than $70.  A huge relief over the $130 shoes I used to buy).  Even the design and trim look leaner and less cluttered than its predecessor, the Hyperspeed 3.    Disadvantages:  Perhaps no surprise, but they wear out quickly.  Having said this, I can usually eke out 250 miles or more per pair.  But when they wear out, they really disintigrate in a hurry.  Another problem is that the \\"holes\\" in the uniquely designed sole (which helps them to be lightweight) seem to suck up tiny little pebbles.  So far, my only solution to this is to select my running routes carefully.    I have run two half-marathons withe these, with no problems.  And this includes all my training as well.

product_title: Sporto Kristen Waterproof Winter Boot Womens
review_body: Great boots! I ordered online 'cause its hard to find warm waterproof boots in Texas.  Comfortable, true to size with roomy toebox, should be able to easily fit thick socks in these.  Label on boot says that they are waterproof. Rubber heal looks to be about an inch to an inch and a half high.  The ties in the front mean that you can easily adjust to fit your calves/jeans.  Love them!

product_title: Vasque Women's Breeze LT GTX Light Hiking Shoe
review_headline: hard and short in the toe
review_body: I read reviews all over the internet to try to find a lightweight but rugged boot. I love my Scarpa boots, but they weigh a ton. This Vasque Breeze LT GTX appeared high on all the lists, so I bought it in a size 10; at the same time I bought a pair of New Balance boots in size 9.5. Both were significantly discounted, so I wasn't going to lose much if I was not happy. I've worn both a few times now...  The Vasque are hard on the inside, not well padded on the bottom and sides, and the toe box is too short. They are light in weight, though. The New Balance hiking boots in the smaller size are longer in the toe and more comfortable on the bottom and sides. They are also lighweight. So I give the Vasques 3* only. [New Balance get 5*]

product_title: Jessica Simpson Women's Parigi Pump
review_body: These shoes are great for photoshoots-very sexy pump! But, even sitting in them for more than two hours is uncomfortable-let alone walking. I LOVE Jessica Simpson shoes and own many pairs but I would not recommend these shoes to anyone for anything other than a shoot.

product_title: Teva Men's Dozer Sandal
review_body: I got these for my honeymoon in Hawaii.  I went horseback riding, snorkeling, kayaking, deep sea fishing, hiking, zip lining. review_body: This shoe does everything pretty darn well, except maybe a 50 yd dash. I'm not much of a heel-hooker, so I can't comment on that. I like the support of a high top, and this one is built like a HumVee. It is very comfortable in the toe area due to a slightly wider front than I'm used to.  One con: I ordered my street shoe size as recommended by the Acopa website and was unable to get my feet in the shoe. I could fit the JB inside my old climbing shoes, not that it would do me any good. Sizing UP 1 1/2 (that's One & a half) sizes gave me a perfect fit.

product_title: Laredo Kadi Boot
review_body: I've been looking for a pair of black cowboy boots for a long time.  I've been hunting online and in stores for the perfect \\"look\\" - something that is a hybrid of what a real cowboy boot looks like but also something sleek and stylish.  I found something close to what I was looking for at ALDO, and I tried them on.  But at the time, I couldn't justify spending almost $200 on a pair of boots that would only be part of my weekend wear... so I continued my hunt.  After seeing a few good reviews on this boot and viewing the photos provided here on amazon, I purchased the boot and it was shipped promptly.    When I opened the box, however, I was a little disappointed.  They weren't exactly what I was looking for.  The fit was okay, but they were a bit clunky (and I know cowboy boots can be as I've tried on a lot of cowboy boots this year) which is something I could have dealt with.  But what I didn't like at all was that the white stitching pattern on the trunk of the boot really really stood out.  I love the look of stitching on cowboy boots, but I think the blend of the white stitching on these black boots were just off-putting to me.  If it's possible, to me, it made the boots look \\"fake\\" and cheap (which they were so I shouldn't complain).  And so I returned them and got a refund (which was easy and pain-free).    Since cowboy boots don't really go out of style, I think I'll wait and invest in a really nice pair.

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Caryssa Platform Pump
review_body: Words cannot express how much I love these shoes! I'm pretty sure they're the hottest thing I own, and instantly kick up any outfit I pair them with (I got the black suede for versatility). Other people have called them \\"comfortable\\"...now I don't know if I'd go QUITE that far, but they certainly didn't hurt my feet at all after a night on the town, which was extremely surprising. So not painful, but also not Ugg-boot comfortable. I've never owned a pair of heels that didn't hurt after about 10 minutes, let alone after an entire evening in them. I think this is partially due to the curved sole beneath the toe...it really allows you to roll along so obviously the toes aren't being bent upwards with every step. I'm sure that takes a huge amount of stress off my feet! The platform on the front also makes them feel like they're a little lower than 5.25 inches. They feel more like my 3 inch heels, but considering I'm already 5'9\\" without 'em, I still get the benefit of being an Amazon woman (pun intended) without tripping and dying constantly. I would love to own these in blue, red, or yellow, but I can't find any of those colours in my size. I would highly recommend these shoes to anyone, they are hot, hot, HOT!

review_body: I've been wearing Dansko for many years, at least 12 yrs maybe more. I wear the clogs in the winter, and the sandals in the summer. product_title: Urban Explorer Canvas Shoulder Bag
review_body: It's not very stylish, but this bag is the most practical, useful and durable carry-all I've got, and the price is amazing. I can't put makeup, cell phone, Moleskine, and other necessary stuff in the small bag, so I stash it all in my Urban Explorer; it has a lot of pockets, an interior zippered section, and enough unstructured space that I can have it hold my passport cross-body.  I can carry my Urban Explorer for hours -- the straps are wide and so is the bag, so it hangs well.  All in all, it's worth twice the price and I'll never be without one!

review_headline: Not quite what I expected, but ok

review_headline: simple, cute, and comfortable with patience
review_body: As most other reviews have stated, these boots are tight in the calf area.  I am a US size 7 and ordered 37.  I'm not skinny sick, and I'm not morbidly obese.  While others have advised ordering up a size, I would think twice.  The 37 is actually a bit long in the foot.  Much longer than I expected based on everyone's reviews.  The calf is tight.  No joke.  When they arrived, I tried them on.  Zipping up the right was tight but no problem.  Zipping up the left was more difficult.  I couldn't even zip it up the whole way--maybe 1-2 inches short.  However, I just wore them around the house for about 30 minutes.  Then I tried zipping the left up, and it worked.  All the way up.  It was uncomfortably tight, but I committed to breaking them in.  I wore them out that night to dinner and soon forgot about the tightness.  These boots are leather, so they do stretch out.  I really only plan to wear these with skirts and tights, so I don't worry about wearing these with thick socks.  If you're truly looking for winter boots to wear with thick socks, then please, go shopping for real winter boots--the kind that are insulated and designed for many feet of snow--the kind with laces that mean business.  However, if you're looking for a cute and simple feminine leather boot, then these are great.  They are very flat, so I've added padding and will probably buy some thicker pads.  But they're casual enough for me to wear out and on casual work days with a skirt and blazer.  I'd recommend getting these in your normal size, as long as you're willing to break them in.

review_headline: This is the best leather shoe for its price I tell you the truth.
review_body: Excellent quality above the rest in its category by far.  We are living in a new world.

product_title: Black Ripple Sole Jungle Boots
review_body: My feet fit nicely into these boots, I find them very comfortable and stable (some boots feel wobbly).  They take polish easily and well.  They tie and untie fairly quickly, but they are not speedlaces all the way down the shoe.  The ripple sole really \\"grips\\" stuff, whether it's a tile floor or a gravel driveway, they stay put.  The ripple sole also seems to be wearing pretty quickly (I'm an every day boot wearer, have been for 15 years), which you might expect from a design like that, unless really durable materials were used.  Once it wears down enough, I'll basically just have flat soled boots left...oh well.    I would recomend these to anyone who wants a decent/affordable pair of boots, but I'd especially recomend them to anyone who won't be wearing them regularly, because then you can make that sole really last!    Oh, and they are a little heavy, but that's good for ya!  ;)

product_title: Large Faux Suede Urban Hobo Handbag
review_body: I hate spending a lot for a handbag because I'm so hard on them.  Despite the bad review I purchased it not expecting very much.  I love this bag.  I purchased the pink, which is actually a dark rose color.  Yes, it comes flat and they folded the stabilizer on the bottom of the bag, but when you fill it w/all of your \\"stuff\\" it fills out the shape very nicely.  The straps are too short to use as a shoulder bag w/a heavy winter coat, but it's not so heavy that I can't carry it in my hand.  A very nice bag for the price...lots of detailing for the price, too.  Items like a fringed zipper pull and little pockets inside and magnetic clasps on the outside pockets.

review_headline: Product not as rain proof as I expected

I have used it for daily school purpose and was definitely not carrying a library with me. Now the stitches inside the flip-over are broken, though it's just a minor issue for me. The biggest frustration is that there is no zippers to seal the bag whatsoever!! Although the materials may be water-proof, yet they can't stop rains from pouring in from the lateral and the best you can do is just to cover with the flip-over!! product_title: Shimano SH-M086L MTB Sport Shoe
review_body: Granted, these are  my first biking shoes so I don't have anything to compare them to, but I've been very pleased.  They're comfortable, stiff, and work great with my [[ASIN:B002NVJEOM Shimano PD-A530 SPD Dual Platform Pedal]].  I love the ratcheting action, makes the fit super snug.  First ride out I could notice a difference, especially on the hills.  I was on the fence for awhile between SPD and SPD-SL/LOOK, but decided to go with the SPD so I can use the same shoe for both riding and RPM/spinning classes.  Plus I like being able to walk comfortably when we stop during longer rides.  I ended up getting them from my local bike shop because of other's issues with proper fit and am glad I did - I got a size smaller than what I'd planned to order.  Now that I know my correct size, I'll probably order online in the future.

review_body: I was very excited to try these new shoes from Sketchers, as two of my co-workers had purchased them and raved about their lack of foot pain. About 3 hours into my shift my feet were killing me. The balls of my feet were getting blisters, no matter how I adjusted the laces throughout  the day, it didn't make a difference. I thought maybe they were just breaking in, so I wore them the next day too. Then I almost twisted my ankle because the shoe threw me off balance at work.  It happened again when I got out of my car after work, the shoe pushed my foot outward and twisted my ankle to the side. They are totally not comfortable for long wearing. Even today, after wearing them for 2 days straight my feet still hurt and feel like they are blistering. I am returning them tomorrow for a refund. Completely disappointed.

product_title: SmartWool Mocaroon Slipper - Men's
review_body: For well over a month, I've been in search of slippers to take the place of my all-leather clogs from Harold's, now beaten and ready for retirement. I've tried Tamarac, LL Bean and now, Smartwool's Mocaroon slippers.     First a little background on my slipper philosophy: Ultimately, a pair of good slippers should meet a few basic criteria - like comfort and style. But then there are some more advanced requirements for people who really rely on their slippers everyday. One, they've got to match the environment you're in. Two, they should help your feet breath and not sweat them out like a high school wrestler looking to drop a few pounds at weigh-in. Lastly, they shouldn't be obnoxiously loud from a hard sole. Nighttime strolls demand it.    Being in the mid-south of the US, having a thick lining wasn't necessary - so when I tried even a little lining (Tamarac's), my feet began to sweat from them. The circulation of air was non-existent. Perhaps it was just my feet and everyone else would be fine - of this, I'm unsure. But something tells me that's not the case. I sent those back. Then, I tried LL Bean's. They had decent air circulation and were quiet when I had to walk on wood floors at night. But, they just didn't look good. I know it's vain, but man - I gave up huge leather stitching and the whole dock-sider look about 20 years ago. Plaid - same deal.     My next move was to try a pair of Ugg's, but I sidetracked to a local REI and took a leap of faith in the shoe section. I took a wild swing on trying these Smartwool Mocaroon slippers and bam - nice fit, great circulation, warm (but not on fire) and definitely usable throughout the year - not just in January. At least, it feels that way now. To boot, strolling around with these for a fridge raid in the middle of the night doesn't wake up a soul. Totally stealth.    I will say a couple of things about the slippers to consider before purchasing: They're not too warm, so in colder regions, they may not do the trick. Along those lines, they wear best with socks. Especially when it's colder. But, if you decide to go barefoot, the wool is light and won't itch. Lastly, they're not super padded on the bottoms, which I like, but others may not. It's a fairly flat feel.    The switch from a nice leather slipper wasn't easy, but it was definitely the Smart way to go.

review_body: Prior to purchasing these shoes, I had no personal experience with the Sketchers brand, so I basically relied upon the reviews and decided to \\"take a chance\\".  After many months of wearing these shoes, I am definitely not disaapointed.  This shoe is very comfortable and offers good support and traction on all surfaces.  If you are looking for a casual shoe that goes well with office attire and a pair of jeans on the weekend, this shoe is hard to beat.

product_title: Robeez Soft Soles Hearts Slip On With Socks (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: If you want shoes that will stay on your little one, these are the ones to buy!

product_title: Nine West Vintage America Women's Frollic Boot
review_body: Purchased the natural dark for myself and my daughter.  We both love this boot. So comfortable. Though the suede shaft is floppy, it does stay up on your leg with no problem.  I normally wear an 8 and ordered the 7 1/2 and they fit great. My daughter could also wear a half size smaller in this boot.

product_title: Palm Springs Ladies Golf Sandals BONE/BLACK
review_body: I have owned many golf sandals and have found these to be the best.  I was unsure when I ordered them because the price was so low compared to other brands.  I found them to be very comfortable and light weight.  Many of my lady golfer friends have asked about them because golf sandals are sometimes hard to find.  I would and have recommended these golf sandals.

product_title: Ray-Ban RB8304 Sunglasses
review_body: Beware of this seller! I purchased a pair of RB8304 brown polarized sunglasses and though they arrived when expected, they were not packaged correctly. (Loose, in a box too large for the product with no protective material!) Additionally, upon further inspection of the glasses, I notticed that there was a hole at the end of the ear pieces and found out something was missing. It was the rubber pieces that are incerted to help keep the glasses on your head as well as feel more comfortable. I will not be buying from this seller again!

product_title: Annie Shoes Women's Austin Sandal
review_body: I was skeptical about these shoes because of the low price but was pleasantly surprised that they are good quality and very comfortable.  I've been wearing them for about a month, so time will tell if they hold up over time.

product_title: Eric Michael Idaho Boot
review_headline: Nice looking boot but I immediately returned them.
review_body: I ordered my usual size 6 and the foot of the boot was too narrow to wear even normal socks.    The shaft was close fitting which was fine for me but I am quite thin so on someone with bigger calves getting them zipped up could be an issue.    The length of the foot bed was fine but my foot was very loosely flopping around in the heel box.    The leather was nice and the soles have good gripping treads.  It really peeves me that most women's boots have smooth 'accident waiting to happen' soles with no traction on wet sidewalks or polished floors.

product_title: Hi-Tec Women's Outlander Light Hiking Boot
review_body: I wore these shoes when my husband and I climbed Mt Fugi in Japan they have good traction for steep climbing. They got a little slick when it rained on our decent but other than that they are great for a tough climb or hike.

product_title: Ray Ban Sunglasses RB 2132 New Wayfarer 902L Tortoise-Havana/G-15XLT, 55mm
review_body: Loved the item and it was exactly as depicted.  Only down side of the transaction was a backorder lag through HDO Sports with no communication of this fact without a couple of emails sent their way.

product_title: GUESS Men's Valen Boot
review_body: This is a very stylish pair. Looks good with anything from jeans to a business suit. However, not your best choice if you intend to keep your feet warm during winter -- no lining inside. product_title: PUMA Men's Future Cat Lo Uni Sneaker
review_body: I bought it a few months ago and i'm very glad to use these shoes.. Comfortable and beautiful... And of course, a great brand!!

review_body: Absolutely love these shoes. Extremely comfortable for work and dont wear down quickly with daily use. Look and feel exactly like regular Kenneth Coles that I paid $175 for.

product_title: Charles David Women's Rikki Platform Sandal
review_headline: LOVE THEM BUT ORDER A SIZE UP
review_body: I totally agree with the previous review. wish i had read it before ordering mine. I am normally a size 5 but ordered a 5.5 but even this was way too tight. managed to squeeze my feet in with a little baby oil. :-)). but once on they look fabulous. great leather and workmenship. heaps of compliments. product_title: Nine West Women's Rocha Pump
review_headline: Good for the price I paid
review_body: These are really cute shoes - they elongate your leg and are relatively comfortable considering the 4-inch heel on them. product_title: FLY London Women's Yalta Boot
review_body: This boot looks good, but does not feel good. I have another pair of boots by fly london that i realy like and had no discomfort with. I wish i had worn them around the house more, because i would have returned them. They just don't move with your leg/ankle area, just feels annoying after a while. To bad,cute style ( i have received compliments the few couple times i have worn them). Oh yeah, the right boot feels less comfortable and made a little more big? That's what it feels like to me.

product_title: Brooks Women's Adrenaline GTS 10 Running Shoe
review_body: My podiatrist recommended this shoe for a fallen arch.  After trying numerous styles of insert arch supports, this shoe is like magic!  I put it on my foot and the pain vanished!  These run a bit narrow, which is fine for me.  The MOST comfortable shoe I have ever worn!

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Kasidy Wedge Sandal
review_body: I recently bought these shoes from a Steve Madden store. They are extremely comfortable, and are really cute! They're great because you can dress them up, or dress them down. The only thing is you have to be careful to get the correct size, Steve Madden sizes are a bit funky, some shoes run REALLY big, and some REALLY little, so try to make sure that the ones you're getting will fit correctly. I've found that in this style, it runs about one to one and a half sizes too SMALL, so order up.

product_title: Saucony Women's ProGrid  Xodus Running Shoe
review_body: I have difficult to fit feet and have never worn a more comfortable shoe!  I have narrow heels and a wide toe area; these shoes felt like custom-made at an extremely reasonable price.

product_title: Tamarac by Slippers International Women's Cozy Sheepskin Clog Slipper
review_body: I love these slippers and they are well worth the money. I purchased a size 8 but I normally wear a size 7. They fit really snug at first but stretched out within about 2 days. I kind of wish that I just ordered them in my true size. At this price I might as well order another pair.

product_title: Clarks Women's Bagel Clog, 9.5W, Black
review_body: I ordered these shoes because I stand on my feet at work and needed comfy shoes which these fit the description!  I am really happy with them because I am able to do my job without suffering!  Thank you!!!  Audra

product_title: Teva Women's Kayenta Outdoor Sandal
review_headline: I like these but they run wide
review_body: I really like these shoes but do feel the need to review b/c the size does run a little wide.  I have a normal foot and am usually a women's size 7.  That is the size I bought and the shoes are perfect in length.  Unfortunately they are slightly wide across the toe box and very wide along the back ankle strap.  I have considered returning these b/c they are too wide but a smaller size would be too short for my foot's length.  I wear these to teach swimming lessons and do general summer activities so they will get a good amount of use.  I have worn Tevos before and I do a lot of outdoor activities so I know they will loosen up as I wear them in.  I wonder if offering a narrow option would help to reduce this issue...   I do love the color and style of these!

product_title: Select-A-Vision Coppertone Sun Reader, Amber
review_body: I had these glasses for 3 days when the frame to the glasses become loose and filmsy........ I returned them after 3 days...... they look good but are cheap!

product_title: Ecco Men's Zone Tie Oxford
review_body: i was very unhappy when i found out they send me the wrong size,i order 10-10.5 M and i rec 10-10.5 N,so i return the shoe to get another pair of M width, and i told the costumer service about the width situation. But when i rec the new pair of shoe, the same happen again,i got another pair Nior,if the shoe were Noir, why amazon post as M, thats one part i don't understand.

product_title: Prince Men's Viper 5 Mid Tennis Shoe
review_body: I first started buying this shoe when it was called a Viper III (4-5 years?).  I have not notice a significant change--which is a good thing.  It has a wide toe box, great support and comfort.  Wear is reasonable.  The heal area is too big for my heal, but the benefit of the wide toe area more than offset it and I have had no ankle roll over since I started wearing these mid tops.    I had one pair split between the sole and the upper, clearly defective, but Prince would not repair because it was beyond 6 months from purchase, although I had only worn 3 months (they have a 6 mo wear guarantee).  They are kind of heavy and the laces are too long.  If you have a narrow foot, or high arch this is probably not the shoe for you.  If you like room for your toes or have ankle problems, check it out.

product_title: Latico Bettina Braided Strap Shoulder Bag
review_headline: Latico bags have the Class and Quality of other High End Bags
review_body: This is the second Latico handbag I have purchased as a gift for my mother. She was first introduced to the Latico Brand at a Sam's Club where they retail for about $150-300. Amazon's prices on these bags are amazing! The quality of Latico's leather in impeccable and they give a more lived in feel as you carry them; my mother owns two and that has been the case (plus this one which she is getting for Christmas!),they look better and better as she carries them. When I opened the box after receiving the package I was impressed by the size because she loves big bags, and the leather was a soft distressed brown as expected. The inside is the same as most Latico Bags with card slots, a zippered pocket and a leather and floral interior. My mother loves these bags and its hard to please her because she is used to carrying Coach, Dooney, and other very expensive names. And let me tell you, with the quality you get in these bags they are up there competing with the high end leather bags at a better price. And guys if your looking for a gift for your mother or that special girl in your life, Latico is a cost conscious way to go!

product_title: ALDO Wiglac - Men Dress Lace-up Shoes
review_body: Great shoes, I know the style is out a little, that's why they dropped the price, each pair of these shoes cost about $100 to $120 from Aldo originally. by the way I'm a big fan of Aldo shoes. I have about 10 pairs of them now.     I like everything about it, except the leather looks a bit dry. but that wouldn't bother me.

product_title: EMU Australia Women's Bronte Mini Boot
review_body: I love these boot, and wear them just about every day.  I would love to get more.

review_body: I have never seen boots like this and was in love with them at first sight. When I received them, I was a little surprised at how thin the leather was, considering how expensive they were.  They also run a little small and I had to stretch them out before I could wear them.  I was also surprised that there was absolutely NO cushioning at all in the shoe. I was still in love with the look, however, so I had to put some \\"gel\\" pads in the front of the  boot to be at all comfortable. product_title: Dearfoams Women's Boucle Mule
review_body: These are by far the most comfortable slippers I've ever had. The transaction was easy, delivery was quick.  All good!

product_title: Dansko Women's Mila Sandal
review_body: I'm totally sold on Dansko shoes.  I got this pair and another pair for work.  I have chronic back problems, and generally speaking, if I am on my feet at all during the day, my back will hurt horribly at night.  The only shoes that have ever alleviated this are my MBT's (tennis shoes), which I can't wear to work.  I did some research online before ordering these and just crossed my fingers and hoped they would work for me...AND they did!  My back doesn't hurt at all when I wear these!  They are super cute too!  I will never, ever, ever, ever buy another brand of dress shoes.  They are well worth the money and I am now a customer for life!

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Chutes And Ladders 2 Open Toe Pump
review_body: I love Naughty Monkey shoes and own several pairs of them. I wear an 8 and these fit perfectly in that size. I ordered them in Blue and they have sort of a spotted pattern on them - attention-getting. The trim is navy, but the shoes easily can be worn with navy, black or red. The strap provides extra support for my foot and makes the shoe easy to walk in. Very comfortable shoe even though the heel is high. Love them.

product_title: Robeez Soft Soles Kitty Slip On (Infant/Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: These shoes stay on..  They look great and help my daughter get traction when cruising furniture..  A bit pricey but definitely worth it.

product_title: Stud Trim Closed Toe Boot
review_body: Okay, I got these shoes in the mail today, and let me tell you, they are GORGEOUS! I was so excited to wear them. The packaging was a little dinged up, but eh. I immediately put them on--I was wearing skinny jeans and they looked really cute. I imagine these shoes are good because you can dress up a more plain outfit--I had on a t-shirt and skinny jeans--or you can compliment a fancier outfit. The shoe itself is a bit stiff at the moment, but once I break them in, they should be fine.     I haven't walked much in them, so I don't know what they are like over long distances. The arch support is decent. Definitely not the most comfortable shoes I've owned (the heel height doesn't help) but they are not uncomfortable. I put in a pair of Dr. Scholl's insoles and they don't seem too bad.     The calves/ankles are a bit big on me. I have a hard time with that, mostly because I'm very small and have thin calves, so it was not unexpected. I imagine someone with average calves would fit comfortably. If you have larger calves, though, proceed with caution. The leather is very soft, almost suede-like in some areas, though not as smooth or as shiny as the picture makes it out to be. I got them in black, so I can't speak for the brown, but the black is a very uniform one, a bit worn in some areas, but they actually look great with it.      Anyway, my friend (who I was with at the time of the opening) loves them and wants to borrow them. I just want to wear them around the house, but alas, I cannot, because they are quite loud and there are sick people who need their beauty sleep more than I need my beautiful shoes! They are totally worth it. And anyone dragging their feet about purchasing them, I would recommend biting the bullet now, because I'm not sure whether or not they're making this shoe anymore.     I believe these boots and I are looking forward to a long, beautiful friendship.

product_title: K-Swiss Albury II Classic Shoe Womens
review_body: There is something on the inside of the sneaker that is causing callouses on the sides of my feet. Something rubbing, I guess. They kind of hurt the first few times I wore them. product_title: Saucony Men's Grid Cohesion Running Shoe
review_headline: First time marathoner runs on clouds
review_body: I bought a pair of these to train for my first marathon.  I'd already went through 3 pairs of Adidas in the first month.  I've trained in them for a while now and love how they feel.  I've never been much for running because it's always made my knees and back hurt.  When I decided I wanted to run the marathon, I started with the same back and knee pains and assumed that I would just have to suffer through it.      Then, after a month of disappointment and pain, I went to Rack Room Shoes and talked to everyone in the store.  They all said the same thing.  \\"If you want comfortable shoes that will hold up to ANY run, go for Saucony.\\"  I bought these because they were modestly priced, and I didn't want to shell out a lot of money for shoes that I'd never heard of before.  Despite the modest price, they are EXCELLENT!  I bought the same size that I've always worn and they feel great.  They are snug enough that my foot doesn't move around in them, and because the top is mesh and flexible, I can still wiggle my toes for no reason whatsoever.  The gel support in the heel takes the jarring out of running.  My spine and knees feel great.  Plus, they're so well ventilated that my feet don't sweat as much, which is one reason I always wound up with so many blisters from other shoes.  I even started with a plantar wart on my toe that I couldn't feel in these things when I run.       The best part, without all of the added pain I was able to start running farther at once so that I could get ready faster.  I'm ordering 2 more pairs so that I can rotate them out every running day.  I will not go back to another shoe.  Oh Saucony, how glad I am that I found you.

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Crossize Pump
review_body: I love these shoes. They are comfortable, and I am always getting compliments on them. The size was perfect.

product_title: Keen Women's Sienna MJ Mary Janes
review_headline: Most well worn pair of shoes I've ever had.
review_body: I've been wearing these shoes for a long time (okay almost 2 years...yikes!) and I love them.  I needed something comfortable while I was pregnant with my 3rd...I had bad sciatica type issues and really needed arch support.  These were SO comfortable from the start.  I've worn them w/ socks, no socks, winter, summer....all the time, too much perhaps?  I've washed them, I've washed the insert MANY times over....they've held up well.  (I wouldn't wash them while they are very new, but they were over a year old and I knew I was taking my chances).  I would say the support has given out quite a bit by now but I've worn them so much it's to be expected.  I'm going to have to break down and get a new pair maybe soon!

product_title: Tignanello T Time Signature Gathered Shopper
review_headline: Nice Bag - Hard to get in to
review_body: Tignanello bags are one of my favorites. They are sturdy, well-designed, great looking bags. The quality is great, the look is great but for me, the gathered top with the belt just makes it too difficult to access my things. On the up side, there are many pockets and places to stay super organized. The handle is long enough to swing over your shoulder and it clears the elbow, which is something I really like. I just hate having to fumble and dig, so I prefer bags that open a bit wider so I can get more light inside. It is very professional looking. I got the one with the dark brown trim and it would be great for fall and winter, its just the digging around factor that makes me debate about keeping it. As for the leather trim -- if it is PVC, it is very good PVC.

Two things we would like--better sizing, sized in narrow and wide, as well as, individual sizes, not multi-sized AND even though they are cushioned, more would be better, with a little arch support.  We like the tex moc and polar moc styles the best.  Don't ever want to be without them!  We love them!

product_title: Robeez Soft Soles Weekend Classic Slip On (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: I have loved every Robeez except for these.  I ordered the 18-24 month shoe and the fit is horrible.  Unless your 18-24 month old has a size 8 foot, I would avoid these.  It's not just that the shoe is ridiculously large, but the foot opening is too big as well. I ordered these because my son has all but outgrown and destroyed his 12-18 month Robeez.  They were the only shoes he did not kick off.  Sadly, that is not the case with the 18-24 month shoe.

product_title: Dansko Women's Trixie Slip-On
review_body: After seeing my daughter-in-law wearing these shoes, I had to get a pair. They are very comfortable and stylish!  Being over 50, I have a hard time finding comfortable dressier shoes with high heels.  I also had the same problem with my feet slipping out wearing hose or dress socks.  I wanted to wear them in colder weather, but my feet get very cold without socks, so I bought a pair of non-slip pads and put them in each shoe.  Have not had any problems with slipping feet now.  I love these shoes so much, I bought a pair in both black and brown.

product_title: Asics Men's Limber Up Asian
review_body: I just recieved my new limber up asians shoes and i have to say that i love them. they feel like i have worn them for months. a great shoe and i would totally buy again.

product_title: Clarks Men's Turtle Flip Flop
review_body: These are great and look great with jeans. They felt a little tight at first but after 1 week of wearing they loosened up and now fit perfectly. I would highly recommend these.

product_title: Black and Silver Starburst Purse Hanger
review_body: This is a great product that works!  My purse is very heavy and it has not problem hanging.

product_title: New Balance Men's MR749 Running Shoe
review_body: Amazon gets an A+ for having the best prices on running shoes ...    NB749 ... decent lightweight running shoe..  I've been training for the past 16 weeks in preparation for my 1st Marathon .. Got NB749 a month ago and so far i've done one 13 mile run, several short runs (4 - 6 miles), two 2 mile hill runs and some 400m sprints in them ... so i've really been pushing them ... my other runs are done in a Saucony ProGrid Hurricane 10    My findings: I would prefer a bit more arch support in the NB749, otherwise its great for my short & hill runs ... after my 13mile run, i felt slight soreness in my achilles tendon & tightness in arch, which i dont usually experience with the Saucony Hurricane 10, so i now do all longer runs in the Sauconys... Shoes fit to size.

review_body: I found these Converse Premieres to be awesome...subtle styling, comfortable because there is more arch support than the regular All-Stars, the sole is of a better rubber than the regular, and very nice.  I own 3 pairs, and worn out a forth.

review_body: I have only ran in Brooks Adrenalines for years.  I typically search Amazon first, and this time I purchased through Road Runner Sports.  I was impressed with their price, and I was even more impressed with how quickly my order arrived.  Kudos, Road Runner!

review_body: Other reviewers are exactly right- heavy, snappy, stiff, and oddly contoured for...I'm not sure who's feet. review_headline: My fiance' no longer has cold feet.

product_title: David Spencer Men's Saddle Oxford
review_headline: Good shoes - VERY POOR pack & ship
review_body: These are good comfortable shoes, although they run at least 1/2 size too large; this should be noted if you choose to order a pair.  The shoes arrived quickly enough, but both the outer and the inner boxes looked as if they had been run over by a truck. I was glad to see the shoes were not damaged, but it was obvious that ABSOLUTELY NO CARE AT ALL was given to the packing or the shipping of these shoes. Both boxes literally screamed \\"mindless throw-it-in-a box handling\\" upon arrival.   Without question, this was the worst looking Amazon package I have ever received, and it tells me that their quality control has gone to zero. Amazon is squarely to blame for failing to include even a modicum of packing material around the inner box, but the pathetic condition of the outer box was obviously due to the gross negligence of UPS.   Fast and affordable shipping is one thing, but cheap careless shipping is quite another. If I hadn't needed these shoes right away, I would have returned them strictly because of the pathetic condition of the shipping materials.    Four stars for the shoes, NEGATIVE 10 for the packing and shipping.

product_title: B. MAKOWSKY Chicago Shoulder Bag
review_body: This purse is just okay, in my opinion.  It's a bit large for me, who likes smaller bags, and it's so soft that it just collapses into a puddle when it's set down on a table, chair, or floor.  That's probably not a problem for those who carry a full load in their bags.  The pockets in the front are nice in that they are secure, but it isn't exactly seamless to use them.  You have to open the clasp, open the flap, put something in, and line up the flap and put it back on, push the buckle-like device closed.  The shoulder strap I got was kinked at the top, and it's not straightened out with use and probably never will.  I am left-handed, and carrying the purse on my left shoulder, I believe the shoulder strap is then backwards in that it's curved on one side, flat on the other.  It doesn't always stay on my shoulder.    The zipper closure on the top requires two hands because there's a little kink about 3 inches in from the end, and you have to pull the end tab to straighten it out while pulling the zipper fob shut to move past that point.    The cell phone pocket is on the back side of the purse, is quite small, and my Blackberry (with its case) doesn't easily fit into the slot.  Plus, being on the back side of the purse, it's much easier to \\"butt dial\\" your phone while it's in the bag.    I got the bag in the color Lake, which is a very pretty color, and the quality is excellent.  But as I said, overall, it's just okay.

review_body: I used to have Mizunos once upon a time and they were absolutely fantastic.  I bought these since I was in dire need of a real pair of volleyball shoes and I haven't been disappointed.  There's good room in the front for toes. The back comes up over the heel far enough to hold on but not far enough to dig into your tendon.  Overall they feel good and are a light weight shoe.  I am definitely happy I bought them.  Good shoe for the price.

product_title: HOBO INTERNATIONAL Lola Shoulder Bag
review_body: I got the green paulina - and I love it! I already got complements on the slick design. Love the yellow interior, well sawn, and fresh colors! Makes me happy!

product_title: NBE Leather Stiletto Heel Dress Boots Black
review_headline: Great looking boot, but with some serious defects.
review_body: I was looking for a pair of stiletto boots to replace the one I bought 3 years ago. As soon as I received the pair from MyHotShoes and got it out of the box, I thought they were good looking boots. Real leather (though it is textured, I believed it to be \\"too textured\\" and a bit on the rough side). The problem came when I tried them on. I am slim girl, maybe considered skinny. My ankle is 7 1/2 in. around, and the thickest part (where the bones stick out) is 8 in. I know I didn't need to go a size up (I ordered a 6) as the size I was ordering was already a bit big for me (I usually wear 5 1/2). These boots are REALLY tight around my ankle, to the point I can only wear them with very thin socks. Forget about tucking your skinny jeans in them. I usually wear my boots under my boot-cut jeans. The other problem they have is that the insole is a tad high on the heel area, causing your feet to feel rather uncomfortable inside the boots. They are 4-in high heels, but they feel 5-in instead. The only reason I didn't return them was because I hadn't paid much for them, and shipping them back was going to cost me a 1/4 of what I had paid, and since I don't wear boots that often, I thought I could bear the pain of walking in these. Then again, they look great! but don't buy them if you are planning on standing long hours in them (or even short hours for that matter). It's ideal for an office job that doesn't require you to walk much but to look good.

product_title: Columbia Men's Flybridge Boat Shoe
review_headline: Shoes are good but their exchange policy is not.
review_body: I got a pair of shoes. But they were a little too small, so I wanted to exchange them to a larger size. But they didn't accept exchanges. They only refund and make you pay for the return shipment, because the return reason is not their error.    There is no way to know their 7.5 size shoes are actually 7.0 size ones for most of other shoe companies, until we receive actual products. This is not my error, either.     I have shopped online but this was the first company that did not accept exchanges of products. I had to buy a new pair. This means that I had to pay for shipping again.    If you are not sure about your shoe size with this company, I do not recommend you buy shoes from them.

product_title: *CREEPER-423, 2", Blk Lea/Silver Star P/F Creeper
review_headline: Love them - but with the silver stars
review_body:
I got these 5 years ago (but with silver stars - not red).

I actually took out the stitching around the piping of the ankle area, removed the piping, and cut down the leather 1/2\\" - then re-sewed up the piping covering.
After that - they fit perfect.
I love them so much and get compliments on them constantly.
Plus, they add 2\\" of height - and being 5'2\\" & going to concerts, that really helps.
They last quite well - but the accent color eventually fades, just from the wear & tear of the colored leather wearing off (but this is over a 5 year period of - and lots of concerts).

review_headline: An outstandingly constructed shoe with phenomenal design and quality

With a natural, organic texture in the rear upper. It has suede highlights moving along it with leather taking up the rest of the shoe. All of it is supremely constructed design-wise. The fit is quite larger than it should be, probably a full size larger although I usually wear a 10 1/2 and ordered a 10, it fits well enough where I can get away with it considering there is no half size smaller in stock. The width fits slightly more narrow than a regular \\"skate\\" shoe, which is nice as it has a better look and feel to it. Not quite as bulky as the DC's and such, more for walking and fashion, less for actual skating. You can't go wrong with Zoo York shoes, let's hope they don't change them up and make me eat my words.
