review_body: I don't think I will ever be able to get another athletic shoe that isn't a Puma. These shoes are so comfortable and look so nice! Also, with most Puma's, you want to make sure you order a half size up since they run a bit small. So, I usually wear a 7 so I got a 7 1/2 and they fit perfect!

product_title: Luichiny Women's Rosa Wedge Sandal
review_headline: luv the height/color, but can barely walk on this!
review_body: haven't tried to walk on rough ground yet!  will try on rugs (indoor!) only....very steep to say the least!!  picture looks better than in person!!!!  WISHING THAT THIS TYPE OF SHOES WERE MADE ON RUBBER SOLE INSTEAD!!!!  (sigh, sigh!!!)

product_title: Tamarac by Slippers International Men's Scuffy Clog Slipper
review_body: These slippers are fantastic.  Super comfortable and perfect for just lounging about.  My only complaint is that they could use a little more foot bed padding.  I know most slippers don't have a good padding, I mean they are slippers not running shoes.  They keep my feet nice and warm and have held up to daily use for a couple months now.  Overall a great buy.

product_title: Merrell Men's Intercept Gore-Tex
review_body: The shoes, as indicated by others, is a size smaller and narrower. There is no cushion under the heel, so after few hours you'd feel like you walked over rocks. Although these are not made for serious hiking, the shoes slip badly on wet surfaces (wet rocks, tree trunks). So do not leave the easy trail with these on. The gore-tex does provide protection from water.

product_title: The Original MuckBoots Daily Garden Shoe
review_headline: comfy- but should have lasted longer for the price
review_body: I agree with the other reviewers about the comfort and convenience of these shoes.  My first pair wore out on my shovel foot, but I read that they had improved the sole so got a second pair. The rubber on the upper cracked (where it flexes near the base of the toes) during their second season, so they were no longer waterproof. I thought for the price they should have lasted longer, and wrote to the company with my dissatisfaction, but the reply I got simply said \\"these are warranteed for a year\\", i.e. tough luck. So, Muck Boot Co has lost a customer.

product_title: BCBGeneration Women's Petler Boot,Black,8 M US
review_body: Great boot and very comfortable. It was almost exactly what I expected except for one thing - I thought the boot would fit a little more snuggly around my calf.  It's not a baggy fit but it is a roomy fit around the calf.

product_title: G.H. Bass & Co. Women's Sharon Fisherman Sandal
review_body: I have purchased many of these sandals.  They are comfortable, versatile, and the quality is excellent.  I totally wear them out, but that takes a long time and I am hard on shoes.  I highly recommend them.

product_title: FitFlop Women's Walkstar Sandal
review_body: I already have 4 pairs of Fitflops and love them. I've had back problems for 8 years, and these sandals are great for anybody with these kind of problems. And they are not bad looking either! I'll keep buying more colors, I'm not done yet!

product_title: Reef Men's Pimptastic Slide Sandal
review_body: My friends know that when I'm wearing these I'm definitely going to be impressing some ladies that night. I call them the Hef's because they remind me of something Hugh would wear around the Mansion. I love them!

product_title: Skins Women's Noelle Skins Flat
review_body: i bought this shoes as i needed a comfortable one, i love walking. Unfortunately, there was no footbed or the bone!!! i only received the outer part which is of NO VALUE by itself. I think the price is so much reduced as they will send you the outer part only to get rid of them. What a disappointement, a total waste of money. Want my advice do not risk and buy it!

product_title: Moda Spana Women's Supple Ankle Strap Sandal
review_body: Love the shoes Quality and price.  However they do run small.  i wear a size 9 ordered a 9.5 and I am glad I did.  Other than that No complaints what so ever.

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Seige Pump
review_body: LOVE LOVE LOVE! The shoe is perfect, I love everything about it. BUY it !

product_title: Aquatalia Women's Urbain Boot
review_body: This is my third fall/winter/spring wearing these boots in the Pacific Northwest rain.  They look fabulous, the feel great, and my feet are always dry. At the beginning of this season I added Dr. Scholl's to the ball of the foot as the cushion was permanently thinned (after two years!) I also polish them on occasion to keep them looking good.

product_title: ara Women's Atlanta Loafer
review_body: while ago i bought ara shoes for the first time and like them for comfort and nice look. when i see at amazon this brand i bought them and price was twice better then i bought in the store. Shoes are very well made and it is all leather which today is rare. I like this shoes

product_title: New Balance Men's MW576 Walking Shoe
review_headline: Excellent shoe, good support, comfortable, not too expensive
review_body: I'd worn out a couple of pairs of New Balance 621s [[ASIN:B000VVH916 New Balance Men's MX621 Training Shoe]] and found these. My kids have had velcro-strap type shoes and I wondered if they were made in adult sizes. Lo and behold, here they are. The tongue does wag a little bit, but overall these shoes have excellent support and are easier to adjust than the lace-up New Balance 621s I had before. I added a couple of heel cups [[ASIN:B000MSZT7O Tuli's Heavy Duty Heel Cups, Large (Over 175lbs)]] and I was all set. Well, I added some Thorlo tennis socks [[ASIN:B000GFGI5U Thorlo Unisex Thick Cushion Tennis Crew Sock]] for good measure. I mashed my foot this past spring and needed a shoe with support and these shoes are ideal. I've played tennis in them and they can be adjusted tight enough for activities. It's a little funky to see adult size velcro-strap shoes, but I've always been one to favor function over appearance. I'm very happy with these shoes.

product_title: FootFitter Steel Arched Shoe Horn, 7"
review_body: Excellent shoe horn.  :)

product_title: BEARPAW Women's Cable Knit Sheepskin Boot
review_body: I got these boots for my daughter, and they looked so cute I wanted a pair for myself.  My only 'warning' would be I think they run small.  My daughter is a size 2 and I got her the 3 so it would last another season, but they fit her perfectly.  I got myself the size 10 and they are very snug - in fact I would have preferred a size 11 but they don't offer that size.  I would suggest ordering a size above your normal size, myself!  I normally never have problems with size 10's (eg I don't consider myself a large 10 or ever have to buy size 11... except in this case!).  Otherwise, love the shoe - very cute, warm and I love how you can wear them up or down/ankle size.  Great for kids too!

product_title: Fergie Women's Amie Slingback Sandal
review_body: I was so excited about these shoes when I ordered them, I couldn't wait for them to come.  I actually ordered them in both black and brown because I was so in love with them.  So, I got them and they were just as cute and sexy as I thought they'd be however, the wooden wedge nicks and marks very easily.  The dark glossy wood, when it gets bumped or you \\"bang\\" it into something, gets a very light colored nick that is extremely visible.  :(  was disappointed in that part.  i actually wouldn't recommend the shoe for that reason because they were delivered with tiny imperfections in the wood, so i knew they must get damaged easily.  i was right... :(

product_title: Madden Girl Women's Layyla Midheel Round Toe Pump
review_body: I loved this, looks cutes and I walked a lot with them and was delicious

product_title: Saucony Men's ProGrid Stabil CS Running Shoe
review_body: I really had problems with my ankles prior to this shoe.  Since my purchase I have been 100 percent.

product_title: Newport Leather Sandal (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body: We bought these shoes when my toddler went through another highly recommended brand & kept falling. They have been a wonderful summer sandal for her. They protect her feet and yet have vents. Also, she can't step out of them while walking (like  the other brand with velcro). Plan on getting them again next season & checking out Keen's winter shoes too!  Very happy with the product!

product_title: adidas Men's +F50.7 Tunit Soccer Cleat
review_body: This is the first pair of Tunits for one of my boys and he loves them.    Played 8 games so far and they have worked great!

product_title: MINK Lace Up Fur Suede Flat Winter Boots Black
review_body: I just got my boots. I ordered a size 7 and they fit very true to size. If you want to wear them with a thick sock, you may want to size up half a size. I have fairly narrow feet and slender legs, and these zip up perfectly over my socks and skinny jeans. You can't really see it in the picture but they do zip up on the sides which makes putting them on and taking them off very easy. They are very cute and the fur featured is real fur and incredibly soft. I bought these to wear as apres ski boots and to walk around cities in the winter, and I think they will work well after I weather-proof the suede. My current pair of apres ski boots work well for playing in the snow (they are ugg-style) but I wanted something a little more feminine for going to dinner, and also something with a sturdier sole for walking on sidewalks. I think these will be much more supportive for walking in the city, but I would not wear these for playing in the snow because they are thinner than my current boots, which are lined with wool.  All in all, these boots are very cute, very comfortable, and fit well. They are not the warmest boots around, but will do very well as apres ski boots after I weatherproof the suede. The fur is real, soft, and very pretty.

product_title: Ellie Shoes Women's 511-BRANDE Pumps
review_body: i got these in the 8220 Blue Pu and they are just so pretty.  i read over the other reviews, and on their advice, even though i usually order a size 7.5, i got the size nine ... and the fit was actually pretty good, with room for a ladies' dress shoe gel insert.  So, i was happy.    In the blue color these just go wonderfully with just about any shade of blue denim miniskirt or jeans.  Coordinating a top might prove challenging, because one doesn't want \\"overkill\\", but i did pair these with a blue denim mini-dress that i usually pair with white pumps or white sandals, and the effect was really very pretty and sexy.    Be warned, ladies, these heels are quite high, so if you're not used to walking in four or even five inch heels, you might want to start with something a little less challenging.  However, if you're like me and you wear high heels a lot, these don't present much difficulty, especially if you put a gel insert in.    These are very sexy and elegant; all in all, a great pair of pumps!

product_title: Jessica Simpson Women's Vandy Wedge
review_headline: Cute shoe - runs a tad long...
review_body: I like this shoe.  I had to reorder it because I normally wear a size 7 and it was just a little too long so I gave it to a friend and ordered another one in a size 61/2.  It is much better.  I like the front squared.  It is true to color and very royal blue.  You will like it, just be aware that it is a little longer than I thought it should be.  Rather unique looking and comfortable - mainly for a cute look.

product_title: FLY London Women's Vela Pump
review_headline: FLY London Women's Vela Pump purple/blue
review_body: I thought these shoes were very cute! And the color was great for me. The shoes were also very comfortable except when I walked!  The heel  bed  and ankle strap seemed to be cut high causing it to rub and cut into my ankle when I walked. It is also unfortunate that there are no half sizes. The 8 was too small and the 9 was too big.  I had to send them back....so sad! The bright side was the ease of return to Amazon. Thank you for being so accomodating.

product_title: Dansko Women's Marion Slide
review_body: These shoes are absolutely wonderful.... so comfortable.  I have an ankle that pronates, so I was recommended by my  ortho doctor to try Dansko shoes-   I now own 3 pairs, and  these sandals are great.  Fit is perfect as well.  And, the  go with everything.

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Chandler Boot
review_body: Nice boot for the price.      For me this boot ran 1/2 size too large----not a problem a pair of sox won't fix.

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Strength Fitness Walking Sneaker
review_body: I have these on right now.  I had no problems breaking them in; the fit was perfect-true to size.  I'm a first grade teacher and I've worn them to work.  At the end of the day, my feet still feel great.  I just wish they were a bit cheaper...I'd love to have several pairs!

product_title: Western Chief Women's Fireman Rain Boot
review_body: Much more comfortable and stylish than similarly priced boots! I usually buy a size larger for my orthotics but this one was roomy enough in my actual size (7).

product_title: Ariat Women's Show Baby Square Toe Boot
review_body: this a a comfortable and roomy pair of  boots.  the square toe cut give one extra wiggle space for the toes. rubber sole so great for walking especially in winter. the teal marking gives it a splash of lively color

product_title: umi Infant/Toddler Patch Crib Shoe

review_body: These are really cute shoes and clearly high quality. But, unlike the ministar and robeez brand leather slip-on shoes, these have velcro on the tongue, which makes them easier to get on, but my son can \\"un-velcro\\" them and take them right off. They also seem a little harder to walk in than the ministar/robeez. The sole is a lot stiffer.

product_title: Palladium Women's Bellingham Mid Calf Boot
review_body: Visually, these are really cute boots. They are a very light weight leather which I did not expect, I was looking for a little more substance. They definitely run big and it is unfortunate that they don't have half sizes. I usually wear a 7.5-8. I ordered a 7 and could easily go down another half size.

product_title: Buxton Heiress Double Cardex Wallet
review_body: I've had Buxton wallets for as long as  I can remember, but this one takes the cake!  The last one I had for over fifteen years before it self-destructed; it was a dark green french wallet that looked a lot like this one.  But the Double Cardex is the world's 8th wonder - I only have 2 credit cards, but it also holds all my appointment cards, my auto insurance form, my many gift cards (did you know if you have a Victoria's Secret CC they send you a card for a free panty EVERY MONTH!!!), my driver's license AND my military ID, all in separate slots so I don't have to \\"double up\\"  (or triple, or whatever) in my wallet any more!  Even if you don't have a lot of credit cards, you can probably put this to good use. It has two currency slots and the coin purse, which closes securely with a kisslock, is divided as well.I never have any trouble finding things anymore, and I actually make it to all my doctor and dental appointments, because the cards are all right there!  I used to carry a \\"famous label\\" knockoff, but it took up half my purse and was a bear to deal with.  Now, all I take is my Double Cardex and my checkbook, and there's actually room left in my famous label (the real thing) handbag!  Thanks Amazon, I got a great product at a great price in less than a week, and I'd been looking in local department stores for months.  See what half an hour on the internet can do for you - Amazon has everything!

product_title: Skechers Women's Shape Ups Optimize Fitness Walking Shoe
review_body: Although they may look odd, they are great on your feet. I am a nurse and on my feet alot and after working my 12 hour shift my feet do not hurt. As far as the leg toning; I have had these shoes for a month and can't say wheter my legs feel more toned yet I only wear them 3 days a week.

product_title: Michael Antonio Women's Sisley Sandal
review_body: When I received the Tan Sisley Sandals in the mail I was so excited--they are beautiful and don't look cheap.  However after wearing them the 1st day I found them to be brutally uncomfortable.  I am very use to high heels--it's mainly all I wear.  So the height of this heel isn't the issue.  The problem is the back of the shoe rubs the back of your foot terribly! For every step taken the shoe just rubs away at the skin--by the end of the day I had blisters on the back of my heels and feet.  Very disappointed because the shoes are beautiful and go with a ton of clothing options.  I will only wear these again after purchasing some type of silicone heel/back of foot protector--surely Dr.Scholl's makes something that can be inserted between the shoe material and the back of the foot. That's the only way I'd be able to wear these again.

product_title: DC Men's Rob Dyrdek Skate Shoe
review_body: The boyfriend loves the shoes! I am very happy the shoes were a hit and that they came soo early.

product_title: Wolverine Men's 8" Work Boots
review_body: This was from another vendor that does business through Amazon.  The item was received timely - and the price was great.  I will definitely deal with this vendor again!

product_title: Men's Rockport MARGIN Flexible Casual Classic Oxford
review_body: I ordered my second pair of these shoes.  For me, the fit was perfect, and the shoes are light on my feet.  They look great too.  The only concern is that they scuffed a little easier than I would like.  But overall, a good shoe, and a good purchase.

product_title: Mundi Moc Croc Tab Frame Clutch Wallet in Choice of Colors
review_headline: Making life easier and more organized
review_body: This is nice to keep several (probably 20+ if you wanted to) cards. Nice quality, plenty of compartments for id, cards, cash, change, checkbook, etc. The insert for checkbook holder is removable if desired. Pretty stylish for [...] and seemingly very sturdy. This wallet is a great organizer for a larger purse (the dimensions are listed on the product description). There are two snaps on the front (the heart snap closure) which is nice if you find yourself with a lot of junk to make your wallet bigger. The snap compartment (presumably for bills) has a middle divider. This is versatile as you can use the compartments as intended or switch where you put most of your items as desired. I was also very pleased with the individual seller. Great buy.

product_title: See Kai Run Mackenzie Sandal (Infant/Toddler)
review_body: I love this brand for my daughter. The shoes are always well made, soft and durable. We ordered them in white so yes they do get a little dirty but they clean up pretty well. You can order them a little large and they will still fit and give your child's feet room to grow over the summer.

product_title: Dr. Martens 1460 Boot
review_body: These boots are a beauty especially for the really great price I bought them for. After a few days of breaking them in, I didn't want to take them off! They are really cute and fashionable. The only bad thing is that they are not waterproof or mud compatible. But that's not a big deal at all because the overall boots are gorgeous!I have received many compliments about my boots when taking a walk out to the city. product_title: GUCCI EYEGLASSES 2788

review_body:
Bought the red since they were in discount...yes I am a value shopper! Love the deal and happy to recommend it.
Product arrived early and in perfect conditions. It is a month that I am using them inside the house; looking good!

product_title: Reebok Women's EasyTone Reeinspire Walking Shoe
review_body:
I read the reviews before I bought these shoes and most of them were complimentary. The first few days took some adjustment, but now I can't imagine wearing anything else! I have chronic knee problems and after few weeks these seem to have helped to strengthen the muscles and eased my knee pain a little. I can even see the toning effects that they advertise- nothing dramatic but everything looks firmer than before.

The fit is normal for athletic shoes. If you plan on doing a lot of running or walking you may want to go a half size up from normal for maximum comfort. I will purchase another pair when these wear out... and with the customizable designs, I can't wait to order another color combination!

product_title: Baffin Mustang Snow Boot (Toddler)
review_body: I bought these for my 1 year old who was getting to the age for recess at daycare.  We live in Alaska and I was impressed with the quality and insulation factor.  They are good, solid boots that I would definately purchase again.  My one complaint is that because of that insulation and quality they are a bit cumbersome for a little one who just learned to walk.  She got used to them pretty quickly though.

product_title: Birkenstock Women's Madrid Sandal
review_body: I have been a long time wearer of birkenstocks in the 'madrid' style.  They are comfortable and cute.  Be careful with the sizing if you are new.  I go by the European sizing.  I'm 38 which birkenstock call a 7 but I take a 7.5 -8 in other shoes which is European 38 or 39.  If I bought the size they say is equivalent to an 8 it would be huge! They take a few days to feel normal when you 1st try them because of the molded footbed but give them a few days to get flexible and they are great.

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Lila Ornamented Moccasin
review_body: I love Anne Klein shoes!!!  I have not been disappointed with any I have purchased.  I have a narrow foot and her B sizing is narrower than most other brands so they fit me.  Workmanship is always great, as well as style.  These are very comfortable and required no break-in wear.  When fitted properly I wear a 7 1/2 A, and AK's 7B fits me fine, a smidgin wider than I would like, but the alternative is no shoes!!!  I was hesitant to buy these at first because of the leopard pattern but decided to try them and am glad I did.  They look great with jeans.  You can't go wrong with these stylish, comfortable shoes.

product_title: Skechers Sport Men's Shape Ups Lace-Up
review_body:
I've had my ShapeUps for just about a month now. At present, I use them exclusively on our treadmill, trying to keep them clean (it's still snowy and muddy here). I have to say, most of the other reviews seem to be correct. The shoe works muscles (calves, hamstrings, lower back)that I'm not used to using when I walk, and it seems to force you to walk more upright, improving your posture. They DO take some getting used to, though. When I first put the shoes on, they felt downright weird, and as folks have said, there is some muscle soreness in the beginning until your body gets used to them. I can't speak to weight loss, at least not yet. I have a wide foot (9 1/2 E), so I was concerned about the fit. I bought a half size larger in regular width as suggested, and they seem to fit well with maybe just a little sliding in the heel but not enough to be an issue. When I change into my well-worn NB's, I feel like I have newspapers tied on my feet.

Update:Well, I never did get used to these suckers and ended up trashing them. I won't say they made my back condition worse ... just added other aches and pains. One other thing: the uppers surely are not durable. The leather will scuff if you just look at it too hard. Don't waste your money as I did. Stick to your NB's.

review_body: I had to put a cushion on the ball portion of the shoe for extra padding, but they are so cute and everyone says they love them and would like them.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Novo Driving Shoe
review_body: I would have rated the shoes with 5 stars, but they run half a size larger than what I usually wear, besides that they are great.

product_title: Teva Women's Open Toachi Sandal
review_body: I bought these for our trip to Hawaii.  The first day I wore them in the tide pools, and when I went to wear them the next day the sole peeled apart on both shoes at the toe and heel!  Never had this happen to other Teva's that I owned.

product_title: Thorogood Men's Hellfire 10-inch Wildland Fire Boot with Removable Zipper 11 M
review_body: Okay, if your full time wildfire you probably want a bigger heel, taller boot and full leather laces.  I will say that I the full leather zipper and wildfire rated boot is above and beyond for a duty boot.  Unless your department requires steel toes they are great duty boots, sticky soles, good support and the scuff proof toes are nice if you're lucky enough to be with a department that has you do pushups you won't have to polish your boots.  Quick in, quick out and most 'all hazard' fire fighters have to be able to jump into wildland boots in a few seconds, not sit lacing them while the truck rolls out.  They look good enough they are also my station boots and though they're not steel toes, are my medic boots if i'm not in turnouts.  a little compromise to make them more broadly useful so 4/5.  But really happy.

product_title: Military Armed Forces Mens Black Sunglasses Polarized *
review_body: The pros: they look good, they're light but sturdy, and they conceal your eyes well without making it hard to see out of them, even in lower lights.    The cons: the hinges are stiff, and the polarization barely cuts down the glare.    One Year Later: No major complaints, but I do see what some reviewers were talking about with the hinges.  After banging them on my visor while getting in the car a few times too many, the right hinge has weakened, making them sit funny on my head.  The nose pads fell off after not too long, but to be honest, I just noticed it while looking at them one day.  Keep in mind, though, that these things have either been on my eyes, on top of my head, or thrown on the counter over the past year.  Even though I'm looking for a new pair now, I feel like I got more than my money worth out of them.

review_body: This is a great shoe for a great price. I am really disappointed it is too big, at least a half size. But since they don't have anything smaller than a 5, I will keep them.

product_title: Aquatik Men & Women Aqua Water Shoes - Beach Shoes with Velcro Lock (Note: Order One Size Smaller)
review_body:
I ordered these to wear in the locker room/shower area and pool area of our local YMCA. I've never been one to go barefoot and the tile floors can be treacherous when wet not only from people walking in and out of the showers, but also from the janitors using soapy mopwater on the floors. These shoes help me feel much safer in these areas. I still have to walk carefully, you can't just trapse around like you're in tennis shoes, but at least now I feel that I'm more in control of my footing.

I wear a 9 and I ordered a 9, which does have some extra room in the toe. However, in the water this actually ends up working like an abbreviated flipper/swim fin and helps me move through the water better while doing laps. The velcro strap makes them easy to take off and put on, and keeps them securely on my feet even though they are a bit big. The insoles do come out (intentionally!) to help the shoe dry quicker. A lot of people seem to be missing this fact. The insoles will bunch up once I get out of the pool and am walking back to the locker room, but I can live with that. These shoes aren't meant to be used for distance walking and it seems that a lot of people are rating them poorly for not performing in that capacity. I think the insoles bunch up because they are quite thin. A thicker insole would all but solve this problem, I believe.

For people complaining that these shoes take too long to dry, here is a suggestion. When I'm done swimming,I put a towel on the floor, turn the shoes upside down on the towel and stand on them in my street shoes. My weight helps squeeze excess water from the shoes into the towel. Then I put them in a plastic shopping bag so they don't get other stuff in my gym bag wet, and when I get home I leave them in the bathroom to dry. I swim almost every other day, and have never had them still be wet the next time I needed them. Setting them in front of a fan or register would also help them dry faster.

review_headline: I'm not a shoe aficionado-but I like them
review_body:
I have very normal feet and no extra problems leg problems that need any specific attention. I do spend a lot of time on my feet, though and I purchased these with the hopes of getting more muscle movement for the time I spend bustling around my shop.
I think they look a little weird and they are bulky, my husband laughs when he sees me wear them (kindly). But I have made it a habit to wear them to work, I thought the Mary Jane style looked a little more like a casual shoe and I like how they feel. On my feet (I did buy 1/2 larger, as suggested) they are very comfortable. Some of the shoes I have worn to work in the past have given me terrible aches in my heels and sometimes the balls of my feet. When I wear these, I have zero foot pain. I do know that I am using different muscles, because I can feel the tension in them as I move around. I have experienced muscle fatigue in my thighs, buttocks, lower abominals and lower back.
I have only been wearing them for a little less than a month, so I cannot say how they will hold up, or whether I will have any further gains in my muscle strength, but overall I am happy.

review_headline: Extremely Comfortable Out of the Box Gladiator
review_body: I love flat, leather, padded, comfortable sandals.  I tried these on last night at Nordstroms and now need to buy a pair.  Very comfortable right out of the box with no break in.  These will get even more comfortable as the leather breaks in. The straps are made of round rope like leather which is very comfortable on your feet. These round straps may even be softly padded.   They securely hold your feet with in the sandal, but do so without undue pressure.  These straps will require almost no break in, quite a feat!  They will even feel nicer as the sandal breaks in.  The foot bed leather is nicely padded and feels good to walk on.  This sandal will become very comfortable as it breaks in.  They also look very nice.  Actually they look great!  The brass rivets make them look rugged.  They fit true to size.  Keep making these!  If you love the feel of comfortable, flat sandals, you will love the feel of these.    I wrote this review over a month ago.  I'm just adding some further comments.   I finally go a pair a little over a week ago.  This sandal can be very addicting to wear as far as comfort goes.  I wore them every day for a week, then just had to give them a break.  The padding is not quite as thick as in some, but the foot bed lining has a feel of softness that just fools you.  It actually feels like it's has more padding than it does.  They are very comfortable to wear.  The straps do not hurt your feet at all from the very beginning.  DV made a similar product earlier this year.  I tried them.  The foot bed is the same, but the straps are of a different arrangement.  But it is quite amazing how much better these feel.  There is a synergy here that makes the wearing experience greater than the individual parts.  I highly recommend this sandal.  It has so many strong points.

From the moment those shoes hit the can, our lives were miserable - he was inconsolable, crying for his beloved dino-shoes, and evoking promises that I would buy him new dino-shoes if I found some in his size.    A couple days after the death of the dino-shoes, my favorite daytime show, \\"Colorado's Everyday\\" on Channel 2 had a segment about Dinosoles. I have to admit, the Halleleujah Chorus ran through my mind as I watched. I immediately hopped onto Amazon, and found the shoes - not only did they have his size, but they had his size in the T-Rex style, which happens to be his absolute favorite dinosaur.     The shoes arrived quickly, and are extremely cool. He is thrilled, and shows them off to everyone. The eye on the T-Rex lights up as he walks, as does the eye on the opposite side; the footprint on the sole makes a print on sand, albeit a faint one. The shoe seems to be well-constructed; I'll have a better idea of their durability once he's worn them for a few months. All in all, they are a hit! product_title: Lucchese® 1883 Mens Burnished Ranchhand
review_body: These are by far the most comfortable boots I own, even more comfortable then my Whites Semi Dress. The arch support is firm and placed just right. The leather is soft yet durable. I can wear these all day and my feet feel great. Classy and understated. I have pretty wide feet, and the wide size is perfect. HOWEVER, keep in mind, all the praises I am bestowing on the fit and comfort of these boots could be worthless to you. Every shoe/boot company uses 'lasts' to craft their footwear, which is basically a mold of the human foot. It just so happens that the last Lucchese uses closely resembles my foot in width and arch. It may not resemble yours, however, if these fit you half as well as they fit me, its well worth the price of shipping to find out.

Overall good, but needlessly expensive.

product_title: Vibram Five Finger Sprint - Women's
review_body: I wear a 5.5 US (=36 european) and have pretty wide feet, flat arches, and no heel bump (it doesn't stick out, and it's pretty low on my ankle).  I went to a brick and mortar store to try these on, and they had a 36 which was too big.  The guy sized me using the Vibram size guide and recommended a 35, which I ordered online.  Well, even with the velcro straps across the back, there's at least 1 cm of room behind each heel.  Cinching up the straps might actually make the fit worse because the contact point with your heel (if it's not a snug fit back there) will rub as you move (I use these for jump training and lunges of all sorts).  The tab on the back of the heel is really annoying and chafes a lot.  The toes fit pretty well.  The instep strap doesn't bother me.      In hindsight, I think the KSOs would fit me better because the back is just mesh and doesn't have that annoying pull tab sticking up to chafe your heel.  I've also read about people performing surgery on their VFFs to remove the tab, but only on the Classics, so I'm a little hesitant to do it with the Sprints.      Lastly:  Quality control is a bit off.  I bought the last pair of 35s in the mossy green color and the fabric was all puckered and there was a hole on the instep that someone (at the factory) tried to repair by loading it up with glue.  There was also a lot of extra glue on the inside of the shoe and the molds for toes (the rubber part) didn't have clean joins.  It really looked homemade, and I think I got either a prototype or a seconds -- and was charged full price.  So not cool.

review_headline: Gives new meaning to buttery leather

Once a handbag designer to the stars as well as a vice president to a major corporation, she began to design bags for \\"the rest of us\\" as in, ones that cannot afford thirteen hundred dollar bags. And her husband did the luxury line. And I definitely can say this bag is luxurious. The only reason I didn't give it five stars is because the lining is not sewn to the bag and it moves around (personal peeve). It is also very heavy. I carry around a big wallet, an umbrella, at least one book, keys, water bottle and other random odds and ends. When this bag is full it can be a bit cumbersome. All in all, definitely worth it. review_body: I purchased this to use as a carry-on during a recent trip to Europe. It did get a little heavy during some of the long airport treks, but the size was easy to handle through Security, and it fit nicely under the seat in front of me onboard and was therefore accessible during the long flights, so it was worth it.  It is very well made.  I'll buy more baggallini products.

product_title: Simple Men's Trekker Lo Lace Up
review_body: I have had these shoes for a week now and I have to say impressed would be an understatement.  I put a lot on the table and risked wearing them the day after I got them to work all day where I knew I would be standing the entire day. review_headline: Lights only last 6-8 weeks per Dinosoles Rep
review_body:
This is the email response I received from Dinosoles when I complained that one of my son's sneakers didnt't light up after 2 months. We went with a hat & we are looking forward to the 2nd generation T-Rex sneaker.

\\"Our apologies for the lights going out. We discovered that the lights are lasting approximately 6 - 8 weeks. We are working on getting longer lasting lights in our future shipments.

Luckily the shoes themselves are quite durable and will last much longer. With a new pair of shoes, the lights will probably only last as long as the current pair you have lasted.

review_body: My second pair ordered within 2 weeks.  Unfortunately for me size 9W, was no longer available as it was a week earlier. Its all about timing and size availability on a close out though.  For those lucky enough to find a pair of Clarks Falcons in a size you can use,now they are marked down to $19.95....damn!  But, you still need the $25.00 to qualify for the free shipping.  Oh well, its a great shoe that Clarks should not have discontinued.

product_title: Leather Shoulder Bag in Multiple Colors
review_body: I purchased the bag in burgundy. The advertising of this product by Shopzeus is terrible through Amazon. It does not say that the shoulder strap cannot be adjusted as it is secured with metal grommets at both ends. The photo either lies showing this, or I received a different bag.  The one I received has a strap too long, except maybe for someone over 6 ft. The product itself is made well except for the shoulder strap. Just a couple of clamps would have made all the difference.  The photo makes it look as if you can pull the strap through the clamp accordingly to shorten. product_title: Stacy Adams Men's Maestro Bicycle Toe Oxford
review_headline: Cheaper quality than expected. Save your money!
review_body:
I bought these shoes through Amazon and have owned them for about 6 months. To be honest I like the design, and I actually have had plenty of compliments about the shoes. They're decently comfortable at first, once you get used to wearing them. Do not waste your money though, and here is why.

These things have fallen apart rapidly. I wear them 5 days a week, granted, but 6 months worth of use and they fall apart? All I do is walk around the office in these things. They've really fallen apart in closer to 4 or 5 months, and are now just plain bad.

The leather scuffs and creases easily, and on the outside the sole of the shoe is already starting to separate away / splinter. For having leather soles, they do not fade well. The bottom of each shoe has ended up being a rough white scratchy color, which just looks bad. Other leather soled shoes I have seen don't tend to have this problem, or maybe they do and I've just never seen it? Also, the sidewall of the shoe where the leather connects to the sole, has torn on one of them.

Then, to top it off, on the inside of BOTH shoes the leather material that would typically press against the bottom of your foot has come up and entirely separated. So when I put these shoes on, I have to slide my hand into the shoe and press the material down. When I take the shoes off, the leather tries to stick to my sock and pulls up again. It's obnoxious and creates weird bumps / rises inside the shoe while wearing it. Cheap, cheap, cheap! It's like having really loose carpet that shifts around as people walk on it - in your shoe.

Given how well other Stacy Adams shoes were being rated, I suspected I was getting a fairly decent quality shoe. Turns out I couldn't be more wrong - even my $50 no-name loafers from Kohl's have outlasted these by leaps and bounds! Due to this experience I am entirely turned off from Stacy Adams and it will be a long time before I try their shoes again.

Credit to Amazon for having an accurate sizing chart. The size was spot on for me.

One star for the design.
One more star for the decent comfort, at first anyway... And because they actually come with decent shoe laces.
Two star rating in total. Boo!art. The size was spot on for me. One star for the design. One more star for the decent comfort, at first anyway... And because they actually come with decent shoe laces. Two star rating in total. Boo!

review_headline: Great bags. Tip for figuring size.
review_body: I own 6 of these bags. I love love love them. I need to say that if you choose one with the printed seatbelts (disney, dots, floral etc) that these bags are much stiffer than the plain solid color ones. I think that this is because the patterns are sprayed on not dyed in the seatbelts that this makes them stiffer. The medium tote is the same size as the baguette but one row of seatbelts taller. It is very easy to figure how big these bags are. Count how many seatbelts run up and down (the medium is 5) now go out to your car and look at your seatbelts, it is very easy to visualize how big they are. When counting only count one side not the ends. The ends and the bottom give you your depth. Most are 2 or 3 belts wide. You can just pull your seatbelt out enough to lay it side by side to see how big it is. Hope this helps. PS the smaller bags hold there shape better when sitting than the big ones do.

product_title: Men's ASICS Running Shoes | ASICS GEL-Nimbus 9 - Road Runner Sports
review_headline: Great Shoe-Cushioned comfort all the way
review_body: I've ran on these shoes about half a dozen times now ranging from 2.5 to 4.5 miles with no problems so far.  I highly recommend ASICS shoes for comfort and stability.  I also have wide feet and ASICS tends to offer shoes in wide widths.  I was running on ASICS Gel Cumulus 9, but I have to say the Nimbus 9 is a superior shoe.  The Cumulus' were great, but my feet could only handle about 3.5 miles before I would get some numbness in my feet.  My shins were also starting to hurt towards the tail end of my use, probably caused by the shoe breaking down and me running on them longer than its lifespan.  The Nimbus feels like a higher quality shoe with better comfort than the Cumulus.  I'll definitely be sticking with ASICS and probably stay with the Nimbus over the Cumulus.

I got really worried that the ones I ordered (which has yet to arrive) would fit horribly the same, but NOT AT ALL!  The ones I ordered online via Amazon looked fantastic!  The boots fit like a glove!  The boots at the outlet fit horrible because they must've been a fake or something!  So don't buy at the Outlet stores, you'll be disappointed due to fakes, or possibly imperfections.  You know the saying... you get what you paid for. product_title: BEARPAW Eva T Boot (Toddler)
review_body: I needed to find boots for my 2 1/2 yr. old son.  But most boots for boys are stiff and \\"clunky\\".  My son has a disorder that makes him a bit wobbley (weak muscles). So, when I found these boots I thought they'd be perfect...only they seemed to be adverstised for girls, and all the comments were about girls having them.  I finally got hold of a representative from another site and asked if the toddler size was just for girls.  She said they're for boys as well.  Yay!  I ordered them and my son walks in them with almost no problem!  I got the chocolate brown so they'd look extra boyish, too.  I LOVE these boots.  My only suggestion is they should make it clear that boys can wear these as well.

product_title: Men's Cat® Alaska FX Boot
review_headline: Not bad, but don't pay over $100 for these
review_body:
these are solid work boots. After about two days of 'break in' the padded ankle feels really good. As with most work boots, you'll probably want to buy a more supportive insole (I bought some Kiwi work insoles, very nice). The outsole is very chunky, i think its supposed to resemble the tire tread on Cat's earth moving equipment, but it seems to grip well enough- still no match for icy surfaces you'll encounter this winter, though. However, the boot did a good job keeping my feet warm at around 20 degrees one morning, with normal \\"athletic\\" cotton socks.

I can't say they're the best fasion statement, Doc Martens wear a little better in that department, but these are good boots and still look pretty sharp in black (nevermind the embossed bulldozer... its not that noticeable).

product_title: The SAK Eco Harmony Malboro
review_body: This purse was the color and size I anticipated but was very disappointed   in the workmanship. Was very flimsy and certainly not worth the price.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Mammoth Lined Clog
review_body: I love these Crocs.  They fit comfortably and I wear them all the time.

product_title: Neil M Men's Website Slip-on
review_body: I love these shoes. Wear them to work and they feel great. I own two pairs of Neil M shoes and I would say they are both slightly narrower than the average D width, which is perfect for me.

product_title: oh DEER! Women's Marshmallow Pump
review_headline: Great Shoes - run a little big
review_body: I love, love, love these shoes!  I bought them to wear with my wedding dress. :)    They run a little big (not enough for me to justify ordering a smaller size).  I am normally an 8.5, so that's what I ordered.  I don't know that I could have gotten away with an 8, but the 8.5 is a little big.      Beautiful shoes, as always!

product_title: Sperry Top-Sider Women's Camp Moc Oxford
review_body: I ordered them on Feb 18th with standard shipping and I got them on the 20th!!!

product_title: Ray-Ban RB 2113 Wayfarer sunglasses
review_body: Great price on a classic.  These are the real deal.  If you are into a retro classic look these are the shades for you.

product_title: Danclog Skagen Professional Clog Made in Denmark.
review_headline: Best danish clogs I have worn, as good or better than dansko
review_body: great product, shoe fits more true to size than sanita or dansko, I wear these all the time and find them so comfortable and quality the best.     I enjoy them a lot and well worth the money and a great savings.

product_title: Timberland Little Kid Field Boot
review_body: This is a great shoe and I'm glad I purchased it for my granddaughter. It is the perfect boot shoe to go with her uniforms for school.  Plus, it has held up under the punishment she puts on a shoe while playing at school.

product_title: Kamik Women's Powder Boot
review_headline: look great, but ripped after one season
review_body: These boots are super-comfortable and extremely cute.  However, after just one winter, the seaming near my toes ripped.  They now leak water, meaning I can only wear them in no-snow/rain conditions.  So much for snow boots.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Gang Active Casual Shoe
review_headline: Felt apart when used for walking around daily.
review_body: I wore this pair and walked around a city for two days and the seam in the front top part of the foot ripped.  Now I have a hole.

product_title: Columbia Men's Belize III Boat Shoe
review_body: Actually this is a good value. Just know that a boat shoe is full of holes and any little puddle will allow water to come through the sole.   Nice, light shoe.

product_title: Camper Men's Asia Leather Sneaker
review_body: I really like these shoes; they are comfortable, look great, and fit snugly in all the right places.     I put them away after three days of wear, however, because the front rubber band is already starting to peel away.   I'm saving them for less rigorous walking days (I walk to and from my studio, about 15 minutes, at least once a day).   I know Camper is a good brand, and maybe I just got a bad pair, but seriously: falling apart already?

product_title: Cole Haan Air Billie Mule Womens Shoes
review_headline: Best Everyday Casual Shoes on the Planet
review_body: I own the brown & white pair, which I got at the Rack at a great price.  I bought them for a boat trip I had coming up, and I thought they were a little better looking than some of the topsider options out there.      Since I bought them 5 months ago, they have become my favorite every day shoes.  I live in southern CA by the beach, so flip-flops are a common choice but I am finding myself choosing these over flip-flops nearly all of the time.      They are very comfortable, stay looking great even as they wear, and I get compliments on them all the time.  I'm definitely picking up another pair in another color!

product_title: Garvalin Infant/Toddler 814 Mary Jane
review_body: These are very comfortable & sturdy for little girls who just started walking.  Especially because it has non-slip soles, she can easily balance outside playing on the ground.

product_title: Genuine Leather Handbag with Cell Phone Holder & Many Pockets (Navy)
review_body: After searching for over a year, both in stores and on the Internet, for a navy blue purse, I found this one.  It exceeded my expectations as it holds everything I normally carry, is very lightweight, well-made, and a reasonable price.  I'm now using it everyday and don't have to bother with changing purses all of the time.

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Hacienda Boot
review_body: These boots are awesome!  Unlike with other finishes, I am not afraid to wear these shoes outside when it's been raining or snowing.  They're so comfortable and I've gotten so many compliments on them.  An added plus - they're mostly waterproof ;)

product_title: FootFitter 23.6" Long Shoe Horn - Made in Sweden
review_headline: When you have trouble bending your back
review_body: I have ankylosing spondylitis, and my back won't bend much. This is a _huge_ help getting my shoes on. Plastic ones break, sooner or later, and the cost of this one is worth it.

product_title: SLOGGERS Women's Garden Footwear (Clogs) - Red Size 7
review_body: I am sorry to say that my shoes arrived while I was away.  The shipper threw them into my yard and my dogs trashed the box (still haven't found it yet) and the shoes inside.  I have requested a new pair, but Plastex says I need to take up my displeasure with the shipper.  NOT.  The shipper is not supposed to put them in my yard (prior arrangement), but sometimes they tie a plastic bag to the fence.  The dogs trash them, too.  I had the same problem with Nordstrom's, but they were delightful and replaced any items torn or destroyed without any complaining.  I am very unhappy with this transaction.

product_title: Skechers Sport Men's Urbantrack Forward Casual Lace-Up
review_headline: Good looking shoes but low quality
review_body: I love the look of this shoes..classy and elegant for a pair of sneakers but after wearing them only 2 weeks the inside wore off significantly. On my other shoes usually the inside wear off after 2-3 months, I did not expect to wear it off so fast on this pair and even the outside sole show sign of wears after few weeks.

product_title: Taryn By Taryn Rose Women's Daring Loafer
review_body: These shoes are so pretty and such a disappointment.  They have an almost non-existent toe box. I suppose if you had small big toes then they might work.  My toes are pretty normal and even tho the size was accurate, the tops of my big toes felt a bit, well, put upon.  Believe me, I tried to make them work.  But after wearing them around the house for a short while, I had to take them off. Put on a 40 dollar pair of Sketchers and the difference could not be denied.  The Sketchers were COMFORTABLE. The Daring Loafers were not.  Taryn Rose is supposed to be an orthopedic specialist so I'm at a loss as to how she could have designed shoes that do not take into account that I have toes.

product_title: Circle Purse Pink
review_body: I knew I liked this purse when I saw it, but I like it even more now that I have it.  I have never gotten so many compliments on a purse before (and I have several designer purses).  I'd love to have one in every color!

product_title: Luichiny Women's Soleil Sandal
review_body: I usually love  Luichiny shoes, but these really were a disppointment!! The heel had color problems. Patches on them. The sandal part was poor quality pleather that scratched my skin. The picture is not true to the product!!  I hate them!!!!

product_title: Fit Flop Fit Flop - Women's
review_body: I wanted to love these shoes and had high hopes.  I wore them all weekend and developed a horrible blister on one foot from the thong.  Paid too much not to keep trying and hoping they work in!  I think if you wear a half size like I do it is hard to determine the right size.  The ladies in the shoe store thought I should go with the 8 and I usually wear a 7.5, due to the fact my heal was close to coming off in the 7.  But I think the reason I got blisters was because my one smaller foot slipped in the shoe.  Oh well back to lunges and squats for the slimmer legs.

product_title: Sag Harbor Valentine Tote
review_headline: Bring back the old sag harbor Valentine totes
review_body: This bag used to be smooth leather rather than this weird alligator skin pattern.  Plus the handle attachments look less sturdy in the picture now.  But historically, this is the BEST bag on the market, hands down--sturdy, perfect for keeping stuff organized!

product_title: Steven by Steve Madden Chrystie Large Tote
review_body: I purchase this bag for my mother and she love it because of the size. I personally didnt like it because of the denim material. But overall it is a cute bag

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Forget Me Not Boot
review_headline: Looks good when worn but quality is really poor.
review_body: Leather too thin and cheap. You can't tell Left from right shoe. Description did not include that it is a pull up. From picture, one would think it opens with a side or back zip. I feel cheated.

product_title: Bearpaw Womens Eva 12-inch Sheepskin Lined Boot
review_body: very good product. I also have uggs but i think this one is at the same level, warm and good quality

product_title: Bruno Magli Men's Riskor Oxford
review_headline: Very good shoes, just not sports shoes
review_body: Bought two pairs of those -- the first at Nordstrom, the second online. Both have been very comfortable, the stretchable part helping a lot with comfort. Satisfied, with one caveat. Extended use while standing/walking (e.g., lecturing for 6-7 hours or walking briskly  for a couple of hours) results in pain to the shins. I suspect it is the angle, as the heels are rather high (thought this was a plus, until the pain popped up a couple of times).    Bottom line: high quality, regret that they have been discontinued.

product_title: Crocs Women's Capri Flip
review_headline: My FAV's ... I wear them constantly
review_body: I ordered the gray with light blue insoles and love them.  I typically wear a 7.5 and a 7 fits perfect.  Like some of the other folks commented, these are my favorite flip flops and I find myself always grabbing them over all my others.  I even walk the dogs in them (in the woods).  Really good traction, even when wet.  They are super comfortable, good support and sturdy.  I've been wearing them all summer and they still look brand new.

product_title: Timberland Women's Nilas Tall Boot
review_body:
These are really nice boots. The leather is stiff, but I suspect it will break in and last forever. Construction is solid, and they look great.

Two things to note. First, a number of people commented about the shoe size running small. My wife was a 9.5, but with losing weight shrank to a 9. Because of availability and comments about sizes running small, I bought the 9.5 and it fit her.

Second, a number of people noted the large calf size. My wife is 5'6\\" and has a large calf that starts low. She could not close the boot, as the elastic top was above her bulge. It was close, and she's always struggled with boots, but it did not fit. We love the boot so much we are visiting a cobbler after the holidays to fix the problem.

I had a small issue with Amazon sending it to the wrong address; I can accept part of the blame, but their response to my questions was long yet accepted none of their responsibility or an attempt to make things right (they suggested, lamely, that my issues were a UPS problem now and made no attempt to refund shipping or even offer any help in reordering should the product come back undeliverable). That this all happened on the day before Xmas (I shipped 2-Day for this reason, and had nothing but a headache over those 48 hours) really made it a horrible experience.

In the end, the boots are great.

product_title: Kidorable Little Girls' Fairy Raincoat
review_headline: The most adorable rain jacket I've ever seen
review_body: Ok, I would never spend this much on a rain jacket but it was a gift to y daughter from family.  I was a little upset at first because I was hoping for a matching ladybug jacket since she has ladybug boots, but this jacket is even cuter than her boots!  It's a 4T which is a little big for her (she's a 3T now) but she loves wearing it, even inside.  I love the bell cuffs and how it flairs out at the bottom.  the little wings on the back tops off the cuteness factor .  If you have a daughter who loves fairies (like Tinkerbell) and is in need of a rain jacket, this is the one.

product_title: Tree Purse Hanger
review_body: this is a handy gizmo and I like having my handbag up off the floor in public places, the only thing I realized after buying it is there usually is an empty chair I can put my bag on so I don't always need the hanger but it does come in handy for when there is no extra chair.

product_title: pediped Flex Conner Sneaker (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_headline: Nice shoe, but slips off easily
review_body: I purchased this for my 15 month old son. This is his 2nd pair of Pediped shoes. We loved the first pair (the Aidan) so we bought this one... It's a great shoe, but at least on our son, it slips off his feet very easily. I'd like to point out that my son doesn't have a narrow foot or ankle, so I'm not sure why these shoes slip off his feet while others do not, perhaps it's because they don't have velcro closures.  We're still fans of this brand though!

product_title: Kamik Slosh Rain Boot (Toddler/Little Kid)
review_body: These are great boots. My daughter is very happy with them. They came in great time and are in excellent shape.

product_title: KATHY Van Zeeland Delicious Ball Shopper
review_body: This bag is absolutely gorgeous. I get complemented on this bag almost everyday. It is great...it is big but not to big and easy to tote.

product_title: botkier Kai Convertible Hobo
review_body: The official online shop of botkier is selling this bag for $357. Why is amazon selling for more...makes me wonder if everything on amazon is costlier than retail price???

product_title: Nine West Women's Mudpie Platform Wedge Slide
review_body: Very comfortable and cute. The fit is perfect, leather is good quality. Was unsure if the wood on platform would look good, picture makes it look a bit rough, much nicer looking in person.

product_title: GUESS Women's Leanna Sandal
review_headline: Black is Awesome; Med Red is Orange
review_body: I love the shoe, it's very sexy. Black goes with many outfits from casual to dressy. This is the 2nd black pair that I own.    However, medium red is really Orange.

product_title: Polo by Ralph Lauren Little Kid/Big Kid Brent  Sandal
review_body: My son wore these sandles for about 1 week before they came apart.  Thank goodness for the dollar store super glue; I was able to fix them very nicely.  If not, they would have been a complete waste of money.

product_title: Stewart/Stand Clover Texture Driving Wallet
review_body: Excellent product, but there is nowhere to put your money in this wallet.  As it's made of stainless steel, it doesn't stretch.  The description doesn't mention a place for cash, so the description isn't misleading, though. . .  My husband had to by another wallet for himself.  He had this one laying around, so I use it now and I love it.

product_title: Dyeables Women's Runway Sandal
review_body: These are very comfortable shoes, and they look really nice. The height of the heel is just perfect to wear for hours without causing my feet to cramp like other high-heeled sandals usually do. The only defect I found was that the straps on the left shoe seem to be a little loose in comparison to the right shoe. I can still walk okay with them, so I decided to keep them.

product_title: Simple Men's 2174 Sneaker
review_body: Very nice shoe for the weekend.  Nice alternative to old running shoes.  They certainly are better looking and go with more.  Flat shoe laces are interesting for the first couple times you use them, but otherwise, a very nice alternative.

product_title: Women's Medium Chalet Shoes 6 Dark Camel
review_body: I've been wearning these shoes less than a week, but so far I love them! They are very comfortable and warm, and best of all, easy to slip on when I'm running out the door for school, errands, etc.  Great shoe at a great price.

product_title: Reebok Women's DMX Walk Control
review_body: Definitely a good purchase for the price. I thought they would have been lighter but they are great walking shoes not so much for long running.  Only other defect is that they keep your feet warm and this would be good if I wouldn't live in Texas and facing the summer. But I would suggest these shoes to anyone who doesn't want to spend too much and have good quality.

product_title: Retro Rockers - Clear - Eyeglasses With Attitude
review_body: The clear glasses will offer UV protection and a slight amount of shade from sun glare, without the dark, heavy, vision-obscuring shade of black-tinted shades. Be advised though that the lenses on these are larger than they appear in the photos. If you have a smaller face they will look huge on you (but they still look cool).

product_title: Springboost Women's Motion Training Shoe
review_headline: The shoes do work alternate muscles
review_body: The shoes do work alternate muscles.  That seems to hold true.  I wear them walking.  I would not recommend jogging or running in these shoes.  The cushioning is not there for those activities.  They are awesome for walking.  They do relieve pressure from the front of the foot.  I would say they run true to size, but the width may be a little more narrow than normal, just a little.

product_title: adidas Little Kid/Big Kid +P Absolion TRX FG Soccer Cleat
review_body: I bought this in size 11.5 for little kids.  My daughter is very petite and this shoe is a great fit and protects her little foot well while playing pee-wee soccer.  Good comfort and good shoe.

product_title: Aerosoles Women's Squishing Trip Winter Boots
review_body: As a previous reviewer pointed out, the picture of these super-sweet boots comes nowhere near conveying the sheer awesomeness that is the Aerosole Squishing Trip boot. They're way hotter looking on actual feet.  I pretty much wear nothing but boots (don't know why, I just do), and so I need a boot that is not only great-looking, but also extreeeemely comfortable. In the past, I have contented myself with slightly uncomfortable shoes, simply choosing to purchase expensive Dr. Scholls inserts to cushion my high arches and over-burdened feet (I do a lot of standing & moving around in my line of work). Not anymore! The minute I put these on, I was in tarsus heaven--they fit like a glove! I suppose true-to-size is the boring way to put it. But more importantly, they do actually feel \\"squishy\\" to stand in, and not in that \\"I just stepped in dog poo\\" kind of way, but in more of a \\"I feel like I've got individual memory-foam mattresses tied to my feet\\" kind of way. VERY comfy. And they remain so even after they have been laced up.   That brings me to my one caveat: the **** laces. Just plan on buying new, snappier laces (instead of fancy inserts), because these puppies are determined to untie themselves, especially as you're walking across a wet parking lot next to your date, and make you kiss asphalt.  But, if you have to buy some $5 laces to get the rest of the benefits of these shoes (like, say, fuzzy insides that don't color-transfer all of your socks black, soles that are shaped & sized like real feet so you don't look like it's your first time walking, calf-high warmth that still circulates enough air so you don't inadvertently give yourself a foot bath inside your shoes, and oh, did I mention the fuzziness?), I'd say you've done well for yourself.  I'm certainly satisfied.

product_title: Sperry Top-Sider Men's Largo 3-Eye Sneaker, Taupe
review_body: I ordered three pairs of these shoes for entirely different guys.(My daughters 24 yr old boyfriend in Florida,38 yr old Veternarian friend,and my 53 yr old Southern husband. They all said pretty much the same thing. Loved them for their casual,clean look and comfort.Rare to please all three with the same thing!

product_title: adidas Little Kid/Big Kid FS180 Sneaker
review_body: These shoes take a beating and keep on movin'!  Very cute too. They fit like other addidas children's shoes.

product_title: Ariat Ladies 'Springbuck' Shoes - Black
review_body: Oh my goodness, I love these shoes!  I had been meaning to replace my old cowboy boots for the last couple of years, and finally broke down and started researching riding shoes and boots. I am sbout the pickiest person you'll find when it comes to what I ride in.  Right away, I was attracted to the Springbucks, really loved the look of them.  Sporty, zip up front, and great for riding. Something I could just slip into and go! I ordered the black, as the chocolate happened to be out of stock in my size.  Boy, am I glad I did!  They couldn't possibly be more comfortable, and they fit into the stirrup just great, also having the stirrup-friendly heel that is safe for riding, one of my biggest requirements.  They feel as if I could walk in them forever, not just ride, which was also a huge plus for me.  I wore them to go shopping, and they are as comfortable and supportive as higher end athletic shoes, in my opinion.  This is the first Ariat footwear I've owned, and I doubt I'll ever wear traditional cowboy boots again.  When these wear out, you better believe I'll go right out and get another pair.

product_title: Ariat Women's Harbor Sandal
review_body: at the moment, i have morton-like symptoms on my left foot and a stressed achilles on my right foot.  i was looking for sandals that would offer sole support, ankle stability, and not allow my foot to shift much while.  these are all that and upscale casual stylish.  they were comfortable immediately.  i sought this brand due to its solid rep with riding boots.  i'm completely satisfied with the sandals and recommend them to anyone with any type of footwear needs.

product_title: KEEN Men's Summit County WP Winter Boot
review_body: I work as a land surveyor so I was looking for winter boots that will keep me warm for a whole day. I tried those boots in every situation (snowshoeing, powder, slush...) and they passed the test especialy keeping my toes warm. Keen dry works even better then I thought!

product_title: BIG BUDDHA Tyler Tote
review_body: I'm not a big girl, so I was surprised at how large the bag was (about 11 x 17), but it's perfect for me to take to work. Can hold my water bottle, lunch, notebook, and a sweater. Great pockets inside and out to store small stuff so you don't have to search the entire bag for your cell phone or a pen. The metal rings on the handle and the main zipper are a bit awkward.

product_title: Crocs Unisex Mammoth Lined Clog
review_body: Awsome product. I could not believe how comfortable these things are. Having a size 14 foot makes it hard to find slippers, and these are the best I have ever had.The liner also keeps your feet at the right temp. Not too hot, not too cold.

product_title: C1RCA Women's ALW50 Mid Casual Sneaker
review_body: OK, it pretty alright but kinda stiff. I always thought shoes should be comfortable but this needs breaking in first. It's high cut and it rubbed on my ankle while walking, definitely need taller socks. The flap is a bit narrow and you can feel something bulky at the base of your little toes, it's not sharp just a might uncomfortable. I bought this because it looks soft but my rubber shoes are more gentle than this. Anyway, it looks great. You just need to suffer for awhile and hope it's not your feet that needs breaking in.

product_title: Reebok Men's MLB Tie Dye Flip Flop
review_body: These flip-flops are very attractive.  However, it seems that they are meant to be over-sized.  I am size 10.5 but they only have size 10 and 11, so when I put them on, they seem to be comfortable, but there is about an inch between the end of my toes and the front edge.  Therefore, if you have an in-between shoe size like myself, consider rounding your size down(If 10.5, consider getting a 10, unless your toes are huge.)

product_title: KALE Cameron Flap
review_body: This is a great purse, nice quality/size, and I love the fuscia lining and inner storage pockets.  They are the perfect size for my cell phone and gps.

product_title: BEARPAW Milan 489 Womens Nailhead Suede Sheepskin Shearling Clogs Mule Shoes Black/Sand
review_body: I bought these shoes because I wanted to try something different, and they looked comfortable. The fur lining does make these shoes really comfortable and soft, but there is so much fur that it just ends up looking awkward. The actual shoe seems even furrier than the picture. The fit is true to size, but definitely snug. I ordered medium width, and wouldn't have wanted them any narrower--and I don't have wide feet. I am returning them, so I didn't walk around a lot in them, but I can imagine the snug fit becoming uncomfortable quickly, especially if worn without socks. Overall, these shoes have a cheap look to them--they kind of look  like they're made of rubber--and are no more than what you would expect for $30.

product_title: Circo Pnk TG Dalila Ballet - 11.0
review_body: My daughter absolutely loved these shoes. They sparkle, but not the kind of sparkle that wears off easily or gets everywhere. She has a very narrow foot and the strap on the top helps keep these on. We are very pleased with this purchase.

product_title: Nine West Women's Jaiya Peep Toe Slingback
review_body: This shoes size is a little on the big side. My shoes size has always been 7 and half, but this shoes wears a little loose. So you should buy a half size smaller than you normal shoe size.

product_title: Sesto Meucci Women's Eddis Mule
review_body: These are quite lovely - a little short, but they are really cute and  fun and comfortable. They took me a little while to break in, but love them now.

product_title: Etienne Aigner Bruckner Tote
review_body: Spacious, elegant, real leather, a name associated with quality.  Allows you to organize your possessions and goes with any outfit.  My wife has been enjoying it since last Christmas and it is holding up well.

product_title: N.Y.L.A. Women's Micki Pump
review_body: Very cheaply made shoes.  Bottom soles feel off 1st time I wore them.  Have never bought this brand of shoes before, will never buy them again.

product_title: Bacco Bucci Men's Culina Oxford
review_body: My husband says \\"Good Leather, and stiching. Painful the first few days, but broke in quickly. Color on soles seems to wear off easily. All in all a great dael.\\"

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Basic Instinct Pump
review_body: OMG, This pair is one of those \\"it's all about the shoes\\".  I got the black/white pair and boy did I get compliments.  True to fit and comfortable.  Love my Naughty Monkeys.

product_title: Latico Women's Ava Buckle Shoulder Bag
review_body: I have received a lot of compliments on this purse.  I love Latico purses and this one does not disappoint.  Definitely a good deal, too!

product_title: Sugar Little Kid/Big Kid Scrunchagami Polyester Shoe
review_body: I got these for my 7 yo and she loved the look, but the ribbon that ties it together broke before she even wore them once.  I'm going to sew it back on, but that says a lot about the quality of this product.

product_title: indigo by Clarks Women's Imagine Pump
review_body: These shoes may look different but still have the same quality and fit of Clarks.  They are comfortable and true to size and look and feel good.

product_title: Nine West Women's Tavinos Platform Slide
review_body: The inside appears like velvet and it seems wearable and attractive. It is O.kj for the price

product_title: Hi-Tec Men's Altitude IV Waterproof Hiking Boot
review_body: This is an excellent light-medium weight boot.  I wanted to find a reasonably priced hiking boot for weekend trips.  This boot meets all of my expectations.  It is light but sturdy, waterproof but still \\"breathes\\" and it fits according to the size listed.  This is not a heavy boot for large pack trips but should be more than enough for light trips.    The seller delivered as promised and gave link for tracking.  I would defintiely buy from this seller again.

product_title: Kenneth Cole REACTION Women's Bard Tender Boot
review_body: I bought these for my daughter and she loved them.  Had a problem with the first pair and Amazon had a new pair at my door within 2 days - great customer service!  She says they are very comfortable and true to size.

product_title: Propet Women's Mary Jane
review_body: I liked these shoes a lot. I ordered them a little big, and they are holding up quite well.

product_title: Warmbat Unisex Gecko Grip Tall Sheepskin Boot
review_body: I absolutely love these boots, they totally rock! I was very pleased with the speedily delivery

product_title: Xhilaration® Slouchy Hobo Bag - Black Plaid

review_headline: My second pair.  Love them.  Sloppy quality control on the green heel label.
review_body:
First off, they are made in China, should you wonder.

This is my second pair of PFs, and I love them. In fact, I may not buy another pair of shoes from another company. BUT, my one gripe about this pair is that the green square \\"PF\\" logo on the heel is cut badly. The white \\"PF\\" is nearly cut in half. Not a big deal, but where is the quality control here?

There is not much to say beyond the fact that they are made from excellent materials and the construction of them is top-notch (beside the heel label thing I mentioned.)

The insole is very comfortable. If you are used to Converse, you will be in for a pleasurable surprise when you put these on: no longer do you have to put up with a flat, uncomfortable and unsupportive insole. The PF Flyer insole is contoured to your foot and will make you wonder why you kept buying those Converse shoes. Oh, the price, right, Well, pay a few more dollars and get something that is more stylish, more comfortable, and NOT made by Nike. (New Balance Shoes owns PF Flyers.)

product_title: Stacy Adams Men's Reginald Oxford
review_headline: Move Aside, Imelda Marcos!  Men, get your groove on.
review_body:
Just when you thought the recession was rendering all luxuries inaccessible, Amazon positively breaks the bank with its shoe sales (find 4-5 of these under twenty bucks, and the next pair is free). Granted, the rule of demand vs. supply factors heavily into these deep discounts, so be prepared for some compromises--and felicitous discoveries (like colors in blue and green).

Occasionally, the difference of a mere half size will equate to a hundred bucks or more, so count yourself lucky if yours is the right number. And be prepared to develop a taste for the sexy, elongated and more pointed European look. Also, if you'd rather be assured that you won't have to return the shoes, bear in mind that laced Oxfords are more likely to fit right out of the box than slip-ons (often \\"slip-offs,\\" unless you don't mind doubling up on socks).

These Stacy Adams fit perfectly, and they're close enough to albino white to meet the requirements of some of the \\"senior-musician\\" band leaders I work for. But I've found some black Stacy Adams for the same price and same comfortable fit. (Best remember that the Europeans have this thing for length--sometimes an inch longer on the outside but true to size where it counts--on the inside.)

Stacy Adams is a company that has its shoes made in China up to exacting standards, unlike some of the other faux Italian shoes--Bacco Bucci, Giorgio Brutini--that strike me as more style than substance. Kenneth Cole is another shoe that consistently passes the quality test, though its ware is manufactured in India. But if you want an Italian original (no sweat-shop guilt), it's almost impossible to go wrong with Donald J. Pliner (Gucci at a discount) or, just slightly below it, the Spanish-made Mezlan brand.

The point is that you no longer need confine your horizons to Hush Puppies and Skechers and limit yourself to one pair of new shoes every 2-3 years. Don't be surprised if you don't see Obama sporting something stylish along these lines (made in the U.S.A., of course--on the other hand, we've got a lot of work to do with repairing international relations. A pair of cosmopolitan shoes would certainly be a simple, thrifty beginning. I wonder if the French make men's shoes).ines (made in the U.S.A., of course--on the other hand, we've got a lot of work to do with repairing international relations. product_title: Sorel Caribou Snow Boots for Men
review_headline: Probably your best choice for a warm basic snow boot
review_body: These 10\\" high winter boots set the standard for basic cold weather boots in snowy conditions. They're probably the boot most commonly worn by locals in snowy Western mountain towns.     But be advised there is not a lot of lateral stability in the sole of the boot. That is to say, the rubber bottoms tend to twist sideways making them, in my opinion, unsuitable for anything other around town use and possibly some work situations. The twisting motion makes traveling off beaten paths, especially climbing hills or side hilling, more difficult and tiring.    My seven year old (Canadian made) Sorel Caribou models have somewhat thicker and probably more water resistant leather uppers, but the current (Chinese made) Sorels seem to have more advanced combination synthetic and wool felt liners and apparently much-needed additional underfoot insulation.     These boots have a cool look with the faux shearling collars but their relatively modest height means you will need to wear gaiters to keep out snow if you leave beaten paths.     Felt lined pacs are typically the warmest boots for the bucks and the liners can be taken out to dry.  I've washed my Sorel liners on gentle cycle using wool-friendly soap with excellent results and spraying some Armorall (used to perk up rubber and plastic in cars) on the rubber bottoms keeps them looking great as well.     Recommended to anyone who wants a warm, foolproof, traditional looking boot to wear in around-town or to cold weather outdoor events, keep in the car for emergencies and possibly wear to work or riding snow machines in really cold weather.
