review_headline: Uncomfortable, badly made and looks cheap
review_body: I bought these leopard UGGS as they looked cute in photos and like the different \\"leopard\\" style with jeans.  Read the review on here and thought perfect.  I wear a size 7.5 and my daughter's size 8 basic brown UGG is huge on me. So I took the advice of a user review on here and bought the size 7 (she said it clearly ran a whole size big and that she was an 8 and her feet fit perfectly)?  I thought I could share this with my daughter who wore an 8.  I can't see how that rule of a whole size bigger is true? I rec'd the boot and it is fairly tight.  I am sure it will stretch but my toes tend to touch the front.  I was never a fan of the UGGS when they first came out..find them ugly but do like some of the newer styles and thought the hype was for comfort and \\"quality\\"??  I was looking for somethng comfortable and was told the reason these boots run so expensive is their comfort (not necessarily their looks).  What a joke!  Stick with the payless knock off brands..the boot was very uncomfortable to put on..the heel area was hard and un-giving, jerks your foot when putting on/off, it runs tighter than expected and is no more comfortable then a stempled, Kmart snow boot.   Also, the leopard print was more a reddish brown in person and looks cheap.  My 13 year old daughter who only buys for name and popularity told me she thought they looked cheap and I thought she would be stealing them from me.  I would not buy this boot and will not buy Uggs in the future.

I now have to spend another $8.50 plus whatever it costs to ship the sunglasses to fossil just to get them to put the little, rubber pieces back on so the screws won't continue fall out. product_title: Reusable Grocery Tote w/ 2 Corner Bottle Holders, Oatmeal 4 Pack
review_headline: Really nice bags, just not exact to photo
review_body:
These bags arrived in decent time. They actually are a bit smaller, and not as thick, as I thought from the photo. That could have just been me though. You can imagine the size, because of the fact they can hold up a bottle of soda. They are mesh-like. I have one of those mesh re-usable bags from Target (which started to give, but I truly used it to it's death!) and these bags are a decent amount thicker than that one. I've used them about six times for groceries now, and stuffed them to their limits! They seem surprisingly strong so far! They can hold quite a bit (I have a family of three and have only used all four twice).
I'm not sure if it's that important, but, I liked the oatmeal color of the bags. But, when they arrived, they were actually a darker tan color. The inside soda flaps matched a the dark tan and were not the green in the photos. It's not a big deal. But, I thought that was a little strange.
The reason they stand on there own is not because of their own strength or thickness. There is actually a black flat piece that lays in the bag--when you open the bag, you push it easily down to the bottom and it is what holds that bag up. It sounds annoying. But, it's actually quite a habit now. I just wasn't aware of that factor at purchase time. It's a nice little trick.
Overall, they are durable and seem like they will get the job done. They came with a FREE surprise of a hot/cold bag. It's not as big. But, it says it keeps things cold for up to six ours! I had it in a very hot car for about an hour and it was still ice cold when we arrived home. I also got a cute little pen. Ha!

review_body: These extremely adorable and potentially comfortable boots gave me a horrible shock when I tried them on: my moderately chubby calves are too big to fit in them!  I can't even fit my leg in there, much less tuck my pants in.  What makes it worse is that the shipping was delayed for some reason, so I've been waiting eagerly for these boots, and for what?  I'm just glad I got them before the price hiked twenty dollars, so I don't feel quite so ripped off.

product_title: Carmen (9.0 B, White)
review_body: I absolutely love the shoes. They were everything I thought they would be. Shipping did take awhile but was expected.

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Strate Over the Knee Flat Boot
review_body: In an episode of Gossip Girl, Blake Lively wears Serena van der Woodsen grey suede boots which look almost exactly like these which are 1/8 of the cost.  These run true to slightly smaller than size, but have little support or traction.  The traction problem was something I ran into when walking over marble floors after it had rained and slipped just because of the style of the boot with a small heel and very smooth flat toe.  Other than that, I love the boots and they look great with mini skirts and over jeans and if you want to be a Gossip Girl, a school uniform.

product_title: Anne Klein New York Women's Bahia Slide
review_body: These slides are so cool that the moment I received them, my daughter grabbed them and went off on Spring Break to Acapulco with them. I had to order another pair!  They are as comfortable as can be and so pretty, and I get compliments whenever I wear them.

product_title: Baby Sequin by Special Occasions, 9.0 B, Gold
review_body: These were not comfortable, didn't look as good as picture, and the return policy was terrible!  I didn't realize I wasn't keeping them until a few weeks later, and therefore could not return them.

product_title: Xhilaration® Sienna Ribbon Pumps - Black
review_body:
The feeling of these pumps is even more comfortable than the price.
Just looks great and feels great.

product_title: Baroque Large City Tote bag or City Shopper ~ Reisenthel, Germany
review_body: I bought this bag to use  for groceries. I've found that I use it more for every day use! I like it so much, I am buying my sister-in-law one for her to use when she moves to Germany. Very sturdy and fashionable. I've received many compliments.

product_title: Capezio Women's Jr. Footlight Character Shoe - 550
review_body: I hated formal ocasions due to the uncomfortable shoes that go with the outfits. Having dancers in the family, these shoes were suggested as a solution. My other sister works in retail and bought the T-strap for work and is very pleased. Street shoes don't breathe well and get uncomfortable after an hour or two, while these have several more hours of comfort in them and breathe very well. I intend to terst all the different styles.

product_title: Teva Women's Open Toachi Sandal
review_body: Was looking for a good water shoe diverse enough for wearing on the boat, on the beach, and walking in general on land.  I read a bunch of reviews.  These shoes live up to all the praise & glad I chose to spend a bit more $ than I expected to.  My prior water shoes were Nike, bought on sale for $35, purchased almost 10 years ago.  Nike no longer made them so I had no sense of direction on where to go or what to look for or what I really wanted.  Hard to judge shoes like these on the internet.  Thanks to all who wrote reviews & helped me make my decision.  I was a bit concerned about how comfortable shoes would be with the water drainage technology, etc.  I'm thrilled with them.  Size is to fit - I'm a 9 1/2 often stuck buying size 10.  These 9 1/2's fit perfectly & fit very well & comfortably.

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Sno Ball Wedge Boot
review_body: these boots are AWESOME!! i can't believe the deal i got on them at $24!!! they are currently selling for over $100 on zappo's so i am more than happy with this purchase. the heel is the perfect height, rather comfortable in my opinion. the upper part that hugs the calve also has a fleece-like lining for extra warmth and the shoe fits true to size; i bought it in the 6.5 and with socks on i still have plenty of room in the shoe. BUY THESE NOW before they run out!

product_title: Lafuma Khumo Sneaker
review_body: Granted, I have only worn these shoes for one day, but they feel good. They're light on my feet and feel like I could walk miles in them. The material is good and there's alot of hippie literature that comes attached to the shoes. So even though they're made by children in Vietnam, I know my purchase of these shoes planted a couple of trees, fed a panda, gassed up an anti-whaling boat, or some other earth friendly junk. I'm sick of $30 sneakers falling apart in 6 months. So I am hoping this pair will last. 4 stars, only because I don't know how long they will last.

product_title: Dearfoams Women's Microfiber Velour Memory Foam Slipper
review_body: These slippers would be very comfortable if it weren't for the placement of the \\"Dearforms\\" label.  It is sewn in the inside heel area of the slipper and the corners of it (the label) curl/stick up and constantly poke your feet.  It feels like one of those annoying plastic price tag holders is embedded in the insole making them impossible to wear. If you actually want to walk in slippers, these aren't for you.

product_title: Jessica Bennett Women's Dusk Gaucho Boot
review_body: These boots were a great purchase.  They are well crafted and the height wears comfortably.  No padding at the bottom so not ideal for long periods of walking.  The shade of dark brown and gold accents are very stylish and they go great with jeans.

product_title: Women's Dunham Greenland Oxford WR5953 (11 B U.S. in Black)
review_body:
I am thrilled with this shoe. I have chronic foot problems and this make of shoe has been the most comfortable shoe I have found. I bought my original pair about 5 years ago from a big shoe company close to where I live. When the company discontinued carrying them, I found the shoes available on-line, much to my delight. The service has been excellent as well. My order arrived well within the time specified and I will certainly be ordering again at a later date.

Thank you!!!

review_body: these shoes are nice. they run a little on the small side in my opinion. i am usually a perfect size 5 with sweat socks on and i will have to wear thinner socks for these puppies. no big deal, otherwise i am quite pleased with them.

product_title: SM New York Women's Destini Slingback
review_body: I love the shoes - very cute and can be worn for casual or dressy! I've gotten compliments every time I've worn them! They are a little tight on the toes, but I got creative and cut some cushions to fit in the shoe (and attached them with double stick tape) where the toes rub, and they're fine!

product_title: Clarks Women's Love Note Boot
review_headline: Boots-Sharp As A Tac, Rusty As Nail
review_body: I really love these boots.  The texture is soft and they fit well.  They are slightly more roomier, but I wouldn't suggest getting a smaller size. Add a foot pad, if you feel you are sliding, and you're good to go.  They are sturdy and go great with skirts and pants. I think you have to break them in a little. But because of the soft leather, this will not be hard to do. All in all I really enjoy these boots. They are sharp as a tac and rusty as a nail. In my mom's terms, these are some hot boots!

product_title: ECCO Women's RXP 3040 Running Shoe
review_body: It was my first purchase of any shoes from online.  I was glad cuz the shoes fit my feet very well. It is very light and has nice cushion.     The one downside I think is that this shoe does not have good support for the arch.

review_body: i bought this bag in navy for a special event and i'm so glad i did.  it's a great size--holds exactly what i needed it to. not too big, not too small.  handles are nice length.  nice complement of the snakeskin and fabric.  love the metal accents. great price too. will definitely be a buyer of her purses.

product_title: High Quality Impact-Resistant Aviator Sunglasses - Pack of 2
review_body: The product seems to be fine but I paid to have them delivered in three days and it took five. This was a little upseting because I needed them for a halloween party but other than that the sunglasses are fine.

product_title: Tennies Women's Tina Sneaker

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Bazille Boot
review_body: Beautiful boot! the only problem I have with it is not amazons fault, the boot is leather so it is not steretchy, therefore if you have small legs like me it may not fit tightly. I still love them and I'm keeping them, I'll just wear thick socks!

product_title: Madden Girls Women's G-Zarahh Boot
review_body: These boots are great- I wear them daily in NYC. I did put a little insole in there to up the arch support because I felt that they were much too flat on the inside- but once I did that they were perfect and I comfortably wear them every day. They are not great for cold though as my feet do get cold in these sometimes when it is freezing outside.

product_title: 2007 Shimano SH-M225S Mountain Bike Shoes
review_body:
I bought these shoes to replace my previous Shimano shoes which were a bad fit. The M225S are a pleasure to wear on long rides. The lightweight carbon heel/bottom makes the shoe feel strong yet very light. As with all Shimano shoes, cleat mounting is a breeze. The sockliner is also quite comfortable, not too hard and not too soft, and should fit most people unless you need orthotics. Energy transfer is excellent and I felt an instant improvement in my pedaling, most likely due to the stiff sole.

The spikes are good for trail walking when you really need to get off your bike. These shoes also really keep the dirt away. Highly recommended!

product_title: BC Footwear Women's Outta This World Ballet Flat
review_body: I'm wearing these right now.  They are great around the house and indoor shoes. I wear 7.5 and the size 8 fits perfectly. I like the elastic around the heel.

product_title: Moda Spana Women's Neala Bootie
review_body: The Moda Spana boots have been a wonderful edition to my boot collection. They are comfortable and sleek looking. Everyone should have a pair.

product_title: Propet Women's Wash & Wear Slip-On
review_body: I'm really not that old - but I'm finding that I'd rather wear slip-ons than lace-ups for work (surgery) and general knocking around. I saw these a couple of years ago online and decided to get a pair. Then another pair, then more. They're good-looking, EXTREMELY COMFORTABLE and you can throw them in the washing machine if they get dirty. I did that a couple of times with both my blue gardening shoes and my white and navy pair. They looked just fine after the washing and wore just as before. I have four pairs in different colors and plan on getting more before they stop production. My 85-year-old mom loves these as her traveling shoes because they're lightweight and pack well, so now she has three pairs too.  Great shoes!!!

review_body: I'm not typically a shoe person, usually I tend to own one pair of sneakers until they basicly disintergrate from use. review_body: As a large footed person (14s) I'm always hunting for shoes that don't come off looking like clown footwear.  These Converse suede shoes fill that requirement.  They look great and are very comfortable.  The steel toe can't be felt from inside the shoe and they lace up tight.  They feature a flat sole and reflective material which adds to a nice urban look.

product_title: Steve Madden Women's Feud Boot
review_body: I ordered these boots in both the black and gray.  The gray is significantly lighter in person than what is shown in the amazon image, which looks the same as black.  I had seen these from another seller, so I knew this, but for someone wanting charcoal gray these are not that dark.  I am in love with the way these boots look.  They lace up the back so the fit on the shaft is pretty customizable.  However I'm a runner and usually find boot tight and these I have laced as tight as they will go and they still fit loose.  So if you have very thin calves be aware.  The heel is pretty low, and there isn't a lot of rigidity in the ankle portion of this boot.  The leather is soft though and I expect to get a lot of wear and use out of these boots.

product_title: Bandolino Women's Yanni Pump
review_body: These were too narrow on the ball of my foot, even though I already own other shoes of the same brand.  Had to return them.

product_title: Rhino Red Women's Chalsie Sneaker
review_body: My daugher loved the look of these.  However, they are very stiff and she has the blisters to prove it!

product_title: Simple Shuf Clog - Women's
review_body: The Simple Shufs -- perfect for \\"shuffling\\" around in. Obviously these are slippers for wearing around the house, since they're made of wool felt and aren't waterproof. review_body: My son has Fred Flintstone feet.  Stride Rites are the only shoes we buy and love getting good deals on them at amazon.  These are good shoes, stylish and durable.  I love that they have a scuff-proof surface on the toe, I've made the mistake of buying the all white leather ones which I loved the look of for about a day until they were hopelessly scuffed up. Also these go with more outfits then you might think BUT buy new flat laces or you will be tying them constantly.  Really, CONSTANTLY!!  I've found all Stride-Rite shoeslaces to be this way.  Also little shoes laces are not easy to find so you might order them here on good ol' amazon.

product_title: Clic Adjustable Front Readers - Strength +2.5
review_body: Purchased these readers for my husband.  Makes him think he's the medical examiner on a t.v. show.  He loves them!

product_title: Skechers USA Men's Tier Canvas Moc Toe Slip-On

One note on casual shoes like this. I personally like a shoe with a bit less traction. These are almost on a par with a basketball shoe for traction. I am too lazy to pick up my feet so I sometimes \\"trip\\" myself with my slouchy walk. This would be a better shoe if it had a smooth sole at least in my middle-aged foot-dragger world.

product_title: AK Anne Klein Women's Greca Bootie
review_body: I recently bought these boots and they were so comfortable that I was able to wear them 8 hrs at work the first day I wore them!  The black suede is very rich looking and fits like a glove.  This is the second pair of Anne Klein boots I bought because the first pair were so great.  The I-flex sole makes them extra comfy and they are very stylish for dressy pants or jeans.

product_title: Reebok Men's Ignited Run Running Shoe
review_body:
The Ignited Run has been my first experimentation with Reebok running shoes within the past 6 years. While the Ignited Run sneakers feature a snazzy \\"clear\\" material on the outboard portion of each heel, they don't have any gimmicks like bubbles filled with inert gas or \\"shock absorber\\" pods on the heel. They feature a nylon/cordura loop on each heel and have some synthetic suede leather on the toes which tend to get dirty quite easily. The tread material is extremely stiff and hard, making it unsuitable for running on tarmac, ESPECIALLY wet tarmac. The tread pattern is of a criss-cross waffle, but is nowhere as good as the Nike Waffle/Zoom competition racing shoes. The Ignited Run is also extremely heavy and the materials are poorly constructed. The loop on each heel is already pulling apart at the stitches. In addition, the lack of a cinch loop on the tongue allows the tongue to shift all about during storage. I tend to wrap my laces under the lacing to prevent flapping and loosening, but I have to re-adjust the tongue before wearing the sneakers each time.

Pros:
-Snazzy exterior design.
-Comfortable for walking, driving, and running on soft dry surfaces.
-Great cushioning, thick outer layer material.
-No gimmicks to fail.

Cons:
-Extremely hard tread compound with poor tread design. It \\"clacks\\" when running on cold or wet surfaces that are hard, like wet tarmac. It hurts my feet after running 1 mile.
-Extremely poor traction on wet surfaces. I've almost slipped on wet tarmac in a few instances.
-Lack of cinch loop on tongue.
-Cheap stitching for loops on each heel. Do not use them to facilitate the ingress of your feet into the shoes, they will rip apart after awhile.
-Lack of reflective material. I only found a few spots that had reflective material so I wouldn't use these at night.

Overall, I don't have any issues wearing these for casual activities, work, or driving. They fall extremely short when used as running sneakers though and since they were advertised for this purpose, I will have to give them only 2 out of 5 stars.ly short when used as running sneakers though and since they were advertised for this purpose, I will have to give them only 2 out of 5 stars.

review_headline: Cute but uncomfortable & not exactly bringin the boyz to the yard

product_title: SANUK Men's You Got My Back
review_body: I first came across these online and wasn't sure what to think of them. I was able to try them out at a local store and was quite amazed. Although I have flat feet, the soles conform to my feet for natural arch support. The canvas upper is breathable and comfy with or without socks. One thing I did notice at the store is that color does vary slightly from pair to pair (my black pair is slightly lighter than the images on another [[ASIN:B0010TIHBO Sanuk Men's You Got My Back? Sandal Shoe]] page). Given the sandal bottom, I am inclined to think that the soles will be the determining factor when it comes to product life. That said, the very bottom is a lot harder than the rest of the sole (you can see that layer if you zoom in on the images via the above link). I lucked out in that my store pair was only $30, so I recommend looking around before paying much more. (As of this posting, the highest vendor price on Amazon is $49 and, as much as I adore these, I couldn't see paying that much for them.)     Additional info/claims from the tags included with my pair (I'm not a podiatrist so I can't vouch for their validity): Sidewalk surfers offer natural torsion, flex and width control. \\"The loose upper allows your foot to spread so it can absorb shock naturally. This strengthens the small muscles which support your arch and encourages you to walk correctly.\\"     I'll close with an interesting piece of trivia: According to the creators of street surfers, Sanuk is the Thai word for \\"pursuit of happiness.\\"

product_title: Western Chief Frog Rain Boot (Toddler/Little Kid/Big Kid)
review_body:
We've been buying Western Chief rain boots for my son since he was 20 months old. We are on our 5th pair and I'm placing an order for our 6th and 7th pairs (as I have to pay duty). Oh, and a second pair for me! Red.

I love them. My kid loves them. He would wear his boots for any occasion... if I let him.

We've always bought the correct size for him. The only time the sizing seemed off was with a pair of Lady Bug boots - too small. So, I just wrapped them up and gave them to a friend's daughter for her birthday. They are just that classy - kids love them. My son has had two pairs of the frog boots, two pairs of the bumble bee boots (I have a pair of these as well and they've held up well to my heavy duty gardening antics), and one pair of dinosaur boots.

I'm so surprised that others have had a bad experience with these boots. I've found the Western Chief boots to be the cadillacs of rubber boots. I pass them down to my nieces and nephews and they are still all going strong. Well-loved. Well-used. Well-worn.

review_body: This shoe looks amazing on and it is not difficult to walk in. product_title: Bacco Bucci Men's Fleming Zippered Shoe
review_body: These shoes are fantastic. The price is very good. They are comfortable, and have a great look. The zipper is fun and ads a bit of whimsy. Very good value!

product_title: Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Top Red
review_body:
Okay, I love these shoes. LOVE them. I have worn red Chuck Taylor high-tops since I was old enough to walk. They are my shoe. So it pisses me off that now that they're more expensive than ever, they're also more poorly made than ever. I love 'em, but seriously, they fall apart after less than a year's use. They used to last longer. A whole hell of a lot longer. But now that Chuck Taylors have become an emo-kid fashion statement, Converse knows they have a captive market, so they can cut corners on the cost of making the shoes but still gouge the customers on the price without losing their clientele, as any normal product would. I mean, seriously, these things probably cost less than twenty dollars to make. Maybe less than fifteen. And they charge you almost forty. WTF?

Yes, the irony of my writing such a passionate review about a pair of shoes has struck me. More than once. Now go die.

product_title: Dearfoams Women's Microfiber Velour Memory Foam Slipper
review_body:
Having just had achilles tendon surgery I was looking for a comfortable slipper that didn't feel like it was \\"flat\\" when I wore it. The memory foam in these is very nice and gives you a cushioned feeling.

My only problem with these slippers is about 1 1/2 months after buying them, the plastic sole on one of them split open right across the side. So now all the inner parts are falling out of one of my slippers.

I am going to try another pair of these because I found them the most comfortable of all the slippers I've tried, and hope that my experience with the cracking plastic sole was only an isolated problem.

review_body: Like others say they are very comfortable and look great.  The shoes are actually slightly flatter than they appear in pictures.

review_body: Great shoes but had to reorder smaller size to try as at least 1/2 to 1 size too big.  Started with an 8, ended up with 7.5, probably could have gone 7.  Other than that, love earth shoes and love the color.  This red goes with anything for me.

product_title: Naughty Monkey Women's Colorful Talk Pump
review_body:
The only issue i've had with naughty monkey shoes is that when i read reviews on line, i come across 2 groups of people: those who think the shoes fits perfectly and those who think it's half a size larger. I wasn't sure which group i fall into despite reading reviews on two different websites so i ordered the scribble dibble in a 7.5m and i found it half a size larger. i ordered these colorful talk in 7M and they fit perfect. I guess i fall into the second group of people. I also ordered another pointy toe pump in a 7M and they fit fine as well so t me they are true to width but run half a size larger in length.
What i've realized is that people with wide shoe width need to order shoes half a size larger so i've found that those people with wide foot fit perfectly into the normal sizes of these. So if you have wide foot, order your size and they'll fit perfect, if you are of average shoe width or an M, then try them on to see if you should go up or down.

Otherwise,these shoes are absolutely stunning. Definately a traffic stopper, they are super cute on, fits well, comfortable for that 4inch heel and even i can walk in them. I have to go somewhere tonite and while i thought of wearing my anne kleins, i think these will be perfect.For the $23 bucks amazon has them, they are a steal. I thought my charles david pump would be awesome for the photo shoot coming up but now i think these will be my shoes. Get them before they're gone.

review_body:

Highly recommended!

Update (August 2014):
It's still going strong. Other than a bit of wear on the sole, the sandal looks nearly new.

product_title: Black Frame & Mirrored Lens Aviator 3-Pack w/ Drawstring Sunglass Pouch
review_headline: Great sunglasses, especially for the money.
review_body: These aviators are a great product for being only $7, and with shipping around $11. You DO get 3 per package, which is a great bargain. They are mirrored, just like the mirror in your bathroom, so you can't see the user's eyes at all and you see your reflection when looking into them. And they are WELL mirrored. You couldn't tell the difference between an actual mirror and these sunglasses.    Each pair of sunglasses comes with its own microfiber bag, and while the bag obviously isn't meant to last for an incredible amount of time, it protects my aviators from scratches.     Please though, take one precaution: these sunglasses are cheap for a reason. Each pair has a minor defect on the lense or body work, which is why they're being sold so cheap. One of my pair had a tiny dot of a scratch, one had a little bit of the coating on the inside missing, and another was bent in the framework. They still look great, and you can't see the defects unless you were really looking.    Overall, these are a GREAT 3 pairs of sunglasses, and I'd recommend them to anyone.

There is plenty of room even when my foot swells. review_body:

I considered really expensive glasses, but found these Windoms at a pretty good price. I would buy H2Optix again, but not without a test drive.

product_title: Brooks Men's Trance 7 Running Shoe
review_body:
I bought these for long (6-15 miles) runs on asphalt or concrete, and for that they work wonderfully...very sturdy and comfortable. The reason I don't use them for softer surfaces like dirt or grass, or for shorter runs, and especially not for speedwork, is their weight---the same massive amount of cushioning needed for long runs on hard surfaces is totally unnecessary and counterproductive for other applications. A lighter, thinner-soled and more flexible shoe is much better in those situations.

Generally am very happy with all of my Brooks shoes and apparel. Brooks makes ONLY running gear, so you know they're going to be good since it's their sole bread and butter specialty. One of the things about Brooks I really like is the fit, I have medium arches and a narrow heel, and their shoes have always fit me like a glove, especially the ever-popular Adrenalines. The Trance is similar to the Adrens, though the heel is a little bit tight...I use a little athletic tape over my Achilles tendon to avoid any abrasions, but since this only happens on my left foot, it might have more to do with my own biomechanics than the shoe itself.

The reason I give this shoe 4 instead of 5 stars is because I think that in hindsight, I probably should've stayed with the slightly lighter and simpler Adrenaline. I'm have a medium-build at 5'9\\" and 165lbs, and am a very efficient midfoot striker; I think that this shoe would be best for a heavier and less efficient runner, especially a heel striker. That said, the Trance is especially good for mid- or fore-foot strikers because it seems to have a lower heel than other Brooks models...unless I'm deceived by outward appearance.

Oh well, you gotta try everything once. The Trance 7 is certainly a HUGE improvement over the last Trance model I tried, the NSX from several years ago.

UPDATE 2/23/09: just ran a marathon with these shoes last week. They held up perfectly, I got zero blisters and my knees felt fine afterwards. I must have at least 200 miles on them by now, they're still going strong...rds. I must have at least 200 miles on them by now, they're still going strong...

product_title: FitFlop Women's Walkstar Classic Thong Sandal
review_headline: Kudos to the ad campaign, but sadly these do not fit all feet!
review_body: The advertising department for these shoes should be given kudos - these FitFlops sound miraculous! But reality says otherwise...these shoes have numerous design flaws. First, if you have slightly higher than normal arches, these flops will not fit your foot correctly. The reason for this is that the T-strap across the arch is made of a non-stretchy, almost grosgrain ribbon-type of heavy, woven material, and does NOT stretch to conform to higher-arched feet. Because of this, my feet kept shifting backwards in the shoe and I had trouble keeping the shoe on my foot, much less able to walk normally in them. Plus, if your feet even slightly over- or under-pronate, your feet will shift to the inside (or outside) of the shoe and you will find yourself walking on the edge of the shoe - I was constantly trying to shift my foot back to center. The strap does nothing to hold the foot in correctly - the shoe needs more support to hold to and conform with the foot. Further, the leather strap between the toes is either shoddily made or poorly designed - the edge of the leather is rough and rubbed blisters on my second toes within the first five minutes. While the shoes are very cushiony and I can see where they would help in burning calories, I spent the entire 1-mile walk stopping to shift my foot back into the shoe in its correct position, tugging on the T-strap to the correct position on the top of my arch, or putting bandaids on my new blisters. It's my opinion that exercise shoes and shoes touted as \\"comfortable\\" should not require a breaking-in period of any sort. I recommend making sure the company you buy from has a good return policy.

product_title: Clarks Women's Navan Sandal
review_headline: Good fit on my hard-to-fit foot
review_body: My toes don't taper the way most people's toes taper--mine are more square, and I also have a high instep and a wide-ish foot.  This makes it difficult to find a shoe that fits well.  These fit well.  My toes aren't too squished, and my pinky toes don't squeeze through the strap.  The back strap does not rub on my heel either.  The heel is high and fairly easy to walk in--certainly not a heel-toe stride--but not wobbly either.  I'm no feather weight; and I was worried these would not support me well, but these shoes do a fine job of supporting my foot.  They are not super cushy, but they do not kill my feet either.  I tolerate these very well.  I have received many compliments on the shoe.  These are much prettier on the foot than they appear in photographs.  I got the beige.  They are very light in color--almost a blonde--very springy/summery yet give good coverage. I wear them to the office with pants and they dress up the outfit but are still not too stuffy. I've worn them 2 to 3 times a week for almost a month, and I haven't ruined the heel yet (from using the gas pedal in the car). I really like these shoes!

review_body: I've tried many brands of walking shoes over the years, with varying degrees of comfort and support.  I wear walking shoes at least 6 days a week - so I need a pair that can last.  Since I purchased a pair of Rockport last year, which I really liked, I figured that I would do the same again.  After having worn the Astride for a good month, I was not disappointed.  I consider Rockport to be one of the best companies when it comes to making quality shoes for a reasonable price.  I would definately purchase this item again through Amazon!

product_title: Crocs™ Unisex Athens Sandal
review_headline: I have also had very poor experience with SHOEMALL
review_body: I have to agree with the previous post. Order from anyone but ShoeMall. I placed my order with them in May and after a LONG wait recieved the wrong size. I then had to wait for them to mail a shipping label to return the shoes and it was another long wait and I recieved the wrong size AGAIN. Same thing had to wait for another shipping label, mailed the shoes back and TODAY 8/8/06 (almost 3 months from the date the order originated) I got an email that they have credited my account and my order has been cancelled. Customer service is PATHETIC. They really do not care if you are satisfied or not.

product_title: Robeez Soft Soles Princess Slip On (Infant/Toddler/Little Kid)
review_headline: Your Little Princess Will Love These
review_body:
I bought these slip-ons for my daughter when the weather started getting a bit cooler and socks alone were not keeping her feet warm enough. She loves her special shoes--especially the faces! Pediatricians recommend that babies not wear hard-soled shoes until they are walking, so these \\"soft\\" shoes are perfect. So far, my Little Lady only has this one pair, but with all of the neat styles (and sizes) available, I can practically guarantee that she'll have another pair or two.

My only gripe with these shoes (hence the 4-star rating) is that the soles seem to get scuffed up relatively quickly. My daughter is not walking yet, but the bottom of the Robeez look like she has been!

product_title: Nike Women's Ace '83
review_body: THESE SHOES ARE AWESOME! i bought the red/grey ones about a year ago, and although they are sort of falling apart right now, they have lasted a lot longer than other nike shoes i have owned in the past. These shoes are awesome for just wearing around, it seems stupid to spend lots of money on fancy running shoes to just wear them to school and about, etc. These shoes are on the cheaper side of nike shoes and they are AWESOME! buy them!

product_title: Stride Rite Little Kid/Big Kid Ashley Lace-Up
review_body: We were very happy with this purchase.  The shoe is perfectly represented in the pictures, quality was just as we expected from Stride Rite and shipping was quick.  Thanks for another great experience.

product_title: Steve Madden Men's Saville
review_body: If you go out at night wearing these and still can't impress the ladies, take a long hard look in the mirror - it aint the shoes! Beautiful.  Buy a pair - you won't regret it.

product_title: Native Eyewear RIPP Sunglass : Polarized Sunglasses
review_body:
These are the most comfortable glasses i have ever worn. I usually forget i have them on and the polarized lens make the glare disappear. I use these for mountain biking and windsurfing with the best feature being...they never fall off.

product_title: Natural Sport Women's Dyan Athletic Shoe Featuring Dr. Scholl's Gel Insoles
review_body: These are the most comfortable shoe on the market!  Buy them!  Your feet will not regret your purchase!

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Safari Sandal
review_body:

They feel comfortable enough to walk for a couple of hours (they have light cushioning, they are somehow stable), but becareful during those hot days because you can get blisters on your feet since they are not leather.

Size, I'm 7.5 in sandals and 8 in boots. In these shoes I have to get an 8 so they fit my wide feet, and they are just fine. They make me look really tall, and yet the are more comfortable than other high heel shoes. I like that. It is true that after a while of walking with them your feet can hurt on the front. (after one or two hours)

product_title: Embassy Italian Stone Design Genuine Leather Shoulder Purse
review_body: This is without a doubt the best $15 purse I've ever had.  This compares favorably with the hot leather bags shown this fall in the $150 and up range.  Seriously. It's lined, it's solid, it garners compliments like crazy.

product_title: BCBGirls Women's Saloma Boot
review_body:
Love these boots, if you are looking for a comfortable stileto heeled boot, THIS IS IT!
You should order 1/2 size larger than your usual size due to the pointed toe.
They are comfortable, even after hours of wear.
LOVE THEM!

product_title: adidas Women's Supernova Cushion 2006 Running Shoe
review_headline: Adidas Women's Supernova Cushions Running Shoe
review_body: This model of the Cushion is NOTHING like the old model!!!  It is not as wide, not as much cushion in the heel......very disappointing.

product_title: Mizuno - Men's Wave Creation 7 - Closeout
review_body: I am a big, heavy runner and a bodybilder (215 pounds) with high arches and a neutral stride, running 20-35 miles per week. My needs are for a neutral shoe with a lot of cushioning. I have tried a lot of different shoes (Asics Gel Nimbus 7, Nike Air Max Tailwind, Adidas Adistar Cushion, Brooke Epiphany, etc. etc.) and these are simply the best shoes I have ever owned. Light weighted, soft riding very confortable and keeps your feet dry from sweating. These shoes have simply been perfectly comfortable from the first day on; I`m impressed. Highlly recommended !!!

product_title: Dr. Martens Original 14 Eye Notched Welt Boot
review_body:
Dr.Martens are classic and NEVER go out of style.
This particular boot is soft nappa leather on the sides for comfort but yet tough and sturdy as any hard combat boot.
You can wear these anywhere.

product_title: Clarks Originals Men's Wallabee Boot
review_body: I have worn WALLABEES for years and I have found that no other shoe keeps my feet as dry as they do. I find find them very comfortable and my wife loves them becuse they don't mark up the floor.

product_title: Saucony Men's ProGrid Triumph 4
review_body: I recently purchased these Triumph's as the last pair of Saucony's (Trigon 4) I had were worn out.  I was a little aprehensive in smacking down $120 as I log about 2-3 hundred miles on a pair before I replace them.  However, I have logged about 50 miles with these on concrete with only minor indication of wear.  Unlike the Triagon 4, after my first run of 10K the soles were showing wear.  The Triumph's do appear to have more cushion as well as more spring.  Additionally, the upper-portion of the shoe is virtually a mesh which could suck if you are running in the northern states with snow and cold (fortunately Detroit has not had a winter yet!).  I will be purchasing another pair (ASAP) to rotate these shoes in my training. The Triumph's have been by far the best shoes that I have owned in sometime.

product_title: Girls' Merrell Sprint Jump - Berry Red
review_body: my daughter got the green dandelion and she loved it..went with almost everything and her friend thought they were the cooolest shoes.  She has also had other Merrells' and always gets compliments, very fun shoes

product_title: Military Style Boots Mens Jungle Tested All Sizes US
review_body: We purchased these boots for my husband who works in the construction field(mainly insulation instalation) which requires him to climb in high places, walk on trusses, and also be under floors sometimes in standing water and other harsh weather conditions. In my opinion these boots DO NOT have \\"heavy duty\\" rubber soles at all but cheap soles that start to rub and crumble almost immediately under working conditions. There is also no arch or foot support inside the boot itself. There is a piece of leather saying \\"Made in China\\" and that's it. The tag even reccomends getting some sort of insole. The worst part is that on the tag of the boot it states that you should get the next size up than what your normal boot size is. The seller did not state this fact. All in all, if you are purchasing these boots for long term wear or work related activities I DO NOT reccomend them. If they are for a teenager making a fashion statement or for a Halloween costume they're perfect.

product_title: Women's Xhilaration® Crystal Pumps - Natural
review_body: This style carries two colors....I've had the black ones for months....and when I saw the tan ones....I just had to get them.  I just wished they carried in all Target stores.  I had to drive to three stores in order to find them.  I can wear them for 8 hours straight and my feet are perfectly fine....SO COMFY!!!  They can go with anything.....from casual to dressy.  I have had many compliments on these...And to think, I saw the name brand ones, they look EXACTLY the same, but more costly. product_title: Anne Klein New York Women's Coconut Hooded Thong
review_body: I have to say that I am very impressed with these shoes, not to mention the whole experience. It was simple and easy and did I mention the shoes are very cute?

product_title: Women's Softspots Ivy (9 M U.S. in Dark Brown Zing Calf)
review_body: I'm very happy w/ these shoes.  I'm a flight attendant, on my feet most of the day on the plane & through airports, and needed a comfortable shoe w/ good support.  These shoes are perfect for the long days and VERY fashionable.  I've gotten many compliments from passengers & crews alike.

product_title: Teva Men's Mush
review_body:
These are the most comfortable flip flops that I've worn. I love them so much, that these are the only flip flops that I will buy anymore. My only complaint is that the spongy footbed holds onto dirt and perspiration, causing a slight odor problem. This is only a minor problem that can be remedied by cleaning the footbed periodically. Another way I've found to reduce the problem is to have several pairs and alternate between pairs each day.

Overall, an excellent product!

product_title: MBT Shoes - Sport White - Womens - FREE SHIPPING
review_body: I love thess shoes and did 6 months of research until buying some.  Now I can't take them off and don't really want to wear anything else!!  They instantly pull your tunmmy in making you use your core muscles, upper legs and behind to stride not your smaller muscles. After just 5 hrs with them on I noticed a big diffrence!  I will be buying more I think for the price they are worth it, I'd probably spend less more going to Dr visits from migrains, and back aches. I'd give then 10 stars if I could!

product_title: Report Women's Shout-Out Lace-Up Buckle Boot
review_body: These are the hottest boots i've seen yet. They are sexy as hell and my boyfriend loves them! (he actually bought them for me) I'm a bit paranoid about the heel ,but that just me! And they do run a bit on the small side as stated by the previous person i ordered them a 1/2 bigger just to make sure my thick winter socks fit but the shoes fit perfect with my regular socks! Overall, these shoes are amazing. Great buy on amazon too!

product_title: Merrell 'Orbit Moc' Athletic Slip-On (Men) 11 M Black
review_body:
I am a stickler for comfort in shoes, and have been known to drive around town to different brand stores looking for particular Clark's or Vasque shoes. In particular, I like to find a shoe that's wide across the balls of the feet, with plenty of room for all the toes -- and good arch support.
I can still remember when I put on my first Merrell Moc, the \\"classic\\" original Moc. I said to my wife \\"Well, this is the most comfortable shoe I've ever worn! I'm going to buy this right here and now!\\" Her jaw dropped.
The original pair has lasted very well for 18 months of consistent use, approximately one-third time mix with other shoes. Still comfortable, getting a little worn on the inside foot bed.
I went to buy another pair on the new Amazon apparel store, and I see that the Moc popularity has bred a wide variety of Merrell Moc offerings. I just bought these \\"winter mocs\\" and am very pleased with them.
Pros: Still comfortable, sturdier outsole. Feels a little taller but more stable. Good tread. Warm. Great construction! Can't beat this shoe.
Cons: I'm still getting used to the neoprene-ish collar around the ankle, takes a little more to slip into. The waterproofing also means that it's a little clammier for the feet. The tread collects mud too well when you want to then walk inside.

product_title: Clarks Women's Sunbeat Adjustable Sandal
review_body:
I had one of these sandals and they lasted me a long time. They are awfully comfortable sturdy and flexible. The adjustable straps lets you adjust the sandals if you are wearing socks and need extra room to wiggle your toes.

However, if you are flat footed this sandal does not provide much of an arch support. This was one of the first pairs of sandals I bought before I was diagnosed with a really bad case of flat foot / feet and had to swtich my footwear.

I cannot believe the price at which these sandals are available. You cannot beat the price!

product_title: DR SCHOLL SLIDE
review_body:
My daughter has what you would call a "Princess" foot. She is super fussy about her shoes. Has to fit just so and no fabric rub or discomfort when she walks. She also has a hard to fit foot. Narrow heel and wider toebox. Thus shoe shopping for her can be a chore!
Recently she picked up a cute little strappy dress for summer and I mentally prepared myself for the hours she would spend finding a summery sandal to go with it.
When we went to the shoe store they had a large display of Dr. Scholl's in an assortment of colors.
I remembered Dr. Scholl's from my teens. They used to sell them in the drugstore.
The look is timeless and she instantly fell in love with them. Because the strap across the toes is adjustable they fit her toebox comfortably. And because they are backless, they are light and breezy for summer and there is nothing in the back to cause foot discomfort.
The hard part was selecting the color. The sandals come in a variety of fun colors including pink, black, tan and more. We settled on the blue. Great with jeans and a nice shade to compliment her summer dress.
Because the sandals feature a wood finished bottom and contoured footbed for arch support they are sturdy and comfortable.
Price is right too when you consider they will last for years and remain classic in styling.
Picking Dr. Scholl's is easy. Picking the color is the challenge!

product_title: adidas Big Kids' Snare Alternate Closure Running Shoe
review_body: My daughter enjoys being able to slip on and off these shoes.  They fit well even though she has a narrow foot.  I gave these shoes 4 stars because the top and sides you see in white are made of a soft mesh material- I would prefer them made of something more durable, like leather.  But so far so good, no rips or tears yet.  Overall a good shoe.

product_title: Kenneth Cole Unlisted Men's Grand Slam Street Casual Shoe
review_body: I love these shoes. They light and comfortable. I wear a size 12 and they are just a tad bit long but nothing that makes my feet feel uncomfortable. This is my second pair that I just bought just cause I like them so much.

product_title: Naturalizer Women's Dahlia Pump
review_headline: disappointment with naturalizer women's dahlia pump brown croco leather
review_body: The shoes are very uncomfortable since it is man made leather and is so hard, not flexible at all.  The heels are low so it's not elegant.  I don't think I can walk much with these shoes.  It is just a big disappointment after all.  This is a second pair of Naturalizer shoes I've bought online so far.  Both of them are not comfortable since they  were not genuine soft leather.  I don't think I'll buy naturalizer shoes any more since the quality is quite compromised.  These were made in China.

product_title: Chinese Laundry Women's Maddy Sandal
review_headline: Fell apart even before it got out of the box
review_body: I read the review and thought what a great pair of sexy shoes. I bought this for my sister as a birthday present and shipped it to her in Canada.  When she unwrapped the tissue paper that was wrapped around the straps, the beads fell off of one sandal.  Not impressed at all.  She'll be shipping it back and the seller has offered to pay the cost of return (I'll let you know how that goes). For a pair of shoes that fall apart even before you slip them on... hmmmm.... makes you wonder what will happen once you've worn them a couple of times. I must say, they are very nice looking though, even if they are not that comfortable (so I'm told). That's the price you pay to look sexy.

product_title: Nike Women's Air Max So Good
review_body: I think this is really a great product. You never waste your money.

product_title: Phoebe-Marabou Pump 2 1/2 inch
review_headline: Sweet and Dreamy and a little Steamy
review_body:
These pink slippers are especially cute with their pink fluffy personality and their sexy shoe design. More stable than other slippers of this nature. The color is very baby pink and I must have picked the wrong color since I needed the fuchsia - OK it only looks like fuchsia, that must be red. However, the color is quite lovely and I could use a few more pairs. These slippers go very well with the Oscar de la Renta lingerie items with the rose patterns.

Can one really own too many of these slippers? Watching TV or a movie is much more fun while wearing these and dressing up in a lovely silky outfit. My husband is especially amused when I cook while wearing these marabou slippers. Of course, now I need more outfits to wear with the slippers.

The pink color is pure cute, but is also sexy. I still need red, hot pink...wait, are there any more colors? They need to make more colors.

~The Rebecca Review

product_title: Nike Men's Air Burst Nylon

product_title: adidas Women's a3 Gigaride Cushion Running Shoe

product_title: Saucony - Women's 3D Grid Triumph 3 - Closeout - Colors White/Sky Blue/Navy Silver/Orange
review_headline: looking for a comfortable shoe from heel to toe?
review_body: After much research for a comfortable fitting shoe and testing these on the streets of New York, I have never been more satisfied.

product_title: Men's Original All Weather Mocs
review_body:
This was the first pair of shoes I ever bought by mail-order. But it was on sale last summer and I needed a hard-soled slip-on to wear outside when the ground was wet from rain. It fit like it was custom-made. I now wear them on weekends instead of the other shoes I used to wear.

I put Land's End service on a par with Amazon.com. I'm glad the two have joined up.

product_title: Great American Leather Smooth Tote
review_body: I bought one of each color.  This bag has a natural texture that goes well with sandals.  Bealls Florida delivers very fast.

product_title: Eastbay Sea Polarized Sunglasses
review_body:
I am a guy, and I think that the previous reviewer would agree that these sunglasses look great on me :)

Seriously, they are lightweight but they fit securely w/o being tight (on me at least). The polarization is superb, and the folding action is strong and sure.

product_title: L.B. Evans Men's Houston Scuff Slipper
review_body: Purchased these for my husband, who is not ordinarily a slipper person, but he likes them a lot, and they were a good deal through amazon.

product_title: Betula Licensed by Birkenstock Suede Clog

product_title: Clarks Women's Valli Clog

review_body: Very comfortable and very stylish. A great shoe to have and shows great quality that we all want in a shoe.

product_title: Nike Women's Air E.L. Mid
review_body: I found out why the price was so cheap.  I bought two pairs, one for myself and one for my niece. However, I have a very high arch and these White Mtn. clogs are too tight and hurt my foot.  Just be aware if  you have a wide foot or high arch to buy a size up.

product_title: Nine West Women's Adalia Flat Sandal
review_body: Great sandals at a great price. Very Stylish. Super comfortable. Have received lots of compliments on them.

product_title: Desperado Clog
review_body: I love the style and design of this shoe. I might also add that the sizing seems to be fairly accurate. The slats (weaving) make the shoe rather uncomfortable to wear without socks which was my intent. The discomfort is complicated by shifting toes getting caught on the slats. product_title: adidas Men's Predator Mania TRX FG

product_title: Exchange by Charles David Women's Gilda Platform Slide
review_body: I also returned these shoes. I thought they looked great in the pictures, but when I tried them on, they hurt like crazy!  The stiff, abrasive straps dug in and I was barely able to walk in them.  And so back to Amazon they went!

product_title: The Matrix - Neo Inspired Sunglasses in Black/Black (Stainless Steel)
review_body: The look and the fit of this item is good but the glass is bad. When I look at the ground with the glass on, the ground looks uneven and closer to me. I wouldn't recomment this even though it is cheap.

product_title: Chuck Taylor All Star Hi Top Navy
review_body: Well, this shoe really is not the most stable and most supporting shoe in the world. I've worn mine for about half a year every single day and now they have holes and the rubber stripe on the sole is coming off. But I'm still wearing them.  I recommend this shoe to every one who thinks of himself he is a person that likes rock, especially punk. The name converse already tells us that this shoe is not out there to please every one. Of course it was initially invented for playing basket ball, but now you'd rather find it on festivals and rock concerts just because it became a symbol for \\"I couldn't care less\\" It's not about looking good or having a good shoe - it's about identifying yourself with an attitude. So just accept the change everything undergoes with age and see the decay of this shoe as a symbol for it.

product_title: Birki's Super Birki Unisex Clog
review_headline: Graceless and Immense - Comfy and Cool
review_body:
My garden clogs make my feet look huge, and even with socks I had to order a smaller size. Generally I can count on being an easy 7, but had to buy a 6, and still have quite a bit of room. I use these in the yard, at the pool, riding my bike, shopping and have even been known to accidentally wear them to work. They are more comfy than sneakers, and have wonderful arch supports built in - important for me and a heel spur I have been dealing with for a number of years now. Teenagers seem to think they are cool too, and the navy upper really might pass as leather if you don't look too close. Great with jeans.
Happy feet when I'm in my clogs!

product_title: Skechers USA Men's Seige Lace Looped Oxford
review_headline: Color is darker than Amazon's photos
review_body: The color of the pair I received is slightly different from the photo. I was hoping for a light cream/tan color, but instead it's light brown. If you google-image search these shoes, you'll see that most of the pics out there are more representative of the actual product than Amazon's. I saw those pics beforehand so I wasn't surprised when I got my shoes, but still a little disappointed. Other than that... the fit is good, the size is standard (unlike some manufacturers), the sole is thin but surprisingly comfortable. I don't know if this shoe will actually last a year before falling apart, but whatever. Worth my $20 bucks.    UPDATE: I've been walking in them every day for a year and a half, and they're in great condition. Still surprisingly comfortable, too. I've been going on long walks recently (1-hour, give or take) without any discomfort.     UPDATE March 1st, 2010: It's been over 3 years and these shoes are still going strong.

product_title: Dr. Martens Men's Moc Toe Lace Up
review_body: These shoes are great for casual use. You will not impress anyone with their style, but they are comfortable, conforming to the natural shape of your feet and providing comforting and cushioning support. The  leather is also relatively maintenance free. Good buy at a reasonable price. I am certain that they will outlive most shoes as is typical with Doc Martens.

product_title: Teva - Women's - Gamma Pro
review_body:
I've never felt anything like these. This is my first pair of Teva's & I'm already a fan. I wear them walking my dog through trails & I don't even slide on steep downhills. And of course he loves going through the creeks. It's so great not to have to worry about getting my \\"pretty\\" shoes dirty as we run. No more sloshy shoes.
There's even a bubble(?) in the heel -very springy. It's just such an unusual & all-round great trail/water running shoe. Only downside is that they feel a litle bit on the narrow side; I almost wish they made wide sizes (& most reg. sizes fit me.) But it's not too snug & I think it actually makes the footing more secure -no sliding. :)

product_title: Matrix Morpheus Sunglasses
review_body: I'll start off by saying that I'm the type of person that is ALWAYS wearing sunglasses.  I mean always, even at night.  I just do.  With that said, I'm also the type of person that has BAD tanlines on the sides of my head from wearing suglasses at all times.  I thought buying these glasses would take care of the problem, at least for the most part.  Anyway, who wouldn't want glasses like Morpheus?  Obviously not the point here.  The point is however that even though these glasses are pretty cool looking, they aren't quite what you'd expect.  The lenses are polycorbonate and work real well in the sunlight, but, they don't appear to be made too well.  This is one case where you are mainly paying for the name, not the product.  I don't mean to comnpletely talk badly here, I am pleased, just not completely.  My main problem here is that these glasses are made in such a way that people such as myself with a wide head should not be wearing glasses such as these.  They look as if they were made for either children or people with really skinny heads.  Really skinny.  After putting them on you get the sensation that your head was pinched in the middle and all your features were pulled into the middle.  Kind of funny really.  So, the breakdown is that this product is cool, definitely cool, but, probably not worth 30.00...  what else can be said?  Just keep in mind, if you have a large head or a wide head, you will look kind of funny.  These glasses do look the same as the ones in the Matrix, but, apparently big headed Fishburn had a style that was made for his large head.  Enjoy.

product_title: CliC Adjustable Front Connect Reader
review_headline: help for hanging onto those glasses!
review_body:
I use reading glasses for my work on the computer and for any kind of close-up reading. I'm constantly putting on or taking off my glasses to switch from close-up to distance. As a result, I've damaged or lost several pairs of glasses over the years because they fell out of my shirt or off the top of my head where I'd pushed them to get them out of the way. I also sweat fairly easily (and live in a climate that's hot much of the year) and glasses tend to slip down my nose and fall off. I've tried straps and other ways of hanging the glasses around my neck, but haven't been happy with them.

Now I've got Clic's \\"front connect\\" reading glasses. These solve all the above problems for me, and they're comfortable to wear all day. I can adjust the band around the back just enough to keep them from sliding down my nose without being uncomfortably close. When I want to switch from close-up to distance vision, I just pull the lenses apart, slip them down to hang around my neck and the magnets find each other and snap back together. No more lost glasses! It's fun watching people's expressions when I break the glasses to slip them down to my neck, or when I put them back on again. The magnets hold surprisingly well. The glasses have never broken apart during normal wearing unless I want them to.

One inconvenience I couldn't have appreciated before trying them out is that it's more awkward to slip these on and off with just one hand. I can usually slip any regular glasses on and off with one hand. With the Clic glasses it's just a little more awkward to take them off with one hand, and I'm getting pretty good at that. But it's really not easy to put them on without using both hands, because you have to line up the lenses and push them together so the magnets engage.

One other difference from regular glasses is that you can't fold them into any kind of a normal eyeglass case for storage or travel. You either wear them, or you set them ona table, or you hang them on a hook. I'll certainly take them traveling, but my spare pair will have to be the old style that fits in a compact travel case.

All the same, I'm so glad to find these that I bought 4 pairs, so I'd have a spare in the bedroom, garage workshop, and my office. I wish Clic would price their sunglasses a lot more reasonably, I'd like to get those too.
